name: Find the Ferns
flavor: Unique Ferns are tasty and all, but when people keep eating them, there are no specimens to research! That's why I need you to go out and gather some before they're all gone. Look for them growing among flowers.
flavor_zh: Unique Ferns are tasty and all, but when people keep eating them, there are no specimens to research! That's why I need you to go out and gather some before they're all gone. Look for them growing among flowers.

name: Due for Dragon Amber
flavor: Dragon Amber is incredibly useful for research, but it's also a pain in the neck to get. Well, for these old bones it is. Grab a few pickaxes and get to mining me some from the Jurassic Frontier!
flavor_zh: Dragon Amber is incredibly useful for research, but it's also a pain in the neck to get. Well, for these old bones it is. Grab a few pickaxes and get to mining me some from the Jurassic Frontier!

name: Medicinal Moths
flavor: A friend of mine told me that there's a medicine that uses Immortal Moths! I'd love to research it, but...sadly I'm a real entomophobe. Could you catch some for me, please?
flavor_zh: A friend of mine told me that there's a medicine that uses Immortal Moths! I'd love to research it, but...sadly I'm a real entomophobe. Could you catch some for me, please?

name: Horns o' Plenty
flavor: Eastern medicine believes Kelbi Horns can help heal injuries, so I'd like to keep a stockpile in my house. That means you get to go carve three of them for me! Don't dawdle now!
flavor_zh: Eastern medicine believes Kelbi Horns can help heal injuries, so I'd like to keep a stockpile in my house. That means you get to go carve three of them for me! Don't dawdle now!

name: A Fungal Hunt
flavor: I've taken an interest in Abyssal Mushrooms. You can only find them deep inside the Jurassic Frontier and they have a very distinct scent. I can't go, but if you could, that'd be great.
flavor_zh: I've taken an interest in Abyssal Mushrooms. You can only find them deep inside the Jurassic Frontier and they have a very distinct scent. I can't go, but if you could, that'd be great.

name: Wipe Out!
flavor: You ever seen a Maccao? You know: big tail, green, bad attitude and totally rude? Seems their alpha has skedaddled off somewhere, so now's a great time to wipe out them pesky pests!
flavor_zh: You ever seen a Maccao? You know: big tail, green, bad attitude and totally rude? Seems their alpha has skedaddled off somewhere, so now's a great time to wipe out them pesky pests!

name: Another Pack Attack
flavor: In the Frontier there are Felynes in trouble. Gather your things and depart on the double! Once you have saved them from certain defeat, come to see me for a sweet little treat!
name_zh: 猫妹妹的讨伐狗龙委托
flavor_zh: In the Frontier there are Felynes in trouble. Gather your things and depart on the double! Once you have saved them from certain defeat, come to see me for a sweet little treat!

name: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: Harvest Tour: Dunes
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gatherin' is what sets a livin' hunter apart from a dead one. Without it, ya can't survive! So take all ya want! Just turn in the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when yer set!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gatherin' is what sets a livin' hunter apart from a dead one. Without it, ya can't survive! So take all ya want! Just turn in the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when yer set!

name: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Time to do some daytime gathering up on the Arctic Ridge! Just be sure to leave some for the tourists, eh? Once you're all set, just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket that's inside the Supply Box!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Time to do some daytime gathering up on the Arctic Ridge! Just be sure to leave some for the tourists, eh? Once you're all set, just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket that's inside the Supply Box!

name: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: You are keen to gather materials from the Peaks. The Guild will cover your flight expenses, so gather all you wish. Once finished, you will deliver the Paw Pass Ticket inside the Supply Box.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: You are keen to gather materials from the Peaks. The Guild will cover your flight expenses, so gather all you wish. Once finished, you will deliver the Paw Pass Ticket inside the Supply Box.

name: Vaulting Outlaw
flavor: We've had a request come in from the Wycademy asking you to hunt a Great Maccao. The beast has been terrorizing their research team. Take care of it and you'll be able to take on more difficult Quests.
flavor_zh: We've had a request come in from the Wycademy asking you to hunt a Great Maccao. The beast has been terrorizing their research team. Take care of it and you'll be able to take on more difficult Quests.

name: Rambunctious Rhenoplos
flavor: The survey team's been having a lot of trouble -- Rhenoplos keep crashing into everything! All the repairs are takin' a huge chunk out of our budget. Those things have got to go! Can you help us out?
flavor_zh: The survey team's been having a lot of trouble -- Rhenoplos keep crashing into everything! All the repairs are takin' a huge chunk out of our budget. Those things have got to go! Can you help us out?

name: On the Rebound
flavor: Recently, there have been a lot of Maccao attacks in the Jurassic Frontier. It's becoming a real problem to anyone who ventures out there. Could you put a stop to those hopping hooligans?
flavor_zh: Recently, there have been a lot of Maccao attacks in the Jurassic Frontier. It's becoming a real problem to anyone who ventures out there. Could you put a stop to those hopping hooligans?

name: A Berry Good Idea
flavor: My wife has her heart set on eating some Ancient Berries despite them being really hard to get. I heard Larinoths drop them if you "interrupt" them while they eat. Up for some "interrupting?"
name_zh: 利用首鸣龙的果物采集法
flavor_zh: My wife has her heart set on eating some Ancient Berries despite them being really hard to get. I heard Larinoths drop them if you "interrupt" them while they eat. Up for some "interrupting?"

name: A Fern is Forever
flavor: A Wycademy kiddo found *hiccup* a boutique urn... I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern! It's bitter, yet sweet, which would go great with my nightly tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and nab me some of them, won't ya?
name_zh: 在紫萁菜肴中感受古风
flavor_zh: A Wycademy kiddo found *hiccup* a boutique urn... I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern! It's bitter, yet sweet, which would go great with my nightly tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and nab me some of them, won't ya?

name: Jurassic Frontier Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Jurassic Frontier? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
name_zh: 缴纳古代森林的精算道具
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Jurassic Frontier? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Gendrome Roadblock
flavor: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!
flavor_zh: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!

name: The Land Sharq
flavor: Argh, my wagon just got marooned in the Dunes! Now, I haven't seen anything fishy out here -- yet -- but I just know there's something waiting to get at my stuff! Find it and let 'em have it!
flavor_zh: Argh, my wagon just got marooned in the Dunes! Now, I haven't seen anything fishy out here -- yet -- but I just know there's something waiting to get at my stuff! Find it and let 'em have it!

name: Slay the Genprey!
flavor: Th-thanks to the Genprey in the Dunes *ouch* and their Paralyzing attacks, I can't move a *ouch* muscle! My nose itches so bad. Avenge me -- take out ten of them!
flavor_zh: Th-thanks to the Genprey in the Dunes *ouch* and their Paralyzing attacks, I can't move a *ouch* muscle! My nose itches so bad. Avenge me -- take out ten of them!

name: Hermit Grab
flavor: When me sandskiff up and died on me, I buried all the edible cargo in the sand to preserve it, but some bloomin' Hermitaurs went and sniffed it out! Can someone hold them off while I work on repairs?
name_zh: 逐渐逼近的盾蟹包围圈
flavor_zh: When me sandskiff up and died on me, I buried all the edible cargo in the sand to preserve it, but some bloomin' Hermitaurs went and sniffed it out! Can someone hold them off while I work on repairs?

name: Birthday Berries
flavor: It's nearly my mama's birthday, and I wanna bake her a berry shortcake! It's her favorite. Can you please help me get the ingredients? Please?
flavor_zh: It's nearly my mama's birthday, and I wanna bake her a berry shortcake! It's her favorite. Can you please help me get the ingredients? Please?

name: Liver of Legend!
flavor: While doing some business out in the Dunes, I heard about a route where livers go for a really high price. I can't ignore the scent of zenny to be made. Can you sniff out five livers for me?
flavor_zh: While doing some business out in the Dunes, I heard about a route where livers go for a really high price. I can't ignore the scent of zenny to be made. Can you sniff out five livers for me?

name: Dunes Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Dunes? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
name_zh: 缴纳旧沙漠的精算道具
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Dunes? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
flavor: My lovely wife, bless her heart, knows I love mushrooms, so she went to the Verdant Hills to pick some. On the way, a Velocidrome attacked her! You've got to make it safe so she can go back! Help her, Hunter!
flavor_zh: My lovely wife, bless her heart, knows I love mushrooms, so she went to the Verdant Hills to pick some. On the way, a Velocidrome attacked her! You've got to make it safe so she can go back! Help her, Hunter!

name: Slay the Velociprey!
flavor: Lately there's been a lot of Velociprey creeping up closer and closer to the village. Lots of villagers are worried. Can you calm their fears by doin' in some of those pesky critters?
flavor_zh: Lately there's been a lot of Velociprey creeping up closer and closer to the village. Lots of villagers are worried. Can you calm their fears by doin' in some of those pesky critters?

name: Bullfango Tango
flavor: We might make a living out in the forest, but even we have a hard time when monsters charge at us, 'specially Bullfango. Make our lives easier and take out 10, won't you?
flavor_zh: We might make a living out in the forest, but even we have a hard time when monsters charge at us, 'specially Bullfango. Make our lives easier and take out 10, won't you?

name: Prime Premium Sashimi
flavor: The Village Chief loves his Premium Sashimi so much, he used to make hunters go fish for their "training." Are ya up for a little refresher course?
flavor_zh: The Village Chief loves his Premium Sashimi so much, he used to make hunters go fish for their "training." Are ya up for a little refresher course?

name: Verdant Hills Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Verdant Hills? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Verdant Hills? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: The Mountain Roughrider
flavor: Y'know, the more I think about it, the more I wanna move to the Arctic Ridge. But I gotta find a way to stay warm... I bet a coat made from Bulldrome pelts would be roasty-toasty! You game?
flavor_zh: Y'know, the more I think about it, the more I wanna move to the Arctic Ridge. But I gotta find a way to stay warm... I bet a coat made from Bulldrome pelts would be roasty-toasty! You game?

name: Slay the Giaprey!
flavor: You know what Giaprey are, yeah? Those buggers went after my Popo, and after I drove them off, more and more keep showin' up. Time to put 'em on the endangered list, if ya know what I mean.
flavor_zh: You know what Giaprey are, yeah? Those buggers went after my Popo, and after I drove them off, more and more keep showin' up. Time to put 'em on the endangered list, if ya know what I mean.

name: A Pack of Blangos
flavor: I'd like you to slay some Blangos running around in the Arctic Ridge. Some people have also spotted Bulldrome around there lately, so keep an eye out so they don't ambush you.
flavor_zh: I'd like you to slay some Blangos running around in the Arctic Ridge. Some people have also spotted Bulldrome around there lately, so keep an eye out so they don't ambush you.

name: Medicinal Mountain Herbs
flavor: My brother hurt himself. Now he's laid up at home. I heard these Mountain Herbs can get him back on his feet, but I ain't going anywhere near them monster-infested mountains. How 'bouts you going in my stead?
flavor_zh: My brother hurt himself. Now he's laid up at home. I heard these Mountain Herbs can get him back on his feet, but I ain't going anywhere near them monster-infested mountains. How 'bouts you going in my stead?

name: Arctic Ridge Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Arctic Ridge? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Arctic Ridge? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Arzuros the Azure Beast
flavor: The Arzuros is a creature we're long used to seeing near the village, but lately it's wandering closer and closer, which endangers the kids. I hate to impose, but I can't do much by myself.
flavor_zh: The Arzuros is a creature we're long used to seeing near the village, but lately it's wandering closer and closer, which endangers the kids. I hate to impose, but I can't do much by myself.

name: Bye Bye Jaggia
flavor: Jaggi are awful, am I right? Well, Jaggia are even worse! And now a gang of 'em are terrorizing the Misty Peaks! Please, put a stop to them before they come ruin our crops!
flavor_zh: Jaggi are awful, am I right? Well, Jaggia are even worse! And now a gang of 'em are terrorizing the Misty Peaks! Please, put a stop to them before they come ruin our crops!

name: Howling Harassment
flavor: I live on the edge of the village, and late every night, these blasted Jaggi come down and raise hell! Have they no respect for their elders!? Please, make my nights quiet again.
flavor_zh: I live on the edge of the village, and late every night, these blasted Jaggi come down and raise hell! Have they no respect for their elders!? Please, make my nights quiet again.

name: Fungal Fad
flavor: Oh my gosh! I'm just dying for some Mushroom Juice! All the girls are drinking it, so I gotta get my hands on some, like now! It'd be totally rad if you got me 10 Unique Mushrooms. Pleeeease!
flavor_zh: Oh my gosh! I'm just dying for some Mushroom Juice! All the girls are drinking it, so I gotta get my hands on some, like now! It'd be totally rad if you got me 10 Unique Mushrooms. Pleeeease!

name: Sunsnug Sprout Courier
flavor: The Felynes on Sunsnug Isle are hoping to get their paws on some Super Spouts. Deliver us some and you'll be rewarded with some tasty ingredients for cooking. Sounds like a great oppurrtunity, nya?
flavor_zh: The Felynes on Sunsnug Isle are hoping to get their paws on some Super Spouts. Deliver us some and you'll be rewarded with some tasty ingredients for cooking. Sounds like a great oppurrtunity, nya?

name: Misty Peaks Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Misty Peaks? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Misty Peaks? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: Tusked Tantrum
flavor: Thanks to the Tetsucabra running loose within the Jurassic Frontier, the Wycademy's research of the area has ground to a halt. If you could, we'd like you to rid us of it.
flavor_zh: Thanks to the Tetsucabra running loose within the Jurassic Frontier, the Wycademy's research of the area has ground to a halt. If you could, we'd like you to rid us of it.

name: Stomping Grounds
flavor: How can I study the flora out in the wilderness when the fauna keeps stomping all over it? Can you hunt the Yian Kut-Ku that is driving me cuckoo? In the name of science, I beg you!
flavor_zh: How can I study the flora out in the wilderness when the fauna keeps stomping all over it? Can you hunt the Yian Kut-Ku that is driving me cuckoo? In the name of science, I beg you!

name: Chasing Tail
flavor: Truly a wonder of nature the Great Maccao is. Even more remarkable are their tails. I wanted to take a closer look, but I got a bit too close. Now, two of them are hot on MY tail! Help!
flavor_zh: Truly a wonder of nature the Great Maccao is. Even more remarkable are their tails. I wanted to take a closer look, but I got a bit too close. Now, two of them are hot on MY tail! Help!

name: Jurassic Treasure: The Frog
flavor: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this 'ere Tailed Frog I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! Capture me a 'uge ol' Tetsucabra!
name_zh: 古代森林的宝藏！蛙之篇
flavor_zh: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this 'ere Tailed Frog I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! Capture me a 'uge ol' Tetsucabra!

name: Bit by the Fashion Bug
flavor: Did you know Bnahabra clothing is the new in-thing? Cha-ching, right? Except, I can't seem to get 'em to hold still long enough to sew 'em together! Rude! So, can you make 'em stop squirming, like, permanently?
flavor_zh: Did you know Bnahabra clothing is the new in-thing? Cha-ching, right? Except, I can't seem to get 'em to hold still long enough to sew 'em together! Rude! So, can you make 'em stop squirming, like, permanently?

name: Tumultuous Sprouts
flavor: I've run out of Abyssal Mushrooms for my research. Could you pick some for me? There's been talk about odd, blade-sharpening sounds coming from deep in the forest, but I'm sure you'll be fine!
flavor_zh: I've run out of Abyssal Mushrooms for my research. Could you pick some for me? There's been talk about odd, blade-sharpening sounds coming from deep in the forest, but I'm sure you'll be fine!

name: Tumultuous Sprouts
flavor: I've run out of Abyssal Mushrooms for my research. Could you pick some for me? There's been talk about odd, blade-sharpening sounds coming from deep in the forest, but I'm sure you'll be fine!
flavor_zh: I've run out of Abyssal Mushrooms for my research. Could you pick some for me? There's been talk about odd, blade-sharpening sounds coming from deep in the forest, but I'm sure you'll be fine!

name: Fishy Favor
flavor: The Meownster Hunters on Sunsnug Island always so kind to me. In return, I want to treat them to some Brocadefish. Could you fish some out of the Jurassic Frontier waters for me?
flavor_zh: The Meownster Hunters on Sunsnug Island always so kind to me. In return, I want to treat them to some Brocadefish. Could you fish some out of the Jurassic Frontier waters for me?

name: Crustacean Frustration
flavor: A buddy of mine went off to the Dunes in search of materials and got pounced on by a Daimew, er, I mean Daimyo Hermitaur! Now we're in a pinch to get him back! Can you crush that crustacean for us?
flavor_zh: A buddy of mine went off to the Dunes in search of materials and got pounced on by a Daimew, er, I mean Daimyo Hermitaur! Now we're in a pinch to get him back! Can you crush that crustacean for us?

name: The Desert Gourmand
flavor: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!
flavor_zh: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

name: Konchu Collector
flavor: The Konchu is a most fascinating creature -- a bug of many metamorphoses! Attack it and watch it switch into defensive mode for evasive action. I need more specimens for my research!
flavor_zh: The Konchu is a most fascinating creature -- a bug of many metamorphoses! Attack it and watch it switch into defensive mode for evasive action. I need more specimens for my research!

name: Cancer of the Dunes
goal: Slay 10 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Grrr! Enough is enough! Those Hermitaurs act like they own the Dunes just beclaws there's more of them than there are of us! Purrlease Hunter, rid the Dunes of this cancer.
goal_zh: 讨伐数量达到10只后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Grrr! Enough is enough! Those Hermitaurs act like they own the Dunes just beclaws there's more of them than there are of us! Purrlease Hunter, rid the Dunes of this cancer.

name: Deliver the Liver
flavor: Have you heard? It's been discovered that Apceros Livers can be used for a variety of medicinal purposes! I'm keen on getting in on the action while demand is high. Mind nabbing me a few?
flavor_zh: Have you heard? It's been discovered that Apceros Livers can be used for a variety of medicinal purposes! I'm keen on getting in on the action while demand is high. Mind nabbing me a few?

name: Farming Frustrations
flavor: The Velociprey that live up in them there Verdant Hills are a real annoyance, going after our livestock and just being downright ornery. Put a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya? Just be careful of their boss!
flavor_zh: The Velociprey that live up in them there Verdant Hills are a real annoyance, going after our livestock and just being downright ornery. Put a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya? Just be careful of their boss!

name: Financial Focus on Fungus
flavor: Mushrooms from the Verdant Hills are suddenly in high demand. If you gather me ten, I'll give you a cut of the profits. Oh, I heard that Velocidrome hang around there, so stay sharp!
flavor_zh: Mushrooms from the Verdant Hills are suddenly in high demand. If you gather me ten, I'll give you a cut of the profits. Oh, I heard that Velocidrome hang around there, so stay sharp!

name: Local Threat
flavor: Yian Kut-Ku have been going after people all over the place, and during my patrol earlier, I spotted one wandering close to town. That curious bugger must be after some Konchu. Can you get rid of it?
flavor_zh: Yian Kut-Ku have been going after people all over the place, and during my patrol earlier, I spotted one wandering close to town. That curious bugger must be after some Konchu. Can you get rid of it?

name: Into the Wyvern's Den
flavor: I have a patient back in my village afflicted with a rare disease. It takes two fresh Wyvern Eggs to cure, so I'd like for you to sneak into a Wyvern nest and whisk some away.
flavor_zh: I have a patient back in my village afflicted with a rare disease. It takes two fresh Wyvern Eggs to cure, so I'd like for you to sneak into a Wyvern nest and whisk some away.

name: Into the Wyvern's Den
flavor: I have a patient back in my village afflicted with a rare disease. It takes two fresh Wyvern Eggs to cure, so I'd like for you to sneak into a Wyvern nest and whisk some away.
flavor_zh: I have a patient back in my village afflicted with a rare disease. It takes two fresh Wyvern Eggs to cure, so I'd like for you to sneak into a Wyvern nest and whisk some away.

name: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
flavor: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]
flavor_zh: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]

name: Anteka Anticipation
flavor: I've gotten my paws on all kinds of monster meat before. You name it, I've grilled it. But I've never tried my paw at grilling up some Anteka. Help me out and we'll have a barbeque for the ages!
flavor_zh: I've gotten my paws on all kinds of monster meat before. You name it, I've grilled it. But I've never tried my paw at grilling up some Anteka. Help me out and we'll have a barbeque for the ages!

name: The Shadow in the Mountains
flavor: We were up in the Arctic Ridge -- doing a little research -- when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!
flavor_zh: We were up in the Arctic Ridge -- doing a little research -- when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!

name: No Go on the Popo
flavor: Usually I can find Popo pretty easily, but the few I spotted today scampered up the mountain like they were spooked by something. I need some Popo meat, but I'm not going up there! Can you go and get me some?
flavor_zh: Usually I can find Popo pretty easily, but the few I spotted today scampered up the mountain like they were spooked by something. I need some Popo meat, but I'm not going up there! Can you go and get me some?

name: No Go on the Popo
flavor: Usually I can find Popo pretty easily, but the few I spotted today scampered up the mountain like they were spooked by something. I need some Popo meat, but I'm not going up there! Can you go and get me some?
flavor_zh: Usually I can find Popo pretty easily, but the few I spotted today scampered up the mountain like they were spooked by something. I need some Popo meat, but I'm not going up there! Can you go and get me some?

name: Bully the Bullfango
flavor: Ugh! My backside's seen better days. Blame the Bullfango! My mom sent me to the Misty Peaks to dig up mushrooms, see, and all of a sudden those beasts were behind me! Long story short, my bottom needs avenging!
flavor_zh: Ugh! My backside's seen better days. Blame the Bullfango! My mom sent me to the Misty Peaks to dig up mushrooms, see, and all of a sudden those beasts were behind me! Long story short, my bottom needs avenging!

name: For Whom the Egg Yolks
flavor: I want...I mean, this TOWN could do with some Gargwa Eggs. They are a hot commodity right meow that people are willing to trade fur. Could you sneak me...er, US, definitely US, three Gargwa Eggs?
flavor_zh: I want...I mean, this TOWN could do with some Gargwa Eggs. They are a hot commodity right meow that people are willing to trade fur. Could you sneak me...er, US, definitely US, three Gargwa Eggs?

name: Royal Spit Take
flavor: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!
flavor_zh: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!

name: A Forest Fracas
flavor: Something's afoot, er, ahoof in the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome suddenly showed up and leveled our crops. Strange happenings 'round here. Can you check it out and take care of that Bulldrome while you're at it?
flavor_zh: Something's afoot, er, ahoof in the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome suddenly showed up and leveled our crops. Strange happenings 'round here. Can you check it out and take care of that Bulldrome while you're at it?

name: A Forest Fracas
flavor: Something's afoot, er, ahoof in the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome suddenly showed up and leveled our crops. Strange happenings 'round here. Can you check it out and take care of that Bulldrome while you're at it?
flavor_zh: Something's afoot, er, ahoof in the forest, Hunter. A Bulldrome suddenly showed up and leveled our crops. Strange happenings 'round here. Can you check it out and take care of that Bulldrome while you're at it?

name: Royal Honey Hunt
flavor: The name "Royal Honey" makes it sound like a divine treat that has to be tasted to be believed! I have to know how I can get my bees to make this "nectar of the gods."
flavor_zh: The name "Royal Honey" makes it sound like a divine treat that has to be tasted to be believed! I have to know how I can get my bees to make this "nectar of the gods."

name: Current Events
flavor: What a twist! People on land suddenly soaked to the bone! The soggy victims insist they saw something yellow before their drenching. What could it have been? Hunter, please, help me solve this riddle!
flavor_zh: What a twist! People on land suddenly soaked to the bone! The soggy victims insist they saw something yellow before their drenching. What could it have been? Hunter, please, help me solve this riddle!

name: The Crabbiest Catch
flavor: You know, Hunter, Moga Mussels found on the Deserted Island are a world famous delicacy, but a Daimyo Hermitaur keeps messin' with their breedin' grounds. Could you capture that crabby critter for me?
flavor_zh: You know, Hunter, Moga Mussels found on the Deserted Island are a world famous delicacy, but a Daimyo Hermitaur keeps messin' with their breedin' grounds. Could you capture that crabby critter for me?

name: Pack Woes
goal: Slay a total of 20 Jaggi or Jaggia
flavor: Oh, dear me! I heard about a pack of Jaggi roaming closer and closer to the village lately. I'm worried my son might get mauled out there! Put my fears to rest and make sure it's safe for my son to play.
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20头狗龙或雌狗龙
flavor_zh: Oh, dear me! I heard about a pack of Jaggi roaming closer and closer to the village lately. I'm worried my son might get mauled out there! Put my fears to rest and make sure it's safe for my son to play.

name: The Fungus Among Us
flavor: I've got a real mushroom problem, Hunter! I need to get my hands on some Ripened Mushrooms for a cookout, but I'm not going anywhere near those creepy Altaroth! Could you get some for me? Pleeease!?
name_zh: 嘿！给你缴纳蘑菇的任务哦！
flavor_zh: I've got a real mushroom problem, Hunter! I need to get my hands on some Ripened Mushrooms for a cookout, but I'm not going anywhere near those creepy Altaroth! Could you get some for me? Pleeease!?

name: Moofah Must-haves
flavor: We need to make warm clothing for our babies, but to make them, I need some Moofah wool from the Moofah on the Deserted Island. If you've got a Cutting-type weapon, it should be easy!
flavor_zh: We need to make warm clothing for our babies, but to make them, I need some Moofah wool from the Moofah on the Deserted Island. If you've got a Cutting-type weapon, it should be easy!

name: Deserted Island Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me on the Deserted Island? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me on the Deserted Island? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Sunsnug Isle Rescue!
flavor: Oh, it's a catastrophe! The Sunsnug Isle Meownster Hunters were in the Marshlands when an Iodrome kitty cornered them! Purrlease rescue them, Hunter!
flavor_zh: Oh, it's a catastrophe! The Sunsnug Isle Meownster Hunters were in the Marshlands when an Iodrome kitty cornered them! Purrlease rescue them, Hunter!

name: Robbed Blind
flavor: I hear that Gypceros take a real shine to shiny objects. They've been known to swipe stuff from people! If we can hunt one down, I bet we'll get our hands on some serious booty! Cha-ching!
flavor_zh: I hear that Gypceros take a real shine to shiny objects. They've been known to swipe stuff from people! If we can hunt one down, I bet we'll get our hands on some serious booty! Cha-ching!

name: Pest Control
goal: Slay a total of 20 Vespoid or Hornetaur
flavor: Work is tough enough as it is, but I can't even get a wink of sleep with all these bugs buzzing around! And now my boss is angry because my work is behind schedule! Make these bugs buzz off!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20只巨蜂或巨甲虫
flavor_zh: Work is tough enough as it is, but I can't even get a wink of sleep with all these bugs buzzing around! And now my boss is angry because my work is behind schedule! Make these bugs buzz off!

name: Travelers in Trouble
flavor: Some travelers came all the way from Dundorma to visit Bherna, but on their way home they got attacked by Ioprey! This is terrible! They'll probably give us terrible scores on the questionnaire!
flavor_zh: Some travelers came all the way from Dundorma to visit Bherna, but on their way home they got attacked by Ioprey! This is terrible! They'll probably give us terrible scores on the questionnaire!

name: Royal Rhinos Gone Wild
flavor: I've had enough of being on the losing side of the Royal Rhino Royale! That's all going to change this year, and that's where you come in! Go out and get me ten. If I win, we can split the prize.
name_zh: 充满野性气息的皇家独角仙
flavor_zh: I've had enough of being on the losing side of the Royal Rhino Royale! That's all going to change this year, and that's where you come in! Go out and get me ten. If I win, we can split the prize.

name: Marshlands Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Marsh- lands? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Marsh- lands? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Harvest Tour: Volcano
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering? Then look no further than this Quest, brave Hunter. Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: The Nocturnal Enchanter
flavor: The survey team ran into a Malfestio in the Jurassic Frontier. Before they knew it, everyone had either passed out or gotten so confused they don't remember a thing. Be on your guard, Hunter!
flavor_zh: The survey team ran into a Malfestio in the Jurassic Frontier. Before they knew it, everyone had either passed out or gotten so confused they don't remember a thing. Be on your guard, Hunter!

name: Wyvern of the Wind
flavor: The Nargacuga out on the Jurassic Frontier is scarily fast. Blink and you'll miss it. But, Hunter, it's gotta go! There's nothing more important right now than hunting it, so get to it!
flavor_zh: The Nargacuga out on the Jurassic Frontier is scarily fast. Blink and you'll miss it. But, Hunter, it's gotta go! There's nothing more important right now than hunting it, so get to it!

name: Jurassic Treasure: The Bug
flavor: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this Blossom Cricket I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! Earn it by 'untin' me a Volvidon!
name_zh: 古代森林的宝藏！虫之篇
flavor_zh: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this Blossom Cricket I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! Earn it by 'untin' me a Volvidon!

name: Unlock the Secret to...
flavor: The Eternal Fossil is a super rare type of fossil said to be the key to unlocking... Yes, blah blah blah...I know. You don't care. But I do! I need to know if what they say is true! My research depends on it!
flavor_zh: The Eternal Fossil is a super rare type of fossil said to be the key to unlocking... Yes, blah blah blah...I know. You don't care. But I do! I need to know if what they say is true! My research depends on it!

name: A Unique Cuppa
goal: Deliver 10 Unique Ferns or a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Hi hi, Hunter-person! Have you ever heard of Bherna's Fern Tea? It's a tried and true recipe, but I think I can improve it with some Unique Ferns! That's sure to make it a hit!
goal_zh: 缴纳10个以上特产紫萁或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Hi hi, Hunter-person! Have you ever heard of Bherna's Fern Tea? It's a tried and true recipe, but I think I can improve it with some Unique Ferns! That's sure to make it a hit!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Gendrome
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: A merchant friend of mine got jumped by a bunch of Gendrome lurkin' out in the desert. She's not too worse for wear, but if y'ask me, we should make sure this sort of happenin' is a one-time-only happenin'.
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: A merchant friend of mine got jumped by a bunch of Gendrome lurkin' out in the desert. She's not too worse for wear, but if y'ask me, we should make sure this sort of happenin' is a one-time-only happenin'.

name: Mining: The Final Frontier
flavor: Ore that falls from the sky is really rare. While we don't know how to refine it yet, it's still a valuable resource. As a forger, I'm keen to learn all that I can. Think you're able to get some for me?
flavor_zh: Ore that falls from the sky is really rare. While we don't know how to refine it yet, it's still a valuable resource. As a forger, I'm keen to learn all that I can. Think you're able to get some for me?

name: Wrath of the Rathian
flavor: Dang Rathian! Ambushed my caravan and tore my business a new one! But I ain't the gettin' mad type, I'm the gettin' even type! Time for some ice cold revenge, and I want you to dish it out!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雌火龙的头部与翼
flavor_zh: Dang Rathian! Ambushed my caravan and tore my business a new one! But I ain't the gettin' mad type, I'm the gettin' even type! Time for some ice cold revenge, and I want you to dish it out!

name: Noise Violation
flavor: The Najarala around the village is making some pawful sounds! Does it think it's some kind of mewsician? Hunter, make it shut up before it drives me up the wall!
flavor_zh: The Najarala around the village is making some pawful sounds! Does it think it's some kind of mewsician? Hunter, make it shut up before it drives me up the wall!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Yian Kut-Ku
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Ugh, will those Yian Kut-Ku ever shut up!? They're running around screaming all day, with those stupid faces and those big ears... Someone please hunt them down so I can finally get some sleep!
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Ugh, will those Yian Kut-Ku ever shut up!? They're running around screaming all day, with those stupid faces and those big ears... Someone please hunt them down so I can finally get some sleep!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Velocidrome
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Nyaaargh! My pointy little ears hurt from the yowling of those Velocidrome! I pounced on one, but more just followed! I dunno how many there are, but save me from their apawling screeches!
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Nyaaargh! My pointy little ears hurt from the yowling of those Velocidrome! I pounced on one, but more just followed! I dunno how many there are, but save me from their apawling screeches!

name: The New Tenant
flavor: A Blangonga has taken up residence in the Arctic Ridge, which spells trouble for us being able to gather firewood. Hurry and take that ugly ape out before we freeze to death!
flavor_zh: A Blangonga has taken up residence in the Arctic Ridge, which spells trouble for us being able to gather firewood. Hurry and take that ugly ape out before we freeze to death!

name: Lagombi Lair
flavor: I'm reporting live from the Arctic Ridge where two Lagombi are making their way across the frozen landscape. I could stand here and watch these graceful creatures all day! ...Wait, are they coming this way!? RUN!
flavor_zh: I'm reporting live from the Arctic Ridge where two Lagombi are making their way across the frozen landscape. I could stand here and watch these graceful creatures all day! ...Wait, are they coming this way!? RUN!

name: Hungry Eyes
flavor: Night fishing is pure bliss, I tell ya. It's cool...quiet. You can see the stars reflected in the water. Last night, I saw two red shooting stars streak overhead. Next thing I know, I'm bruised and battered.
flavor_zh: Night fishing is pure bliss, I tell ya. It's cool...quiet. You can see the stars reflected in the water. Last night, I saw two red shooting stars streak overhead. Next thing I know, I'm bruised and battered.

name: Royal Pains
flavor: You came at just the right time, Hunter! I've got two Royal Ludroth I'd love to see gone from the Misty Peaks. Can't look for Super Sprouts with those spongy varmints sprayin' me down!
flavor_zh: You came at just the right time, Hunter! I've got two Royal Ludroth I'd love to see gone from the Misty Peaks. Can't look for Super Sprouts with those spongy varmints sprayin' me down!

name: Peddling Practice
flavor: Heya, Hunter! Can we play merchant for a bit!? Um, let's thee... I want you to dee-liver... Yeah! Deliver some Balm-thtone Pie-thes to me! If you do, I'll give ya thomethin' cool I found!
flavor_zh: Heya, Hunter! Can we play merchant for a bit!? Um, let's thee... I want you to dee-liver... Yeah! Deliver some Balm-thtone Pie-thes to me! If you do, I'll give ya thomethin' cool I found!

name: Island Menace
flavor: Some kids came up to me and said they spotted something real odd-like on the Deserted Island. Could be one of those Malfestio. If that's the case, capture that hootin' hooligan before it hurts someone.
flavor_zh: Some kids came up to me and said they spotted something real odd-like on the Deserted Island. Could be one of those Malfestio. If that's the case, capture that hootin' hooligan before it hurts someone.

name: Deviled Legs
flavor: I've heard stories of frog legs bein' an in-demand delicacy overseas. Imagine the feast we could cook up with those two Tetsucabras over on the Deserted Island. Spring to it Hunter, our beast feast awaits!
name_zh: 鬼怪吃后都会晕厥的晚餐？
flavor_zh: I've heard stories of frog legs bein' an in-demand delicacy overseas. Imagine the feast we could cook up with those two Tetsucabras over on the Deserted Island. Spring to it Hunter, our beast feast awaits!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Daimyo Hermitaur
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Goodness gravy! Whitescruff, bless his heart, has set off to drive away some Daimyo Hermitaurs that have popped up lately. I'm really worried about him. Be a doll and help him drive them away.
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Goodness gravy! Whitescruff, bless his heart, has set off to drive away some Daimyo Hermitaurs that have popped up lately. I'm really worried about him. Be a doll and help him drive them away.

name: Marshlands Mission
flavor: New orders, priority one: Protect the villagers and increase our deployment options. We can't do either until you hunt that Shogun Ceanataur. This mission is classified, understood?
flavor_zh: New orders, priority one: Protect the villagers and increase our deployment options. We can't do either until you hunt that Shogun Ceanataur. This mission is classified, understood?

name: Serpentine Samba
flavor: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?
flavor_zh: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?

name: Lurkin' in the Murk
flavor: True horror lurks within the murky Marshlands... Two airborne wyverns, pallid hides gleaming in the dark skies, bodies sparking with electricity. Beware! They're right behind you!
flavor_zh: True horror lurks within the murky Marshlands... Two airborne wyverns, pallid hides gleaming in the dark skies, bodies sparking with electricity. Beware! They're right behind you!

name: Crustacean Infestation
flavor: I was just mindin' my own business, mining for some goodies, when a Ceanataur pops out of nowhere and breaks my Pickaxe! I would've yanked it out of its shell, but more of 'em showed up!
flavor_zh: I was just mindin' my own business, mining for some goodies, when a Ceanataur pops out of nowhere and breaks my Pickaxe! I would've yanked it out of its shell, but more of 'em showed up!

name: Tumbling Troublemaker
flavor: Holy moly! Have you seen one of those things before? I thought it was a giant boulder tumbling down the mountain, but no, it was a monster comin' to eat me! I'm not going back there until you get rid of it!
flavor_zh: Holy moly! Have you seen one of those things before? I thought it was a giant boulder tumbling down the mountain, but no, it was a monster comin' to eat me! I'm not going back there until you get rid of it!

name: Crustacean Infatuation
flavor: I love Shogun Ceanataurs, don't you!? Their carapaces have so many fine details, their claws are so long and beautiful... *ahem* I want to, er, study one up close, so could you capture one?
flavor_zh: I love Shogun Ceanataurs, don't you!? Their carapaces have so many fine details, their claws are so long and beautiful... *ahem* I want to, er, study one up close, so could you capture one?

name: Rocking the Uroktor
flavor: These Uroktor are fascinatin' creatures! They burrow right through volcanic rock. How is that even possible? I wanna find out more about 'em, but they keep spittin' gobs of fire at me. Help me unlock their mysteries!
flavor_zh: These Uroktor are fascinatin' creatures! They burrow right through volcanic rock. How is that even possible? I wanna find out more about 'em, but they keep spittin' gobs of fire at me. Help me unlock their mysteries!

name: Great Ore Discovery
flavor: Great news! A new Coal bed has been discovered in the Volcano, and as much as I'd like to get in on that action, that place is Shogun Ceanataur turf. Care to go mining for me, Hunter?
flavor_zh: Great news! A new Coal bed has been discovered in the Volcano, and as much as I'd like to get in on that action, that place is Shogun Ceanataur turf. Care to go mining for me, Hunter?

name: Volcano Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Volcano? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Volcano? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: The Dark Age
flavor: Recently, a Yian Garuga has appeared in the Jurassic Frontier. Research in that area can't continue until the threat has been dealt with. Good luck, Hunter.
flavor_zh: Recently, a Yian Garuga has appeared in the Jurassic Frontier. Research in that area can't continue until the threat has been dealt with. Good luck, Hunter.

name: Trifecta of Terror
flavor: A trio of Nibelsnarf have been spotted in the Dunes. There's no telling what kind of trouble this triad is up to. One thing is for sure: You need to tackle those three overgrown tadpoles!
flavor_zh: A trio of Nibelsnarf have been spotted in the Dunes. There's no telling what kind of trouble this triad is up to. One thing is for sure: You need to tackle those three overgrown tadpoles!

name: Garuga of the Hills
flavor: I'll let you in on a secret of mine: I managed to track down where a Yian Garuga is hanging out. Don't let anyone else know, but it's in the Verdant Hills as we speak!
flavor_zh: I'll let you in on a secret of mine: I managed to track down where a Yian Garuga is hanging out. Don't let anyone else know, but it's in the Verdant Hills as we speak!

name: The Thunderclaw Wyvern
flavor: Listen here, kid! Things are lookin' grim out in the Verdant Hills. There's a mean, green, electrocutin' machine out there messin' things up. I need you to get out there and mess IT up!
flavor_zh: Listen here, kid! Things are lookin' grim out in the Verdant Hills. There's a mean, green, electrocutin' machine out there messin' things up. I need you to get out there and mess IT up!

name: Fungus Fetch
goal: Deliver 10 Unique Mushrooms or a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Thanks to you, business is soaring! So much, in fact, that I can't keep up with demand! Hurry back to the Hills and gather me some more. But be careful, I heard there's a Rathian about!
name_zh: 再次寻找蘑菇，大赚一笔！？
goal_zh: 缴纳10个以上特产菇或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Thanks to you, business is soaring! So much, in fact, that I can't keep up with demand! Hurry back to the Hills and gather me some more. But be careful, I heard there's a Rathian about!

name: Two Roars in the Snow
flavor: It all happened so fast... These two Blangongas showed up and just wrecked all I had! I wanna rebuild my life, but there's no way I'm going up there with those things! Help me get my life back!
flavor_zh: It all happened so fast... These two Blangongas showed up and just wrecked all I had! I wanna rebuild my life, but there's no way I'm going up there with those things! Help me get my life back!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Khezu
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: You look like you could go for a little adrenaline in your day! Well, you're in luck! There's heaps of monsters with electrifying personalities up in the Arctic Ridge! Have at it!
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: You look like you could go for a little adrenaline in your day! Well, you're in luck! There's heaps of monsters with electrifying personalities up in the Arctic Ridge! Have at it!

name: The Unwavering Colossus
flavor: If we can tame the Gammoth, we'll have an attraction to make us more famous than Bherna and Yukumo com- bined! You can't tame monsters? Bah! Well, at least give it a try!
flavor_zh: If we can tame the Gammoth, we'll have an attraction to make us more famous than Bherna and Yukumo com- bined! You can't tame monsters? Bah! Well, at least give it a try!

name: Lagiacrus Fuss
flavor: You came at just the right time, Hunter. See, I was on my way back from explorin' the Misty Peaks when I ran into a dagnabbed Lagiacrus! Here's hopin' you make quick work of that varmint.
flavor_zh: You came at just the right time, Hunter. See, I was on my way back from explorin' the Misty Peaks when I ran into a dagnabbed Lagiacrus! Here's hopin' you make quick work of that varmint.

name: The Entrancing Water Dancer
flavor: Heed my words, Hunter: It is said that there is a Mizutsune in the Misty Peaks. You will help rid Yukumo of this slippery devil, and your journey will be a safe one.
name_zh: 随风漂浮的淡红色泡狐
flavor_zh: Heed my words, Hunter: It is said that there is a Mizutsune in the Misty Peaks. You will help rid Yukumo of this slippery devil, and your journey will be a safe one.

name: The Fisherman's Fiend
flavor: Yikes, this is horrible! We've just heard from our fishermen out in the sea that a Lagiacrus is here in this region! We need you to stop it before it does any serious damage!
flavor_zh: Yikes, this is horrible! We've just heard from our fishermen out in the sea that a Lagiacrus is here in this region! We need you to stop it before it does any serious damage!

name: Island Heat
flavor: How's it hangin', Hunter dude? The Yukumo Gal hooked me up with a Quest request for you to house that Lame-o-los that's lurkin' on the Deserted Island. I'm just gonna chill here and think about these fluffy clouds.
flavor_zh: How's it hangin', Hunter dude? The Yukumo Gal hooked me up with a Quest request for you to house that Lame-o-los that's lurkin' on the Deserted Island. I'm just gonna chill here and think about these fluffy clouds.

name: Double Vision
flavor: Here's an idea: What would happen if you ate the scales of two Malfestio? Would your brain go extra on the fritz or would the second batch cancel the first? Inquiring minds want to know!
flavor_zh: Here's an idea: What would happen if you ate the scales of two Malfestio? Would your brain go extra on the fritz or would the second batch cancel the first? Inquiring minds want to know!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Gypceros
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: My trade colleagues are in a bit of a jam after some Gypceros showed up on their route! Get rid of a few of them for me, and I'll reward you with some grade-A Yukumo Riceflour!
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: My trade colleagues are in a bit of a jam after some Gypceros showed up on their route! Get rid of a few of them for me, and I'll reward you with some grade-A Yukumo Riceflour!

name: Behind Closed Ores
goal: Slay 10 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Psst! Hunter! I need you to take care of something for me. My best mining spot is infested with Bullfango. I need you to un-fest it, if you know what I mean. Thing is, the place is a trade secret, so be discreet!
goal_zh: 讨伐数量达到10只后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Psst! Hunter! I need you to take care of something for me. My best mining spot is infested with Bullfango. I need you to un-fest it, if you know what I mean. Thing is, the place is a trade secret, so be discreet!

name: A King, Robed in Smoke
flavor: I fear the end times are upon us. A blood-colored demon has ascended from the depths to plague the land. I beg of thee, save the shrine that protects the Volcano and send that beast back to the abyss.
flavor_zh: I fear the end times are upon us. A blood-colored demon has ascended from the depths to plague the land. I beg of thee, save the shrine that protects the Volcano and send that beast back to the abyss.

name: Fight or Uragaan!
flavor: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.
flavor_zh: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

name: Great Knuckleballs o' Fire!
flavor: I'm reporting live from the Volcano, where we're observing two majestic Volvidons. If you look closely, you can see... you can see... them coming this way! Run for your lives!
flavor_zh: I'm reporting live from the Volcano, where we're observing two majestic Volvidons. If you look closely, you can see... you can see... them coming this way! Run for your lives!

name: Hunt-a-thon: Iodrome
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Some Iodrome are fighting for position as alpha, but their fighting's going to leave the entire ecosystem poisoned! Please take out a couple to help mitigate the damage!
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Some Iodrome are fighting for position as alpha, but their fighting's going to leave the entire ecosystem poisoned! Please take out a couple to help mitigate the damage!

name: Envoy to Disaster
flavor: I sense an ill omen that could spell disaster for the Volcano, should it be left unchecked. Slay ten of the serpents to quell the danger before it's too late!
flavor_zh: I sense an ill omen that could spell disaster for the Volcano, should it be left unchecked. Slay ten of the serpents to quell the danger before it's too late!

name: A Late Jurassic Excursion
flavor: I train the only way a warrior can -- with full abandon! Yet whenever I perform my kata, monsters gather around me. Honorable hunter! Winnow the beasts from this place so that I may hone my body properly!
name_zh: 来啊！深夜中的古代森林
flavor_zh: I train the only way a warrior can -- with full abandon! Yet whenever I perform my kata, monsters gather around me. Honorable hunter! Winnow the beasts from this place so that I may hone my body properly!

name: A Sandy Battle Royale
flavor: My ship was cruising over the sand when we suddenly ran aground, our cargo spilling hither and yon. Now, the local monsters are really keen on taking it, so I need you to dissuade them!
flavor_zh: My ship was cruising over the sand when we suddenly ran aground, our cargo spilling hither and yon. Now, the local monsters are really keen on taking it, so I need you to dissuade them!

name: Scientific Method
flavor: This island is, like, sooo amazing, don'tcha think? It's got unique evolutionary patterns you can't find aaanywhere else! Sweet, huh? So, like, be a pal and hunt me a monster! For science!
flavor_zh: This island is, like, sooo amazing, don'tcha think? It's got unique evolutionary patterns you can't find aaanywhere else! Sweet, huh? So, like, be a pal and hunt me a monster! For science!

name: The Scorching Blade
flavor: That bedeviled Glavenus has reappeared in the Jurassic Frontier, and the Wycademy search team's outmatched. There is no time to waste. It has to be brought down. I'm counting on you!
flavor_zh: That bedeviled Glavenus has reappeared in the Jurassic Frontier, and the Wycademy search team's outmatched. There is no time to waste. It has to be brought down. I'm counting on you!

name: Dark Wings, Dark Work
flavor: Beneath the azure skies of the Jurassic Frontier lurks a mysterious monster cloaked in black. Writhing in pain, it glares from unseen eyes. The hunter or the hunted: Which will you be?
flavor_zh: Beneath the azure skies of the Jurassic Frontier lurks a mysterious monster cloaked in black. Writhing in pain, it glares from unseen eyes. The hunter or the hunted: Which will you be?

name: Tuff Turf
flavor: I was training my tail off in the Jurassic Frontier when, uh, I guess I kinda sorta riled up a Zinogre. My bad! No way I can handle that beast. Somebody beat it up for me!
flavor_zh: I was training my tail off in the Jurassic Frontier when, uh, I guess I kinda sorta riled up a Zinogre. My bad! No way I can handle that beast. Somebody beat it up for me!

name: From Beyond the Sands
flavor: I was roaming the Dunes when I happened to see a Glavenus blocking one of the major trade routes! Normally I keep to myself, but I can't live without my delivery of Moga curry!
flavor_zh: I was roaming the Dunes when I happened to see a Glavenus blocking one of the major trade routes! Normally I keep to myself, but I can't live without my delivery of Moga curry!

name: Tigrex by the Tail
flavor: I've got a distress signal from a hunter in the Dunes who's run into a Tigrex! Anyone who finds this message is requested to head there and take it down ASAP!
flavor_zh: I've got a distress signal from a hunter in the Dunes who's run into a Tigrex! Anyone who finds this message is requested to head there and take it down ASAP!

name: A Thousand Scales of Dread
flavor: Breaking news from the Elder Hall: A Seregios has shown up in the Dunes! Any and all skilled hunters are asked to help hunt it as soon as possible. Beware its blades!
flavor_zh: Breaking news from the Elder Hall: A Seregios has shown up in the Dunes! Any and all skilled hunters are asked to help hunt it as soon as possible. Beware its blades!

name: The Perilous Pair
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: Luggage left with Neko still no make it here. Maybe that because there is Rathalos and Rathian in the Verdant Hills? Iya... All this give me bad yokan. "Yokan" means feeling!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: Luggage left with Neko still no make it here. Maybe that because there is Rathalos and Rathian in the Verdant Hills? Iya... All this give me bad yokan. "Yokan" means feeling!

name: The Hero's Journey
flavor: The Arctic Ridge has materials I need to remake the Hero's Blade, but right now it's home to a nasty Tigrex. Be a dear and clear it out for me so I can go about my work, won't you?
flavor_zh: The Arctic Ridge has materials I need to remake the Hero's Blade, but right now it's home to a nasty Tigrex. Be a dear and clear it out for me so I can go about my work, won't you?

name: The Bellowing Zinogre
flavor: Eeek, that Zinogre's at it again, howling away! I get so scared hearing it, I can't move, even when I have customers to serve! Someone, anyone, make it stop so I can do my job!
flavor_zh: Eeek, that Zinogre's at it again, howling away! I get so scared hearing it, I can't move, even when I have customers to serve! Someone, anyone, make it stop so I can do my job!

name: Brachydios Mio!
flavor: We recently came across a monster with a dangerous slime on its forelimbs... If any gets on you, it explodes. We've been holding out okay so far, but we could really do with more hands on deck.
flavor_zh: We recently came across a monster with a dangerous slime on its forelimbs... If any gets on you, it explodes. We've been holding out okay so far, but we could really do with more hands on deck.

name: Under the Gaze of Heaven
flavor: My granddad let it slip that he was gonna go watch a "battle of shoguns." He has no place being there, but he won't listen! Look, I'll help, too. I just don't wanna do it alone!
flavor_zh: My granddad let it slip that he was gonna go watch a "battle of shoguns." He has no place being there, but he won't listen! Look, I'll help, too. I just don't wanna do it alone!

name: Break the Brachydios
flavor: There's still much to learn about Brachydios, especially given that it's only just been recently discovered. I simply must know more, so I'd love it if you captured me a specimen to examine!
flavor_zh: There's still much to learn about Brachydios, especially given that it's only just been recently discovered. I simply must know more, so I'd love it if you captured me a specimen to examine!

name: Night Terrors
flavor: Some eerie cries have been getting closer to the village every night. It's freaking out the villagers here, so would you mind going out hunting for whatever's behind it?
flavor_zh: Some eerie cries have been getting closer to the village every night. It's freaking out the villagers here, so would you mind going out hunting for whatever's behind it?

name: Bristly Fanged Beasts
flavor: There're three diff'rent Fanged Beasts out where I'm stayin'. Right now it ain't too big a worry, but even the tiniest spark can cause a big fire, so you'd best put it out soon.
flavor_zh: There're three diff'rent Fanged Beasts out where I'm stayin'. Right now it ain't too big a worry, but even the tiniest spark can cause a big fire, so you'd best put it out soon.

name: Drawing the Waterline
flavor: It's a catastrophe! Terrible things came splashing up from the river, and now everything's soaked! Trenya, bring your big-nosed hunter lackey and come punish the purrpetrators right away!
flavor_zh: It's a catastrophe! Terrible things came splashing up from the river, and now everything's soaked! Trenya, bring your big-nosed hunter lackey and come punish the purrpetrators right away!

name: The Cankerous Quagmire
flavor: I can't believe it -- two Iodrome in the same place? What do they want? What if they fight the local Najarala!? This is bad! If you don't act fast, the Marshlands'll be a miasma of Poison and Paralysis!
flavor_zh: I can't believe it -- two Iodrome in the same place? What do they want? What if they fight the local Najarala!? This is bad! If you don't act fast, the Marshlands'll be a miasma of Poison and Paralysis!

name: Volcano Triple Play
flavor: I was practicing out by the Volcano when I saw some cool monsters bouncing and leaping around! If you show me how to hit something like that, it'll help me be the world's best slugger!
flavor_zh: I was practicing out by the Volcano when I saw some cool monsters bouncing and leaping around! If you show me how to hit something like that, it'll help me be the world's best slugger!

name: It's Electric
flavor: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.
flavor_zh: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.

name: The White Brute
flavor: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.
flavor_zh: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.

name: Stop the Wheel
flavor: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?
name_zh: 吾将轮回，吾将聚集，吾将归来
flavor_zh: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?

name: The Fated Four
flavor: O brave, wise, courageous hunter, only you can rise to the challenge that I have set forth. It shall take both all your mind and body to overcome, but I ask you to venture forth.
flavor_zh: O brave, wise, courageous hunter, only you can rise to the challenge that I have set forth. It shall take both all your mind and body to overcome, but I ask you to venture forth.

name: Advanced: Fungus Fetchin'
flavor: We're prepurring a new menu at the Tanzinya Grill, and we think a Dish with mushrooms in it would be the cat's meow. Purrhaps you could pick some up for us, Hunter?
flavor_zh: We're prepurring a new menu at the Tanzinya Grill, and we think a Dish with mushrooms in it would be the cat's meow. Purrhaps you could pick some up for us, Hunter?

name: Advanced: Jurassic Treasure
flavor: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this 'ere Kingmeat I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! 'Unt me a Glavenus -- then we'll talk!
name_zh: 高难度：古代森林的宝藏！
flavor_zh: Gettin' treasure trembles fer this 'ere Kingmeat I picked up in the Jurassic Frontier? Sorry to say, but if ye want it, ye gotta go work fer it! 'Unt me a Glavenus -- then we'll talk!

name: Advanced: Sly Swooper
flavor: I was out peddling a little while ago when I saw a Yian Garuga swoop down! I'm scared what'll happen to my friends and everyone else if we leave it alone. Can you make it go away?
name_zh: 高难度：黑狼鸟从天而降
flavor_zh: I was out peddling a little while ago when I saw a Yian Garuga swoop down! I'm scared what'll happen to my friends and everyone else if we leave it alone. Can you make it go away?

name: Advanced: Invoking Rath
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: You look like you're in the mood to bump against some tough monsters! There's a Rathalos and a Rathian on the loose in the Verdant Hills. Knowing you, I'm sure you can handle 'em!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: You look like you're in the mood to bump against some tough monsters! There's a Rathalos and a Rathian on the loose in the Verdant Hills. Knowing you, I'm sure you can handle 'em!

name: Advanced: Seismic Scares
flavor: Hunter, I must implore you to take arms for me once again. Your target this time is a pair of Tigrex. Steel yourself, and be careful.
flavor_zh: Hunter, I must implore you to take arms for me once again. Your target this time is a pair of Tigrex. Steel yourself, and be careful.

name: Advanced: Twinkle Toes
flavor: I'm no hunter, but the way I see it, yer only as good as the hardest blow ya can take. An' the hardest of all are the ones Duramboros can deal! Take one down in the Misty Peaks, an' prove your worth!
name_zh: 高难度：使出全力的尾锤龙
flavor_zh: I'm no hunter, but the way I see it, yer only as good as the hardest blow ya can take. An' the hardest of all are the ones Duramboros can deal! Take one down in the Misty Peaks, an' prove your worth!

name: Advanced: Seltas Queen
flavor: Hey, there's a Seltas Queen that's giving all the other hunters around here a run for their money. Could you step up and give it a shot? Think of it as a real test of strength! Feh heh!
name_zh: 高难度：与重甲虫比试力气！
flavor_zh: Hey, there's a Seltas Queen that's giving all the other hunters around here a run for their money. Could you step up and give it a shot? Think of it as a real test of strength! Feh heh!

name: Advanced: The Goliaths
flavor: A Wycademy search team's been attacked by some large monsters, and now they're stranded. What's more, some villagers were with them! I'd breathe easier if you'd hunt those beasts.
name_zh: 高难度：征服天地的强者
flavor_zh: A Wycademy search team's been attacked by some large monsters, and now they're stranded. What's more, some villagers were with them! I'd breathe easier if you'd hunt those beasts.

name: Advanced: Barrage of Blue
flavor: Hunter, it looks like the Guild wants you at the Arena. A trio of blue monsters have shown up and is causing a fuss, but I'm sure you can handle it! At any rate, I won't take no for an answer!
flavor_zh: Hunter, it looks like the Guild wants you at the Arena. A trio of blue monsters have shown up and is causing a fuss, but I'm sure you can handle it! At any rate, I won't take no for an answer!

name: Advanced: Seeing Red
flavor: Looks like another request from the Guild... They want some red monsters hunted down. You'll do it for me and save these hands from getting dirty, of course? Wonderful. Good luck, now!
flavor_zh: Looks like another request from the Guild... They want some red monsters hunted down. You'll do it for me and save these hands from getting dirty, of course? Wonderful. Good luck, now!

name: Advanced: Nothing is Sacred
flavor: Got word a Shagaru Magala's turned up at the Sanctuary near Cathar. A thing like that'll make short work of anythin' in its path. Ain't many that could face it, but I know you're the one to get it done!
name_zh: 高难度：完成轮回的灾祸古龙
flavor_zh: Got word a Shagaru Magala's turned up at the Sanctuary near Cathar. A thing like that'll make short work of anythin' in its path. Ain't many that could face it, but I know you're the one to get it done!

name: Advanced: Snowtal Recall
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
flavor: The Kushala Daora strikes again up in the Arctic Ridge, eh? Now that's a foe I'm all too familiar with: Ol' Stormbringer. It's gonna be cold there, so down some Hot Drinks!
flavor_zh: The Kushala Daora strikes again up in the Arctic Ridge, eh? Now that's a foe I'm all too familiar with: Ol' Stormbringer. It's gonna be cold there, so down some Hot Drinks!

name: Advanced: Invisible Thief
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: Urgent wire! "Chameleos approaching village [STOP] All available hunters report ASAP [END MESSAGE]" Please hurry, and mind it doesn't steal your supplies with that blasted tongue!
name_zh: 高难度：抵御霞龙防卫行动！
flavor_zh: Urgent wire! "Chameleos approaching village [STOP] All available hunters report ASAP [END MESSAGE]" Please hurry, and mind it doesn't steal your supplies with that blasted tongue!

name: Advanced: Teostra's Return
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: A Teostra has appeared in the Volcano! Not only are folks in the area in danger, but dragons prowling willy-nilly means I can't grow my world- famous Prismatic Dandelions! Ward it off, would you?
flavor_zh: A Teostra has appeared in the Volcano! Not only are folks in the area in danger, but dragons prowling willy-nilly means I can't grow my world- famous Prismatic Dandelions! Ward it off, would you?

name: Advanced: Might is Right
flavor: When you have it all, the Arena is the only thing that can excite you. But lately, it's just been a bunch of weaklings! I need a real hunter to come in and show us how it's done!
flavor_zh: When you have it all, the Arena is the only thing that can excite you. But lately, it's just been a bunch of weaklings! I need a real hunter to come in and show us how it's done!

name: Advanced: State in Flux
flavor: Today's cast of monsters oughta keep you right busy! That's because they come packed with attacks that'll inflict all sorts of Abnormal Statuses! Hope you're up for a wild ride!
name_zh: 高难度：毫无人性的状态异常连番轰炸
flavor_zh: Today's cast of monsters oughta keep you right busy! That's because they come packed with attacks that'll inflict all sorts of Abnormal Statuses! Hope you're up for a wild ride!

name: Advanced: The Field's a Stage
flavor: Calling all actors for the role of a lifetime! Everyone's dreamed of standing in the limelight, and the Arena's the limest light of all! Are you the star we need to bring the house down at the finale?
flavor_zh: Calling all actors for the role of a lifetime! Everyone's dreamed of standing in the limelight, and the Arena's the limest light of all! Are you the star we need to bring the house down at the finale?

name: Advanced: Wrath of Rath
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: You've become a fine hunter, so how 'bout a bigger challenge? Picture this: you, versus a Rathalos AND a Rathian! Whaddaya say? Think you can get the wyvern royalty to bow down to you?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: You've become a fine hunter, so how 'bout a bigger challenge? Picture this: you, versus a Rathalos AND a Rathian! Whaddaya say? Think you can get the wyvern royalty to bow down to you?

name: Advanced: The Golden Pair
flavor: I've got something special whipped up for today: two Rajang sporting shiny gold coats! Hope you're ready to give them all you've got, 'cause they don't know how to go easy on anybody!
flavor_zh: I've got something special whipped up for today: two Rajang sporting shiny gold coats! Hope you're ready to give them all you've got, 'cause they don't know how to go easy on anybody!

name: Advanced: Out of the Fry Pan
flavor: You must be the hunter that nobody can shut up about! To hear them tell it, there ain't no one better. But I'll only believe it when I see it myself, so show me proof you're hot stuff!
flavor_zh: You must be the hunter that nobody can shut up about! To hear them tell it, there ain't no one better. But I'll only believe it when I see it myself, so show me proof you're hot stuff!

name: Harvest Tour: Desert
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I can't help notice you've taken an interest in gathering. Well, the Desert's a fine place for it! Go on -- get stuck right in there! Just remember to deliver a Paw Pass Ticket once you've finished playing in the sand!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I can't help notice you've taken an interest in gathering. Well, the Desert's a fine place for it! Go on -- get stuck right in there! Just remember to deliver a Paw Pass Ticket once you've finished playing in the sand!

name: Harvest Tour: Ruined Pinnacle
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I see you're interested in doing some gathering up at the Ruined Pinnacle. This Quest will let you gather to your heart's content. Just don't forget to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I see you're interested in doing some gathering up at the Ruined Pinnacle. This Quest will let you gather to your heart's content. Just don't forget to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done!

name: Bug Appétit Encore
flavor: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people make bugs into burgers. You've cooked me up a Seltas once before, but I just can't get enough of that crunchy insect goodness! Oh, could you? Would you?
flavor_zh: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people make bugs into burgers. You've cooked me up a Seltas once before, but I just can't get enough of that crunchy insect goodness! Oh, could you? Would you?

name: Azure Azure Can Be
flavor: For some weird reason, my little sister thinks monsters are cute. So when she heard about an Arzuros at the Ruined Pinnacle, she was desperate to go see it, but no way am I putting her in harm's way. Could you get rid of it for me?
flavor_zh: For some weird reason, my little sister thinks monsters are cute. So when she heard about an Arzuros at the Ruined Pinnacle, she was desperate to go see it, but no way am I putting her in harm's way. Could you get rid of it for me?

name: Investment Flanking
flavor: Grrr, stupid varmints! There I was mindin' me own business, tryin' ta lug my wares over yonder ridge, 'til those confounded Giaprey come out some hidey-hole an' trash all my stuff! They had a leader, too -- a Giadrome! Take 'er out, I beg ya!
flavor_zh: Grrr, stupid varmints! There I was mindin' me own business, tryin' ta lug my wares over yonder ridge, 'til those confounded Giaprey come out some hidey-hole an' trash all my stuff! They had a leader, too -- a Giadrome! Take 'er out, I beg ya!

name: Kut-Ku Misunderstood
flavor: So, uh, I heard a Yian Kut-Ku showed up at the Ruined Pinnacle. I'm sure it's totally, absolutely 100% fine, but let's say -- hypothetically speaking -- that it actually turns out to be some terrifying mutant deathbird...you could handle it, couldn't you?
flavor_zh: So, uh, I heard a Yian Kut-Ku showed up at the Ruined Pinnacle. I'm sure it's totally, absolutely 100% fine, but let's say -- hypothetically speaking -- that it actually turns out to be some terrifying mutant deathbird...you could handle it, couldn't you?
