name: Enough Monkeying Around
flavor: Oof... That mischievous monkey in the Ancestral Steppe really got me good. It's starting to stretch my patience. In fact, I've a good mind to put this boot up its... *ahem* Please, teach it a lesson before I do something incredibly rash...
flavor_zh: Oof... That mischievous monkey in the Ancestral Steppe really got me good. It's starting to stretch my patience. In fact, I've a good mind to put this boot up its... *ahem* Please, teach it a lesson before I do something incredibly rash...

name: The Killer Rabbit of Arctic Ridge
flavor: Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up the mountain to see the bunny. It looked so darn...ANGRY! Where is my cute fluffybuns!? I can't sleep at night like this! Put that abomination somewhere I can't see him, ever!
flavor_zh: Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up the mountain to see the bunny. It looked so darn...ANGRY! Where is my cute fluffybuns!? I can't sleep at night like this! Put that abomination somewhere I can't see him, ever!

name: Poisoned for Action
flavor: An old pal of mine says the rubbery hide of a Gypceros is great for shipbuilding, thanks to its water-resistant properties! I hear one of 'em's roaming the Primal Forest right now. Could you haul it in for me?
flavor_zh: An old pal of mine says the rubbery hide of a Gypceros is great for shipbuilding, thanks to its water-resistant properties! I hear one of 'em's roaming the Primal Forest right now. Could you haul it in for me?

name: Spit It Out
flavor: Grrrr! I am reawy, reawy upset! A big, nasty Tetsucabwa in the Juwassic Fwontier ate my pwecious dowwy wowwy in one big guwp! My worthwess butwer cawwied me away befowe I could save it... Somebody, avenge my dowwy!
flavor_zh: Grrrr! I am reawy, reawy upset! A big, nasty Tetsucabwa in the Juwassic Fwontier ate my pwecious dowwy wowwy in one big guwp! My worthwess butwer cawwied me away befowe I could save it... Somebody, avenge my dowwy!

name: Fashion Victim
flavor: I just can't keep my line of Crab Couture accessories in stock! Their wild success has caused an unforeseen issue: a lack of materials. Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur for me, and for the sake of fashion!
name_zh: 这才是真正的大名排场？
flavor_zh: I just can't keep my line of Crab Couture accessories in stock! Their wild success has caused an unforeseen issue: a lack of materials. Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur for me, and for the sake of fashion!

name: Research Team's First Rodeo
flavor: As the name implies, the Ruined Pinnacle is way up high and covered in ruins. Now we have the Soaratorium, we can launch a proper expedition! ...But first, we'll need to help the advance team, as they've been beset by a Congalala!
name_zh: 调查队初次上阵！无人山岭的桃毛兽王
flavor_zh: As the name implies, the Ruined Pinnacle is way up high and covered in ruins. Now we have the Soaratorium, we can launch a proper expedition! ...But first, we'll need to help the advance team, as they've been beset by a Congalala!

name: Ruined Pinnacle, RUINED
flavor: Th-This is terrible! Because of the intense methane buildup from all the Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks! They just won't stop farting! How are we supposed to do any research under these conditions!? Can you thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!
flavor_zh: Th-This is terrible! Because of the intense methane buildup from all the Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks! They just won't stop farting! How are we supposed to do any research under these conditions!? Can you thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!

name: Brave New Ore
flavor: We discovered special ore at the Ruined Pinnacle that we can't get anywhere else! We still have much to learn about this place, but maybe if you collect some, we could analyze it and see where that takes us. Can you help us?
name_zh: 无人山岭中的神奇石块
flavor_zh: We discovered special ore at the Ruined Pinnacle that we can't get anywhere else! We still have much to learn about this place, but maybe if you collect some, we could analyze it and see where that takes us. Can you help us?

name: Taking Royal Liberties
flavor: The Misty Peaks near our village are currently undergoing some hardship in the form of a Royal Ludroth. It has taken a liking to the trees, attacking our lumberjacks when they need to work. You will humbly protect our wonderful peaks by slaying the fiend.
flavor_zh: The Misty Peaks near our village are currently undergoing some hardship in the form of a Royal Ludroth. It has taken a liking to the trees, attacking our lumberjacks when they need to work. You will humbly protect our wonderful peaks by slaying the fiend.

name: A Friend in Need
flavor: One of the top staff at the Wycademy is under attack from a Barroth on the road to the village. He's more than just an official -- he's my dear friend. I've known him for most my life. Please, Hunter, save him.
flavor_zh: One of the top staff at the Wycademy is under attack from a Barroth on the road to the village. He's more than just an official -- he's my dear friend. I've known him for most my life. Please, Hunter, save him.

name: March of the Genprey
flavor: Pesky Genprey attacks are obstructing my research into the Desert's ecosystem. Could you hunt 12 of them? Hahaha, what are you talking about? I'm an expert, I'm fairly sure Genprey aren't necessary to the ecosystem!
flavor_zh: Pesky Genprey attacks are obstructing my research into the Desert's ecosystem. Could you hunt 12 of them? Hahaha, what are you talking about? I'm an expert, I'm fairly sure Genprey aren't necessary to the ecosystem!

name: On Burrowed Time
flavor: Ughhh! How's anybody supposed to cross the Desert with those darn Cephalos burrowing about the place!? Now every step I take I'm scared something's gonna jump out and get me! Go take care of five of 'em, will you?
flavor_zh: Ughhh! How's anybody supposed to cross the Desert with those darn Cephalos burrowing about the place!? Now every step I take I'm scared something's gonna jump out and get me! Go take care of five of 'em, will you?

name: A Berry Dubious Idea
flavor: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Tropical Berries that grow in the Desert? I just came up with a way to make them really tasty! They're going to be HUGE! I think I smell money... I'll split the profits with you if you collect some for me. 70-30?
name_zh: 热带草莓有金钱的味道？
flavor_zh: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Tropical Berries that grow in the Desert? I just came up with a way to make them really tasty! They're going to be HUGE! I think I smell money... I'll split the profits with you if you collect some for me. 70-30?

name: Harvest Tour: Ancestral Steppe
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: So you're interested in what you can find on the Ancestral Steppe, eh? Then have I got a Quest for you! Collect as much as you like, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: So you're interested in what you can find on the Ancestral Steppe, eh? Then have I got a Quest for you! Collect as much as you like, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.

name: Harvest Tour: Primal Forest
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I see that steely glint in your eye. You want to see if you can find something primal in the Primal Forest, don't you? Then have I got a Quest for you! Collect as much as you like, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I see that steely glint in your eye. You want to see if you can find something primal in the Primal Forest, don't you? Then have I got a Quest for you! Collect as much as you like, then deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.

name: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I've always thought the Jurassic Frontier must be a haven for gathering. Haven't you? Hey, you should take this Quest! Collect as much as you like, and just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I've always thought the Jurassic Frontier must be a haven for gathering. Haven't you? Hey, you should take this Quest! Collect as much as you like, and just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you want to return.

name: Harvest Tour: Dunes
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I can see you're interested in stuff that can be gathered in the Dunes. I've got just the Quest for this eventuality! Go! And gather to your heart's content! Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done, and back you'll come.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I can see you're interested in stuff that can be gathered in the Dunes. I've got just the Quest for this eventuality! Go! And gather to your heart's content! Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done, and back you'll come.

name: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: You've got that wanting-to-gather- -stuff-in-the-Verdant-Hills look about you, if I ever saw it. Well, here's a Quest tailor-made for you! Go and gather till you drop. When you're done just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket to return!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: You've got that wanting-to-gather- -stuff-in-the-Verdant-Hills look about you, if I ever saw it. Well, here's a Quest tailor-made for you! Go and gather till you drop. When you're done just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket to return!

name: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Oh, I can see you're hankering to go a-gathering at the Arctic Ridge! Here's a Quest you'll love! Gather till your arms o'erflow, and when you can't carry anymore, deliver a Paw Pass Ticket.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Oh, I can see you're hankering to go a-gathering at the Arctic Ridge! Here's a Quest you'll love! Gather till your arms o'erflow, and when you can't carry anymore, deliver a Paw Pass Ticket.

name: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I have a Quest right here that will allow you to fulfill your long-cherished desire to gather on Misty Peaks. I know, you don't have to tell me! Who wouldn't want to gather in the Misty Peaks? Once you've had your fill of gathering, just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I have a Quest right here that will allow you to fulfill your long-cherished desire to gather on Misty Peaks. I know, you don't have to tell me! Who wouldn't want to gather in the Misty Peaks? Once you've had your fill of gathering, just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket.

name: Defiant Maccao
flavor: Um, excuse me, there's a Great Maccao up at Ruined Pinnacle, causing havoc. Came flying at me, so I fled. Beat me black and blue. Isn't it your job to keep the wildlife in line? Would you mind doing something about it? I mean seriously, I can't work like this.
flavor_zh: Um, excuse me, there's a Great Maccao up at Ruined Pinnacle, causing havoc. Came flying at me, so I fled. Beat me black and blue. Isn't it your job to keep the wildlife in line? Would you mind doing something about it? I mean seriously, I can't work like this.

name: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Breakfast
flavor: Ah, a nice Wyvern Egg would be just the thing for a royal breakfast. In fact, I'll probably be for the chop if I don't manage to lay my hands on one. If you could source a couple for me, I'll be sure to make it worth your while!
flavor_zh: Ah, a nice Wyvern Egg would be just the thing for a royal breakfast. In fact, I'll probably be for the chop if I don't manage to lay my hands on one. If you could source a couple for me, I'll be sure to make it worth your while!

name: Husk Hunter
flavor: You know, when comets stain the sky red, there are comet fragments to be had on the ground beneath! The Wycademy calls these Burned Husks, and they're important subjects for study. Do you think you can find us some at the Ruined Pinnacle?
flavor_zh: You know, when comets stain the sky red, there are comet fragments to be had on the ground beneath! The Wycademy calls these Burned Husks, and they're important subjects for study. Do you think you can find us some at the Ruined Pinnacle?

name: Dune the Honors
goal: Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Barroth
flavor: My liege lord certainly has a lot of possessions... All of them necessary, I'm sure, but they do slow things down a tad. Not to mention the Hermitaurs and Barroths that plague the Dunes! Could I prevail upon you to clear the way for us a smidgen?
goal_zh: 狩猎1只大名盾蟹和1头土砂龙
flavor_zh: My liege lord certainly has a lot of possessions... All of them necessary, I'm sure, but they do slow things down a tad. Not to mention the Hermitaurs and Barroths that plague the Dunes! Could I prevail upon you to clear the way for us a smidgen?

name: Eau de Congalala
flavor: Keep your distance! I got hit with a stink that could peel paint! A Congalala got me good when I went to the Jurassic Frontier. Seize the beast that dealt what I smelt, Hunter! I gotta get payback!
flavor_zh: Keep your distance! I got hit with a stink that could peel paint! A Congalala got me good when I went to the Jurassic Frontier. Seize the beast that dealt what I smelt, Hunter! I gotta get payback!

name: Bag a Barroth!
flavor: I've found the most fascinating specimen in the Dunes that I want you to trap! Even from far away I was able to spot some weird and wonderful behavioral patterns, so imagine what I can find up close! Oh, and naturally I'll let it go when I'm done.
flavor_zh: I've found the most fascinating specimen in the Dunes that I want you to trap! Even from far away I was able to spot some weird and wonderful behavioral patterns, so imagine what I can find up close! Oh, and naturally I'll let it go when I'm done.

name: Verdant Hills Horror
goal: Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and a Gypceros
flavor: So I was...ulp...after a Yian Kut-Ku in the Verdant Hills, then this...urk... Gypceros flew through the air. First a weird big-eared bird, then a weird poisonous bird... I can't take it! Somebody take 'em out so I can get back to normal... Ulp.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头怪鸟和1头毒怪鸟
flavor_zh: So I was...ulp...after a Yian Kut-Ku in the Verdant Hills, then this...urk... Gypceros flew through the air. First a weird big-eared bird, then a weird poisonous bird... I can't take it! Somebody take 'em out so I can get back to normal... Ulp.

name: Season's Eatings
flavor: Right. There are some seasonal ingredients in the Misty Peaks which are ripe for the taking. Naturally, two brutish Arzuros have to turn up and ruin everything. I need to grab the ingredients while they're fresh, so you need to fell those beasts.
flavor_zh: Right. There are some seasonal ingredients in the Misty Peaks which are ripe for the taking. Naturally, two brutish Arzuros have to turn up and ruin everything. I need to grab the ingredients while they're fresh, so you need to fell those beasts.

name: Harvest Tour: Jungle
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Looks like you're interested in the wonderful bounty of materials you can get in the Jungle. Well then, have I got just the Quest for you! Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Looks like you're interested in the wonderful bounty of materials you can get in the Jungle. Well then, have I got just the Quest for you! Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box to return at any time.

name: Perfectly Normal Rock
flavor: Bloomin' 'eck I got a right old surprise! I heard there was a big rock needin' movin' out in the Marshlands, but when I went to move it wi' my prodigious strength, turned out ter be a Basarios... I think this might be a job fer you!
flavor_zh: Bloomin' 'eck I got a right old surprise! I heard there was a big rock needin' movin' out in the Marshlands, but when I went to move it wi' my prodigious strength, turned out ter be a Basarios... I think this might be a job fer you!

name: Dazed and Confused
flavor: Malfestio's weird mojo got us all befuddled and we lost our way. We were lucky that we ran aground on the Ruined Pinnacle, to be honest. Could you hunt the Malfestio and make sure nobody else falls foul of it?
flavor_zh: Malfestio's weird mojo got us all befuddled and we lost our way. We were lucky that we ran aground on the Ruined Pinnacle, to be honest. Could you hunt the Malfestio and make sure nobody else falls foul of it?

name: Bloof!
flavor: Ahhh, I want to see one so badly. What? A Zamtrios, of course! What else would I want to see? One second it's spiky and mean, the next...BLOOF! Completely round! Hunt one down and I'll, er, just watch from the sidelines.
flavor_zh: Ahhh, I want to see one so badly. What? A Zamtrios, of course! What else would I want to see? One second it's spiky and mean, the next...BLOOF! Completely round! Hunt one down and I'll, er, just watch from the sidelines.

name: Khezu Deserve It
flavor: Oooof. Me shoulders are givin' me trouble again. You know what I need? One of them electric shock sacs. Yes, a nice electric massage should do the trick. Could you hunt me a Khezu at the Arctic Ridge?
flavor_zh: Oooof. Me shoulders are givin' me trouble again. You know what I need? One of them electric shock sacs. Yes, a nice electric massage should do the trick. Could you hunt me a Khezu at the Arctic Ridge?

name: Primal Forest Arachnids
flavor: I'm gonna do what I can as Pokke Chief to strengthen the Soaratorium and help mine ore! Thing is, the ore's hard to get, thanks to a little Nerscylla infestation in the Primal Forest. Sounds like a job for you, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I'm gonna do what I can as Pokke Chief to strengthen the Soaratorium and help mine ore! Thing is, the ore's hard to get, thanks to a little Nerscylla infestation in the Primal Forest. Sounds like a job for you, Hunter!

name: Grapes of Rathian
flavor: Oh, please hear me out! I was doing research at the Ruined Pinnacle, when I was set upon by a Rathian. If I can't finish my work, I won't be able to submit my report to my client before the deadline... Hunter, could you take care of that rotten Rathian for me?
name_zh: 飞翔于山岭间的雌火龙
flavor_zh: Oh, please hear me out! I was doing research at the Ruined Pinnacle, when I was set upon by a Rathian. If I can't finish my work, I won't be able to submit my report to my client before the deadline... Hunter, could you take care of that rotten Rathian for me?

name: It's Gonna Eat Me!
flavor: Hey, somethin' pretty bad's going down! I was out fishin' in the Desert, when some Nibelsnarf jerk shot out of the ground at me! Can't fish with one of those goofs hanging round. Take care of it for me, will ya? I'll see you right if you do!
flavor_zh: Hey, somethin' pretty bad's going down! I was out fishin' in the Desert, when some Nibelsnarf jerk shot out of the ground at me! Can't fish with one of those goofs hanging round. Take care of it for me, will ya? I'll see you right if you do!

name: Airship Upgrade: Plesioth
flavor: The Plesioth's ability to move quickly through the water could be used to enhance the Soaratorium. Rumor has it that there's one flitting about at the Ruined Pinnacle. Hunter, can you do the honors? Just take it down and we'll harvest the materials.
flavor_zh: The Plesioth's ability to move quickly through the water could be used to enhance the Soaratorium. Rumor has it that there's one flitting about at the Ruined Pinnacle. Hunter, can you do the honors? Just take it down and we'll harvest the materials.

name: Whiteout
flavor: Hey, Hunter! I got a message from a noble from my country, who's hemmed in by a Blangonga, and out of food and fuel. I need you to go and take care of that monstrosity. Can you help me, Hunter?
flavor_zh: Hey, Hunter! I got a message from a noble from my country, who's hemmed in by a Blangonga, and out of food and fuel. I need you to go and take care of that monstrosity. Can you help me, Hunter?

name: Airship Upgrade: Lavasioth
flavor: Lavasioth live in molten rock, so their shells are just the thing for insulating the outer parts of the Soaratorium. You're sure to find some up at the Volcano. If you take care of the hunting, we'll take care of the gathering!
flavor_zh: Lavasioth live in molten rock, so their shells are just the thing for insulating the outer parts of the Soaratorium. You're sure to find some up at the Volcano. If you take care of the hunting, we'll take care of the gathering!

name: Naked Aggression
flavor: There was a hunter in town walking about in only his drawers! Naturally I had to protect the townspeople, so I questioned him. He claims a Ceanataur ripped up his clothes! I need you to verify his claims, and eliminate the monster. If there is one.
flavor_zh: There was a hunter in town walking about in only his drawers! Naturally I had to protect the townspeople, so I questioned him. He claims a Ceanataur ripped up his clothes! I need you to verify his claims, and eliminate the monster. If there is one.

name: The Perils of Commerce
flavor: A Felyne helping my sister out has got himself in a bit of a pickle! At the Verdant Hills he gathered up some goods for her to sell, but stumbled into a Najarala's neighborhood! I don't like to press you, but could you come to the Felyne's rescue?
flavor_zh: A Felyne helping my sister out has got himself in a bit of a pickle! At the Verdant Hills he gathered up some goods for her to sell, but stumbled into a Najarala's neighborhood! I don't like to press you, but could you come to the Felyne's rescue?

name: Airship Upgrade: Nargacuga
flavor: The tough yet light scales of a Nargacuga are perfect for reinforcing the main and auxiliary engines! I've got reports of one tearing up the Jungle, so could you hunt it down? We'll take care of recovering what we need.
flavor_zh: The tough yet light scales of a Nargacuga are perfect for reinforcing the main and auxiliary engines! I've got reports of one tearing up the Jungle, so could you hunt it down? We'll take care of recovering what we need.

name: Wrong Bird, Idiots...
flavor: I've been under orders from the Guild to train up some youngsters. I thought it was high time they take on a Yian Kut-Ku, so I put out the request and what do I find? They went for a Yian Garuga instead. They're idiots, but I can't leave 'em be. Help out, eh?
flavor_zh: I've been under orders from the Guild to train up some youngsters. I thought it was high time they take on a Yian Kut-Ku, so I put out the request and what do I find? They went for a Yian Garuga instead. They're idiots, but I can't leave 'em be. Help out, eh?

name: A Trace of Light
flavor: My father used to travel the world, but ever since he went missing all I've had are the notes of all the adventures he used to have... But there's one note about glowing insects... I think he means Great Thunderbugs, and they might be a clue to finding him!
flavor_zh: My father used to travel the world, but ever since he went missing all I've had are the notes of all the adventures he used to have... But there's one note about glowing insects... I think he means Great Thunderbugs, and they might be a clue to finding him!

name: Shell Game
flavor: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Beautiful Shells you can find in the Jungle? How brilliantly shiny they are! Get me some and I'll bash 'em into round shapes, pass 'em off as pearls and watch the moolah roll in! ...Ahem, pretend you didn't hear that.
flavor_zh: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Beautiful Shells you can find in the Jungle? How brilliantly shiny they are! Get me some and I'll bash 'em into round shapes, pass 'em off as pearls and watch the moolah roll in! ...Ahem, pretend you didn't hear that.

name: It's Not Uragaan's, It's Mine!
flavor: Hiya Hunter! We got a bit of a problem here. It's volcano season, which is better than it sounds, because all the good ore comes out! Yay! Sadly, an Uragaan has come out too, and it's kinda terrorizing the miners! Can you help keep them safe?
name_zh: 现身酷暑之地的爆锤龙！
flavor_zh: Hiya Hunter! We got a bit of a problem here. It's volcano season, which is better than it sounds, because all the good ore comes out! Yay! Sadly, an Uragaan has come out too, and it's kinda terrorizing the miners! Can you help keep them safe?

name: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I can see that you're interested in what you can harvest from the Frozen Seaway. Am I right? Then take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I can see that you're interested in what you can harvest from the Frozen Seaway. Am I right? Then take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!

name: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Have you ever wondered what you can gather from the Volcanic Hollow? Me too! Lucky for you, here's the perfect Quest. Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and see what you found!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Have you ever wondered what you can gather from the Volcanic Hollow? Me too! Lucky for you, here's the perfect Quest. Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and see what you found!

name: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Aren't deserted islands great? All that data just lying around! Hey, if you're in the mood to gather stuff, take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Aren't deserted islands great? All that data just lying around! Hey, if you're in the mood to gather stuff, take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!

name: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Do you know what's awesome? Fieldwork! You agree, right? Of course! We're best friends! You should take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Do you know what's awesome? Fieldwork! You agree, right? Of course! We're best friends! You should take this Quest! Gather to your heart's content, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket from the Supply Box when you're ready to return and start sifting through your data!

name: Harvest Tour: Volcano
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Oh, you're just itching to go gathering at the Volcano, aren't you? I can tell from the look in your eyes. Well, you're in luck with this Quest! Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Oh, you're just itching to go gathering at the Volcano, aren't you? I can tell from the look in your eyes. Well, you're in luck with this Quest! Gather as much as you like, then deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done!

name: Mushroom for Improvement
flavor: We're doing some pretty important research here! Namely, how to make every mealtime delicious! That's why we need some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined Pinnacle. The Wycademy's future depends on it! I admit, it's an acquired taste...
flavor_zh: We're doing some pretty important research here! Namely, how to make every mealtime delicious! That's why we need some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined Pinnacle. The Wycademy's future depends on it! I admit, it's an acquired taste...

name: I See It Rollin'...
flavor: That stupid overgrown fanged tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just won't stop trundling around after me. If only there was some brave, strong hunter who could teach it a lesson once and for all... Oh...? You'll take care of it? Seriously? How sweet!
name_zh: 滚起来！一起滚！赤色牙兽
flavor_zh: That stupid overgrown fanged tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just won't stop trundling around after me. If only there was some brave, strong hunter who could teach it a lesson once and for all... Oh...? You'll take care of it? Seriously? How sweet!

name: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Lunch
flavor: Oh bother, I need to find some Wyvern Eggs before the royal luncheon! My position as Royal Cook is at steak! I mean stake! I mean-- look, can you just throw me a bone here? Preferably in egg form?
flavor_zh: Oh bother, I need to find some Wyvern Eggs before the royal luncheon! My position as Royal Cook is at steak! I mean stake! I mean-- look, can you just throw me a bone here? Preferably in egg form?

name: My New Life as a Maccao
goal: Hunt a Kecha Wacha and a Great Maccao
flavor: On the way to the Ancestral Steppe, I got noticed by a Kecha Wacha and a Great Maccao! Yikes! Luckily, I thought quickly and started jumping around pretending I was a monster too. I think it's working, but my legs are getting tired... Help me!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头奇猿狐和1头跳狗龙王
flavor_zh: On the way to the Ancestral Steppe, I got noticed by a Kecha Wacha and a Great Maccao! Yikes! Luckily, I thought quickly and started jumping around pretending I was a monster too. I think it's working, but my legs are getting tired... Help me!

name: Much Ado about Najarala
flavor: O Hunter strong in arm and weapon skill: Seek thou the Primal Forest's cunning serpent; And heed ye well the danger of his coils; That ye may capture this fell beast alive. And in the taking of thy monstrous prize, return thee here to sate my curious eyes.
flavor_zh: O Hunter strong in arm and weapon skill: Seek thou the Primal Forest's cunning serpent; And heed ye well the danger of his coils; That ye may capture this fell beast alive. And in the taking of thy monstrous prize, return thee here to sate my curious eyes.

name: A Seaway Just for You
flavor: My acquaintance says that hunters freeze up with happiness when they encounter their target. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind going to the Frozen Seaway to demonstrate for me?
flavor_zh: My acquaintance says that hunters freeze up with happiness when they encounter their target. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind going to the Frozen Seaway to demonstrate for me?

name: A Cure for Laziness
flavor: I don't wanna get outta bed... Mom yelled at me and the world sucks and no one understands how hard it is. But you know, if someone hunted an Uragaan in the Volcanic Hollow, I might be inspired to get outta bed. (Hehe, maybe if I'm not napping.)
name_zh: 对懒虫就该用爆锤龙呵斥！
flavor_zh: I don't wanna get outta bed... Mom yelled at me and the world sucks and no one understands how hard it is. But you know, if someone hunted an Uragaan in the Volcanic Hollow, I might be inspired to get outta bed. (Hehe, maybe if I'm not napping.)

name: The Furtilizer That Time Furgot
flavor: The trick to purrlantin' the best veggies, youngster, is not to skimp on the furtilizer! And do you know where the best furtilizer comes from? That's right: the Jurassic Frontier! Immortal moths, 'bout ten should do it. Watch out fur the Nargacuga though!
flavor_zh: The trick to purrlantin' the best veggies, youngster, is not to skimp on the furtilizer! And do you know where the best furtilizer comes from? That's right: the Jurassic Frontier! Immortal moths, 'bout ten should do it. Watch out fur the Nargacuga though!

name: Just Deserts
goal: Hunt a Nibelsnarf and a Cephadrome
flavor: Well, I say! I was crossing the Dunes when I was accosted by a Nibelsnarf and a Cephadrome! Not only was it jolly scary but now I'm simply COVERED in sand! I can't be seen in public like this! I say, are you in the revenge biz? Fancy slaying some monsters?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头潜口龙和1头砂龙王
flavor_zh: Well, I say! I was crossing the Dunes when I was accosted by a Nibelsnarf and a Cephadrome! Not only was it jolly scary but now I'm simply COVERED in sand! I can't be seen in public like this! I say, are you in the revenge biz? Fancy slaying some monsters?

name: Fishing's Lure
flavor: Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being a kid again! You should take a load off and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find a glimmer of the good ol' days in the glitter of water in the Misty Peaks!
flavor_zh: Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being a kid again! You should take a load off and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find a glimmer of the good ol' days in the glitter of water in the Misty Peaks!

name: A Royal Rumble
flavor: Pardon my discretion, my good hunter, but my liege lord -- who shall remain nameless -- desires a live queen of his own. I fear I am not up to the task, but I cannot refuse his request.
flavor_zh: Pardon my discretion, my good hunter, but my liege lord -- who shall remain nameless -- desires a live queen of his own. I fear I am not up to the task, but I cannot refuse his request.

name: The Way of the Nargacuga
flavor: I've just had a flash of inspurration for a new technique! But I'll need to take a look at the movements of a Nargacuga... Could you hunt one fur me? I'll watch you fight and that should give me all the refurence I need!
flavor_zh: I've just had a flash of inspurration for a new technique! But I'll need to take a look at the movements of a Nargacuga... Could you hunt one fur me? I'll watch you fight and that should give me all the refurence I need!

name: Deserted Island Missive
goal: Hunt a Malfestio and a Tetsucabra
flavor: This is my last hope. Been attacked by a Malfestio and Tetsucabra on Deserted Island. Am hiding in the forest. Have given this note to a friendly Moofah in the vain hope it'll end up in the right hands. Please help. And feed the Moofah, he's a good boy.
flavor_zh: This is my last hope. Been attacked by a Malfestio and Tetsucabra on Deserted Island. Am hiding in the forest. Have given this note to a friendly Moofah in the vain hope it'll end up in the right hands. Please help. And feed the Moofah, he's a good boy.

name: Marshlands Horror Story
goal: Hunt a Shogun Ceanataur and a Congalala
flavor: I was walking in the Marshlands when I smelled something really weird. I ran to a cave, but inside there was this strange dry rustling nearby and getting closer. And once it was directly above me, the sound stopped... -- Here the record ends --
goal_zh: 狩猎1只将军镰蟹和1头桃毛兽王
flavor_zh: I was walking in the Marshlands when I smelled something really weird. I ran to a cave, but inside there was this strange dry rustling nearby and getting closer. And once it was directly above me, the sound stopped... -- Here the record ends --

name: Volcanic Vexations
goal: Hunt a Basarios and an Iodrome
flavor: Don't you just hate it when two monsters pop up at once and throw you off your game? I mean, which one do you hunt first!? Anyway, I hate being decisive, so I'm gonna give YOU the chance to get decisive on them...permanently.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头岩龙和1头红速龙王
flavor_zh: Don't you just hate it when two monsters pop up at once and throw you off your game? I mean, which one do you hunt first!? Anyway, I hate being decisive, so I'm gonna give YOU the chance to get decisive on them...permanently.

name: Airship Upgrade: Barioth
flavor: Barioth maintain high levels of energy even in the coldest of environments. If we used the materials from a Barioth to reinforce our ship's hull, it should be able to withstand the extreme altitudes of the Ruined Pinnacle!
flavor_zh: Barioth maintain high levels of energy even in the coldest of environments. If we used the materials from a Barioth to reinforce our ship's hull, it should be able to withstand the extreme altitudes of the Ruined Pinnacle!

name: The Fly in the Ointment
flavor: We were investigating whether rumors of giant cooperative insects are true, and our specimens got away. They flew towards the Jungle. Rumors are true! Great day for science! Terrible day for scientists! HELP!
name_zh: 突击采访！追捕巨大甲虫！
flavor_zh: We were investigating whether rumors of giant cooperative insects are true, and our specimens got away. They flew towards the Jungle. Rumors are true! Great day for science! Terrible day for scientists! HELP!

name: You're under a Rath
flavor: Nyahoo! That's my stage name, dont'cha know! I had a spangly costume to go with it, but it got stolen. It'll be in Rathalos territory now... But it's okay -- my "totally platonic friend" is getting it back! So, can you hunt us the Rathalos?
flavor_zh: Nyahoo! That's my stage name, dont'cha know! I had a spangly costume to go with it, but it got stolen. It'll be in Rathalos territory now... But it's okay -- my "totally platonic friend" is getting it back! So, can you hunt us the Rathalos?

name: Lagiacrus x Width x Height
flavor: EUREKA! I have it! The volume of any object, no matter how large, can be gauged by how much water it displaces! Yes, even a Lagiacrus! Don't believe me? Then hunt me one and I'll prove it to you!
flavor_zh: EUREKA! I have it! The volume of any object, no matter how large, can be gauged by how much water it displaces! Yes, even a Lagiacrus! Don't believe me? Then hunt me one and I'll prove it to you!

name: Whatdunnit
flavor: A series of assaults on peddlers in the Jungle, each occurring on a cloudless day? With multiple reports of thunderous roaring and an eerie glow? The culprit you are looking for...is a Zinogre! And I shall prove it by having you hunt it!
flavor_zh: A series of assaults on peddlers in the Jungle, each occurring on a cloudless day? With multiple reports of thunderous roaring and an eerie glow? The culprit you are looking for...is a Zinogre! And I shall prove it by having you hunt it!

name: Wish upon a...Gravios?
flavor: Well, our able hands went off to look for this fallen star for you Wycademy folk, but it looks like we wound up aggravatin' a Gravios instead! Could ya lend 'em a hand? I'd help ya, kiddo, but I'm busy battling the lumbago myself!
flavor_zh: Well, our able hands went off to look for this fallen star for you Wycademy folk, but it looks like we wound up aggravatin' a Gravios instead! Could ya lend 'em a hand? I'd help ya, kiddo, but I'm busy battling the lumbago myself!

name: Man, Mizutsune Again?
flavor: Our prayers do not seem to have repelled these comets' dark designs. Once more, a Mizutsune threat has descended upon our village... You will not hesitate to remove this monster from our vicinity.
flavor_zh: Our prayers do not seem to have repelled these comets' dark designs. Once more, a Mizutsune threat has descended upon our village... You will not hesitate to remove this monster from our vicinity.

name: Alas, Astalos Again
flavor: Kokoto has a problem -- we got an Astalos on the asta-loose, and I need it to get asta-lost. I don't know if this is to do with those creepy ancient writings you guys found, but I do know you're the only Wycademy hunter around who can take care of it.
flavor_zh: Kokoto has a problem -- we got an Astalos on the asta-loose, and I need it to get asta-lost. I don't know if this is to do with those creepy ancient writings you guys found, but I do know you're the only Wycademy hunter around who can take care of it.

name: Groan, Gammoth Again
flavor: I had a bad feeling ever since that Valstrax monster showed up. And now here we are, with a rampaging Gammoth back to finish the job he started earlier... Hunter, I don't like my people being in danger. Can you hunt this Gammoth for me and Pokke?
flavor_zh: I had a bad feeling ever since that Valstrax monster showed up. And now here we are, with a rampaging Gammoth back to finish the job he started earlier... Hunter, I don't like my people being in danger. Can you hunt this Gammoth for me and Pokke?

name: Great, Glavenus Again
flavor: Well, Valstrax's coming promised despair and destruction and we're not being disappointed. Another Glavenus is back and terrorizing the Wycademy! We have no one else to rely on, I'm afraid, but we need to get this menace away from my village!
flavor_zh: Well, Valstrax's coming promised despair and destruction and we're not being disappointed. Another Glavenus is back and terrorizing the Wycademy! We have no one else to rely on, I'm afraid, but we need to get this menace away from my village!

name: You Had One Job
goal: Hunt an Agnaktor and a Lavasioth
flavor: Turns out those newbie hunters of mine have the worst luck I've ever seen. Sent them to hunt a Lavasioth and they end up aggravating an Agnaktor as well. I mean, they don't look even remotely the same, right? Is it just me? Anyway, can you help them out again?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头炎戈龙和1头熔岩龙
flavor_zh: Turns out those newbie hunters of mine have the worst luck I've ever seen. Sent them to hunt a Lavasioth and they end up aggravating an Agnaktor as well. I mean, they don't look even remotely the same, right? Is it just me? Anyway, can you help them out again?

name: Earn Your Gear
flavor: If you want new equipment...you have to prove...prove that you're strong enough... Duramboros...in the Marshlands... If you're not strong enough... you'll fail.
flavor_zh: If you want new equipment...you have to prove...prove that you're strong enough... Duramboros...in the Marshlands... If you're not strong enough... you'll fail.

name: Fearful Symmetry
flavor: Guah ha ha! We figured you might be interested in picking up some of our slack. It's a Tigrex hunt in the Desert. How about it, Scrawn? We'd go, but our bowels are moving in the opposite direction if ya know what I mean! Bah ha-- hurgh...
flavor_zh: Guah ha ha! We figured you might be interested in picking up some of our slack. It's a Tigrex hunt in the Desert. How about it, Scrawn? We'd go, but our bowels are moving in the opposite direction if ya know what I mean! Bah ha-- hurgh...

name: Impossible Standards
flavor: One night, as I left the ballroom, I saw through the mist a silvery creature... And how majestic it was! No dress could hope to match its beauty! Please, somebody hunt that wondrous beast and let me look upon its effulgent radiance again!
flavor_zh: One night, as I left the ballroom, I saw through the mist a silvery creature... And how majestic it was! No dress could hope to match its beauty! Please, somebody hunt that wondrous beast and let me look upon its effulgent radiance again!

name: Ruined and Tarnished
flavor: The Wycademy research team that went to the Ruined Pinnacle bumped into a Gore Magala! They're safe for now, but there's no telling for how long! Please, Hunter, you have to do something, for their sake!
flavor_zh: The Wycademy research team that went to the Ruined Pinnacle bumped into a Gore Magala! They're safe for now, but there's no telling for how long! Please, Hunter, you have to do something, for their sake!

name: Rathalos Topping
flavor: Calling all elite hunters! I'd like for you to hunt a Rathalos at the recently discovered location we call the Ruined Pinnacle. If it's not too much trouble, that is. And you don't have to be particularly elite either...
flavor_zh: Calling all elite hunters! I'd like for you to hunt a Rathalos at the recently discovered location we call the Ruined Pinnacle. If it's not too much trouble, that is. And you don't have to be particularly elite either...

name: Taming of the Zinogre
flavor: O Hunter sharp in mind and weapon true; Atop the Ruined Pinnacle it lies; A thund'rous beast with claws as sharp as steel, so proud and golden in its regal stride. Take it captive, Hunter, like my heart, and let its bloody splendor here impart.
flavor_zh: O Hunter sharp in mind and weapon true; Atop the Ruined Pinnacle it lies; A thund'rous beast with claws as sharp as steel, so proud and golden in its regal stride. Take it captive, Hunter, like my heart, and let its bloody splendor here impart.

name: Ore d'Oeuvres
flavor: Our team crash-landed on the Ruined Pinnacle, no thanks to a Gravios. Then it started eating our research samples because its primary food source is ore! Could you help us out here? It's actually embarrassing...
name_zh: 铠龙是很讲究的美食家？
flavor_zh: Our team crash-landed on the Ruined Pinnacle, no thanks to a Gravios. Then it started eating our research samples because its primary food source is ore! Could you help us out here? It's actually embarrassing...

name: Desert Death Duel
flavor: We set out in pursuit of new land to reclaim, when all of a sudden, THWAM! A Glavenus hit us out of nowhere. But come wind or city- leveling monster, we're not giving up our dream! Come, fellow settlers! Today, we make history!
flavor_zh: We set out in pursuit of new land to reclaim, when all of a sudden, THWAM! A Glavenus hit us out of nowhere. But come wind or city- leveling monster, we're not giving up our dream! Come, fellow settlers! Today, we make history!

name: Soap Opera
flavor: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please hunt the Mizutsune blocking our trade routes. I hope the reward is of interest to you. (Ugh, the stress. Once the market's back, I'm going on the BIGGEST shopping spree...)
flavor_zh: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please hunt the Mizutsune blocking our trade routes. I hope the reward is of interest to you. (Ugh, the stress. Once the market's back, I'm going on the BIGGEST shopping spree...)

name: Mt. Duramboros
flavor: I live to hike. To date, I've climbed to every mountain there is in the known world. But then my friend told me that the Duramboros is basically a moving mountain. She's right, of course. Now, I can't move mountains...but I believe you can, Hunter!
name_zh: 登上尾锤龙才算是登山达人
flavor_zh: I live to hike. To date, I've climbed to every mountain there is in the known world. But then my friend told me that the Duramboros is basically a moving mountain. She's right, of course. Now, I can't move mountains...but I believe you can, Hunter!

name: A Jungle Just for You
goal: Hunt a Yian Garuga and a Plesioth
flavor: My acquaintance says that hunters become awfully flustered when fighting two monsters at once. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. So, how about you jaunt along to the Jungle to demonstrate for me?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头黑狼鸟和1头水龙
flavor_zh: My acquaintance says that hunters become awfully flustered when fighting two monsters at once. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. So, how about you jaunt along to the Jungle to demonstrate for me?

name: Flappy Pest
flavor: Why does this keep happening!? Now there's a big flappy Astalos in the way of the ship! Just...argh! Well, good thing we can outmaneuver it. Quick, to the Ancestral Steppe! And steppe on it!
flavor_zh: Why does this keep happening!? Now there's a big flappy Astalos in the way of the ship! Just...argh! Well, good thing we can outmaneuver it. Quick, to the Ancestral Steppe! And steppe on it!

name: Pheromone Moans
flavor: Now, I was lookin' ta inspect me some bug pheromones so I could make my bees down at the apiary happy, but I need 'em fresh. Real fresh. I'm talkin' straight from the Seltas Queen. So I'd be real grateful if ya could rustle her up from the Primal Forest.
flavor_zh: Now, I was lookin' ta inspect me some bug pheromones so I could make my bees down at the apiary happy, but I need 'em fresh. Real fresh. I'm talkin' straight from the Seltas Queen. So I'd be real grateful if ya could rustle her up from the Primal Forest.

name: Primal Panic
flavor: Urgently requesting help in Primal Forest. Gore Magala identified near area frequented by villagers. Some injuries sustained. Immediate hunter action required.
name_zh: 来自原生林的救援请求
flavor_zh: Urgently requesting help in Primal Forest. Gore Magala identified near area frequented by villagers. Some injuries sustained. Immediate hunter action required.

name: Distress Signal
flavor: Mayday! Mayday! Anyone who can hear my voice, send help to the Primal Forest at once! A pair of Nerscylla have me in their web. Cripes, they're looking right at me! I'm in a sticky situation here!
name_zh: 消失在黑暗中的暗杀者们
flavor_zh: Mayday! Mayday! Anyone who can hear my voice, send help to the Primal Forest at once! A pair of Nerscylla have me in their web. Cripes, they're looking right at me! I'm in a sticky situation here!

name: Snow Joke
flavor: I got in a fight recently, and I kinda lost. But I heard that if you eat the snow off a Gammoth, you get super strong! I wanna be able to stomp around and make earthquakes too! Can you catch me a Gammoth, Hunter- person? Can you can you can you?
flavor_zh: I got in a fight recently, and I kinda lost. But I heard that if you eat the snow off a Gammoth, you get super strong! I wanna be able to stomp around and make earthquakes too! Can you catch me a Gammoth, Hunter- person? Can you can you can you?

name: Ruler of the Frozen Seaway
flavor: What I saw... It was like terror incarnate -- jaws wide open, lunging at a poor Popo. Just thinking about it stiffens my whiskers. Someone put an end to this nightmare!
flavor_zh: What I saw... It was like terror incarnate -- jaws wide open, lunging at a poor Popo. Just thinking about it stiffens my whiskers. Someone put an end to this nightmare!

name: An Ice Surprise
flavor: I was tearing up the tundra on my sled in the Frozen Seaway when these two Zamtrios leaped right through the ice. KRACK! I purractically jumped out of my fur! Can some brave hunter skate in to help?
flavor_zh: I was tearing up the tundra on my sled in the Frozen Seaway when these two Zamtrios leaped right through the ice. KRACK! I purractically jumped out of my fur! Can some brave hunter skate in to help?

name: Capture the Agnaktor
flavor: To understand the Agnaktor, you must understand the volcano. The two are inseparable. You must also understand the havoc it wreaks, and our duty to prevent it from reaching our homes. Yes, we suspect you're really going to need your wits about you for this one!
flavor_zh: To understand the Agnaktor, you must understand the volcano. The two are inseparable. You must also understand the havoc it wreaks, and our duty to prevent it from reaching our homes. Yes, we suspect you're really going to need your wits about you for this one!

name: Desert Double Act
goal: Hunt a Tigrex and a Volvidon
flavor: The Tigrex roars.  The Volvidon rolls. Two girls implore:  Please save our souls! Two Dune-bound hunts.  Two monsters slain. We know you can. So end their reign!
name_zh: 轰龙与赤甲兽的二重奏
goal_zh: 狩猎1头轰龙和1头赤甲兽
flavor_zh: The Tigrex roars.  The Volvidon rolls. Two girls implore:  Please save our souls! Two Dune-bound hunts.  Two monsters slain. We know you can. So end their reign!

name: Interruption: Eggstra Delivery
flavor: Oh what? She's charging off on another Quest and neglecting her Guild Gal duties? Well, I can't say it's a huge surprise. Can you please yank her out of trouble again? She's delivering Wyvern Eggs because she's insane. Sorry to ask this of you again...
flavor_zh: Oh what? She's charging off on another Quest and neglecting her Guild Gal duties? Well, I can't say it's a huge surprise. Can you please yank her out of trouble again? She's delivering Wyvern Eggs because she's insane. Sorry to ask this of you again...

name: Once upon a Barioth
flavor: I heard a legend when I was a kid of a ghostly wyvern, and I've been following that ghost all these years. My sleuthing tells me that it must live somewhere in a land of ice and snow... What I need you for is to capture it. I'll take care of the songwriting duties.
flavor_zh: I heard a legend when I was a kid of a ghostly wyvern, and I've been following that ghost all these years. My sleuthing tells me that it must live somewhere in a land of ice and snow... What I need you for is to capture it. I'll take care of the songwriting duties.

name: Snowball Skirmish
goal: Hunt a Blangonga and a Lagombi
flavor: Mi-hao, Hunter! I'm betting with the Wyverian merchant man about which is tougher: a snowball thrown by a Blangonga or one thrown by a Lagombi. Can you go to the Arctic Ridge and hunt them both, maybe take a few snowballs for the team? Miao!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头雪狮子王和1头白兔兽
flavor_zh: Mi-hao, Hunter! I'm betting with the Wyverian merchant man about which is tougher: a snowball thrown by a Blangonga or one thrown by a Lagombi. Can you go to the Arctic Ridge and hunt them both, maybe take a few snowballs for the team? Miao!

name: Sky Tribe: Rice to the Occasion
flavor: Ahoy! I'm thinking of treating the Soaratorium crew to our special Hunting Fleet Fisherman's Rice, and the stuff I need's on the Deserted Island. O' course, a Lagiacrus is lurking there too, so you'll need to take care of that. Cheers, pally!
flavor_zh: Ahoy! I'm thinking of treating the Soaratorium crew to our special Hunting Fleet Fisherman's Rice, and the stuff I need's on the Deserted Island. O' course, a Lagiacrus is lurking there too, so you'll need to take care of that. Cheers, pally!

name: My Kirin for a Horse
flavor: My meowster is a tad...deluded. He thinks he's this famous knight, you see. Just earlier he spied a Kirin, said, "that seems like a suitable mount" and tried to drag it off! Could you just slay it so he'll give up already?
name_zh: 骑士与古代森林的挑战
flavor_zh: My meowster is a tad...deluded. He thinks he's this famous knight, you see. Just earlier he spied a Kirin, said, "that seems like a suitable mount" and tried to drag it off! Could you just slay it so he'll give up already?

name: Disaster on the Steppes
flavor: I wandered into a Seltas nest while out looking for Herbs... I chased off an insect blocking my way, which angered a hungry Kecha Wacha... THEN I saw smoke far off and thought I was saved, but it was just Gore Magala scales! Help me, I'll do anything! Heeelp!
flavor_zh: I wandered into a Seltas nest while out looking for Herbs... I chased off an insect blocking my way, which angered a hungry Kecha Wacha... THEN I saw smoke far off and thought I was saved, but it was just Gore Magala scales! Help me, I'll do anything! Heeelp!

name: Jurassic Frontier Fracas
flavor: Seriously, what is up with the Jurassic Frontier these days? Monsters tearing about here, rolling all over there... How am I supposed to gather fresh ingredients for medicine with all this going on!? Do you reckon you could thin the numbers a little bit?
flavor_zh: Seriously, what is up with the Jurassic Frontier these days? Monsters tearing about here, rolling all over there... How am I supposed to gather fresh ingredients for medicine with all this going on!? Do you reckon you could thin the numbers a little bit?

name: Just a Mirage...?
flavor: You gotta come quick! I spotted a Gendrome in the Dunes, then a Barroth came out of a sandstorm, then I heard a roar and a Tigrex showed up! We don't have enough people to defend the settlement if they attack!
name_zh: 摇曳在旧沙漠中的海市蜃楼
flavor_zh: You gotta come quick! I spotted a Gendrome in the Dunes, then a Barroth came out of a sandstorm, then I heard a roar and a Tigrex showed up! We don't have enough people to defend the settlement if they attack!

name: Trouble Comes in Threes
flavor: We've got three very much unwanted visitors at our mine, in the form of an Iodrome, a Basarios and a Gravios! They started going crazy the moment they arrived, I feel like I'm watching a volcano erupting! Can you hotfoot it over here and help?
flavor_zh: We've got three very much unwanted visitors at our mine, in the form of an Iodrome, a Basarios and a Gravios! They started going crazy the moment they arrived, I feel like I'm watching a volcano erupting! Can you hotfoot it over here and help?

name: Thousand-Blade Brouhaha
flavor: E-erm... I'm just a novice, but I was in the Desert earlier trying to gather stuff... But there was this big Seregios flapping about and...well, let's just say it was a close call. I think maybe someone with a bit more skill should take care of it?
flavor_zh: E-erm... I'm just a novice, but I was in the Desert earlier trying to gather stuff... But there was this big Seregios flapping about and...well, let's just say it was a close call. I think maybe someone with a bit more skill should take care of it?

name: Duel With the Devil
flavor: Diablos regularly attack the border wall, but this time the Border Captain was injured! With the chain of command broken we had no choice but to withdraw. Somebody needs to deal with that Diablos!
flavor_zh: Diablos regularly attack the border wall, but this time the Border Captain was injured! With the chain of command broken we had no choice but to withdraw. Somebody needs to deal with that Diablos!

name: Bad Hair Day: Brachydios
flavor: Oh baby, I've found it: the burning inspiration I've been longing for! Let me give you a clue: It has an EXPLOSIVE pompadour. That's right, the Brachydios! Now go do that voodoo that you do!
flavor_zh: Oh baby, I've found it: the burning inspiration I've been longing for! Let me give you a clue: It has an EXPLOSIVE pompadour. That's right, the Brachydios! Now go do that voodoo that you do!

name: Wheel of Time
flavor: There's a song in my village of a traveler who traversed time itself. That traveler, it would seem, is an elder dragon. And it's homecoming time. Protect my home and my people, I beg of you.
flavor_zh: There's a song in my village of a traveler who traversed time itself. That traveler, it would seem, is an elder dragon. And it's homecoming time. Protect my home and my people, I beg of you.

name: Beware the Comet of Disaster
flavor: Friend, it's time to settle things with Valstrax! Each and every one of us will keep a close eye on you from the Soaratorium. Please...win this thing and come back alive!
name_zh: 赤色的灾祸彗星，为之颤栗吧
flavor_zh: Friend, it's time to settle things with Valstrax! Each and every one of us will keep a close eye on you from the Soaratorium. Please...win this thing and come back alive!

name: Roar of the Rajang
flavor: Memo to research team. Rajang sighted in the Desert. Subject previously considered too dangerous to apprehend, but research team now requested to proceed to Desert and engage with maximum available force.
flavor_zh: Memo to research team. Rajang sighted in the Desert. Subject previously considered too dangerous to apprehend, but research team now requested to proceed to Desert and engage with maximum available force.

name: Deviljho Food Cake
flavor: Please, someone help! A Deviljho's taken a liking to our family home and it won't stop eating things! If we can't get it away it'll swallow up the whole house, and my family's in there! I need it to bite the dust before it takes a big bite out of my house!
flavor_zh: Please, someone help! A Deviljho's taken a liking to our family home and it won't stop eating things! If we can't get it away it'll swallow up the whole house, and my family's in there! I need it to bite the dust before it takes a big bite out of my house!

name: Advanced: Steel Yourself
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
flavor: Hey, have you heard anything about this steel dragon doohickey in the Jungle? I need it. I need to make a sword out of a dragon. I've never needed anything more in my life. I also need you to take care of it while I pick up the materials, okay?
name_zh: 高难度：灾祸比钢铁更加坚硬
flavor_zh: Hey, have you heard anything about this steel dragon doohickey in the Jungle? I need it. I need to make a sword out of a dragon. I've never needed anything more in my life. I also need you to take care of it while I pick up the materials, okay?

name: Advanced: Empire of the Sun
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: Some of our hunters haven't shown up at their meeting point after finishing a hunt in the Desert. We've found traces of an explosion nearby, and fear the worst: Teostra. We need an experienced hunter to support the search efforts.
flavor_zh: Some of our hunters haven't shown up at their meeting point after finishing a hunt in the Desert. We've found traces of an explosion nearby, and fear the worst: Teostra. We need an experienced hunter to support the search efforts.

name: Advanced: Wrong One Silver
flavor: One of my little hunter newbies has gone off alone to hunt a Rathian. Well, he was totally ready for it. What he wasn't ready for was the Silver Rathalos that showed up instead. Were new hunters always this unlucky!? Please, pull him out of the fire!
flavor_zh: One of my little hunter newbies has gone off alone to hunt a Rathian. Well, he was totally ready for it. What he wasn't ready for was the Silver Rathalos that showed up instead. Were new hunters always this unlucky!? Please, pull him out of the fire!

name: Advanced: Heart of Gold
flavor: Okay, this is embarrassing, but I took this hunt to take care of a troublesome Gold Rathian. Thing is, when I found myself in front of her I was consumed by how beautiful her golden scales were and I couldn't do anything! Please, hide my shame! Hunt it for me!
name_zh: 高难度：她是闪耀的金火龙
flavor_zh: Okay, this is embarrassing, but I took this hunt to take care of a troublesome Gold Rathian. Thing is, when I found myself in front of her I was consumed by how beautiful her golden scales were and I couldn't do anything! Please, hide my shame! Hunt it for me!

name: King of Hellfire
flavor: Memo to research team. Researchers investigating Ingle Isle under threat from wild Akantor. Threat level extremely high. Research team requested to proceed to Ingle Isle with alacrity and eliminate the Akantor.
flavor_zh: Memo to research team. Researchers investigating Ingle Isle under threat from wild Akantor. Threat level extremely high. Research team requested to proceed to Ingle Isle with alacrity and eliminate the Akantor.

name: The Seat of a God
flavor: Memo to research team. Large-scale collapse of iceberg reported in Polar Field. Dragonwatch reports collapse due to nesting Ukanlos. Research team requested to remove Ukanlos using all force at their disposal.
name_zh: 崩塌吧――神明之座、天威之榻
flavor_zh: Memo to research team. Large-scale collapse of iceberg reported in Polar Field. Dragonwatch reports collapse due to nesting Ukanlos. Research team requested to remove Ukanlos using all force at their disposal.

name: Stormlord
flavor: Memo to research team. Amatsu sighted at Sacred Pinnacle. Reports of it already causing widespread storm damage in the area. Research team requested to proceed to Sacred Pinnacle and eliminate the threat.
flavor_zh: Memo to research team. Amatsu sighted at Sacred Pinnacle. Reports of it already causing widespread storm damage in the area. Research team requested to proceed to Sacred Pinnacle and eliminate the threat.

name: An Almost-Certainly-Fine Comet
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: Oh jeez, a comet fell in the Jurassic Frontier. I'll bet that's the omen of doom everyone's been talking about. I'm sure it's fine, but just in case it's some kind of ancient, vicious dragon, would you mind going to check up on it for me?
flavor_zh: Oh jeez, a comet fell in the Jurassic Frontier. I'll bet that's the omen of doom everyone's been talking about. I'm sure it's fine, but just in case it's some kind of ancient, vicious dragon, would you mind going to check up on it for me?

name: Turn That Frown Upside Down
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: I heard that a comet landed in the Frozen Seaway and thought it might finally be a bit of good news for me. But just my luck -- it turned out to be a merciless dragon from an ancient age. Great. Could you maybe...take care of it for me?
flavor_zh: I heard that a comet landed in the Frozen Seaway and thought it might finally be a bit of good news for me. But just my luck -- it turned out to be a merciless dragon from an ancient age. Great. Could you maybe...take care of it for me?

name: The Baleful Comet
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: "A baleful comet, crimson-bright:  the terrible Valstrax!  The hunter gathers all his might,  And seeks the monster's tracks-" Well? What are you waiting for? You heard the song! I can't finish it unless the hunter (that's you) actually goes!
flavor_zh: "A baleful comet, crimson-bright:  the terrible Valstrax!  The hunter gathers all his might,  And seeks the monster's tracks-" Well? What are you waiting for? You heard the song! I can't finish it unless the hunter (that's you) actually goes!

name: Grave Peril
flavor: Memo to the research team. Nakarkos sighted at Wyvern's End. All available hunters have been mobilized, but to no avail. Research team is requested to proceed to Wyvern's End and eliminate the threat.
flavor_zh: Memo to the research team. Nakarkos sighted at Wyvern's End. All available hunters have been mobilized, but to no avail. Research team is requested to proceed to Wyvern's End and eliminate the threat.

name: Advanced: Monster Hunter!
flavor: 'Tis truly a wondrous thing to encounter one of such might again. Upon completion of this final hunt, you may find your eyes opened to the true meaning of being a hunter.
flavor_zh: 'Tis truly a wondrous thing to encounter one of such might again. Upon completion of this final hunt, you may find your eyes opened to the true meaning of being a hunter.

name: Advanced: Proof of a Champion
flavor: Once upon a time, there was a hunter who sought to be honored as a champion above all others. Do you have the mettle to follow in their footsteps and prove that the spirit of the champion is alive today? Of course you do!
flavor_zh: Once upon a time, there was a hunter who sought to be honored as a champion above all others. Do you have the mettle to follow in their footsteps and prove that the spirit of the champion is alive today? Of course you do!

name: Advanced: Wycademy Challenge
flavor: This is the culmination of decades of work picking through ancient tomes and tablets and translating forgotten languages. There is a mystery at the heart of this world, Hunter, and we finally know where the key to it lies! Proceed there with haste!
name_zh: 高难度：来自龙历院的挑战书
flavor_zh: This is the culmination of decades of work picking through ancient tomes and tablets and translating forgotten languages. There is a mystery at the heart of this world, Hunter, and we finally know where the key to it lies! Proceed there with haste!

name: Advanced: Guild's Greatest Hit
flavor: I honestly never thought anybody could make it this far...but a hunter's journey never ends, and the trial I'm about to give you is just another bump in the road. There's nothing to fear; get to it and show me you have what it takes to succeed!
name_zh: 高难度：来自公会的考验
flavor_zh: I honestly never thought anybody could make it this far...but a hunter's journey never ends, and the trial I'm about to give you is just another bump in the road. There's nothing to fear; get to it and show me you have what it takes to succeed!

name: Deviljho Dispossession
flavor: The other merchants and I have been discussing how to source the stone from the Ruined Pinnacle. One of the *ahem* biggest barriers is a Deviljho roaming about. We just can't get near! Commerce demands you hunt the beast so we can get at the stone!
name_zh: 阻塞在无人山岭的恐暴龙
flavor_zh: The other merchants and I have been discussing how to source the stone from the Ruined Pinnacle. One of the *ahem* biggest barriers is a Deviljho roaming about. We just can't get near! Commerce demands you hunt the beast so we can get at the stone!

name: Red Dragon, Green Dragon
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: My mom's sick, and there's some herbs in the Ancestral Steppe that'll make her better! But I can't go 'cause a Rathalos and Rathian couple just built their nest there! Mom's gonna get worse if we don't do something! Please!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: My mom's sick, and there's some herbs in the Ancestral Steppe that'll make her better! But I can't go 'cause a Rathalos and Rathian couple just built their nest there! Mom's gonna get worse if we don't do something! Please!

name: Primal Panic
flavor: Urgently requesting help in Primal Forest. Rajang identified inflicting destruction on plants and animals alike. Whole ecosystem could be in danger. Immediate hunter action required.
name_zh: 来自原生林的救援请求
flavor_zh: Urgently requesting help in Primal Forest. Rajang identified inflicting destruction on plants and animals alike. Whole ecosystem could be in danger. Immediate hunter action required.

name: A Cure for Idleness
flavor: Dad's been flipping out at me, but I just can't put my mind to studying. I don't think I can concentrate until someone hunts down a Seregios at the Volcanic Hollow for me... (Ha! I'll never have to study now!)
name_zh: 对懒惰就该用千刃龙呵斥！
flavor_zh: Dad's been flipping out at me, but I just can't put my mind to studying. I don't think I can concentrate until someone hunts down a Seregios at the Volcanic Hollow for me... (Ha! I'll never have to study now!)

name: Bring Me My Sword
flavor: Ah, nary a soul who undertook this Quest has returned in success. It's truly tragic that none are up to the task in this day and age. What's the world coming to! Surely, there must be one who will step up to the challenge?
flavor_zh: Ah, nary a soul who undertook this Quest has returned in success. It's truly tragic that none are up to the task in this day and age. What's the world coming to! Surely, there must be one who will step up to the challenge?

name: Horned and Dangerous
flavor: We've confirmed a sighting of the winged, twin-horned Diablos from the watchtower. A caravan will be passing by there soon, too, and it'll be a real mess if they encounter that beast. Can you capture it and make the Dunes safe for commerce?
flavor_zh: We've confirmed a sighting of the winged, twin-horned Diablos from the watchtower. A caravan will be passing by there soon, too, and it'll be a real mess if they encounter that beast. Can you capture it and make the Dunes safe for commerce?

name: Barioth's Blizzard
flavor: Indeed, it was a strange thing. A pair of white devils at the Arctic Ridge... A pair, can you believe! We sent out a party to take care of them, but only one made it back. Someone else can take this job. I don't get paid enough for this...
name_zh: 飞驰在雪山中的白色疾风！
flavor_zh: Indeed, it was a strange thing. A pair of white devils at the Arctic Ridge... A pair, can you believe! We sent out a party to take care of them, but only one made it back. Someone else can take this job. I don't get paid enough for this...

name: Bag a Brachydios
flavor: We've been researching the Brachydios for some time now, but it's still a creature draped in mystery. However, one thing of which we can be certain, is that it's a totally unique beast. Could you capture one for us so that we can press closer to its enigma?
name_zh: 粉骨碎龙捕获计划，准备就绪！
flavor_zh: We've been researching the Brachydios for some time now, but it's still a creature draped in mystery. However, one thing of which we can be certain, is that it's a totally unique beast. Could you capture one for us so that we can press closer to its enigma?

name: Blazing Black of a Dark God
flavor: Memo to research team. Unforeseen disaster occurred, total destruction of area imminent without Wycademy intervention. Proceed to Ingle Isle immediately to render aid.
flavor_zh: Memo to research team. Unforeseen disaster occurred, total destruction of area imminent without Wycademy intervention. Proceed to Ingle Isle immediately to render aid.

name: Advanced: Ranging Rathalos
flavor: Been gettin' word of a Rathalos circling the Verdant Hills, and this one's way stronger than your average Rathalos... Eventually it's gonna approach the village, so I want you to take it out before it causes any damage. Got it?
name_zh: 高难度：盘旋于山林的火龙
flavor_zh: Been gettin' word of a Rathalos circling the Verdant Hills, and this one's way stronger than your average Rathalos... Eventually it's gonna approach the village, so I want you to take it out before it causes any damage. Got it?

name: Advanced: Roaring in the Ridge
flavor: I've got a report that says a Tigrex was spotted at the summit of the Arctic Ridge, and this one's much stronger than your average specimen. Everybody in the village still has all their body parts, but that doesn't mean we're not still in danger.
name_zh: 高难度：伫立于雪山之巅的轰龙
flavor_zh: I've got a report that says a Tigrex was spotted at the summit of the Arctic Ridge, and this one's much stronger than your average specimen. Everybody in the village still has all their body parts, but that doesn't mean we're not still in danger.

name: Advanced: Moonlight Zinogre
flavor: There is a Zinogre in the Misty Peaks whose power, I'm told, is much greater than that of a regular specimen. It may be most dangerous, but you would be honored to eliminate it and keep the villagers safe from harm.
name_zh: 高难度：仰望月夜的雷狼龙
flavor_zh: There is a Zinogre in the Misty Peaks whose power, I'm told, is much greater than that of a regular specimen. It may be most dangerous, but you would be honored to eliminate it and keep the villagers safe from harm.

name: Advanced: Trial at the Pinnacle
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: Hoi, youngster! I can tell you about a place nobody else knows. There the golden sun and silver moon are always shining day and night, and visitors encounter a trial the likes of which they've never seen before! So, wanna give it a shot? Hehehehe...
name_zh: 高难度：无人山岭的考验
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: Hoi, youngster! I can tell you about a place nobody else knows. There the golden sun and silver moon are always shining day and night, and visitors encounter a trial the likes of which they've never seen before! So, wanna give it a shot? Hehehehe...

name: Advanced: Karma Chameleos
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: You might think it's impossible to fight an enemy you can't see, youngster, but I'm here to tell you that's not the case! You gotta connect with your life force. Use the eyes in your heart... And then...SMASH IT WITH EVERYTHING YOU'VE GOT! SMASH SMASH SMASH!
flavor_zh: You might think it's impossible to fight an enemy you can't see, youngster, but I'm here to tell you that's not the case! You gotta connect with your life force. Use the eyes in your heart... And then...SMASH IT WITH EVERYTHING YOU'VE GOT! SMASH SMASH SMASH!

name: Coalition of Chaos
flavor: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please rid us of the scourges destroying our fields. Our foes number three. A Gypceros, a Rathian, and a Yian Garuga. (Ugh, the stress. Once this is over I'm going to take a nice stroll through the fields.)
name_zh: 领主的委托～大型连续篇～
flavor_zh: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please rid us of the scourges destroying our fields. Our foes number three. A Gypceros, a Rathian, and a Yian Garuga. (Ugh, the stress. Once this is over I'm going to take a nice stroll through the fields.)

name: Verdant Hills Just for You
flavor: My acquaintance says hunters cry with happiness whenever they find new prey. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind going to the Verdant Hills to demonstrate for me?
flavor_zh: My acquaintance says hunters cry with happiness whenever they find new prey. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind going to the Verdant Hills to demonstrate for me?

name: Misty Peaks Missive
flavor: Expedition ruined. Attacked by Royal Ludroth and Plesioth, blown by Duramboros tail into the heart of the Misty Peaks. Have entrusted this note to a friendly Gargwa in the vain hope that it falls into friendly hands. Worst expedition.
flavor_zh: Expedition ruined. Attacked by Royal Ludroth and Plesioth, blown by Duramboros tail into the heart of the Misty Peaks. Have entrusted this note to a friendly Gargwa in the vain hope that it falls into friendly hands. Worst expedition.

name: Deserted Islands Horror
flavor: One day as I was on my way to the Deserted Island I heard thunder from a cloudless sky. An unsettling blue light leached color from the forest... What was that sound? ...So sleepy... -- Here the record ends --
flavor_zh: One day as I was on my way to the Deserted Island I heard thunder from a cloudless sky. An unsettling blue light leached color from the forest... What was that sound? ...So sleepy... -- Here the record ends --

name: The Marshlands Morass
flavor: While researching in the Marshlands I was attacked by a Congalala, so I ran for it! I felt a tug on my foot and knew I was done for. I find myself caught up in a shadowy spider web. And then I hear slithering all around me. Well, out of the frying pan, into the fire...
flavor_zh: While researching in the Marshlands I was attacked by a Congalala, so I ran for it! I felt a tug on my foot and knew I was done for. I find myself caught up in a shadowy spider web. And then I hear slithering all around me. Well, out of the frying pan, into the fire...

name: Advanced: Jurassic Pair
flavor: A Glavenus has been sighted at the Jurassic Frontier. According to the observatory, the frontier's been seeing many more formidable monsters than usual. There are also reports of a Yian Garuga up there. A tough pair, no doubt... But if anyone can do it, you can!
name_zh: 高难度：出现在古代森林的2头黑影
flavor_zh: A Glavenus has been sighted at the Jurassic Frontier. According to the observatory, the frontier's been seeing many more formidable monsters than usual. There are also reports of a Yian Garuga up there. A tough pair, no doubt... But if anyone can do it, you can!

name: Advanced: Quarrel Quelling
flavor: Are you kidding!? I finally found all the paperwork and they're telling me the trading route into the village has been buried in an avalanche? Now I can't get that delivery of wood to fix the broken roofs! Stop those pesky monsters from fighting and causing avalanches!
name_zh: 高难度：劝架能够拯救村庄
flavor_zh: Are you kidding!? I finally found all the paperwork and they're telling me the trading route into the village has been buried in an avalanche? Now I can't get that delivery of wood to fix the broken roofs! Stop those pesky monsters from fighting and causing avalanches!

name: Beware the Comet of Disaster
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: Friend, it's time to finally settle things with Valstrax! Each and every one of us will keep a close eye on you from the Soaratorium. Please...win this thing and come back alive!
name_zh: 赤色的灾祸彗星，为之颤栗吧
flavor_zh: Friend, it's time to finally settle things with Valstrax! Each and every one of us will keep a close eye on you from the Soaratorium. Please...win this thing and come back alive!

name: Wyvern Egg Delivery: Dinner
flavor: I have an urgent request! If I do not serve Herbivore Eggs at the upcoming banquet, I'll be fired -- as in literally set on fire! Save me from becoming the main course and you'll be amply rewarded!
flavor_zh: I have an urgent request! If I do not serve Herbivore Eggs at the upcoming banquet, I'll be fired -- as in literally set on fire! Save me from becoming the main course and you'll be amply rewarded!

name: Advanced: Ultimate Generation
flavor: When suitable challengers have appeared, the gate will be opened. The ones you will face are overwhelmingly powerful and fierce. It will be a true test of strength. Take heart, and with weapon in hand, step forth, Hunter. Onwards!
