flavor_zh: When suitable challengers have appeared, the gate will be opened. The ones you will face are overwhelmingly powerful and fierce. It will be a true test of strength. Take heart, and with weapon in hand, step forth, Hunter. Onwards!

name: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Jurassic Frontier, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Jurassic Frontier, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Harvest Tour: Dunes
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Dunes, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Dunes, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Verdant Hills, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Verdant Hills, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Arctic Ridge, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Arctic Ridge, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Misty Peaks, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Misty Peaks, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Boot to the Head
flavor: Ever taken a jump kick from a Great Maccao? I have! It nailed me, but I got up and wrecked it hard! You jelly? If you think you can do the same, then let me see what you got!
flavor_zh: Ever taken a jump kick from a Great Maccao? I have! It nailed me, but I got up and wrecked it hard! You jelly? If you think you can do the same, then let me see what you got!

name: Tackling the Tetsucabra
flavor: Rock hard! That just about sums up what it's like to fight that thing and see your attacks bounce off those boulders it digs up... I give up! How about you, though? Up for a challenge?
flavor_zh: Rock hard! That just about sums up what it's like to fight that thing and see your attacks bounce off those boulders it digs up... I give up! How about you, though? Up for a challenge?

name: Lost in the Jurassic Frontier
flavor: My luck is so bad lately. First a Gypceros swipes my Book of Combos, and then a Melynx runs off with my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna have to quit hunting! Can you help me out here!?
flavor_zh: My luck is so bad lately. First a Gypceros swipes my Book of Combos, and then a Melynx runs off with my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna have to quit hunting! Can you help me out here!?

name: Red-Faced Ruffians
flavor: I was taking a walk when a herd of Maccao surrounded me! Those blood-red faces... I was left catatonic for days! I'm too afraid to go out on walks now. Could you purrlease help me, Hunter?
flavor_zh: I was taking a walk when a herd of Maccao surrounded me! Those blood-red faces... I was left catatonic for days! I'm too afraid to go out on walks now. Could you purrlease help me, Hunter?

name: A Fern is Forever
flavor: A Wycademy kiddo found *hiccup* a boutique urn... I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern! It's bitter, yet sweet, which would go great with my nightly tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and nab me some of them, won't ya?
name_zh: 在紫萁菜肴中感受古风
flavor_zh: A Wycademy kiddo found *hiccup* a boutique urn... I mean a *hiccup* Unique Fern! It's bitter, yet sweet, which would go great with my nightly tipple. *hiccup* Be a pal and nab me some of them, won't ya?

name: Gendrome Roadblock
flavor: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!
flavor_zh: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!

name: In Pursuit of the Sand Wyvern
flavor: When a Cephadrome shows up somewhere, a bunch of Cephalos follow suit and wreak havoc on our trade routes! If you take out the Cephadrome, that should get rid of the lot of 'em!
flavor_zh: When a Cephadrome shows up somewhere, a bunch of Cephalos follow suit and wreak havoc on our trade routes! If you take out the Cephadrome, that should get rid of the lot of 'em!

name: Shells of Steel
flavor: I hate to ask hunters for help, but there's a huge Hermitaur out in the Dunes that just won't go down nicely. No matter what I do, I can't hurt it. I need you to go after it for me.
flavor_zh: I hate to ask hunters for help, but there's a huge Hermitaur out in the Dunes that just won't go down nicely. No matter what I do, I can't hurt it. I need you to go after it for me.

name: Hermitaur Party
flavor: Hermitaurs are getting to be a real pain... They wait in the sand to ambush us traders, and we can't get anything done! Help us out! Careful, though: A Daimyo Hermitaur's been sighted, too!
flavor_zh: Hermitaurs are getting to be a real pain... They wait in the sand to ambush us traders, and we can't get anything done! Help us out! Careful, though: A Daimyo Hermitaur's been sighted, too!

name: Ingredient Hunter
flavor: I can see the desire in your eyes... The desire for new ingredients, miao! If you purrcure some Tropical Berries for me, I'll paw over some of my special ingredients!
flavor_zh: I can see the desire in your eyes... The desire for new ingredients, miao! If you purrcure some Tropical Berries for me, I'll paw over some of my special ingredients!

name: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
flavor: My wife was in the Verdant Hills, picking some of my favorite mushrooms, when she was almost attacked by some wyverns! Please, make the woods safe for her again!
flavor_zh: My wife was in the Verdant Hills, picking some of my favorite mushrooms, when she was almost attacked by some wyverns! Please, make the woods safe for her again!

name: Local Threat
flavor: Yian Kut-Ku have been going after people all over the place, and during my patrol earlier, I spotted one wandering close to town. That curious bugger must be after some Konchu. Can you get rid of it?
flavor_zh: Yian Kut-Ku have been going after people all over the place, and during my patrol earlier, I spotted one wandering close to town. That curious bugger must be after some Konchu. Can you get rid of it?

name: Financial Focus on Fungus
flavor: Mushrooms from the Verdant Hills are suddenly in high demand. If you gather me 20, I'll give you a cut of the profits. Oh, I heard that Gypceros hang around there, so stay sharp!
flavor_zh: Mushrooms from the Verdant Hills are suddenly in high demand. If you gather me 20, I'll give you a cut of the profits. Oh, I heard that Gypceros hang around there, so stay sharp!

name: Farming Frustrations
flavor: The Velociprey that live up in them there Verdant Hills are a real annoyance, going after our livestock and just being downright ornery. Put a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya? Just be careful of their boss!
flavor_zh: The Velociprey that live up in them there Verdant Hills are a real annoyance, going after our livestock and just being downright ornery. Put a hurtin' on 20 fer me, will ya? Just be careful of their boss!

name: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
flavor: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]
flavor_zh: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]

name: Preying on Giaprey
flavor: I've got bad news: A pack of Giaprey is going after our villagers and they need to be stopped! If some kind hunter is up for taking out 20 of the beasts, that'd be great!
flavor_zh: I've got bad news: A pack of Giaprey is going after our villagers and they need to be stopped! If some kind hunter is up for taking out 20 of the beasts, that'd be great!

name: Special Home Brew
flavor: My artisanal home brews steeped in Mountain Herbs are the epitome of liquid refreshment! I want to make more, but I've run out of herbs! I need a refill stat, so go pick me 20, okay?
flavor_zh: My artisanal home brews steeped in Mountain Herbs are the epitome of liquid refreshment! I want to make more, but I've run out of herbs! I need a refill stat, so go pick me 20, okay?

name: Bulldrome of the Peaks
flavor: Gah! I was on my way back from some nice hot springs when BAM! I'm surrounded by Bulldrome -- angry ones! Visiting the inside of a gullet wasn't on my itinerary! Help get me outta here!
flavor_zh: Gah! I was on my way back from some nice hot springs when BAM! I'm surrounded by Bulldrome -- angry ones! Visiting the inside of a gullet wasn't on my itinerary! Help get me outta here!

name: The Ingredient of Legend
flavor: I have tracked down a legendary ingredient in ze Misty Peaks! Keep ze Arzuros busy, and I will purrcure ze ingredient! Then we will be un paw de plus to a legendary dish!
name_zh: 制作传说中菜式的必需品
flavor_zh: I have tracked down a legendary ingredient in ze Misty Peaks! Keep ze Arzuros busy, and I will purrcure ze ingredient! Then we will be un paw de plus to a legendary dish!

name: Royal Spit Take
flavor: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!
flavor_zh: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!

name: A Mother's Woes
flavor: My son can't stop wetting the bed! I figure I can at least stop having to dry his sheets every day if I can make a cover out of absorbent Ludroth parts... Please get some for me!
flavor_zh: My son can't stop wetting the bed! I figure I can at least stop having to dry his sheets every day if I can make a cover out of absorbent Ludroth parts... Please get some for me!

name: Jaggi Junket
flavor: Are you going to the Misty Peaks? How about we make it interesting, and see how many Jaggi you can slay? I like to make all my retainers compete that way. Come on, it'll be fun!
flavor_zh: Are you going to the Misty Peaks? How about we make it interesting, and see how many Jaggi you can slay? I like to make all my retainers compete that way. Come on, it'll be fun!

name: The Next Best Thing
flavor: My sweetheart just adores flowers, so it came to me: Why not give him a Balm- stone? The scent of flowers in your pocket! You must find me one! But, I suppose pieces would do just as well.
flavor_zh: My sweetheart just adores flowers, so it came to me: Why not give him a Balm- stone? The scent of flowers in your pocket! You must find me one! But, I suppose pieces would do just as well.

name: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering at the Deserted Island? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come home.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering at the Deserted Island? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come home.

name: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Marshlands, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Marshlands, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Insomnia? Meet Hypnotism
flavor: My husband's got insomnia. Over the years, I've tried knocking him out to get him to sleep, but it turned out that's not a great idea... So I want you to capture a Malfestio to hypnotize him!
name_zh: 催眠治疗法送给失眠的你
flavor_zh: My husband's got insomnia. Over the years, I've tried knocking him out to get him to sleep, but it turned out that's not a great idea... So I want you to capture a Malfestio to hypnotize him!

name: Walk 'n Roll
flavor: At times a ball of crimson, at times a lumbering, four- legged beast -- one of the Frontier's many terrors: Volvidon! Go now, young hunter. You know what to do!
flavor_zh: At times a ball of crimson, at times a lumbering, four- legged beast -- one of the Frontier's many terrors: Volvidon! Go now, young hunter. You know what to do!

name: Rocking Rhenoplos
goal: Slay 10 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: The people here are gettin' rammed by Rhenoplos whenever they leave the village. They told me to take care of them, but you look strong enough. Go hunt some for me!
goal_zh: 讨伐数量达到10只后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: The people here are gettin' rammed by Rhenoplos whenever they leave the village. They told me to take care of them, but you look strong enough. Go hunt some for me!

name: The Desert Gourmand
flavor: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!
flavor_zh: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

name: Tongue-Tied
flavor: Yo, Hunter! Long tongues are weird, y'know what I'm sayin'? Especially Volvidon ones! But, y'know, it'd be interesting to see just how long they can get... I know! Go capture me one!
flavor_zh: Yo, Hunter! Long tongues are weird, y'know what I'm sayin'? Especially Volvidon ones! But, y'know, it'd be interesting to see just how long they can get... I know! Go capture me one!

name: The Poison-fanged Duo
flavor: Two new alphas joined the Genprey in the Dunes, and now the whole pack of 'em are acting up, and people are gettin' attacked! Time to downsize these bosses -- go wipe the pair out!
flavor_zh: Two new alphas joined the Genprey in the Dunes, and now the whole pack of 'em are acting up, and people are gettin' attacked! Time to downsize these bosses -- go wipe the pair out!

name: Konchu Collector
flavor: The Konchu is a most fascinating creature -- a bug of many metamorphoses! Attack it and watch it switch into defensive mode for evasive action. I need more specimens for my research!
flavor_zh: The Konchu is a most fascinating creature -- a bug of many metamorphoses! Attack it and watch it switch into defensive mode for evasive action. I need more specimens for my research!

name: Liver of Legend!
flavor: While doing some business out in the Dunes, I heard about a route where livers go for a really high price. I can't ignore the scent of zenny to be made, so hurry and get me eight livers.
flavor_zh: While doing some business out in the Dunes, I heard about a route where livers go for a really high price. I can't ignore the scent of zenny to be made, so hurry and get me eight livers.

name: Noise Violation
flavor: The Najarala around the village is making some pawful sounds! Does it think it's some kind of mewsician? Hunter, make it shut up before it drives me up the wall!
flavor_zh: The Najarala around the village is making some pawful sounds! Does it think it's some kind of mewsician? Hunter, make it shut up before it drives me up the wall!

name: In Search of the Yian Garuga
flavor: In researching the mysteries of the Garuga King, I've come to the theory that the Yian Garuga is the key to solving it all. Hunt me one, and your name will go down in history! Under mine, of course.
flavor_zh: In researching the mysteries of the Garuga King, I've come to the theory that the Yian Garuga is the key to solving it all. Hunt me one, and your name will go down in history! Under mine, of course.

name: Finishing the Job
flavor: My appurrentice in Pokke Village is in fur a world of trouble! Can't even beat a Velociprey, and she agreed to hunt Velocidrome -- two! To avoid catastrophe, can you go hunt them instead?
flavor_zh: My appurrentice in Pokke Village is in fur a world of trouble! Can't even beat a Velociprey, and she agreed to hunt Velocidrome -- two! To avoid catastrophe, can you go hunt them instead?

name: Fresh is Best
flavor: I need you to procure some groceries for me. To be specific, I want meat, and you can get plenty off some Bullfango. Think you can go to the Verdant Hills and hunt me 20 of them?
name_zh: 食材的价值在于新鲜度
flavor_zh: I need you to procure some groceries for me. To be specific, I want meat, and you can get plenty off some Bullfango. Think you can go to the Verdant Hills and hunt me 20 of them?

name: The Shadow in the Mountains
flavor: We were up in the Arctic Ridge -- doing a little research -- when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!
flavor_zh: We were up in the Arctic Ridge -- doing a little research -- when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!

name: The New Tenant
flavor: A Blangonga has taken up residence in the Arctic Ridge, which spells trouble for us being able to gather firewood. Hurry and take that ugly ape out before we freeze to death!
flavor_zh: A Blangonga has taken up residence in the Arctic Ridge, which spells trouble for us being able to gather firewood. Hurry and take that ugly ape out before we freeze to death!

name: Blango Slaying Tactics
flavor: Blango Pelts have so many great uses. In particular, their insulation properties keep you toasty in snow! So could you hunt me 20 Blangos? Thanks! Oh, and watch out for Bulldrome!
flavor_zh: Blango Pelts have so many great uses. In particular, their insulation properties keep you toasty in snow! So could you hunt me 20 Blangos? Thanks! Oh, and watch out for Bulldrome!

name: Operation: Secure Specimen
flavor: My boss from hell is making me write up a report on Nargacuga eating habits! No way can I do that on my own! Can you go capture one for me, Hunter? I'll... I'll get the cage ready!
flavor_zh: My boss from hell is making me write up a report on Nargacuga eating habits! No way can I do that on my own! Can you go capture one for me, Hunter? I'll... I'll get the cage ready!

name: Royal Assassination
flavor: The Misty Peaks aren't safe for normal travelers now that a Rathian's built her nest there. Can you do something about her so people like me can pass through there in peace!?
flavor_zh: The Misty Peaks aren't safe for normal travelers now that a Rathian's built her nest there. Can you do something about her so people like me can pass through there in peace!?

name: Ahoy! Royal Ludroth!
flavor: Shimpai... I worried because no hear word from Felyne carrying Neko's luggage! If it met Royal Ludroth, all that water would... Taihen! Please shuryo them! "Shuryo" means hunt!
flavor_zh: Shimpai... I worried because no hear word from Felyne carrying Neko's luggage! If it met Royal Ludroth, all that water would... Taihen! Please shuryo them! "Shuryo" means hunt!

name: Bye Bye Jaggia
flavor: Jaggi are awful, am I right? Well, Jaggia are even worse! And now a gang of 'em are terrorizing the Misty Peaks! Please, put a stop to them before they come ruin our crops!
flavor_zh: Jaggi are awful, am I right? Well, Jaggia are even worse! And now a gang of 'em are terrorizing the Misty Peaks! Please, put a stop to them before they come ruin our crops!

name: Malfestio Festival
flavor: selacs s'oitseflaM !gnizamA lortnoc esol uoy ekam yllaer tsum ylpmis I !ydob ruoy fo ,esaelP !selpmas erom evah !em rof emos hctef ...Though the effects seem to be short-lived. *sigh*
flavor_zh: selacs s'oitseflaM !gnizamA lortnoc esol uoy ekam yllaer tsum ylpmis I !ydob ruoy fo ,esaelP !selpmas erom evah !em rof emos hctef ...Though the effects seem to be short-lived. *sigh*

name: Wyvern of the Wind
flavor: The Nargacuga out on the Deserted Island is scarily fast. Blink and you'll miss it. But, Hunter, it's gotta go! There's nothing more important right now than hunting it, so get to it!
flavor_zh: The Nargacuga out on the Deserted Island is scarily fast. Blink and you'll miss it. But, Hunter, it's gotta go! There's nothing more important right now than hunting it, so get to it!

name: Tetsucabra Bounty
flavor: Oh, the horror! Oh, the zenny! Apparently, a Tetsucabra is making a mess of some newly developed land. Big reward on its head, I hear. Help me and we'll split it fifty-fifty!
flavor_zh: Oh, the horror! Oh, the zenny! Apparently, a Tetsucabra is making a mess of some newly developed land. Big reward on its head, I hear. Help me and we'll split it fifty-fifty!

name: Deserted Island Dustup
flavor: I'm reporting live from the Deserted Island, where two Arzuros have decided to discuss their differences like civilized monsters. Oh, who am I kidding? Run for your lives! Women and reporters first!
flavor_zh: I'm reporting live from the Deserted Island, where two Arzuros have decided to discuss their differences like civilized monsters. Oh, who am I kidding? Run for your lives! Women and reporters first!

name: Bnahabra Bloodbath
flavor: What, you expect me to wear some old sad sack to the big soiree tonight? I wanna feel pretty! I need Bnahabra material to make that happen. So... Uh, hello? Help me make that happen already!
flavor_zh: What, you expect me to wear some old sad sack to the big soiree tonight? I wanna feel pretty! I need Bnahabra material to make that happen. So... Uh, hello? Help me make that happen already!

name: Poisonous Pest
flavor: Ioprey storming our village, we can handle. But their poison ruining our crops!? That's our livelihood! Take out the big ugly one, and the rest of them should get the hint and leave!
flavor_zh: Ioprey storming our village, we can handle. But their poison ruining our crops!? That's our livelihood! Take out the big ugly one, and the rest of them should get the hint and leave!

name: Pincer through the Sky
flavor: A Shogun Ceanataur's moved into the Marshlands recently and it's attacking people and livestock alike. We're at our wit's end here! We need you to go hunt it down!
flavor_zh: A Shogun Ceanataur's moved into the Marshlands recently and it's attacking people and livestock alike. We're at our wit's end here! We need you to go hunt it down!

name: Serpentine Samba
flavor: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?
flavor_zh: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?

name: Ioprey Hunting
flavor: Got a second? I was out working in the Marshlands when a bunch of Ioprey popped up out of nowhere! If you could hunt 20 of them for me, I could get back to work!
flavor_zh: Got a second? I was out working in the Marshlands when a bunch of Ioprey popped up out of nowhere! If you could hunt 20 of them for me, I could get back to work!

name: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
flavor: My village is being plagued by giant bugs. If you could squash 50 of them, that'd help us a lot. But keep your guard up! Those bugs are tough in groups and a Najarala's nearby, too!
flavor_zh: My village is being plagued by giant bugs. If you could squash 50 of them, that'd help us a lot. But keep your guard up! Those bugs are tough in groups and a Najarala's nearby, too!

name: Collect to Combine
flavor: Passion is important, but a true combiner knows that the key to quality combining is having fresh materials! So how 'bout you pick me, say, 20 Unique Mushrooms from the Marshlands? Sound good?
flavor_zh: Passion is important, but a true combiner knows that the key to quality combining is having fresh materials! So how 'bout you pick me, say, 20 Unique Mushrooms from the Marshlands? Sound good?

name: Harvest Tour: Volcano
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Volcano, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Volcano, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Flames of Glavenus Passion
flavor: People only care about the Glavenus's tail, but me? I'm way more into that lava it breathes! How does its body make that stuff!? I want you to hunt it and find that out for me!
flavor_zh: People only care about the Glavenus's tail, but me? I'm way more into that lava it breathes! How does its body make that stuff!? I want you to hunt it and find that out for me!

name: Tigrex by the Tail
flavor: I've got a distress signal from a hunter in the Jurassic Frontier who's run into a Tigrex! Anyone who finds this message is requested to head there and take it down ASAP!
flavor_zh: I've got a distress signal from a hunter in the Jurassic Frontier who's run into a Tigrex! Anyone who finds this message is requested to head there and take it down ASAP!

name: Dark Wings, Dark Work
flavor: Beneath the azure skies of the Jurassic Frontier lurks a mysterious monster cloaked in black. Writhing in pain, it glares from unseen eyes. The hunter or the hunted: Which will you be?
flavor_zh: Beneath the azure skies of the Jurassic Frontier lurks a mysterious monster cloaked in black. Writhing in pain, it glares from unseen eyes. The hunter or the hunted: Which will you be?

name: Fossilized Memories
flavor: Could you help me gather some Eternal Fossils for a fellow merchant in the Jurassic Frontier? If you do, I'll hook you up with a soft toy that can help you fall asleep!
name_zh: 沉睡在化石中的太古记忆
flavor_zh: Could you help me gather some Eternal Fossils for a fellow merchant in the Jurassic Frontier? If you do, I'll hook you up with a soft toy that can help you fall asleep!

name: A Thousand Scales of Dread
flavor: Breaking news from the Elder Hall: A Seregios has shown up in the Dunes! Any and all skilled hunters are asked to help hunt it as soon as possible. Beware its blades!
flavor_zh: Breaking news from the Elder Hall: A Seregios has shown up in the Dunes! Any and all skilled hunters are asked to help hunt it as soon as possible. Beware its blades!

name: A Shocking Scoundrel
flavor: Sounds like an Astalos showed up in the Verdant Hills. It may be pretty for a monster, but don't be fooled: its attacks are lethal, and it won't hold back. Go prepared.
flavor_zh: Sounds like an Astalos showed up in the Verdant Hills. It may be pretty for a monster, but don't be fooled: its attacks are lethal, and it won't hold back. Go prepared.

name: The King's Domain
flavor: You hear that, Hunter? It's the roar of a Rathalos, a wyvern that puts fear into even our fearless mercs. We need that thing gone, and it looks like you're the best one for the job!
flavor_zh: You hear that, Hunter? It's the roar of a Rathalos, a wyvern that puts fear into even our fearless mercs. We need that thing gone, and it looks like you're the best one for the job!

name: Fury Run Afoul
flavor: A shortage of food has got a Gammoth goin' crazy up on the ridge. No one can sleep at night, fearin' it'll come a-chargin' through the walls! I beg ya, put it down so we can rest easy!
flavor_zh: A shortage of food has got a Gammoth goin' crazy up on the ridge. No one can sleep at night, fearin' it'll come a-chargin' through the walls! I beg ya, put it down so we can rest easy!

name: Lagiacrus Lethargy
flavor: The Lagiacrus may be king of the seas, but it's just as scary on land. It was all I could do to distract the beast and hightail it out of there... Think you can fare any better?
flavor_zh: The Lagiacrus may be king of the seas, but it's just as scary on land. It was all I could do to distract the beast and hightail it out of there... Think you can fare any better?

name: Moonlit Bubble Bath
flavor: What a beautiful creature that Mizutsune is. And the way it uses bubbles to catch its prey... You gotta put a stop to it! What if people slip on those bubbles in the dark? Safety first!
flavor_zh: What a beautiful creature that Mizutsune is. And the way it uses bubbles to catch its prey... You gotta put a stop to it! What if people slip on those bubbles in the dark? Safety first!

name: Topple the Monarch
flavor: Many a poor soul has tried to hunt a Zinogre, only to end up being the one hunted instead. It's truly worthy of its title, "The Hunter." Isn't there anyone who can defy it?
flavor_zh: Many a poor soul has tried to hunt a Zinogre, only to end up being the one hunted instead. It's truly worthy of its title, "The Hunter." Isn't there anyone who can defy it?

name: Lagiacrushed
flavor: The mighty Lagiacrus is feared even by the most hardened men of the sea, and one has shown up where our villagers fish and work! Please, for their safety, hunt the Lagiacrus!
flavor_zh: The mighty Lagiacrus is feared even by the most hardened men of the sea, and one has shown up where our villagers fish and work! Please, for their safety, hunt the Lagiacrus!

name: Tuff Turf
flavor: I was training my tail off on the Deserted Island when, uh, I guess I kinda sorta riled up a Zinogre. My bad! No way I can handle that beast. Somebody beat it up for me!
flavor_zh: I was training my tail off on the Deserted Island when, uh, I guess I kinda sorta riled up a Zinogre. My bad! No way I can handle that beast. Somebody beat it up for me!

name: Isle About that Bass
flavor: This time, I have a Quest for you. You hear that rumbling sound out of the Deserted Island? I want to know what's causing it. If it seems to be something dangerous, then I want you to eliminate it!
flavor_zh: This time, I have a Quest for you. You hear that rumbling sound out of the Deserted Island? I want to know what's causing it. If it seems to be something dangerous, then I want you to eliminate it!

name: Heaven and Earth
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: A Rathalos and a Rathian appeared on the Deserted Island. Do you know just how deadly they are when they're together? And during mating season, it's suicide! Still up for the hunt?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: A Rathalos and a Rathian appeared on the Deserted Island. Do you know just how deadly they are when they're together? And during mating season, it's suicide! Still up for the hunt?

name: Fro Shizzle
flavor: Oh baby, I just had the grooviest idea: using an Astalos's lightning to style the ultimate 'fro! That's right, so hit the Marshlands and do your thang for me, baby!
flavor_zh: Oh baby, I just had the grooviest idea: using an Astalos's lightning to style the ultimate 'fro! That's right, so hit the Marshlands and do your thang for me, baby!

name: Bladed Glavenus
flavor: I hear there are wyverns in this land that can wield katanas... Where I'm from, no such creatures exist. How do they do it? I'd really like to see one up close. Capture it for me.
flavor_zh: I hear there are wyverns in this land that can wield katanas... Where I'm from, no such creatures exist. How do they do it? I'd really like to see one up close. Capture it for me.

name: Fight or Uragaan!
flavor: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.
flavor_zh: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

name: The Shogun's Encampment
flavor: Did you hear that two giant Carapaceon appeared at the Volcano!? This is where you hunters leap into action, yeah? If you really are a hunter, then you'll be first in line to take out those beasts!
flavor_zh: Did you hear that two giant Carapaceon appeared at the Volcano!? This is where you hunters leap into action, yeah? If you really are a hunter, then you'll be first in line to take out those beasts!

name: Crustacean Infestation
flavor: I was just minding my own business mining stuff when all of a sudden a Ceanataur shows up and bends my Iron Pickaxe clean in half! Rude! Go defeat 20 of them so I can resume my craft!
flavor_zh: I was just minding my own business mining stuff when all of a sudden a Ceanataur shows up and bends my Iron Pickaxe clean in half! Rude! Go defeat 20 of them so I can resume my craft!

name: Scavengers United
goal: Slay a total of 20 Remobra or Uroktor
flavor: I was attacked by some monsters, but I played dead and fooled 'em all! All of 'em...except Uroktor and Remobras! Please, go out and slay them! My pride is at stake!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20头蛇龙或熔岩兽
flavor_zh: I was attacked by some monsters, but I played dead and fooled 'em all! All of 'em...except Uroktor and Remobras! Please, go out and slay them! My pride is at stake!

name: More Coal Please
flavor: The giant lance that protects our fortress runs on Coal, and I hear there's plenty at the Volcano! Can you get some for us? If you break all your Pickaxes, you can always combine more!
flavor_zh: The giant lance that protects our fortress runs on Coal, and I hear there's plenty at the Volcano! Can you get some for us? If you break all your Pickaxes, you can always combine more!

name: An Early Jurassic Excursion
flavor: Every time I try to focus my mind during training, some monster or other always attacks me. Noble Hunter! Clear these beasts from the Jurassic Frontier that I may meditate in peace!
name_zh: 来啊！大白天的古代森林
flavor_zh: Every time I try to focus my mind during training, some monster or other always attacks me. Noble Hunter! Clear these beasts from the Jurassic Frontier that I may meditate in peace!

name: Wyvern Sand Runners
flavor: On hunts, your footwork must be light, yet sturdy. That's why I always train on the sand! I also look to bird wyverns and Seregios for inspiration. Fight a few so I can study their movements!
flavor_zh: On hunts, your footwork must be light, yet sturdy. That's why I always train on the sand! I also look to bird wyverns and Seregios for inspiration. Fight a few so I can study their movements!

name: Zinogre, Bearly Fazed
flavor: Did you see that!? An Arzuros totally just picked a fight with that Zinogre! Pretty reckless, I have to say... But whatever, now you should have the chance to get the jump on 'em both!
flavor_zh: Did you see that!? An Arzuros totally just picked a fight with that Zinogre! Pretty reckless, I have to say... But whatever, now you should have the chance to get the jump on 'em both!

name: Making it Safe for Swine
flavor: Our studies show that the number of Mosswine in the Marshlands has declined due to large monsters in the area! Please, hunt down these beasts and protect the noble Mosswine!
flavor_zh: Our studies show that the number of Mosswine in the Marshlands has declined due to large monsters in the area! Please, hunt down these beasts and protect the noble Mosswine!

name: Rumble in the Volcano
flavor: I saw a Volvidon attacked by a Brachydios at the Volcano! It got away, and now it's roaming dangerously close to my village! Can you hunt it for us? Keep an eye out for the Brachydios, too!
flavor_zh: I saw a Volvidon attacked by a Brachydios at the Volcano! It got away, and now it's roaming dangerously close to my village! Can you hunt it for us? Keep an eye out for the Brachydios, too!

name: It's Electric
flavor: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.
flavor_zh: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.

name: The White Brute
flavor: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.
flavor_zh: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.

name: The Frozen Dictator
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
flavor: I saw it! I know I did! A pair of black wings among a flurry of snow... Then a gust of wind nearly blew me off the mountain! Take my advice and don't even go near that thing!
flavor_zh: I saw it! I know I did! A pair of black wings among a flurry of snow... Then a gust of wind nearly blew me off the mountain! Take my advice and don't even go near that thing!

name: The Elder Dragon of Mist
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: I sensed a strong presence and turned around, but there was nobody there. There's no way anything could have sneaked up on us from our vantage point, but still... Keep your guard up, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I sensed a strong presence and turned around, but there was nobody there. There's no way anything could have sneaked up on us from our vantage point, but still... Keep your guard up, Hunter!

name: Emperor of Flame
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: I beg of you, help me in carrying out my last task. I've chased a Teostra to the Volcano. Beware its flames, for they may roast you alive if you are careless. Godspeed, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I beg of you, help me in carrying out my last task. I've chased a Teostra to the Volcano. Beware its flames, for they may roast you alive if you are careless. Godspeed, Hunter!

name: Stop the Wheel
flavor: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?
name_zh: 吾将轮回，吾将聚集，吾将归来
flavor_zh: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?

name: Two-headed Carcass
flavor: Attention all hunters. Repelling Nakarkos is now the Wycademy's top priority. Combine your efforts and bring this task to fruition. May luck be with you.
flavor_zh: Attention all hunters. Repelling Nakarkos is now the Wycademy's top priority. Combine your efforts and bring this task to fruition. May luck be with you.

name: Harvest Tour: A. Steppe
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering in the Ancestral Steppe, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Ancestral Steppe, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

flavor: Interested in gathering in the Misty Peaks, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Misty Peaks, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: Swing into Action
flavor: That danged dirty primate, swinging all over the place, knocking over my cart, hocking up mucus everywhere! I'll be looking for a new line of work if this keeps up. Help me out, Hunter!
name_zh: 狩猎爱恶作剧的奇猿狐
flavor_zh: That danged dirty primate, swinging all over the place, knocking over my cart, hocking up mucus everywhere! I'll be looking for a new line of work if this keeps up. Help me out, Hunter!

name: Ruining the Ruins
flavor: Just when I was starting to suspect that something was off about the Steppe, a Yian Kut-Ku sprang from the shadows! Help me secure the area, Hunter, so I can continue my work.
flavor_zh: Just when I was starting to suspect that something was off about the Steppe, a Yian Kut-Ku sprang from the shadows! Help me secure the area, Hunter, so I can continue my work.

name: Bag the Bounding Bandit
flavor: My training is complete, but now, monsters refuse to draw near. My mind and body yearn to test their strength! Honorable Hunter, bring me a Great Maccao that I may challenge!
name_zh: 来啊！遗迹平原的跳狗龙王
flavor_zh: My training is complete, but now, monsters refuse to draw near. My mind and body yearn to test their strength! Honorable Hunter, bring me a Great Maccao that I may challenge!

name: Jaggi of the Steppe
goal: Slay a total of 20 Jaggia or Jaggi
flavor: We saved up and bought our dream plot of land near the Ancestral Steppe, but it's been overrun by Jaggi! Please drive them off, or I'll never be able to make my dream garden!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20头狗龙或雌狗龙
flavor_zh: We saved up and bought our dream plot of land near the Ancestral Steppe, but it's been overrun by Jaggi! Please drive them off, or I'll never be able to make my dream garden!

name: Ancestral Steppe Fungus Run
flavor: Mushroom diets are so hot right now, and I have a lot to lose! Be a dear and bring me some Unique Mushrooms from the Ancestral Steppe. I'll be ready for swimsuit season in no time! Tee hee!
flavor_zh: Mushroom diets are so hot right now, and I have a lot to lose! Be a dear and bring me some Unique Mushrooms from the Ancestral Steppe. I'll be ready for swimsuit season in no time! Tee hee!

name: Bug Appétit
flavor: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people make bugs into burgers. I must partake in this culinary adventure! Someone saw a Seltas in the Primal Forest. Go for it!
flavor_zh: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people make bugs into burgers. I must partake in this culinary adventure! Someone saw a Seltas in the Primal Forest. Go for it!

name: Gendrome Roadblock
flavor: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!
flavor_zh: I've been ferrying goods for a big deal coming up, only packs of Genprey keep messing things up. I'd bet there's an alpha behind it. Take 'em out so my deal won't fall through!

name: Lost in the Primal Forest
flavor: My luck is so bad lately. First a Gypceros swipes my Book of Combos, and then a Melynx runs off with my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna have to quit hunting! Can you help me out here!?
flavor_zh: My luck is so bad lately. First a Gypceros swipes my Book of Combos, and then a Melynx runs off with my BBQ Spit! At this rate, I'm gonna have to quit hunting! Can you help me out here!?

name: Hunt Down the Velocidrome!
flavor: My wife, bless her heart, went to the Primal Forest to pick me some of my favorite mushrooms, but was almost attacked by wyverns! Please, make the forest safe for her again!
flavor_zh: My wife, bless her heart, went to the Primal Forest to pick me some of my favorite mushrooms, but was almost attacked by wyverns! Please, make the forest safe for her again!

name: Poison Paralysis Pinch
goal: Slay a total of 20 Ioprey or Genprey
flavor: Research is my life! I'm currently studying the differences between Poison and Paralysis agents. Ioprey and Genprey are perfect for comparative analysis. Slay me a combined total of twenty!
name_zh: 医生的毒与麻痹毒的研究
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20头红速龙或黄速龙
flavor_zh: Research is my life! I'm currently studying the differences between Poison and Paralysis agents. Ioprey and Genprey are perfect for comparative analysis. Slay me a combined total of twenty!

name: Crystal Bone Collector
flavor: Crystal Bones are a source of crucial data about ancient organisms and even modern biological phenomena! Please find me some to further my research, but don't forget to take a Pickaxe!
flavor_zh: Crystal Bones are a source of crucial data about ancient organisms and even modern biological phenomena! Please find me some to further my research, but don't forget to take a Pickaxe!

name: Hair of the Dog
flavor: Dad was supposed to play outside with me today, but he said his head hurts! He said that some Slagtoth Oil could cure his "hanged dover" quick! Can you find us some? I wanna go play!
flavor_zh: Dad was supposed to play outside with me today, but he said his head hurts! He said that some Slagtoth Oil could cure his "hanged dover" quick! Can you find us some? I wanna go play!

name: Tackling the Tetsucabra
flavor: Rock hard! That just about sums up what it's like to fight that thing and see your attacks bounce off those boulders it digs up... I give up! How about you, though? Up for a challenge?
flavor_zh: Rock hard! That just about sums up what it's like to fight that thing and see your attacks bounce off those boulders it digs up... I give up! How about you, though? Up for a challenge?

name: So Notable: Great Maccao
flavor: You've seen Great Maccao hopping around on their tails and throwing punches, right? My notebook hasn't! At least, not until you go hunt two of them for me so I can make an accurate sketch!
name_zh: 超级☆备忘录 ～跳狗龙王狩猎篇～
flavor_zh: You've seen Great Maccao hopping around on their tails and throwing punches, right? My notebook hasn't! At least, not until you go hunt two of them for me so I can make an accurate sketch!

name: The Land Sharq
flavor: Argh, my wagon just got marooned in the Dunes! Now, I haven't seen anything fishy out here -- yet -- but I just know there's something waiting to get at my stuff! Find it and let 'em have it!
flavor_zh: Argh, my wagon just got marooned in the Dunes! Now, I haven't seen anything fishy out here -- yet -- but I just know there's something waiting to get at my stuff! Find it and let 'em have it!

name: Shells of Steel
flavor: I hate to ask hunters for help, but there's a huge Hermitaur out in the Dunes that just won't go down nicely. No matter what I do, I can't hurt it. I need you to go after it for me.
flavor_zh: I hate to ask hunters for help, but there's a huge Hermitaur out in the Dunes that just won't go down nicely. No matter what I do, I can't hurt it. I need you to go after it for me.

name: Birds of a Feather
goal: Hunt a Yian Kut-Ku and a Gypceros
flavor: The Verdant Hills are littered with fiery goo and poison. The culprits are obvious, but we can't let them roam around freely. Forgive us, Hunter, but we ask you to please eliminate these two threats.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头怪鸟和1头毒怪鸟
flavor_zh: The Verdant Hills are littered with fiery goo and poison. The culprits are obvious, but we can't let them roam around freely. Forgive us, Hunter, but we ask you to please eliminate these two threats.

name: Bullfango Brigade
flavor: What's that? A pack of Bullfango in the Verdant Hills!? That would mean no one can approach the area for fear of their lives! Hunter, you're up!
flavor_zh: What's that? A pack of Bullfango in the Verdant Hills!? That would mean no one can approach the area for fear of their lives! Hunter, you're up!

name: Delicious White Livers
flavor: There's nothing like sharing a drink with good friends... Only, I forgot to bring food to pair it with! Can you bring me some White Livers? Just remember not to bruise them with bluntified weapons!
flavor_zh: There's nothing like sharing a drink with good friends... Only, I forgot to bring food to pair it with! Can you bring me some White Livers? Just remember not to bruise them with bluntified weapons!

name: The Bulldrome Charges
flavor: My son wants to be a hunter when he grows up. He tried taking on a Bulldrome, but he lost, of course. As his parent, it's tough seeing him sad like this. Can you hunt this beast roaming the Arctic Ridge?
flavor_zh: My son wants to be a hunter when he grows up. He tried taking on a Bulldrome, but he lost, of course. As his parent, it's tough seeing him sad like this. Can you hunt this beast roaming the Arctic Ridge?

name: Snow with Occasional Lagombi
flavor: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]
flavor_zh: [REPORT BEGINS] Lagombi spotted in the Arctic Ridge [STOP] Requesting support from all qualified hunters [STOP] We are snowed in and cannot render assistance [REPORT ENDS]

name: Arzuros Encroaches
flavor: I have a field up in the Misty Peaks. Nice and safe... That is, until an Arzuros showed up! Now I'm too scared to harvest my crops! Go beat it up so I can get back to work!
flavor_zh: I have a field up in the Misty Peaks. Nice and safe... That is, until an Arzuros showed up! Now I'm too scared to harvest my crops! Go beat it up so I can get back to work!

name: Royal Spit Take
flavor: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!
flavor_zh: Ick! I got splattered with weird gunk that sapped my Stamina, so I couldn't even run! Luckily, a Felyne came by and saved me, but now whenever I see anything yellow...urgh!

name: Netting Neopterons
flavor: It's not easy for my son, being the center of the universe and all. The other children are too jealous to join him in his new hobby: bug collecting! You there, help my boy catch some bugs!
flavor_zh: It's not easy for my son, being the center of the universe and all. The other children are too jealous to join him in his new hobby: bug collecting! You there, help my boy catch some bugs!

name: Clash of Rivals
goal: Slay a total of 30 Bullfango or Rhenoplos
flavor: The Arena overflow with Bullfango and Rhenoplos. Too much for little Cha- Cha! And if they breaka-lake the place, Cha-Cha be in more of a pickle! Hunt-hunt them for me... Please?
goal_zh: 合计讨伐30头野猪或硬甲龙
flavor_zh: The Arena overflow with Bullfango and Rhenoplos. Too much for little Cha- Cha! And if they breaka-lake the place, Cha-Cha be in more of a pickle! Hunt-hunt them for me... Please?

name: A Powerful Team
flavor: W-What should I do? There are so many monsters runnin' about in the Arena! Is it 'cause I blew my Field Horn? I mean, I've never even seen this many monsters in the same place before! Help!
flavor_zh: W-What should I do? There are so many monsters runnin' about in the Arena! Is it 'cause I blew my Field Horn? I mean, I've never even seen this many monsters in the same place before! Help!

name: Enter the Giadrome
flavor: Giaprey are clever carnivores. Super-fast on their feet, too. And you know what else? They've got a big, bad boss, called a Giadrome! Can you show me some badass moves that'll teach it a lesson and send 'em all packing?
flavor_zh: Giaprey are clever carnivores. Super-fast on their feet, too. And you know what else? They've got a big, bad boss, called a Giadrome! Can you show me some badass moves that'll teach it a lesson and send 'em all packing?

flavor_zh: Interested in gathering in the Volcano, young Hunter? Take this Quest and you can gather as much as you like! Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come back.

name: So Notable: Kecha Wacha
flavor: When two Kecha Wacha meet, do they just carry on as usual, or do they break into the craziest dance the world has never seen? My notebook and I need to know! I'll be waiting for a full report!
name_zh: 超级☆备忘录 ～奇猿狐狩猎篇～
flavor_zh: When two Kecha Wacha meet, do they just carry on as usual, or do they break into the craziest dance the world has never seen? My notebook and I need to know! I'll be waiting for a full report!

name: Ancestral Steppe Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Ancestral Steppe? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
name_zh: 缴纳遗迹平原的精算道具
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Ancestral Steppe? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Dragon Lady
flavor: Gah! Again my cargo is kaput. What use is guard if he guard nothing? Always, I hire guard! Always, I hear same story: monster too strong! But not immortal, yes? So, you hunt him? I reward. We understand?
flavor_zh: Gah! Again my cargo is kaput. What use is guard if he guard nothing? Always, I hire guard! Always, I hear same story: monster too strong! But not immortal, yes? So, you hunt him? I reward. We understand?

name: The Ioprey Leader
flavor: A pack of Ioprey ain't nothin' I can't handle, but this was a giant horde. We would've been goners if we didn't call off the hunt. Take 'em down, will ya? Oh, and mind their poison.
flavor_zh: A pack of Ioprey ain't nothin' I can't handle, but this was a giant horde. We would've been goners if we didn't call off the hunt. Take 'em down, will ya? Oh, and mind their poison.

name: The Intelligent Malfestio
flavor: What a clever creature, confusing its prey before it sinks in its claws... Just like me! A quill pen made of one of its feathers would be the perfect symbol of my intelligence and class!
flavor_zh: What a clever creature, confusing its prey before it sinks in its claws... Just like me! A quill pen made of one of its feathers would be the perfect symbol of my intelligence and class!

name: Serpentine Samba
flavor: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?
flavor_zh: My huntin' is near as bad as my dancin', but my little sis? Best moves in the tribe! I wanna make her a costume of serpent scales for the big festival. Could ya help me bag a big snake!?

name: Spotted Beauty
flavor: Beasts with lovely spots roam the Primal Forest. The patterns of Gendrome... Simply breathtaking. Hunt a few so I can see them up close, and I'll reward you with this Rainbow Ore.
flavor_zh: Beasts with lovely spots roam the Primal Forest. The patterns of Gendrome... Simply breathtaking. Hunt a few so I can see them up close, and I'll reward you with this Rainbow Ore.

name: Primal Forest Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Primal Forest? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
name_zh: 缴纳原生林的精算道具
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Primal Forest? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Fin Finder
flavor: The uneducated masses call it a "monster Sharq." What nonsense! It's a most magnificent creature, able to shift into so many forms... I must have a specimen for my research!
flavor_zh: The uneducated masses call it a "monster Sharq." What nonsense! It's a most magnificent creature, able to shift into so many forms... I must have a specimen for my research!

name: The Walls Have Eyes
flavor: I was in the Frozen Seaway, I was, and that's when I felt it -- like me blood turned ta ice. Somethin' was a-spyin' on me. Cross me heart and hope ta die. Mind sussin' out the creepy peeper?
flavor_zh: I was in the Frozen Seaway, I was, and that's when I felt it -- like me blood turned ta ice. Somethin' was a-spyin' on me. Cross me heart and hope ta die. Mind sussin' out the creepy peeper?

name: Must Love Lagombi
flavor: The Frozen Seaway sounds cold. I hate the cold! But, I am curious about the rabbit- like creatures that live there. Could you hunt some for me? No fewer than two, please! Ta-ta, now!
flavor_zh: The Frozen Seaway sounds cold. I hate the cold! But, I am curious about the rabbit- like creatures that live there. Could you hunt some for me? No fewer than two, please! Ta-ta, now!

name: Zamite Fight
flavor: I was out scouring the Frozen Seaway for harvest supplies when I was blindsided by these big, spiky beasts! I managed to get away, but it haunts me still... Someone dispatch the sneaky savages!
flavor_zh: I was out scouring the Frozen Seaway for harvest supplies when I was blindsided by these big, spiky beasts! I managed to get away, but it haunts me still... Someone dispatch the sneaky savages!

name: Stone-cold Stones
flavor: The Frozen Seaway beats any tropical paradise for a geologist like me. Every day brings a new discovery! Did you know it's the only place you can find Bloodstones? I gotta get me some of that.
flavor_zh: The Frozen Seaway beats any tropical paradise for a geologist like me. Every day brings a new discovery! Did you know it's the only place you can find Bloodstones? I gotta get me some of that.

name: Liver and Let Die
flavor: Lightly grilled over charcoal, stir-fried with spicy and sweet sauce, or boiled to the perfect texture... Mmm... I'm hungry just thinking about it! Please, bring me some delicious Monster Guts!
flavor_zh: Lightly grilled over charcoal, stir-fried with spicy and sweet sauce, or boiled to the perfect texture... Mmm... I'm hungry just thinking about it! Please, bring me some delicious Monster Guts!

name: Fight or Uragaan!
flavor: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.
flavor_zh: Don't bother readin' any further unless you're a true hunter -- the type who loves that quiver in your guts when you're livin' on the razor's edge. Still with me? Go to the Volcano. Somethin's waitin'.

name: Worst. Trip. Ever!
flavor: Ugh... I think I was a little too ambitious to try climbing the Volcanic Hollow. I forgot my Cool Drinks and ran out of Stamina. Worst of all, I was attacked by a Yian Garuga. Somebody help me, please!
flavor_zh: Ugh... I think I was a little too ambitious to try climbing the Volcanic Hollow. I forgot my Cool Drinks and ran out of Stamina. Worst of all, I was attacked by a Yian Garuga. Somebody help me, please!

name: Tetsucabra Bounty
flavor: Oh, the horror! Oh, the zenny! Apparently, a Tetsucabra is making a mess of some newly developed land. Big reward on its head, I hear. Help me and we'll split it fifty-fifty!
flavor_zh: Oh, the horror! Oh, the zenny! Apparently, a Tetsucabra is making a mess of some newly developed land. Big reward on its head, I hear. Help me and we'll split it fifty-fifty!

name: Close Coal
flavor: If I don't have Coal to roast tonight's feast, my goose is cooked! Actually, it won't be cooked, but I'll still end up in hot water. Er, not literally. Oh, just help me, will you!?
flavor_zh: If I don't have Coal to roast tonight's feast, my goose is cooked! Actually, it won't be cooked, but I'll still end up in hot water. Er, not literally. Oh, just help me, will you!?

name: Nargacuga Throwdown
flavor: This is the kind of Quest that the G Rank hunters that used to come to Pokke would finish in their SLEEP! You look like you're at least half-awake, so it should be no sweat for you! Good luck!
flavor_zh: This is the kind of Quest that the G Rank hunters that used to come to Pokke would finish in their SLEEP! You look like you're at least half-awake, so it should be no sweat for you! Good luck!

name: Insomnia? Meet Hypnotism x 2
flavor: My wife gave me a Malfestio to help me deal with insomnia, but one doesn't seem to be enough. I'm also afraid that using two at once may have some ill side effects. Could you test it out for me?
name_zh: 催眠治疗法送给失眠的你X2
flavor_zh: My wife gave me a Malfestio to help me deal with insomnia, but one doesn't seem to be enough. I'm also afraid that using two at once may have some ill side effects. Could you test it out for me?

name: The Desert Gourmand
flavor: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!
flavor_zh: One minute I was rattlin' along the Dunes in me barrel buggy, mindin' me own. And then, RAAARRR! Cart goes flyin' -- and me with it! What gives!? The barrel business is s'pposed t'be safe, by gum!

name: Line in the Sand
flavor: Sandboarding! It's the latest craze! ...Or it will be, as soon as I finish inventing it. But I can't do anything with these darned Cephadrome in the way. Get rid of 'em and I'll give you some Rainbow Ore!
name_zh: 错在砂龙王，而非沾满沙子的食物
flavor_zh: Sandboarding! It's the latest craze! ...Or it will be, as soon as I finish inventing it. But I can't do anything with these darned Cephadrome in the way. Get rid of 'em and I'll give you some Rainbow Ore!

name: Wrath of the Rathian
flavor: Dang Rathian! Ambushed my caravan and tore my business a new one! But I ain't the gettin' mad type, I'm the gettin' even type! Time for some ice cold revenge, and I want you to dish it out!
flavor_zh: Dang Rathian! Ambushed my caravan and tore my business a new one! But I ain't the gettin' mad type, I'm the gettin' even type! Time for some ice cold revenge, and I want you to dish it out!

name: Twin Velocidrome
flavor: A pair of Velocidrome is leading around a menacing pack of Velociprey. If you can take them out and help restore peace to the Hills, I'll give you this Rainbow Ore!
flavor_zh: A pair of Velocidrome is leading around a menacing pack of Velociprey. If you can take them out and help restore peace to the Hills, I'll give you this Rainbow Ore!

name: The New Tenant
flavor: A Blangonga is wreaking havoc on one of my trade routes. Think you can take care of it for me? Once you do, I can give you gigantic ladybugs that you can use as materials for equipment!
flavor_zh: A Blangonga is wreaking havoc on one of my trade routes. Think you can take care of it for me? Once you do, I can give you gigantic ladybugs that you can use as materials for equipment!

name: A Plesioth in the Misty Peaks
flavor: A Plesioth! In the Misty Peaks! And I would have had it, too, if not for its water breath and hiding in the river all the time... I didn't have my bathing suit! I'll let you deal with it!
flavor_zh: A Plesioth! In the Misty Peaks! And I would have had it, too, if not for its water breath and hiding in the river all the time... I didn't have my bathing suit! I'll let you deal with it!

name: Awful Guest
flavor: The Loc Lac Tourism Board will not sit idly by as this Plesioth eats into our tourism revenues. We would like you to deal with this nuisance and help our other guests return home safely.
flavor_zh: The Loc Lac Tourism Board will not sit idly by as this Plesioth eats into our tourism revenues. We would like you to deal with this nuisance and help our other guests return home safely.

name: Poisonous Pair
flavor: Ioprey ain't nothin' I can't handle, but this pack had two bosses. I couldn't pin 'em down and they got away, but if you can take 'em down for me, I'll give you some Rainbow Ore.
flavor_zh: Ioprey ain't nothin' I can't handle, but this pack had two bosses. I couldn't pin 'em down and they got away, but if you can take 'em down for me, I'll give you some Rainbow Ore.

name: Attack of the Giant Bugs!
flavor: My village has a huge bug problem. We're talkin' like Bugtopia here! If you can help us out by squashing about 50 of them, that'd help us a lot. Just watch out for any big monsters!
flavor_zh: My village has a huge bug problem. We're talkin' like Bugtopia here! If you can help us out by squashing about 50 of them, that'd help us a lot. Just watch out for any big monsters!

name: You Caught This? I Caught This
flavor: So my brother thinks he's the best fisher in our castle. We'll see about that! Catch me a Lavasioth and I can prove him wrong! I'm a genius! Now, off you go. Don't keep me waiting!
flavor_zh: So my brother thinks he's the best fisher in our castle. We'll see about that! Catch me a Lavasioth and I can prove him wrong! I'm a genius! Now, off you go. Don't keep me waiting!

name: Tumbling Troublemaker
flavor: Holy moly! Have you seen one of those things before? I thought it was a giant boulder tumbling down the mountain, but no, it was a monster comin' to eat me! I'm not going back there until you get rid of it!
flavor_zh: Holy moly! Have you seen one of those things before? I thought it was a giant boulder tumbling down the mountain, but no, it was a monster comin' to eat me! I'm not going back there until you get rid of it!

name: Shogun in the Flames
flavor: Hours of walking through a sweltering cave, only to find ourselves in the Volcano, swooped down upon by a giant Ceanataur! We may make weapons, but we're still merchants. Help!
flavor_zh: Hours of walking through a sweltering cave, only to find ourselves in the Volcano, swooped down upon by a giant Ceanataur! We may make weapons, but we're still merchants. Help!

name: The Most Dangerous Game
flavor: Would you fancy a game of Konchu dodgeball? What a marvelous way to pass the time... For me, of course! There may be a red ball tossed in there, too, but pay it no heed, Hunter!
flavor_zh: Would you fancy a game of Konchu dodgeball? What a marvelous way to pass the time... For me, of course! There may be a red ball tossed in there, too, but pay it no heed, Hunter!

name: Status: Effected
flavor: For a year I researched safe hunting practices: Antidotes, anti-Paralysis, you name it. The results of my research? The safest hunt...is one you've pushed off onto someone else! Good luck!
flavor_zh: For a year I researched safe hunting practices: Antidotes, anti-Paralysis, you name it. The results of my research? The safest hunt...is one you've pushed off onto someone else! Good luck!

name: Desert Brawlers
flavor: The Dunes are crawling with big ol' monsters that won't even let me NEAR the materials I need to make my weapons! Think you can head out and whip 'em for me?
name_zh: 热沙中的喧嚷乃武器的来源
flavor_zh: The Dunes are crawling with big ol' monsters that won't even let me NEAR the materials I need to make my weapons! Think you can head out and whip 'em for me?

name: The Hunter Games
flavor: I've gathered only the most unique monsters to display the best tournament ever hosted. Shockers, rollers, slicers... Expect no shortage of mayhem. Just try not to embarrass yourself out there!
flavor_zh: 未知

name: Hunt, Sweat, and Tears
flavor: I simply love the sight of brave hunters only barely escaping death! And this lineup of five awful beasties is sure to grant me just that. Now, be a dear and give me a good show!
flavor_zh: I simply love the sight of brave hunters only barely escaping death! And this lineup of five awful beasties is sure to grant me just that. Now, be a dear and give me a good show!

name: Pink Stink
flavor: Whaddaya know about the Congas with the pink fur in the Primal Forest? That Congalala ringleader of theirs just trashed 'n' gassed my entire shop. Go clear the air, will ya?
sub_goal_zh: 缴纳1个标记地盘的巨粪
flavor_zh: Whaddaya know about the Congas with the pink fur in the Primal Forest? That Congalala ringleader of theirs just trashed 'n' gassed my entire shop. Go clear the air, will ya?

name: Brute of the Sands
flavor: My weapon...bounced off its hide like a toy. That thing moved...so fast. Before I knew it...I was knocked cold. The Medicine Man says it's... just a scratch, but the pain! Avenge my flesh wound!
flavor_zh: My weapon...bounced off its hide like a toy. That thing moved...so fast. Before I knew it...I was knocked cold. The Medicine Man says it's... just a scratch, but the pain! Avenge my flesh wound!

name: Disruptive Eruption
flavor: What? Why, that's a... There's a Basarios after me!? I didn't sign up for this, you know. There's much to be said for staying indoors! You take care of the Basarios, Hunter. I'll deal with the, er... Mosswine!
flavor_zh: What? Why, that's a... There's a Basarios after me!? I didn't sign up for this, you know. There's much to be said for staying indoors! You take care of the Basarios, Hunter. I'll deal with the, er... Mosswine!

name: Web Sighting
flavor: I got webbed up, chewed on, smacked around, and tossed away like garbage! That Nerscylla really put me through the wringer. Someone needs to return the favor to that creepy cave menace!
flavor_zh: I got webbed up, chewed on, smacked around, and tossed away like garbage! That Nerscylla really put me through the wringer. Someone needs to return the favor to that creepy cave menace!

name: The Lightning Crown
flavor: The Astalos's head is so cool! Its crest looks like some kind of crown. Man, I'd love to see it up close! Then I could do some really great research... Can you please hunt one for me?
flavor_zh: The Astalos's head is so cool! Its crest looks like some kind of crown. Man, I'd love to see it up close! Then I could do some really great research... Can you please hunt one for me?

name: What a Girl Wants
flavor: My lil' sis got mad at me for forgetting her birthday. Now the only way she'll forgive me is if I hunt her a Tigrex for a late birthday present! Please, Hunter, you gotta help me!
flavor_zh: My lil' sis got mad at me for forgetting her birthday. Now the only way she'll forgive me is if I hunt her a Tigrex for a late birthday present! Please, Hunter, you gotta help me!

name: Rathalos Run
flavor: That Rathalos flying near the Ancestral Steppe? Yeah, I let him get away. Figured he deserved a break. Now he's too far away for me to bother with. Someone else tackle him for me.
flavor_zh: That Rathalos flying near the Ancestral Steppe? Yeah, I let him get away. Figured he deserved a break. Now he's too far away for me to bother with. Someone else tackle him for me.

name: Watch Your Steppe
flavor: We received reports that a Gore Magala has shown itself in the Steppe. I'd like for you to investigate, and hunt the beast. Do so, and you'll have ensured the safety of many.
name_zh: 调查遗迹平原的黑蚀龙
flavor_zh: We received reports that a Gore Magala has shown itself in the Steppe. I'd like for you to investigate, and hunt the beast. Do so, and you'll have ensured the safety of many.

name: Bug Buffet
flavor: Legend tells of a faraway land where they boil up bugs and swallow them down. Say, I hear a Seltas Queen was spotted nearby. Sounds yummy! Hmm? How was the last bug I ate? ...No comment.
flavor_zh: Legend tells of a faraway land where they boil up bugs and swallow them down. Say, I hear a Seltas Queen was spotted nearby. Sounds yummy! Hmm? How was the last bug I ate? ...No comment.

name: A Bewitching Dance
flavor: A Mizutsune has laid claim to the Primal Forest. But the forest is not for it alone. You must go and reclaim what is all of ours. Beware its peculiar bubbles, Hunter.
flavor_zh: A Mizutsune has laid claim to the Primal Forest. But the forest is not for it alone. You must go and reclaim what is all of ours. Beware its peculiar bubbles, Hunter.

name: Dread Locked
flavor: Gore Magala... Its name sends grown men running for their mothers. Don't expect a cheery hunt with this one -- its black mist swallows all. Can you drive away this relentless evil?
flavor_zh: Gore Magala... Its name sends grown men running for their mothers. Don't expect a cheery hunt with this one -- its black mist swallows all. Can you drive away this relentless evil?

name: The Unshakable Mountain God
flavor: The beast known as the God of the Mountain is quite a challenge, indeed, but it's certainly nothing that a Wycademy Hunter can't handle! Go, Hunter, and bring honor to our name.
flavor_zh: The beast known as the God of the Mountain is quite a challenge, indeed, but it's certainly nothing that a Wycademy Hunter can't handle! Go, Hunter, and bring honor to our name.

name: Topple the Monarch
flavor: I suppose I'm being too harsh on myself. I'm far from the only hunter who has challenged the Zinogre in the Frozen Seaway only to become the hunted. Why else would the monster be known as "The Hunter"? Still...
flavor_zh: I suppose I'm being too harsh on myself. I'm far from the only hunter who has challenged the Zinogre in the Frozen Seaway only to become the hunted. Why else would the monster be known as "The Hunter"? Still...

name: Bedevil a Deviljho
flavor: A terrifying beast has appeared in the Frozen Seaway! It's a vicious thing, crueler than anything I've ever seen... Be sure to write up a will before you go out there!
flavor_zh: A terrifying beast has appeared in the Frozen Seaway! It's a vicious thing, crueler than anything I've ever seen... Be sure to write up a will before you go out there!

name: Frozen Seaway Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Frozen Seaway? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Frozen Seaway? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Master of the Molten Deep
flavor: For the past few years, my people have lived in ever- mounting fear of the wrath of the volcano, and the great wyvern who sleeps in its flames. Please, save my people!
flavor_zh: For the past few years, my people have lived in ever- mounting fear of the wrath of the volcano, and the great wyvern who sleeps in its flames. Please, save my people!

name: Duel in the Volcanic Hollow
flavor: I fought a Glavenus in a duel, but I was soundly defeated. To think that such a master of sword- play could exist... You would do well to see it for yourself.
name_zh: 出击！地底火山中的死战！
flavor_zh: I fought a Glavenus in a duel, but I was soundly defeated. To think that such a master of sword- play could exist... You would do well to see it for yourself.

name: Volcanic Hollow Accounting
flavor: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Volcanic Hollow? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.
name_zh: 缴纳地底火山的精算道具
flavor_zh: Young Hunter, your hands seem idle. Would you care to busy yourself collecting points for me in the Volcanic Hollow? Any items are fine, as long as you meet the quota. Take care, now.

name: Bug Bite
flavor: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people turn insects into hors d'oeuvres. For my final request, hunt me a Seltas Queen so I can try a taste. This is the last time I'll ask, promise!
flavor_zh: Legends tell of a faraway land where the people turn insects into hors d'oeuvres. For my final request, hunt me a Seltas Queen so I can try a taste. This is the last time I'll ask, promise!

name: Heaven and Earth
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: A Rathalos and a Rathian appeared in the Jurassic Frontier. Do you know just how deadly they are when they're together? And during mating season, it's suicide! Still up for the hunt?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: A Rathalos and a Rathian appeared in the Jurassic Frontier. Do you know just how deadly they are when they're together? And during mating season, it's suicide! Still up for the hunt?

name: From Beyond the Sands
flavor: I was roaming the Dunes when I happened to see a Glavenus blocking one of the major trade routes! Normally I keep to myself, but I can't live without my delivery of Moga curry!
flavor_zh: I was roaming the Dunes when I happened to see a Glavenus blocking one of the major trade routes! Normally I keep to myself, but I can't live without my delivery of Moga curry!

name: Legend of the Monkey King
flavor: A legendary priest once embarked on a journey of discovery with three disciples. I tried to copy him, but failed miserably. My disciple turned on me, and is now rampaging in the Dunes. Please help!
flavor_zh: A legendary priest once embarked on a journey of discovery with three disciples. I tried to copy him, but failed miserably. My disciple turned on me, and is now rampaging in the Dunes. Please help!

name: Astalos Territory
flavor: Our caravan wandered into an Astalos's territory, and it didn't seem to like us. I barely escaped with my life, but my friends are still in the Verdant Hills. Please hunt it down and save my friends!
flavor_zh: Our caravan wandered into an Astalos's territory, and it didn't seem to like us. I barely escaped with my life, but my friends are still in the Verdant Hills. Please hunt it down and save my friends!

name: Lord of the Skies
flavor: A message for all brave hunters. A Rathalos has been seen in our land, and for the safety of my people, we need your help to eliminate it. Your help will be aptly rewarded.
flavor_zh: A message for all brave hunters. A Rathalos has been seen in our land, and for the safety of my people, we need your help to eliminate it. Your help will be aptly rewarded.

name: The Rajang in the Snow
flavor: A crazy monster with two horns and mouth lasers showed up in the Arctic Ridge! What the heck are we supposed to do against something like that!? Help us out, here!
name_zh: 屹立在暴雪中的金狮子
flavor_zh: A crazy monster with two horns and mouth lasers showed up in the Arctic Ridge! What the heck are we supposed to do against something like that!? Help us out, here!

name: Fury Run Afoul
flavor: A shortage of food has got a Gammoth goin' crazy up on the ridge. No one can sleep at night, fearin' it'll come a-chargin' through the walls! I beg ya, put it down so we can rest easy!
flavor_zh: A shortage of food has got a Gammoth goin' crazy up on the ridge. No one can sleep at night, fearin' it'll come a-chargin' through the walls! I beg ya, put it down so we can rest easy!

name: Bl-Bl-Blangongas!
flavor: It's bad enough that we've got a gig out in the middle of nowhere for a bunch of lushes, but now we're liable to get stranded in the mountains because of these Blangongas! Help!
sub_goal_zh: 缴纳1个标记地盘的巨粪
flavor_zh: It's bad enough that we've got a gig out in the middle of nowhere for a bunch of lushes, but now we're liable to get stranded in the mountains because of these Blangongas! Help!

name: Surrounded by Bubbles
flavor: Covering yourself in Mizutsune bubbles gives you tremendous sliding ability... Fascinating! Hunt one for me so I can study the chemical makeup of its bubbles... For science!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏泡狐龙的右爪与左爪
flavor_zh: Covering yourself in Mizutsune bubbles gives you tremendous sliding ability... Fascinating! Hunt one for me so I can study the chemical makeup of its bubbles... For science!

name: The Moving Mountain
