flavor: That little moss-covered hill at the Misty Peaks was just begging to be painted. But the second I pulled out my easel and brush, it was gone! How can I be a landscape artist if the landscape won't cooperate?
flavor_zh: That little moss-covered hill at the Misty Peaks was just begging to be painted. But the second I pulled out my easel and brush, it was gone! How can I be a landscape artist if the landscape won't cooperate?

name: The Fisherman's Fiend
flavor: Yikes, this is horrible! We've just heard from our fishermen out in the sea that a Lagiacrus is here in this region! We need you to stop it before it does any serious damage!
flavor_zh: Yikes, this is horrible! We've just heard from our fishermen out in the sea that a Lagiacrus is here in this region! We need you to stop it before it does any serious damage!

name: Open Season for Jaggia
flavor: This isn't good at all! There's been an unusually high number of Jaggia recently, and at this rate, I don't think the village'll survive the winter! Could you help us thin out the herd?
flavor_zh: This isn't good at all! There's been an unusually high number of Jaggia recently, and at this rate, I don't think the village'll survive the winter! Could you help us thin out the herd?

name: For Whom the Gong Tolls
flavor: A friend of mine who rings gongs for a living says she'd like to model her movements after those of a Duramboros. Could you hunt one for her? Then maybe she'll finally get back to work!
flavor_zh: A friend of mine who rings gongs for a living says she'd like to model her movements after those of a Duramboros. Could you hunt one for her? Then maybe she'll finally get back to work!

name: Quartz Rivalry
flavor: I need something classy for the big soirée... Oh, I know! A Quartz Ore brooch! You can help me with that, can't you, Hunter? Ooh, I can already see everyone's faces, green with envy!
flavor_zh: I need something classy for the big soirée... Oh, I know! A Quartz Ore brooch! You can help me with that, can't you, Hunter? Ooh, I can already see everyone's faces, green with envy!

name: We Can Dig It
flavor: I've been fascinated by how the Agnaktor can easily break through solid rock. As a fellow digger, I have nothing but respect. I'd like to see it up close. Can you capture one for me?
flavor_zh: I've been fascinated by how the Agnaktor can easily break through solid rock. As a fellow digger, I have nothing but respect. I'd like to see it up close. Can you capture one for me?

name: Coal Hearted
goal: Deliver 10 pieces of Coal or a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Me and Grampaw Maple got somethin' amazin' in the works, but we need some Coal! Gather about ten for us, would ya? Use the Paw Pass Ticket to come back once ya do!
goal_zh: 燃石炭缴纳数量达到10个或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Me and Grampaw Maple got somethin' amazin' in the works, but we need some Coal! Gather about ten for us, would ya? Use the Paw Pass Ticket to come back once ya do!

name: River of Fire
flavor: Two Lavasioth are ambushing workers near the mine! As if our job wasn't hard enough without these brutes popping out and scaring us half to death. Please, take care of them for us!
flavor_zh: Two Lavasioth are ambushing workers near the mine! As if our job wasn't hard enough without these brutes popping out and scaring us half to death. Please, take care of them for us!

name: Dances with Wyverns
flavor: Wyverns attacked my airship the other day! Just WHAM, right out of the sky with their claws and fire and... *sigh* My trip was ruined, but you can save others by hunting those beasts!
flavor_zh: Wyverns attacked my airship the other day! Just WHAM, right out of the sky with their claws and fire and... *sigh* My trip was ruined, but you can save others by hunting those beasts!

name: Bugging Out
goal: Hunt all large monsters, not including Seltas
flavor: I heard the Primal Forest had some big bugs, so I went to check it out, but something put me to sleep and I woke up covered in bubbles! Could you go look for the bugs instead?
goal_zh: 除穿甲虫以外狩猎所有大型怪物
flavor_zh: I heard the Primal Forest had some big bugs, so I went to check it out, but something put me to sleep and I woke up covered in bubbles! Could you go look for the bugs instead?

name: A Three Hour Tour
flavor: This was supposed to be a nice trip to see the aurora, but all we saw here were monsters! Nothing is so beautiful it's worth risking our lives for! Hunt them so we can finish our trip!
flavor_zh: This was supposed to be a nice trip to see the aurora, but all we saw here were monsters! Nothing is so beautiful it's worth risking our lives for! Hunt them so we can finish our trip!

name: A Hollow Defense
flavor: Just our luck that we go digging for ore, only to dig up a shortcut to a bunch of monsters! We threw up a makeshift barrier, but we can't hold them off anymore... Help!
name_zh: 地底火山中回荡着侵略者的脚步声
flavor_zh: Just our luck that we go digging for ore, only to dig up a shortcut to a bunch of monsters! We threw up a makeshift barrier, but we can't hold them off anymore... Help!

name: Wild Gunman
flavor: I'm a bullet researcher by trade. Yes, we exist. By studying the unique ranged attacks of monsters, I can craft better tools to fight them. By helping me, you'll be doing yourself a favor.
flavor_zh: I'm a bullet researcher by trade. Yes, we exist. By studying the unique ranged attacks of monsters, I can craft better tools to fight them. By helping me, you'll be doing yourself a favor.

name: Marshlands Rag
flavor: Can you hear that...? The perfect melody of wildlife in the Marshlands! Bulldrome footsteps, Najarala rustles through the treetops, and the bass-like drumming of a Duramboros! Bravo! Bravo!
flavor_zh: Can you hear that...? The perfect melody of wildlife in the Marshlands! Bulldrome footsteps, Najarala rustles through the treetops, and the bass-like drumming of a Duramboros! Bravo! Bravo!

name: Firefight to the Finish!
flavor: I heard some monsters were making a mess at the Volcano, so I'm like BAM! Let me at 'em! But then they were like BAM! No way, bro! I can't let them burn me like that, man! Please, avenge me!
flavor_zh: I heard some monsters were making a mess at the Volcano, so I'm like BAM! Let me at 'em! But then they were like BAM! No way, bro! I can't let them burn me like that, man! Please, avenge me!

name: At the Slayground
flavor: We thought we'd found the perfect place to train, but it's been overrun by both a Kecha Wacha and a Rathalos! And now a Rajang is on its way, too! Help us newbies out!
flavor_zh: We thought we'd found the perfect place to train, but it's been overrun by both a Kecha Wacha and a Rathalos! And now a Rajang is on its way, too! Help us newbies out!

name: It's Electric
flavor: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.
flavor_zh: Unexplained natural events have been occurring deep within the Jurassic Frontier. Intriguing, don't you think? I believe it's a sign of mythic beasts, but you should go see it with your own eyes.

name: The White Brute
flavor: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.
flavor_zh: My friends and I sought out a phantom beast. When we came upon it, we had but a moment before it smote us with thunder, casting us asunder. Please help us, Hunter.

name: A Scenic Locale
flavor: They say that somewhere in the world, monsters from ancient times roam free. I wanted to find this place, and risked life and limb to do so. Now, I'll show you how to get there too.
flavor_zh: They say that somewhere in the world, monsters from ancient times roam free. I wanted to find this place, and risked life and limb to do so. Now, I'll show you how to get there too.

name: Miasma Attack
flavor: I saw a Gypceros emitting some sort of odd glow... And it made me want to break its face in! So I hit it with all my Hunter Arts, but it got away. Still, I had my fun. You finish it off!
flavor_zh: I saw a Gypceros emitting some sort of odd glow... And it made me want to break its face in! So I hit it with all my Hunter Arts, but it got away. Still, I had my fun. You finish it off!

name: Stop the Wacha!
flavor: The Kecha Wacha around here's been acting pawfully strange. It's always been a trickster, but now it's glowing and its tricks are getting purrtty unsafe! Purrlease hunt it for us!
flavor_zh: The Kecha Wacha around here's been acting pawfully strange. It's always been a trickster, but now it's glowing and its tricks are getting purrtty unsafe! Purrlease hunt it for us!

name: We Are Not Amused
flavor: Mirror, mirror, in my hand, who is the greatest queen in the land? ...What? Who does this "Queen of the Land" think she is!? You, Hunter! Hunt down this abomination at once!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雌火龙的翼，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Mirror, mirror, in my hand, who is the greatest queen in the land? ...What? Who does this "Queen of the Land" think she is!? You, Hunter! Hunt down this abomination at once!

name: Zamtrios Fight!
flavor: Y'know, I think Hyper Zamtrios might be the coolest out of all the Hyper ones. That dark, red smoke, on top of its wicked ice armor... I bet you're just dying to see it for yourself!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏变形冰鲨的头部与背鳍
flavor_zh: Y'know, I think Hyper Zamtrios might be the coolest out of all the Hyper ones. That dark, red smoke, on top of its wicked ice armor... I bet you're just dying to see it for yourself!

name: The Frog of War
flavor: I received a request to hunt a Tetsucabra in the Volcanic Hollow. I'd never seen a beast with such a powerful aura. You'll understand when you see it yourself.
flavor_zh: I received a request to hunt a Tetsucabra in the Volcanic Hollow. I'd never seen a beast with such a powerful aura. You'll understand when you see it yourself.

name: Triple Toady Terror
flavor: I hate to ask for even more help, Hunter, but could you take care of a Tetsucabra for us? It's one of 'em Hyper beasties, but if you take it out, we should be able to make some great gear!
flavor_zh: I hate to ask for even more help, Hunter, but could you take care of a Tetsucabra for us? It's one of 'em Hyper beasties, but if you take it out, we should be able to make some great gear!

name: The Coal Still Burns
flavor: My pop seems pretty set on creating the perfect set of armor, but I just want him to get some bed rest! Can you please get him some Coal so he doesn't overexert himself!? Pretty please!?
flavor_zh: My pop seems pretty set on creating the perfect set of armor, but I just want him to get some bed rest! Can you please get him some Coal so he doesn't overexert himself!? Pretty please!?

name: Woe Malfestio
flavor: A merchant looking for a Malfestio came to me, and I accidentally pointed her to a Hyper one. Oops! She has a bodyguard, but he's no hunter. Please take out that Hyper Malfestio!
flavor_zh: A merchant looking for a Malfestio came to me, and I accidentally pointed her to a Hyper one. Oops! She has a bodyguard, but he's no hunter. Please take out that Hyper Malfestio!

name: Born of Darkness
flavor: All we saw were two bright, flashing red eyes and suddenly my friends were unconscious at my feet. Please, help me avenge my friends and find a way to defeat this dark beast!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏迅龙的头部与刃翼
flavor_zh: All we saw were two bright, flashing red eyes and suddenly my friends were unconscious at my feet. Please, help me avenge my friends and find a way to defeat this dark beast!

name: Nibeling on Apples
flavor: I've discovered the ultimate apple! If only that Hyper Nibelsnarf weren't keeping me from harvesting more... But, the world must know of its deliciousness! Help me, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I've discovered the ultimate apple! If only that Hyper Nibelsnarf weren't keeping me from harvesting more... But, the world must know of its deliciousness! Help me, Hunter!

name: Warning: Hyper Yian Garuga!
flavor: Yian Garuga are known for their ill temperaments, and the Hyper anomaly only seems to exacerbate this. One such specimen is loose in the Hills. Not good. Hunter, you know what to do.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑狼鸟的头部与背部
flavor_zh: Yian Garuga are known for their ill temperaments, and the Hyper anomaly only seems to exacerbate this. One such specimen is loose in the Hills. Not good. Hunter, you know what to do.

name: Hyper for Holes
flavor: I was out on the Ridge looking for the perfect place to do some high-quality digging when a Hyper Blangonga attacked me and broke my favorite pickaxe! Argh! Dish out justice for me, Hunter!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雪狮子王的牙与尾巴
flavor_zh: I was out on the Ridge looking for the perfect place to do some high-quality digging when a Hyper Blangonga attacked me and broke my favorite pickaxe! Argh! Dish out justice for me, Hunter!

name: The Plesioth Adventure
flavor: I was walking in the Misty Peaks when I came across a Plesioth all riled up. And you know what? I think that sucker would be perfect practice for you! Now, go get 'em, sport!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏水龙的头部与背鳍
flavor_zh: I was walking in the Misty Peaks when I came across a Plesioth all riled up. And you know what? I think that sucker would be perfect practice for you! Now, go get 'em, sport!

name: Daimyo of the Deserted Island
flavor: I set out for the Deserted Island to reflect on my life and find ways I might better myself. But before I could get far, a Hyper Daimyo Hermitaur attacked me! Help me, so I can resume my meditation.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏大名盾蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: I set out for the Deserted Island to reflect on my life and find ways I might better myself. But before I could get far, a Hyper Daimyo Hermitaur attacked me! Help me, so I can resume my meditation.

name: Where the Wild Manes Are
flavor: Royal Ludroth have such lovely, fluffy necks! And I hear that recently, one with an exceptionally fluffy one is up and about! I wonder how soft it is... Please! You must help me find out!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏帅水兽的鬃毛，并且切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Royal Ludroth have such lovely, fluffy necks! And I hear that recently, one with an exceptionally fluffy one is up and about! I wonder how soft it is... Please! You must help me find out!

name: Hyper Investigation
flavor: We've been receiving reports of fierce monsters in the area that give off a dark red glow. Verify this information, and also take care of the Yian Kut-Kut spotted in the same area. Good luck.
flavor_zh: We've been receiving reports of fierce monsters in the area that give off a dark red glow. Verify this information, and also take care of the Yian Kut-Kut spotted in the same area. Good luck.

name: The Khezu and the Shadow
flavor: I saw a Khezu when I was out fishing. There was something odd about it though. It had some black haze on its face, making it look even creepier than usual. Please, get rid of it for us!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏白电的头部与身体
flavor_zh: I saw a Khezu when I was out fishing. There was something odd about it though. It had some black haze on its face, making it look even creepier than usual. Please, get rid of it for us!

name: Bring On the Shogun
flavor: I'm looking for somebody to hunt a Hyper Ceanataur! Its Hyper state makes its pincers dangerously sharp... But they'd be perfect for sharpening my weapons!
name_zh: 探究持有镰刀的将军吧
sub_goal_zh: 破坏将军镰蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: I'm looking for somebody to hunt a Hyper Ceanataur! Its Hyper state makes its pincers dangerously sharp... But they'd be perfect for sharpening my weapons!

name: Unnerving Najarala
flavor: I snuck into the Marshlands to check out some of the scary monsters there, and I saw a Najarala giving off some weird black smoke! Honest! Just don't tell my mom I was there!
name_zh: 绞蛇龙透出瘆人的笑意
sub_goal_zh: 破坏绞蛇龙的头部与尾巴
flavor_zh: I snuck into the Marshlands to check out some of the scary monsters there, and I saw a Najarala giving off some weird black smoke! Honest! Just don't tell my mom I was there!

name: Eruption Embodied
flavor: There's a Hyper Uragaan near our village, spewing out so much smoke and molten rocks that I really thought the Volcano was erupting! Our village is in real trouble. You've gotta help!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏爆锤龙的颚，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: There's a Hyper Uragaan near our village, spewing out so much smoke and molten rocks that I really thought the Volcano was erupting! Our village is in real trouble. You've gotta help!

name: The Magma's Rage
flavor: A certain...someone...needs you to complete this highly classified Quest. Even I am not sure why. Your target: a Hyper Lavasioth. I'm sure this goes without saying, but be careful.
name_zh: 绝密委托！狞猛的熔岩龙！
sub_goal_zh: 破坏熔岩龙的头部与1背鳍
flavor_zh: A certain...someone...needs you to complete this highly classified Quest. Even I am not sure why. Your target: a Hyper Lavasioth. I'm sure this goes without saying, but be careful.

name: Minion Audition Imposition
flavor: If you really want to be Cha-Cha's minion, you must prove yourself-self! In the Marshlands, Hyper Yian Kut-Ku and Shogun Ceanataur need hunting! Cha-Cha will be watcha-latching you!
flavor_zh: If you really want to be Cha-Cha's minion, you must prove yourself-self! In the Marshlands, Hyper Yian Kut-Ku and Shogun Ceanataur need hunting! Cha-Cha will be watcha-latching you!

name: Barioth Hunt
flavor: *sigh* Can NOTHING save me from the depths of my boredom? I got it! I want the so-called "white demon," the Barioth! Such a cold-hearted creature might ALMOST amuse me, so hop to it, peasant!
flavor_zh: *sigh* Can NOTHING save me from the depths of my boredom? I got it! I want the so-called "white demon," the Barioth! Such a cold-hearted creature might ALMOST amuse me, so hop to it, peasant!

name: A Cure for Cowardice
flavor: Hmph, the Chief might get angry with me, but there's no way I'm apologizing... Yeah, well, if someone ever managed to hunt down a Gravios in the Volcanic Hollow, maybe then I'd have a change of heart and be nice to my sis! (Ha, fat chance of that!)
name_zh: 专治窝囊废的铠龙一喝！
flavor_zh: Hmph, the Chief might get angry with me, but there's no way I'm apologizing... Yeah, well, if someone ever managed to hunt down a Gravios in the Volcanic Hollow, maybe then I'd have a change of heart and be nice to my sis! (Ha, fat chance of that!)

name: Stop the Wheel
flavor: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?
name_zh: 吾将轮回，吾将聚集，吾将归来
flavor_zh: I've only known the gods from their legends -- never did I expect to see one in my lifetime. Dare you attempt to halt the cycle of death and etch your own name into legend, Hunter?

name: A Gathering of Wyverns
goal: Hunt an Astalos and a Rathian
flavor: You'll never guess what I saw! An Astalos trying to pick up a Rathian! Clearly, this is a case of forbidden love... Or it is in my book! This is simply too scandalous! Please do something!
name_zh: 热恋暴露！？龙之间的幽会！
goal_zh: 狩猎1头电龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: You'll never guess what I saw! An Astalos trying to pick up a Rathian! Clearly, this is a case of forbidden love... Or it is in my book! This is simply too scandalous! Please do something!

name: A Song of White and Lapis
goal: Hunt a Mizutsune and a Malfestio
flavor: I had a dream where I was covered in white bubbles and surrounded by lapis-colored feathers. When I woke up, I saw a Mizutsune and a Malfestio fighting. Please drive them off so I can sleep!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头泡狐龙和1头夜鸟
flavor_zh: I had a dream where I was covered in white bubbles and surrounded by lapis-colored feathers. When I woke up, I saw a Mizutsune and a Malfestio fighting. Please drive them off so I can sleep!

name: A Cold Set of Armor
goal: Hunt a Gammoth and a Zamtrios
flavor: I've heard that monsters in the Frozen Seaway have armor of ice and snow. If I knew their secrets, I could make some truly splendid armor. I'm not a fighter, so could you do some research on my behalf?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头巨兽和1头变形冰鲨
flavor_zh: I've heard that monsters in the Frozen Seaway have armor of ice and snow. If I knew their secrets, I could make some truly splendid armor. I'm not a fighter, so could you do some research on my behalf?

name: Rocked and Rolled
flavor: Ever take a knockout punch? I know a monster who packs a wallop. And don't get me started on its sticky goop. Good thing it came off before I went down for the count. You up for a round?
flavor_zh: Ever take a knockout punch? I know a monster who packs a wallop. And don't get me started on its sticky goop. Good thing it came off before I went down for the count. You up for a round?

name: So Notable: Seregios
flavor: I need your help ASAP! I've got a fresh notebook page just screaming to be filled with facts, and I know just what will do the trick: a freshly captured Seregios! Good luck!
name_zh: 超级☆备忘录 ～千刃龙捕获篇～
flavor_zh: I need your help ASAP! I've got a fresh notebook page just screaming to be filled with facts, and I know just what will do the trick: a freshly captured Seregios! Good luck!

name: Hammer vs. Blade
goal: Hunt a Glavenus and an Uragaan
flavor: I found two monsters in the Volcanic Hollow, both wielding finely honed weapons: a sharp sword and a crushing hammer. Dangerous weapons like those must be apprehended.
name_zh: 锤子与刀刃的短兵相接
goal_zh: 狩猎1头斩龙和1头爆锤龙
flavor_zh: I found two monsters in the Volcanic Hollow, both wielding finely honed weapons: a sharp sword and a crushing hammer. Dangerous weapons like those must be apprehended.

name: A Roar to the Heavens
goal: Hunt a Zinogre and a Tigrex
flavor: I ran into a Tigrex in the Frontier, and then a Zinogre jumped out, too! Just when I thought I was done for, the Tigrex charged the Zinogre, and I made a break for it! I can't take much more of this!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头雷狼龙和1头轰龙
flavor_zh: I ran into a Tigrex in the Frontier, and then a Zinogre jumped out, too! Just when I thought I was done for, the Tigrex charged the Zinogre, and I made a break for it! I can't take much more of this!

name: The Hapless Bodyguard
flavor: If I'm gonna follow this plan to a T, I'm going to need all the materials I can get! And I can't get them with a bunch of Rajang hanging on my back. That's where you come in!
flavor_zh: If I'm gonna follow this plan to a T, I'm going to need all the materials I can get! And I can't get them with a bunch of Rajang hanging on my back. That's where you come in!

name: Seer of Swords
flavor: Seregios, or the "Wyvern of One Thousand Blades," has made an appearance. Razor- sharp scales and strength that may even surpass that of Rathalos. Keep your wits about you, young Hunter.
flavor_zh: Seregios, or the "Wyvern of One Thousand Blades," has made an appearance. Razor- sharp scales and strength that may even surpass that of Rathalos. Keep your wits about you, young Hunter.

name: The Yukumo Gal Special
flavor: That Quest the Yukumo Gal recommended to me was ridiculous! Did she really expect me to take on a pair of Zinogres by myself!? Be a pal and take this Quest off my hands!
flavor_zh: That Quest the Yukumo Gal recommended to me was ridiculous! Did she really expect me to take on a pair of Zinogres by myself!? Be a pal and take this Quest off my hands!

name: Repaying the Favor
flavor: My apprentice in Bherna got into some trouble. I want to repay the kind purrson who bailed him out with Brachydios materials, but my paws are tied with work! Could you go instead?
name_zh: 为硬干的弟子收拾残局
flavor_zh: My apprentice in Bherna got into some trouble. I want to repay the kind purrson who bailed him out with Brachydios materials, but my paws are tied with work! Could you go instead?

name: You Bet Your Life
goal: Hunt a Deviljho and a Rajang
flavor: "Nobody can handle a Rajang and a Deviljho," they said. "Impossible," they said. So I made an impulse bet with my life savings. Now I have gambler's remorse. Mind evening the odds for me?
name_zh: 战战兢兢，最恐怖的组合
goal_zh: 狩猎1头恐暴龙和1头金狮子
flavor_zh: "Nobody can handle a Rajang and a Deviljho," they said. "Impossible," they said. So I made an impulse bet with my life savings. Now I have gambler's remorse. Mind evening the odds for me?

name: Wyvern's Way
goal: Hunt a Yian Garuga and a Tigrex
flavor: I hear there's a foreign sport where participants compete to see who can most elegantly dodge a charging beast. I'd like to see it for myself, so I've prepared the beasts. Now, give me a good show!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头黑狼鸟和1头轰龙
flavor_zh: I hear there's a foreign sport where participants compete to see who can most elegantly dodge a charging beast. I'd like to see it for myself, so I've prepared the beasts. Now, give me a good show!

name: Bewitching Heat
goal: Hunt a Glavenus and a Mizutsune
flavor: There are two mighty beasts at the Forlorn Arena. One harbors extreme heat as it cuts opponents to ribbons, while the other bewitches its opponents with its spry movements. Stay alert!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头斩龙和1头泡狐龙
flavor_zh: There are two mighty beasts at the Forlorn Arena. One harbors extreme heat as it cuts opponents to ribbons, while the other bewitches its opponents with its spry movements. Stay alert!

name: The Mountain God's Lightning
goal: Hunt an Astalos and a Gammoth
flavor: There are two mighty beasts at the Forlorn Arena. One attacks by freezing its foes to their very core, while the other fires electric blasts to stun its prey. Steel yourself for the battle ahead.
flavor_zh: There are two mighty beasts at the Forlorn Arena. One attacks by freezing its foes to their very core, while the other fires electric blasts to stun its prey. Steel yourself for the battle ahead.

name: A Man's Arena is His Castle
flavor: I walk away for five minutes and the place is crawling with monsters! Lagombi, Blangonga, Zamtrios, and a Gammoth! Someone's gotta teach 'em their proper place! Hm? You're saying that's my job?
name_zh: 久居为安的斗技场生活
flavor_zh: I walk away for five minutes and the place is crawling with monsters! Lagombi, Blangonga, Zamtrios, and a Gammoth! Someone's gotta teach 'em their proper place! Hm? You're saying that's my job?

name: The Hunter Games
goal: Hunt all large monsters, not including Seltas
flavor: We've got an intense lineup for everyone today! Foxes, beasts, fish, and even bugs! This gauntlet's sure to have challengers quaking in their booties. Hahaha! Well, have fun out there!
goal_zh: 除穿甲虫以外狩猎所有大型怪物
flavor_zh: 未知

name: The Flames of War
flavor: The Arena is blazing with action today! Why, you ask? Because it's stoked with lava, exploding rocks, flaming breath, and red-hot blades! Got what it takes to burn through the competition?
flavor_zh: The Arena is blazing with action today! Why, you ask? Because it's stoked with lava, exploding rocks, flaming breath, and red-hot blades! Got what it takes to burn through the competition?

name: A Shocking Revelation!
flavor: Every time I walk around, I get zapped with static! Mom says it's 'cause there's so many Thunder monsters around. I dunno about that, but I do know that these shocks hurt! Please help!
flavor_zh: Every time I walk around, I get zapped with static! Mom says it's 'cause there's so many Thunder monsters around. I dunno about that, but I do know that these shocks hurt! Please help!

name: The Gathering Storm
flavor: Wyverns have gathered in the Sanctuary, casting dark shadows over it as they split the earth and rip through flesh. Will you be the one to face these foul beasts?
name_zh: 齐聚在彼方的毁灭性灾祸
flavor_zh: Wyverns have gathered in the Sanctuary, casting dark shadows over it as they split the earth and rip through flesh. Will you be the one to face these foul beasts?

name: Hellfire Star
flavor: Attention all hunters. Slaying Nakarkos is now the Wycademy's top priority. Combine your efforts and bring this task to fruition. May luck be with you.
flavor_zh: Attention all hunters. Slaying Nakarkos is now the Wycademy's top priority. Combine your efforts and bring this task to fruition. May luck be with you.

name: Putting the Gore in Magala
flavor: We've received word that a Hyper Gore Magala is in the Ancestral Steppe. I'd like for you to head out there right away. A Hyper specimen of Gore Magala is a deadly foe. Be careful out there.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑蚀龙的触角与翼爪
flavor_zh: We've received word that a Hyper Gore Magala is in the Ancestral Steppe. I'd like for you to head out there right away. A Hyper specimen of Gore Magala is a deadly foe. Be careful out there.

name: Tigrex, Tigrex, Burning Bright
flavor: A certain...someone...needs you to complete this highly classified Quest. Even I am not sure why. Your target: a Hyper Tigrex. I'm sure this goes without saying, but be careful.
flavor_zh: A certain...someone...needs you to complete this highly classified Quest. Even I am not sure why. Your target: a Hyper Tigrex. I'm sure this goes without saying, but be careful.

name: A Thousand Blades of Wrath
flavor: S-Somebody help us! A H-Hyper Seregios showed up and... Ahhh! Wh-What should we d-do!? S-Somebody get rid of that thing!
flavor_zh: S-Somebody help us! A H-Hyper Seregios showed up and... Ahhh! Wh-What should we d-do!? S-Somebody get rid of that thing!

name: A Fiery Temper
flavor: Help! A Hyper Rathalos is in the Volcanic Hollow! I told the Kokoto Gal that if we didn't act now, we'd all be done for, but she just laughed! I can't be the only one who thinks we're in big trouble!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏火龙的翼，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Help! A Hyper Rathalos is in the Volcanic Hollow! I told the Kokoto Gal that if we didn't act now, we'd all be done for, but she just laughed! I can't be the only one who thinks we're in big trouble!

name: The Unassailable Seltas Queen
flavor: I was asked to hunt a Seltas Queen, but my hunting skills were insufficient for the task. It isn't like regular Seltas Queens, but I-I must train harder. Please fulfill the task in my stead, Hunter.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏重甲虫的头部与脚
flavor_zh: I was asked to hunt a Seltas Queen, but my hunting skills were insufficient for the task. It isn't like regular Seltas Queens, but I-I must train harder. Please fulfill the task in my stead, Hunter.

name: Savage Sword of the Desert
flavor: It was so hot, the air itself hissed as if burned. That was no ordinary blade, but one expertly forged for battle. If I face it again, I fear it will shatter my trusted blade. I must leave the rest to you.
name_zh: 灼热沙漠上的勇猛刀剑
sub_goal_zh: 破坏斩龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: It was so hot, the air itself hissed as if burned. That was no ordinary blade, but one expertly forged for battle. If I face it again, I fear it will shatter my trusted blade. I must leave the rest to you.

name: Wyvernlit Evening
flavor: That intimidating crest and its sharp gaze cutting through that menacing dark glow... These things are terrifying! What could they be planning? No! I-It can't be! It's coming toward us! P-Please, help!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏电龙的头冠与背部
flavor_zh: That intimidating crest and its sharp gaze cutting through that menacing dark glow... These things are terrifying! What could they be planning? No! I-It can't be! It's coming toward us! P-Please, help!

name: Wyverns All Around Us
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: You look ready to rumble with some tough monsters! Lucky for you, a pair of Hyper wyverns are tearin' through the Verdant Hills. Dangerous, sure, but I'm sure you can handle 'em!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: You look ready to rumble with some tough monsters! Lucky for you, a pair of Hyper wyverns are tearin' through the Verdant Hills. Dangerous, sure, but I'm sure you can handle 'em!

name: Wild Gods, Calm Rangers
flavor: The god of the mountains, Gammoth, is threatening a nearby village. Is there anyone who can stop its footsteps that rupture the earth, its breath that com- mands the fury of winter?
flavor_zh: The god of the mountains, Gammoth, is threatening a nearby village. Is there anyone who can stop its footsteps that rupture the earth, its breath that com- mands the fury of winter?

name: Into the Maelstrom
flavor: De wa, to prove how effective is your training, I propose little test! This Lagiacrus is more abunai than average. Extra danger! The sea breeze says you'll need to give it your all!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏海龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: De wa, to prove how effective is your training, I propose little test! This Lagiacrus is more abunai than average. Extra danger! The sea breeze says you'll need to give it your all!

name: The Lithe and Unbreaking
flavor: The Mizutsune moves with power and fluidity, strength and beauty. And the aura this one gives off is almost ethereal. Do you think you even have a chance of defeating it?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏泡狐龙的头部与背鳍
flavor_zh: The Mizutsune moves with power and fluidity, strength and beauty. And the aura this one gives off is almost ethereal. Do you think you even have a chance of defeating it?

name: The Peril of the Land
flavor: A Hyper Duramboros is running amok, ripping out trees and threatening to reduce our mountains to ruins... Please! Defeat this beast and save our beautiful land!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏尾锤龙的角与肉峰
flavor_zh: A Hyper Duramboros is running amok, ripping out trees and threatening to reduce our mountains to ruins... Please! Defeat this beast and save our beautiful land!

name: The Wolf and the Footbath
flavor: Our footbath has been flourishing! The only thing is, the equipment hasn't held up. If you could take care of the Hyper Zinogre roaming about, we could get materials to fix it up!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雷狼龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: Our footbath has been flourishing! The only thing is, the equipment hasn't held up. If you could take care of the Hyper Zinogre roaming about, we could get materials to fix it up!

name: The Thieving Gypceros
flavor: That hammer... I poured my heart and soul into it, only for those Gypceros in the Marshlands to swipe it from me! Get rid of 'em for me, and I'll get it back once the coast is clear!
flavor_zh: That hammer... I poured my heart and soul into it, only for those Gypceros in the Marshlands to swipe it from me! Get rid of 'em for me, and I'll get it back once the coast is clear!

name: Steam and Smoke
flavor: To purrvide our patrons with a more soothing footbath experience, we need some Volcanic Ore. Unfortunately, an especially fierce Brachydios is in the way. Please help, Hunter!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏碎龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: To purrvide our patrons with a more soothing footbath experience, we need some Volcanic Ore. Unfortunately, an especially fierce Brachydios is in the way. Please help, Hunter!

name: The Glowing Embers
flavor: As if its lava coating weren't enough, that Agnaktor had some glowing crud all over it! And when those parts hit me, I might as well have been wearing paper armor! Please, finish it off for me!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏炎戈龙的背部与脚
flavor_zh: As if its lava coating weren't enough, that Agnaktor had some glowing crud all over it! And when those parts hit me, I might as well have been wearing paper armor! Please, finish it off for me!

name: Primal Forest Defense
goal: Hunt all large monsters, not including Seltas
flavor: Some good friends of ours are in trouble after a buncha Hyper Monsters showed up in the Primal Forest! I got a feelin' yer the only one who can help. You're the one to get it done!
goal_zh: 除穿甲虫以外狩猎所有大型怪物
flavor_zh: Some good friends of ours are in trouble after a buncha Hyper Monsters showed up in the Primal Forest! I got a feelin' yer the only one who can help. You're the one to get it done!

name: The End of the Trials
flavor: I've got a big favor to ask. I need you to hunt down a Tigrex and a Seregios. They're both Hyper, so I know that ordinary hunters wouldn't stand a chance. But you're no ordinary hunter!
flavor_zh: I've got a big favor to ask. I need you to hunt down a Tigrex and a Seregios. They're both Hyper, so I know that ordinary hunters wouldn't stand a chance. But you're no ordinary hunter!

name: The Descending Fog
flavor: I have a request for the famed Wycademy Hunter. A group of Hyper Monsters has descended upon the Verdant Hills. You may be our only hope. Our trust is in you!
flavor_zh: I have a request for the famed Wycademy Hunter. A group of Hyper Monsters has descended upon the Verdant Hills. You may be our only hope. Our trust is in you!

name: Searching for Secret Baths
flavor: We found the purrfect purrlace to build a fabulous mew hot spring. The purroblem is, it's overrun with Hypurr Meownsters. Could you make them vacate the purremises?
name_zh: 寻求尚未面世的秘密温泉
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雷狼龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: We found the purrfect purrlace to build a fabulous mew hot spring. The purroblem is, it's overrun with Hypurr Meownsters. Could you make them vacate the purremises?

name: Show Me Your Shaka-Strength
flavor: Cha-Cha hear voice, and it tell Cha-Cha that if can defeat a red wyvern, turquoise wolf, and blue leviathan, then all be made clear! You no laka-look busy. Help Cha-Cha out!
flavor_zh: Cha-Cha hear voice, and it tell Cha-Cha that if can defeat a red wyvern, turquoise wolf, and blue leviathan, then all be made clear! You no laka-look busy. Help Cha-Cha out!

name: The Marshlands Nightmare
flavor: Aha! Perfect timing! I've got just the Quest for a hunter of your *hic* talents! How d'ya feel about some Hyper monsters? Thass the ticket! Now, go and ssshow me what yer made of! *hic*
flavor_zh: Aha! Perfect timing! I've got just the Quest for a hunter of your *hic* talents! How d'ya feel about some Hyper monsters? Thass the ticket! Now, go and ssshow me what yer made of! *hic*

name: The Birds of Prey
flavor: Beware the beaks that bite, the claws that catch! The shrieking Yian Kut-Ku; the colorful Malfestio; and the war machine, Yian Garuga! Slay these beasts and bring safety to the skies!
flavor_zh: Beware the beaks that bite, the claws that catch! The shrieking Yian Kut-Ku; the colorful Malfestio; and the war machine, Yian Garuga! Slay these beasts and bring safety to the skies!

name: The Fanged Beasts
flavor: Beware the beasts that pierce with tusk and fang. The giant Gammoth; the erratic Kecha Wacha; and the wily Blangonga! Can you avoid the skewer of these sharp challengers?
flavor_zh: Beware the beasts that pierce with tusk and fang. The giant Gammoth; the erratic Kecha Wacha; and the wily Blangonga! Can you avoid the skewer of these sharp challengers?

name: The Winged Wyverns
flavor: Beware the skies and those that rule it! The new rival, Astalos; the divebombing Rathalos; and the flesh- tearing Seregios. Do you have what it takes to reclaim the skies?
flavor_zh: Beware the skies and those that rule it! The new rival, Astalos; the divebombing Rathalos; and the flesh- tearing Seregios. Do you have what it takes to reclaim the skies?

name: The Foes of the Deep
flavor: Beware the creatures of the deep! The bewitching bubble fox, Mizutsune; the torrential blasts of Plesioth; the all- devouring Nibelsnarf; and the thunderous Lagiacrus! Will you sink or swim?
flavor_zh: Beware the creatures of the deep! The bewitching bubble fox, Mizutsune; the torrential blasts of Plesioth; the all- devouring Nibelsnarf; and the thunderous Lagiacrus! Will you sink or swim?

name: The Beasts of Brawn
flavor: Beware the beasts of strength and savagery! The massive Uragaan; the whirling might of Duramboros; the brute strength of Brachydios; and the razor-bladed Glavenus. Who will reign king?
flavor_zh: Beware the beasts of strength and savagery! The massive Uragaan; the whirling might of Duramboros; the brute strength of Brachydios; and the razor-bladed Glavenus. Who will reign king?

name: Ring of the Silver Sol
flavor: I saw it with my own eyes! Two suns blazing up in the sky, except one was all silvery. I couldn't make this stuff up if I tried! It's up to you to get to the bottom of this!
flavor_zh: I saw it with my own eyes! Two suns blazing up in the sky, except one was all silvery. I couldn't make this stuff up if I tried! It's up to you to get to the bottom of this!

name: Ring of the Golden Lune
flavor: *Sigh* Life as king is just one council meeting after another. I long to see the wonders of the world, like the golden wyvern from my minstrel's ballads. Bring it to me, Hunter!
flavor_zh: *Sigh* Life as king is just one council meeting after another. I long to see the wonders of the world, like the golden wyvern from my minstrel's ballads. Bring it to me, Hunter!

name: Usurpers of the Throne
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: The king robed in silver, and the queen wrapped in gold. Those who defeat them can truly claim to have usurped the throne of Hunterdom. I await with a toast to your success, Hunter.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: The king robed in silver, and the queen wrapped in gold. Those who defeat them can truly claim to have usurped the throne of Hunterdom. I await with a toast to your success, Hunter.

name: Child of Destruction
flavor: The Rajang has shown its true colors at last. Left un- checked, it will visit utter destruction upon us. I must entrust you with its defeat, as I have another task, and dear ones awaiting my return.
flavor_zh: The Rajang has shown its true colors at last. Left un- checked, it will visit utter destruction upon us. I must entrust you with its defeat, as I have another task, and dear ones awaiting my return.

name: A Shock in the Dark
flavor: The moon is especially beautiful here. Nature is at its best when untouched by mankind... However, you must beware, as this very nature may visit its wrath upon the unsuspecting.
name_zh: 现身在月夜下石狮的雷击
flavor_zh: The moon is especially beautiful here. Nature is at its best when untouched by mankind... However, you must beware, as this very nature may visit its wrath upon the unsuspecting.

name: Triumphant Rage
flavor: Even within the Loc Lac Guild, there is one monster that keeps us all on our toes...the Deviljho! You are perhaps the only hunter capable of taking it on! Defeat this foul beast!
flavor_zh: Even within the Loc Lac Guild, there is one monster that keeps us all on our toes...the Deviljho! You are perhaps the only hunter capable of taking it on! Defeat this foul beast!

name: The Frozen Dictator
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
flavor: I saw it! I know I did! A pair of black wings among a flurry of snow... Then a gust of wind nearly blew me off the mountain! Take my advice and don't even go near that thing!
flavor_zh: I saw it! I know I did! A pair of black wings among a flurry of snow... Then a gust of wind nearly blew me off the mountain! Take my advice and don't even go near that thing!

name: Kushala Daora Strikes
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
flavor: Blizzards have been striking with increasing frequency. We've managed to identify a Kushala Daora as the cause. The storms are growing...and may consume us all. Please, Hunter, you must help us.
flavor_zh: Blizzards have been striking with increasing frequency. We've managed to identify a Kushala Daora as the cause. The storms are growing...and may consume us all. Please, Hunter, you must help us.

name: The Elder Dragon of Mist
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: I sensed a strong presence and turned around, but there was nobody there. There's no way anything could have sneaked up on us from our vantage point, but still... Keep your guard up, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I sensed a strong presence and turned around, but there was nobody there. There's no way anything could have sneaked up on us from our vantage point, but still... Keep your guard up, Hunter!

name: Beyond the Silence
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: A mysterious elder dragon has appeared, but no one has set eyes upon it. Of course, seeing it may be the last thing you do... We need you to eliminate it, but please be careful!
flavor_zh: A mysterious elder dragon has appeared, but no one has set eyes upon it. Of course, seeing it may be the last thing you do... We need you to eliminate it, but please be careful!

name: Emperor of Flame
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: I beg of you, help me in carrying out my last task. I've chased a Teostra to the Volcano. Beware its flames, for they may roast you alive if you are careless. Godspeed, Hunter!
flavor_zh: I beg of you, help me in carrying out my last task. I've chased a Teostra to the Volcano. Beware its flames, for they may roast you alive if you are careless. Godspeed, Hunter!

name: The Fires of Devastation
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: When I was a child, a Teostra attacked our village. Now, that foul beast has come again to rain destruction down upon us. Please! Put an end to this evil presence!
flavor_zh: When I was a child, a Teostra attacked our village. Now, that foul beast has come again to rain destruction down upon us. Please! Put an end to this evil presence!

name: Grim Tidings
flavor: Uh-oh. Our observers over at the Volcano have gone silent. Their last message mentioned something about a "black god." That can't be good. We need someone to investigate.
flavor_zh: Uh-oh. Our observers over at the Volcano have gone silent. Their last message mentioned something about a "black god." That can't be good. We need someone to investigate.

name: Absolute Zero
flavor: An Ukanlos appeared in the Polar Field and is headed towards this village. But we've got one hope, and that's you. Everyone here believes in you. Please, save our village!
flavor_zh: An Ukanlos appeared in the Polar Field and is headed towards this village. But we've got one hope, and that's you. Everyone here believes in you. Please, save our village!

name: The Looming Calamity
flavor: We have met many times, and you have never failed to impress me with your courage in the face of adversity. Now, with Amatsu threatening our village, we need your bravery more than ever.
flavor_zh: We have met many times, and you have never failed to impress me with your courage in the face of adversity. Now, with Amatsu threatening our village, we need your bravery more than ever.

name: The Brilliant Darkness
flavor: "None can foresee disaster. In darkness, it comes; among despair, it departs. Now is such a time, when all may struggle...and in the end, perish." Catchy, eh? My aide wrote it. Anyway, save us!
flavor_zh: "None can foresee disaster. In darkness, it comes; among despair, it departs. Now is such a time, when all may struggle...and in the end, perish." Catchy, eh? My aide wrote it. Anyway, save us!

name: Legendary Skills?
flavor: Are you ready to prove yourself to me, darling? A Diablos is attacking the neighboring settlements from its lair in the Dunes. Beware its two-horned charge, and watch for when it bursts from the ground too. It knows no mercy!
name_zh: 你的本领真的名副其实吗……？
flavor_zh: Are you ready to prove yourself to me, darling? A Diablos is attacking the neighboring settlements from its lair in the Dunes. Beware its two-horned charge, and watch for when it bursts from the ground too. It knows no mercy!

name: Steppe in the Right Direction
flavor: On my travels across the Ancestral Steppe, I stumbled upon a fearsome Deviljho! I ran as fast as I could, but now my legs have given out. I entrust this message to a Kelbi I befriended on the way -- even though it didn't seem too keen on the idea at first!
flavor_zh: On my travels across the Ancestral Steppe, I stumbled upon a fearsome Deviljho! I ran as fast as I could, but now my legs have given out. I entrust this message to a Kelbi I befriended on the way -- even though it didn't seem too keen on the idea at first!

name: Rajang's Black Spirit
flavor: It was all so sudden. It just came rushing out of the undergrowth. Mane flowing, wrapped in some dark aura... Wouldn't want to head back in there for fear of meeting that again. We'll have to wait for the Guild to take care of it.
flavor_zh: It was all so sudden. It just came rushing out of the undergrowth. Mane flowing, wrapped in some dark aura... Wouldn't want to head back in there for fear of meeting that again. We'll have to wait for the Guild to take care of it.

name: Following the Fallen
sub_goal: Wound Silver Rathalos's head and wings
flavor: I first met my husband in the Jurassic Frontier when he rescued me from a Silver Rathalos. So if I can find a Rathalos, maybe I could meet him again... If anyone reads this, please don't come looking for me. I won't give up on him. I can't...
sub_goal_zh: 破坏银火龙的头部与翼
flavor_zh: I first met my husband in the Jurassic Frontier when he rescued me from a Silver Rathalos. So if I can find a Rathalos, maybe I could meet him again... If anyone reads this, please don't come looking for me. I won't give up on him. I can't...

name: Fool's Gold
sub_goal: Wound Gold Rathian's head and wings
flavor: Urgently requesting help in Misty Peaks. Reports of rare Rathian breed attacking patrols from nearby villages. Hunters gone to help now missing. Bad situation we're in. Send help to deal with Rathian!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏金火龙的头部与翼
flavor_zh: Urgently requesting help in Misty Peaks. Reports of rare Rathian breed attacking patrols from nearby villages. Hunters gone to help now missing. Bad situation we're in. Send help to deal with Rathian!

name: Shining Examples
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: A Gold Rathian and a Silver Rathalos... How fierce, how exciting, how beautiful! I can't take my eyes off them... And what better chance to see them again than in the Arena! Don't be shy, get in there!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: A Gold Rathian and a Silver Rathalos... How fierce, how exciting, how beautiful! I can't take my eyes off them... And what better chance to see them again than in the Arena! Don't be shy, get in there!

name: Harvest Tour: Ruined Pinnacle
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Oh, hello, darling. My intuition tells me that you'd love to go gathering up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Am I wrong? Well, I have just the Quest for you. Go and satisfy your gathering urges, and just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done. It's as easy as that.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Oh, hello, darling. My intuition tells me that you'd love to go gathering up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Am I wrong? Well, I have just the Quest for you. Go and satisfy your gathering urges, and just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're done. It's as easy as that.

name: Harvest Tour: Desert
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Hello, darling. I can sense that you're yearning for a taste of the Desert's rich bounty. Don't try and hide it! Go, take this Quest, and scratch that itch. Deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're satisfied. That's all.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Hello, darling. I can sense that you're yearning for a taste of the Desert's rich bounty. Don't try and hide it! Go, take this Quest, and scratch that itch. Deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you're satisfied. That's all.

name: A Brush with Bugs
flavor: Waaa! I can't... Eww! I need a shower... I was at the Jurassic Frontier, and this absolutely enormous vile insect came flying at me! And then another one, even worse, to top it off! Get out there and squish them! Please! Oh no, is one of them on me!?
flavor_zh: Waaa! I can't... Eww! I need a shower... I was at the Jurassic Frontier, and this absolutely enormous vile insect came flying at me! And then another one, even worse, to top it off! Get out there and squish them! Please! Oh no, is one of them on me!?

name: Riverside Rumble
flavor: Hey, have you got a sec? I wanted to check out the fish from that pretty river they've got in Yukumo, but there was one of those Arzuros things going wild at the Misty Peaks. I can't concentrate on fish with one of those things about. Can you go and whack it for me?
flavor_zh: Hey, have you got a sec? I wanted to check out the fish from that pretty river they've got in Yukumo, but there was one of those Arzuros things going wild at the Misty Peaks. I can't concentrate on fish with one of those things about. Can you go and whack it for me?

name: Survival of the Biggest
goal: Hunt a Giadrome and a Bulldrome
flavor: A Giadrome and Bulldrome have turned up at the Arctic Ridge and they're beefing over territory. It's getting in the way of my observation activities, so do you think you could snuff them out for me? But be careful... They're pretty beastly.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头白速龙王和1头野猪王
flavor_zh: A Giadrome and Bulldrome have turned up at the Arctic Ridge and they're beefing over territory. It's getting in the way of my observation activities, so do you think you could snuff them out for me? But be careful... They're pretty beastly.

name: Pecking Order
flavor: Oh, geez, this is really... I mean, this bird thing was just poking at me with its beak... It didn't really hurt, but it was just like... I can't really describe it. I think it would be best all round if you just went and got rid of it for me.
flavor_zh: Oh, geez, this is really... I mean, this bird thing was just poking at me with its beak... It didn't really hurt, but it was just like... I can't really describe it. I think it would be best all round if you just went and got rid of it for me.

name: Enough Monkeying Around
flavor: Well I never! That vile primate thing came at me in the Primal Forest. I've had it up here with its pranks and tomfoolery! Hunter, could you please take care of it before I do something I regret?
flavor_zh: Well I never! That vile primate thing came at me in the Primal Forest. I've had it up here with its pranks and tomfoolery! Hunter, could you please take care of it before I do something I regret?

name: The Killer Rabbit of Arctic Ridge
flavor: Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up the mountain to see the bunny. It looked so darn...ANGRY! All my hopes and dreams, dashed in an instant! Where is my cute fluffybun!? Put that abomination somewhere I can't see it, ever!
flavor_zh: Don't tell my brother, but I snuck up the mountain to see the bunny. It looked so darn...ANGRY! All my hopes and dreams, dashed in an instant! Where is my cute fluffybun!? Put that abomination somewhere I can't see it, ever!

name: Lost, But Not for Long
flavor: Waaaah! This is just *sob* terrible! My *sniff* my super important survey report... I was out on the Ancestral Steppe when this *hic* Gypceros stole it! My academic career will be OVER!!! You gotta get my report back, *sob* pleeeease!
flavor_zh: Waaaah! This is just *sob* terrible! My *sniff* my super important survey report... I was out on the Ancestral Steppe when this *hic* Gypceros stole it! My academic career will be OVER!!! You gotta get my report back, *sob* pleeeease!

name: Pleasantly Sozzled
flavor: I've obtained infurmation through completely lawful means on some ingredients in the Jurassic Furrontier which I need for my plan. Unfurtunately a Tetsucabra is in the way... Could you lend me a paw by hunting the monster while I swipe the goods? Nya!
name_zh: 罪恶深重木桶的食材探访
flavor_zh: I've obtained infurmation through completely lawful means on some ingredients in the Jurassic Furrontier which I need for my plan. Unfurtunately a Tetsucabra is in the way... Could you lend me a paw by hunting the monster while I swipe the goods? Nya!

name: Surprise!
goal: Hunt a Cephadrome and a Daimyo Hermitaur
flavor: Okay, just breathe, just breathe... Is this place trying to kill me!? I'm just out traipsing through the sand when a Cephadrome AND Daimyo Hermitaur pop out! I'm not sure how much more I can take... Hunter, can you sort this out before I have an arrest?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头砂龙王和1只大名盾蟹
flavor_zh: Okay, just breathe, just breathe... Is this place trying to kill me!? I'm just out traipsing through the sand when a Cephadrome AND Daimyo Hermitaur pop out! I'm not sure how much more I can take... Hunter, can you sort this out before I have an arrest?

name: A Berry Dubious Idea
flavor: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Tropical Berries that grow in the Desert? I just came up with a way to make them really tasty! They're going to be HUGE! I think I smell money... I'll split the profits with you if you collect some for me. 70-30?
name_zh: 热带草莓有金钱的味道？
flavor_zh: Hunter, Hunter! Are you familiar with the Tropical Berries that grow in the Desert? I just came up with a way to make them really tasty! They're going to be HUGE! I think I smell money... I'll split the profits with you if you collect some for me. 70-30?

name: Daimyo Hermitaur Flambé
flavor: I am determined to teach ma langue divine to tolerate ze heat! Zere is but one purroblème. Fur ze heat, I must be in ze Desert. But in ze Desert, zere are ze meownsters... I love ze crab cakes, but zis Daimyo Hermitaur is too much for me to handle...!
name_zh: 狩猎滚烫沙漠中的大名盾蟹
flavor_zh: I am determined to teach ma langue divine to tolerate ze heat! Zere is but one purroblème. Fur ze heat, I must be in ze Desert. But in ze Desert, zere are ze meownsters... I love ze crab cakes, but zis Daimyo Hermitaur is too much for me to handle...!

name: Ruined Pinnacle, RUINED
flavor: Th-This is terrible! Because of the intense methane buildup from all the Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks! They just won't stop farting! How are we supposed to do any research under these conditions!? Can you thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!
flavor_zh: Th-This is terrible! Because of the intense methane buildup from all the Congas, the Ruined Pinnacle stinks! They just won't stop farting! How are we supposed to do any research under these conditions!? Can you thin their numbers a bit? ...Puaah!

name: Sweetheart's Pick: Lofty Ludroth
flavor: Thanks for accepting this Quest, Hunter! This time you'll be fighting a Royal Ludroth at the Ruined Pinnacle. It's a bit similar to the crazy one my apprentice, the Yukumo Gal, was thinking of. Just, you know, made a bit more sane. I really appreciate your help!
name_zh: 看板娘精选：无人山岭的水兽
flavor_zh: Thanks for accepting this Quest, Hunter! This time you'll be fighting a Royal Ludroth at the Ruined Pinnacle. It's a bit similar to the crazy one my apprentice, the Yukumo Gal, was thinking of. Just, you know, made a bit more sane. I really appreciate your help!

name: Harvest Tour: Ancestral Steppe
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Interested in gathering at the Ruined Pinnacle, are we? I know just the Quest. Gather away, darling, gather away. Just remember to be a dear and deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Interested in gathering at the Ruined Pinnacle, are we? I know just the Quest. Gather away, darling, gather away. Just remember to be a dear and deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

name: Harvest Tour: Primal Forest
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: So you're looking to gather at the Primal Forest, are you? This Quest should be perfect for you, then, darling. Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done and we'll gladly pick you up.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: So you're looking to gather at the Primal Forest, are you? This Quest should be perfect for you, then, darling. Deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done and we'll gladly pick you up.

name: Harvest Tour: Jurassic Frontier
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gathering in the Jurassic Frontier certainly has its appeal. I'll pull up a Quest for you. Don't be out too late, though, darling -- you'll need to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gathering in the Jurassic Frontier certainly has its appeal. I'll pull up a Quest for you. Don't be out too late, though, darling -- you'll need to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

name: Harvest Tour: Dunes
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: The Dunes hold all sorts of curiosities, don't they? Well now, I've got just the Quest to sate your foraging appetite. We will, of course, pick you up as soon as you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: The Dunes hold all sorts of curiosities, don't they? Well now, I've got just the Quest to sate your foraging appetite. We will, of course, pick you up as soon as you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.

name: Harvest Tour: Verdant Hills
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gathering in the Verdant Hills? That brings back memories... Let me fetch a Quest for you, darling. Enjoy your gathering, and remember to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gathering in the Verdant Hills? That brings back memories... Let me fetch a Quest for you, darling. Enjoy your gathering, and remember to deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're done.

name: Harvest Tour: Arctic Ridge
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gathering at the Arctic Ridge, are we? Well, I hope you'll wrap up warm. Here's your Quest. Enjoy! Oh, and let me remind you that we'll come and pick you up when you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gathering at the Arctic Ridge, are we? Well, I hope you'll wrap up warm. Here's your Quest. Enjoy! Oh, and let me remind you that we'll come and pick you up when you deliver your Paw Pass Ticket.

name: Harvest Tour: Misty Peaks
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: The Misty Peaks? Gorgeous place for gathering. I'll find a Quest for you right away, darling. You go ahead and enjoy yourself. Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come home.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: The Misty Peaks? Gorgeous place for gathering. I'll find a Quest for you right away, darling. You go ahead and enjoy yourself. Just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket when you're ready to come home.

name: After That Bird!
flavor: A precious Felyne friend with whom I am extremely close, has today become the victim of a wicked Gypceros! It pilfered such a precious gift; it's given him such grief! But now all that is going to change -- Hunter, go smite that thief!
flavor_zh: A precious Felyne friend with whom I am extremely close, has today become the victim of a wicked Gypceros! It pilfered such a precious gift; it's given him such grief! But now all that is going to change -- Hunter, go smite that thief!

name: Fangs for the Bath
flavor: Mrowwwww! The worst has happened! Two infurnal Arzuros at the Ruined Pinnacle in a furrenzy! We hid in a cave but we got soaked to the skin! We look like something the cat dragged in! Someone, blow them out of the water!
flavor_zh: Mrowwwww! The worst has happened! Two infurnal Arzuros at the Ruined Pinnacle in a furrenzy! We hid in a cave but we got soaked to the skin! We look like something the cat dragged in! Someone, blow them out of the water!

name: Just Five Morel Minutes...
flavor: We're doing some pretty important research here! Namely, how to shed the human need for sleep using the power of mushrooms! So we need some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined Pinnacle. Wake us when you're back. We're just resting our eyes.
flavor_zh: We're doing some pretty important research here! Namely, how to shed the human need for sleep using the power of mushrooms! So we need some Tall Mushrooms from the Ruined Pinnacle. Wake us when you're back. We're just resting our eyes.

name: Face Two Face
flavor: What a conundrum! I was minding my own business on the Ancestral Steppe when I spotted two monsters with the exact same face! This must be some Kecha Wacha voodoo -- I'm sure of it!
flavor_zh: What a conundrum! I was minding my own business on the Ancestral Steppe when I spotted two monsters with the exact same face! This must be some Kecha Wacha voodoo -- I'm sure of it!

name: Antony and Tetsucabra
flavor: O Hunter, keen of brain and stout of heart; Frontiers Jurassic shall not throw your search, Nor leaping beasties dash you on the rocks (Though lesser hunters, mewling, would flee home.) But catch this toxic monster, let me see; How hunting frogs may yet the hunted be.
flavor_zh: O Hunter, keen of brain and stout of heart; Frontiers Jurassic shall not throw your search, Nor leaping beasties dash you on the rocks (Though lesser hunters, mewling, would flee home.) But catch this toxic monster, let me see; How hunting frogs may yet the hunted be.

name: The Bird Who Wood Be King
flavor: ...Well, I'm in a pickle and no mistake. Went down to the Verdant Hills to gather wood, and got myself chased off by a Yian Kut-Ku. If I can't get wood, then I can't keep a roof over my head. Can somebody fix this birdbrain's wagon for me?
name_zh: 山林中碍事的怪鸟邻居
flavor_zh: ...Well, I'm in a pickle and no mistake. Went down to the Verdant Hills to gather wood, and got myself chased off by a Yian Kut-Ku. If I can't get wood, then I can't keep a roof over my head. Can somebody fix this birdbrain's wagon for me?

name: Water Fight
flavor: Oh my gosh, two Royal Ludroth have been seen in the Misty Peaks! I have never ever seen two of them in the same place before. EVER! They're so territorial...this can't end well! Get in there and put them down before all hell breaks loose!
flavor_zh: Oh my gosh, two Royal Ludroth have been seen in the Misty Peaks! I have never ever seen two of them in the same place before. EVER! They're so territorial...this can't end well! Get in there and put them down before all hell breaks loose!

name: Harvest Tour: Jungle
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Ah, hello, darling. If you're interested in gathering in the Jungle, I have a Quest that you simply must try. Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough and want out. Bye for now!
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Ah, hello, darling. If you're interested in gathering in the Jungle, I have a Quest that you simply must try. Just deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough and want out. Bye for now!

name: I See It Rollin'...
flavor: That stupid overgrown fanged tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just won't stop trundling around after me. If only there was some brave, strong hunter who could teach it a lesson once and for all... Oh...? You'll take care of it? Seriously? How sweet!
name_zh: 滚起来！一起滚！赤色牙兽
flavor_zh: That stupid overgrown fanged tumbleweed! This dumb Volvidon just won't stop trundling around after me. If only there was some brave, strong hunter who could teach it a lesson once and for all... Oh...? You'll take care of it? Seriously? How sweet!

name: Not Mushroom to Swing a Congalala
flavor: You can get real good mushrooms in the Jungle. But lately, them Conga- whatsits have been hogging all the good ones. And that's not the half of it. The Congadoodahs stink so much that you can barely sniff out the mushrooms! You know what to do.
name_zh: 桃毛兽王的蘑菇品鉴会
flavor_zh: You can get real good mushrooms in the Jungle. But lately, them Conga- whatsits have been hogging all the good ones. And that's not the half of it. The Congadoodahs stink so much that you can barely sniff out the mushrooms! You know what to do.

name: Dirty Deals
flavor: Here's a job from one of my regulars. Apparently a Barroth is causing a ruckus in the Desert, and the trade routes are in complete disarray. Go get that muddy scoundrel, and watch out, okay? They move a lot quicker than you'd expect!
flavor_zh: Here's a job from one of my regulars. Apparently a Barroth is causing a ruckus in the Desert, and the trade routes are in complete disarray. Go get that muddy scoundrel, and watch out, okay? They move a lot quicker than you'd expect!

name: That's No Rock...
flavor: The rock! It was m-m-moving! It was alive, I swear! I've never seen anything so uncanny... I'll never forget it, ever, but maybe if you get rid of whatever's behind the mystery, I'll find a way to live with the trauma...
flavor_zh: The rock! It was m-m-moving! It was alive, I swear! I've never seen anything so uncanny... I'll never forget it, ever, but maybe if you get rid of whatever's behind the mystery, I'll find a way to live with the trauma...

name: Treasure Pinnacle: Rice
flavor: I can tell you got the treasure trembles! And yer want a bit of my extra-good Chomoran Rice, don't yer? No? Well, then don't go up to the Ruined Pinnacle and hunt a Malfestio. Simple enough. Don't do it if you don't want it, but don't not do it if you do want it.
name_zh: 无人山岭的宝藏！米之篇
flavor_zh: I can tell you got the treasure trembles! And yer want a bit of my extra-good Chomoran Rice, don't yer? No? Well, then don't go up to the Ruined Pinnacle and hunt a Malfestio. Simple enough. Don't do it if you don't want it, but don't not do it if you do want it.

name: Through Thick and Fin
flavor: I heard about some of the life habits of Zamtrios and thought "Eureka! This is perfect for the Hunter Art I'm working on!" And it is! And you'll see too, because you're going to hunt it for me in the Frozen Seaway! Give me the details when you return.
name_zh: 寻求通向灵感的零星碎片
flavor_zh: I heard about some of the life habits of Zamtrios and thought "Eureka! This is perfect for the Hunter Art I'm working on!" And it is! And you'll see too, because you're going to hunt it for me in the Frozen Seaway! Give me the details when you return.

name: Chilled to the Marrow
flavor: We're hoping to give our footbath a boost with an extra special, zippy zappy electric bath! Purrovided we can come up with the right meowterials. Want to help? Then we'll need you to hunt a Khezu at the Arctic Ridge. Nothing has as much zap!
flavor_zh: We're hoping to give our footbath a boost with an extra special, zippy zappy electric bath! Purrovided we can come up with the right meowterials. Want to help? Then we'll need you to hunt a Khezu at the Arctic Ridge. Nothing has as much zap!

name: Feeding Time
flavor: I went to feed the Nerscylla, and it started getting a bit bitey. I made haste, but unfortunately, I dropped my notes. Could you take care of the beast so I can retrieve them? Just remember, it's more scared of you than you are of it.
flavor_zh: I went to feed the Nerscylla, and it started getting a bit bitey. I made haste, but unfortunately, I dropped my notes. Could you take care of the beast so I can retrieve them? Just remember, it's more scared of you than you are of it.

name: Sky Tribe: Savior of the Skyway
flavor: Oh, Hunter, we're in trouble! A big dumb Rathian has staked out its territory right in the path of the Soaratorium. Can you go to the Jungle and fix it so it, uh, doesn't have any more birthdays?
flavor_zh: Oh, Hunter, we're in trouble! A big dumb Rathian has staked out its territory right in the path of the Soaratorium. Can you go to the Jungle and fix it so it, uh, doesn't have any more birthdays?

name: Share the Load (and the Reward)
flavor: You gotta help me with a Quest the Master of Style gave me! What I need you to do is hunt a Nibelsnarf in the Desert, while I take care of the other monster! This is gonna be Radalos!
flavor_zh: You gotta help me with a Quest the Master of Style gave me! What I need you to do is hunt a Nibelsnarf in the Desert, while I take care of the other monster! This is gonna be Radalos!

name: Shadows in the Desert Lake
flavor: I was fishing in the Desert, like you do, when I caught a Plesioth. Wouldn't you know it, he wasn't too pleased? Now he's gone a little bit crazy and our caravan's in a tizzy. Any more of this and we won't have anywhere to go back to. Can you help out?
name_zh: 潜伏在沙漠水面的黑影
flavor_zh: I was fishing in the Desert, like you do, when I caught a Plesioth. Wouldn't you know it, he wasn't too pleased? Now he's gone a little bit crazy and our caravan's in a tizzy. Any more of this and we won't have anywhere to go back to. Can you help out?

name: Earn Your Strength
flavor: If you want more power...you have to prove...prove that you're strong enough... Blangonga...in the Arctic Ridge... If you're not strong enough... you'll fail.
flavor_zh: If you want more power...you have to prove...prove that you're strong enough... Blangonga...in the Arctic Ridge... If you're not strong enough... you'll fail.

name: Feeling Generally Crabby
flavor: AAAARGH! DAMN IT!!! I was all ready to get back to questing, but my guts are STILL acting up. I better pass this one on to you, Scrawn. Gotta hunt a Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano. Even you can manage that, right? HAHAHA!
name_zh: 就让你狩猎将军镰蟹好了！
flavor_zh: AAAARGH! DAMN IT!!! I was all ready to get back to questing, but my guts are STILL acting up. I better pass this one on to you, Scrawn. Gotta hunt a Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano. Even you can manage that, right? HAHAHA!

name: A Coil to Arms
flavor: You know, you shouldn't laugh when a girl tells you embarrassing yet formative traumas, like getting a monster wedgie! DON'T LAUGH! ...Um, maybe I just shouldn't have told you. Oh, and your mark is in the Verdant Hills.
flavor_zh: You know, you shouldn't laugh when a girl tells you embarrassing yet formative traumas, like getting a monster wedgie! DON'T LAUGH! ...Um, maybe I just shouldn't have told you. Oh, and your mark is in the Verdant Hills.

name: Face-off in the Jungle
flavor: This time we'd like you to hunt a Nargacuga in the Jungle. You should be able to pick up a few things you'll need for some new Hunter Arts, but we'll save that for when you come back victorious. Just keep an open mind and you'll learn a lot.
flavor_zh: This time we'd like you to hunt a Nargacuga in the Jungle. You should be able to pick up a few things you'll need for some new Hunter Arts, but we'll save that for when you come back victorious. Just keep an open mind and you'll learn a lot.

name: Poisoned Primal Forest
flavor: Oh dear... A pack a Ioprey in the Primal Forest is getting poison everywhere, and villagers could be in danger. We wanted to take care of this ourselves, but at this rate, we'll even have to start asking Felynes for help. Oh, is there nobody capable of doing this Quest?
flavor_zh: Oh dear... A pack a Ioprey in the Primal Forest is getting poison everywhere, and villagers could be in danger. We wanted to take care of this ourselves, but at this rate, we'll even have to start asking Felynes for help. Oh, is there nobody capable of doing this Quest?

name: Hit the Lights
flavor: My eyes! My eyeeees! Those blasted Great Thunderbugs are so bright, I think they've blinded me! There's a great swarm of them here in the Jungle. Please, make them go away before they leave me with permanent retinal damage!
flavor_zh: My eyes! My eyeeees! Those blasted Great Thunderbugs are so bright, I think they've blinded me! There's a great swarm of them here in the Jungle. Please, make them go away before they leave me with permanent retinal damage!

name: Shelling Out for Fashion
flavor: Shell-based accessories are, like, the trendiest things right now in the city. I'm an urban gal at heart, so this is pretty much a life and death matter for me! So, uh, can you get me the materials I need from the Jungle?
flavor_zh: Shell-based accessories are, like, the trendiest things right now in the city. I'm an urban gal at heart, so this is pretty much a life and death matter for me! So, uh, can you get me the materials I need from the Jungle?

name: Harvest Tour: Frozen Seaway
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: I can see you're determined to go gathering at the Frozen Seaway. Well, watch you don't catch a death of cold, darling! I'll let you go, but only if you promise me to deliver your Paw Pass Ticket when you're finished.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: I can see you're determined to go gathering at the Frozen Seaway. Well, watch you don't catch a death of cold, darling! I'll let you go, but only if you promise me to deliver your Paw Pass Ticket when you're finished.

name: Harvest Tour: Deserted Island
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: So you'd like to do some gathering on the Deserted Island, would you? Let me just get your Quest ready. When you find enough things worth your while, just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket and we'll gladly pick you up.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: So you'd like to do some gathering on the Deserted Island, would you? Let me just get your Quest ready. When you find enough things worth your while, just deliver the Paw Pass Ticket and we'll gladly pick you up.

name: Harvest Tour: Marshlands
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gathering in the Marshlands? Well, watch where you step, darling. All right, I've got your Quest here. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket whenever you feel you're done and we'll pick you up.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gathering in the Marshlands? Well, watch where you step, darling. All right, I've got your Quest here. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket whenever you feel you're done and we'll pick you up.

name: Harvest Tour: Volcano
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Gathering at the Volcano, are we? I'll give you the Quest, darling, but you're not to stay in there too long. We've had enough hunters coming back with heat stroke already. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket as soon as you're done, do you hear?
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Gathering at the Volcano, are we? I'll give you the Quest, darling, but you're not to stay in there too long. We've had enough hunters coming back with heat stroke already. Deliver your Paw Pass Ticket as soon as you're done, do you hear?

name: The Legend of King Apple
flavor: Ever since I heard about 'em, I've been questin' my butt off lookin' for those legendary apples. And now, at last, I found 'em! Hangin' from some trees at the Ruined Pinnacle. All I need now is for you to shift the darn Volvidon blockin' 'em!
flavor_zh: Ever since I heard about 'em, I've been questin' my butt off lookin' for those legendary apples. And now, at last, I found 'em! Hangin' from some trees at the Ruined Pinnacle. All I need now is for you to shift the darn Volvidon blockin' 'em!

name: Smithy Business
flavor: Every waking moment I spend working on equipment, forging slowly ahead. Every day, it's head down, nose to the grindstone, hammering away. The anvil is my life. I've no time to be fetching Comet Rocks from the Ruined Pinnacle! You can do that!
flavor_zh: Every waking moment I spend working on equipment, forging slowly ahead. Every day, it's head down, nose to the grindstone, hammering away. The anvil is my life. I've no time to be fetching Comet Rocks from the Ruined Pinnacle! You can do that!

name: Royal Assassination
flavor: What are we travelers to do now that a Rathian's taken up occupancy at the Ancestral Steppe? Health and Safety are sure to have something to say about this! Unless of course, you'd like to deal with the matter?
flavor_zh: What are we travelers to do now that a Rathian's taken up occupancy at the Ancestral Steppe? Health and Safety are sure to have something to say about this! Unless of course, you'd like to deal with the matter?

name: Zamite Fright
flavor: So there I was, mining away at the Frozen Seaway, when suddenly I felt something sharp stick me from behind. I tell you, when I saw those odd spiky beasts, I ran like the wind! Even now, I walk around covering my backside... Those Zamites have to go!
flavor_zh: So there I was, mining away at the Frozen Seaway, when suddenly I felt something sharp stick me from behind. I tell you, when I saw those odd spiky beasts, I ran like the wind! Even now, I walk around covering my backside... Those Zamites have to go!

name: Fishing's Lure
flavor: Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being a kid again! You should take a load off and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find a glimmer of the good ol' days in the glitter of water in the Frozen Seaway!
flavor_zh: Nothin' beats fishing. It's just like being a kid again! You should take a load off and catch some Goldenfish. You'll find a glimmer of the good ol' days in the glitter of water in the Frozen Seaway!

name: The Next Stage of E-Volvi-lution
goal: Hunt a Volvidon and a Great Maccao
