flavor: On my way home from the Jurassic Frontier I was spotted by a Volvidon and a Great Maccao! Luckily I threw myself into a series of somersaults and I think they've accepted me as one of them. I think they like me! Unfortunately I'm super dizzy already, so help...?
goal_zh: 狩猎1头赤甲兽和1头跳狗龙王
flavor_zh: On my way home from the Jurassic Frontier I was spotted by a Volvidon and a Great Maccao! Luckily I threw myself into a series of somersaults and I think they've accepted me as one of them. I think they like me! Unfortunately I'm super dizzy already, so help...?

name: Brute of the Sands
flavor: There's something mighty abnormal out there in the Dunes. It's so tough it can't be hurt with normal weapons, and covers itself in mud. It's all very fascinating! There's still so much we don't know about this majestic creature. Could you catch me one?
flavor_zh: There's something mighty abnormal out there in the Dunes. It's so tough it can't be hurt with normal weapons, and covers itself in mud. It's all very fascinating! There's still so much we don't know about this majestic creature. Could you catch me one?

name: Trade Dispute
flavor: Our usual trade route is being terrorized by a Nibelsnarf! We'd just tough it out, but Nibelsnarfs will eat anything, and I can't afford to lose another shipment! Please teach the brute it's not okay to steal! Theft isn't a victimless crime!
flavor_zh: Our usual trade route is being terrorized by a Nibelsnarf! We'd just tough it out, but Nibelsnarfs will eat anything, and I can't afford to lose another shipment! Please teach the brute it's not okay to steal! Theft isn't a victimless crime!

name: We've Reached Peak Blangonga
flavor: I saw...ulp...a Blangonga on the mountain. Not so weird, you might think. But when...urk...I saw the second one emerge from the ground, I high-tailed it to a cave. This is altogether too many Blangongas for one person to deal with! Please...ulp...deal with it for me!
flavor_zh: I saw...ulp...a Blangonga on the mountain. Not so weird, you might think. But when...urk...I saw the second one emerge from the ground, I high-tailed it to a cave. This is altogether too many Blangongas for one person to deal with! Please...ulp...deal with it for me!

name: Please Plesioth Me!
flavor: Everyone in Cheeko Sands is in trouble! A Plesioth has made an appurrance and is furolicking very destructively! It's rampaging around the Misty Peaks, and the people of Cheeko Sands asked if you'd purrlease hunt it.
name_zh: 狩猎威胁基可村的水龙！
flavor_zh: Everyone in Cheeko Sands is in trouble! A Plesioth has made an appurrance and is furolicking very destructively! It's rampaging around the Misty Peaks, and the people of Cheeko Sands asked if you'd purrlease hunt it.

name: Jumping at Shadows
flavor: Oh my gosh! I totally just saw a huge black shadow jump into a tree! I think it's going to attack the village! Arghhh! The problem is, no one believes me! You have to help my village! And then tell them I was right and they should take me more seriously in future!!!
flavor_zh: Oh my gosh! I totally just saw a huge black shadow jump into a tree! I think it's going to attack the village! Arghhh! The problem is, no one believes me! You have to help my village! And then tell them I was right and they should take me more seriously in future!!!

name: The Owled Man and the Sea
flavor: Welp, I guess this old-timer's plumb out of luck. Thought it'd be nice to retire in the sun on the Deserted Island, but the place has a Malfestio problem and it's got its owl dust all over everything. Oh, don't worry about me, I'm just old and useless. I'm sure I'll be fine. I'll manage.
flavor_zh: Welp, I guess this old-timer's plumb out of luck. Thought it'd be nice to retire in the sun on the Deserted Island, but the place has a Malfestio problem and it's got its owl dust all over everything. Oh, don't worry about me, I'm just old and useless. I'm sure I'll be fine. I'll manage.

name: The Shadow in the Cave
flavor: We were doing some research in the caves when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!
flavor_zh: We were doing some research in the caves when all of a sudden, something really creepy and gross plopped down behind us. We managed to escape, but we can't do any research with that thing up there!

name: March Melancolico
flavor: The stage: the darkest marshlands, damp with haunting melancholy! Our villain: the ultimate Najarala! Our hero: a hunter of legend! ...That would be you. Go earn us a standing ovation! Break a leg!
flavor_zh: The stage: the darkest marshlands, damp with haunting melancholy! Our villain: the ultimate Najarala! Our hero: a hunter of legend! ...That would be you. Go earn us a standing ovation! Break a leg!

name: Interruption: Conga Line
flavor: Give me strength! If there's a village where they sell a cure for idiocy, please tell me where it is. What kind of Guild Gal runs off to take on a couple of Congalalas? Please make sure you get to them first.
sub_goal_zh: 缴纳1个标记地盘的巨粪
flavor_zh: Give me strength! If there's a village where they sell a cure for idiocy, please tell me where it is. What kind of Guild Gal runs off to take on a couple of Congalalas? Please make sure you get to them first.

name: Commission: Basarios
flavor: Hey, so I just got a request to hunt down a Basarios, but I'm incredibly busy doing an important, uh, other thing. I'd be very grateful if you could take it on for me. I'd hurry if I was you, or you might not make it to the Volcano in time!
flavor_zh: Hey, so I just got a request to hunt down a Basarios, but I'm incredibly busy doing an important, uh, other thing. I'd be very grateful if you could take it on for me. I'd hurry if I was you, or you might not make it to the Volcano in time!

name: Great Ore Discovery
flavor: Great news! A new Coal bed has been discovered in the Volcano, and as much as I'd like to get in on that action, the place is Basarios turf. Care to go mining for me, Hunter?
flavor_zh: Great news! A new Coal bed has been discovered in the Volcano, and as much as I'd like to get in on that action, the place is Basarios turf. Care to go mining for me, Hunter?

name: Minion's Devotion
flavor: Recently, minion's sense of duty has been lacka-wacking! Cha-Cha has prepared Quest to solidify minion's devotion! Go bash many monster in aka-arena! If minion not up to challenge, come tell Cha-Cha, okay?
name_zh: 你欠缺作为手下的自觉嗏！
flavor_zh: Recently, minion's sense of duty has been lacka-wacking! Cha-Cha has prepared Quest to solidify minion's devotion! Go bash many monster in aka-arena! If minion not up to challenge, come tell Cha-Cha, okay?

name: So Notable: Hyper Hermitaur
flavor: The next page of my notebook is whispering to me, Squiggle. And do you know what it's saying? It's saying HYPER MONSTERS! So, I figure I should give it what it wants! Could you hunt down a Daimyo Hermitaur while I watch from a safe distance?
name_zh: 超级☆备忘录 ～狞猛化大名盾蟹篇～
sub_goal_zh: 破坏大名盾蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: The next page of my notebook is whispering to me, Squiggle. And do you know what it's saying? It's saying HYPER MONSTERS! So, I figure I should give it what it wants! Could you hunt down a Daimyo Hermitaur while I watch from a safe distance?

name: Revenge from the Skies
flavor: Oh, that Yian Kut-Ku had such an aura... I've never seen the likes of it before! I'll bet it was some kind of spectral manifestation of the unquiet spirits of its hunted brethren! What's certain is it was totally consumed by rage! Be careful when you hunt it!
flavor_zh: Oh, that Yian Kut-Ku had such an aura... I've never seen the likes of it before! I'll bet it was some kind of spectral manifestation of the unquiet spirits of its hunted brethren! What's certain is it was totally consumed by rage! Be careful when you hunt it!

name: Commission: Hyper Kecha Wacha
sub_goal: Wound Kecha Wacha's ears and tail
flavor: There's so much to learn from those so-called "Hyper" monsters, but there's nobody I trust to bring back the kind of data I'm interested in...except you, hunter. Could you go to the Ancestral Steppe and hunt down a Hyper Kecha Wacha for me, please?
name_zh: 调查委托：狞猛的奇猿狐
sub_goal_zh: 破坏奇猿狐的耳与尾巴
flavor_zh: There's so much to learn from those so-called "Hyper" monsters, but there's nobody I trust to bring back the kind of data I'm interested in...except you, hunter. Could you go to the Ancestral Steppe and hunt down a Hyper Kecha Wacha for me, please?

name: Frog's Face, Demon's Heart
flavor: The mug on that Tetsucabra is as scary as any demon. How can I put the nature of its fierce, defiant aura into words...? Anyway, I've got the feeling that it's going to take a hard-bitten Hunter like you to have that beast on the boat to Hades.
flavor_zh: The mug on that Tetsucabra is as scary as any demon. How can I put the nature of its fierce, defiant aura into words...? Anyway, I've got the feeling that it's going to take a hard-bitten Hunter like you to have that beast on the boat to Hades.

name: The Hype is Royal
sub_goal: Wound Royal Ludroth's head and mane
flavor: I'm researching Hyperosity in monsters, and my experiments call for a Royal Ludroth. Aren't you the least bit interested to know how one would look all Hypered up? Sure you are! Go find me one of those babies and let's find out! For science!
name_zh: 水兽的狞猛化观察记录
sub_goal_zh: 破坏水兽的头部与鬃毛
flavor_zh: I'm researching Hyperosity in monsters, and my experiments call for a Royal Ludroth. Aren't you the least bit interested to know how one would look all Hypered up? Sure you are! Go find me one of those babies and let's find out! For science!

name: The Verdant Hills Are Alive
flavor: I'm sort of concerned about this Hyper Gypceros running wild over the Verdant Hills... It's pretty inconvenient, and the monster just seems happy as a pig in mud. It's really raising my stress levels, so do you think you could maybe convince it to behave? Or just hunt it?
flavor_zh: I'm sort of concerned about this Hyper Gypceros running wild over the Verdant Hills... It's pretty inconvenient, and the monster just seems happy as a pig in mud. It's really raising my stress levels, so do you think you could maybe convince it to behave? Or just hunt it?

name: Queen of the Ruined Pinnacle
flavor: I got lost, and after wandering for ages I found myself in a strange fantasy land. Or so I thought. Actually, it was the Ruined Pinnacle, and I'd stumbled into Rathian territory. Me and another lost traveler are hiding from it now. Help!
flavor_zh: I got lost, and after wandering for ages I found myself in a strange fantasy land. Or so I thought. Actually, it was the Ruined Pinnacle, and I'd stumbled into Rathian territory. Me and another lost traveler are hiding from it now. Help!

name: Afro Soul Is a Way of Life
flavor: Oh baby! If you want to truly funk up your soul, there's only one place to go: the Volcano! Hot hot HOT, baby! You got this! You're gonna dip your soul in some o' that Lavasioth magic, baby!
name_zh: 冲撞生存法则☆爆炸头之魂
flavor_zh: Oh baby! If you want to truly funk up your soul, there's only one place to go: the Volcano! Hot hot HOT, baby! You got this! You're gonna dip your soul in some o' that Lavasioth magic, baby!

name: Naked Aggression
flavor: There was a hunter in town walking about in only his drawers! Naturally I had to protect the townspeople, so I questioned him. He claims a Ceanataur ripped up his clothes! I need you to verify his claims, and eliminate the monster. If there is one.
flavor_zh: There was a hunter in town walking about in only his drawers! Naturally I had to protect the townspeople, so I questioned him. He claims a Ceanataur ripped up his clothes! I need you to verify his claims, and eliminate the monster. If there is one.

name: The Unapproachable Yian Garuga
flavor: Please, Hunter, I need you to hunt a Yian Garuga! It's been on the most wanted list for so long now, I've lost count of how many other hunters it's taken down! I think its nest is in the Ruined Pinnacle. Go give that big chicken a real good basting!
flavor_zh: Please, Hunter, I need you to hunt a Yian Garuga! It's been on the most wanted list for so long now, I've lost count of how many other hunters it's taken down! I think its nest is in the Ruined Pinnacle. Go give that big chicken a real good basting!

name: Uragaan Grief
flavor: I got sent to the Volcano on a meownster-hunting expedition but a big, furrocious Uragaan purrevented us from going any further! I can see it even meow, looming befur me... Purrlease, Hunter, meowst it from that place!
flavor_zh: I got sent to the Volcano on a meownster-hunting expedition but a big, furrocious Uragaan purrevented us from going any further! I can see it even meow, looming befur me... Purrlease, Hunter, meowst it from that place!

name: The Lost Expedition
flavor: I'm worried, Hunter. We haven't heard a peep from one of our Frozen Seaway-expedition teams. Mind investigating? It's a cold, cruel region, so gird those loins before you go! Pave the way for our exploration.
flavor_zh: I'm worried, Hunter. We haven't heard a peep from one of our Frozen Seaway-expedition teams. Mind investigating? It's a cold, cruel region, so gird those loins before you go! Pave the way for our exploration.

name: The Royal Guard
flavor: A Seltas Queen is nesting in the Jurassic Frontier! Rumor has it "her majesty" relies on a soldier-like male of the species for protection. I could write a book about their relationship. Help me!
flavor_zh: A Seltas Queen is nesting in the Jurassic Frontier! Rumor has it "her majesty" relies on a soldier-like male of the species for protection. I could write a book about their relationship. Help me!

name: Predator in the Hills
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: I was herding a flock of Moofahs in the Verdant Hills, when suddenly along came a Rathian and a Rathalos! I hid the moment I saw them, but I was too scared to move, and so were my babies! Please, save us before we end up on their plate!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: I was herding a flock of Moofahs in the Verdant Hills, when suddenly along came a Rathian and a Rathalos! I hid the moment I saw them, but I was too scared to move, and so were my babies! Please, save us before we end up on their plate!

name: The Sun, Also Wyverns
flavor: Welp, looks like this old-timer's outta luck again. It's such a nice day, I thought I'd go for a dip in the sea, but a Lagiacrus popped up and shocked me. No, save your concern. I'll just lie here and not move until I die and stop being such a hindrance to you young folk.
flavor_zh: Welp, looks like this old-timer's outta luck again. It's such a nice day, I thought I'd go for a dip in the sea, but a Lagiacrus popped up and shocked me. No, save your concern. I'll just lie here and not move until I die and stop being such a hindrance to you young folk.

name: Return from the Pinnacle
flavor: We came to survey the Ruined Pinnacle, but had a run-in with a very tetchy Zinogre. We tried to evacuate all the researchers, but the unfamiliar terrain is really making that difficult. Could you remove the Zinogre, please?
flavor_zh: We came to survey the Ruined Pinnacle, but had a run-in with a very tetchy Zinogre. We tried to evacuate all the researchers, but the unfamiliar terrain is really making that difficult. Could you remove the Zinogre, please?

name: A Certain Gravitas
flavor: Ah, Volcanic Hollow, bereft of life, where not a blade of grass grows nor cheerful swallow sings. The only thing that stirs is the bubbling magma... and the furiously rampaging Gravios, of course. Actually, you should probably do something about that.
flavor_zh: Ah, Volcanic Hollow, bereft of life, where not a blade of grass grows nor cheerful swallow sings. The only thing that stirs is the bubbling magma... and the furiously rampaging Gravios, of course. Actually, you should probably do something about that.

name: Water Kerfuffle
flavor: My meowster, ever the romeowntic, said he met the meowst wonderful lady in a dream. He said something about her "wondrous bubbles" and "lustrous pink crest"... Oh my stripes and whiskers, he's fallen in love with a Mizutsune, hasn't he? Help!
flavor_zh: My meowster, ever the romeowntic, said he met the meowst wonderful lady in a dream. He said something about her "wondrous bubbles" and "lustrous pink crest"... Oh my stripes and whiskers, he's fallen in love with a Mizutsune, hasn't he? Help!

name: Pinnacle Pioneering
flavor: Howdy, everybody! The King requested a thorough cataloging of the Ruined Pinnacle. Just when I was thinking how completely normal and uninteresting it was, POW! SHAZAM! You're up, Hunter!
flavor_zh: Howdy, everybody! The King requested a thorough cataloging of the Ruined Pinnacle. Just when I was thinking how completely normal and uninteresting it was, POW! SHAZAM! You're up, Hunter!

name: Ice Recovery
flavor: Let me tell you about the most amazing thing the Frozen Seaway has to offer. Imagine: ice from Gammoth snowballs that's been trampled down to become part of the ground. Ugh, so post-modern! I must have some! Will you help me?
flavor_zh: Let me tell you about the most amazing thing the Frozen Seaway has to offer. Imagine: ice from Gammoth snowballs that's been trampled down to become part of the ground. Ugh, so post-modern! I must have some! Will you help me?

name: The Boiling Broiling Desert
flavor: Blazing sun! Earth dry as a bone! And to top it off, the flaming breath of a Glavenus! It's too hot to stand! Unless someone does something about that beast, I won't make it out of this desert. How about you, Hunter? Or is the challenge too hot to handle?
flavor_zh: Blazing sun! Earth dry as a bone! And to top it off, the flaming breath of a Glavenus! It's too hot to stand! Unless someone does something about that beast, I won't make it out of this desert. How about you, Hunter? Or is the challenge too hot to handle?

name: Eclipse at Jurassic Frontier
flavor: Boy, has my luck run out today. I was fleeing through the Jurassic Frontier when I tripped and fell. I cried out in pain, and a disgusting black creature sidled up to me. This is it, I'm done for. Heavens help me! I promise I'll change my ways!
name_zh: 造访古代森林的黑色侵蚀
flavor_zh: Boy, has my luck run out today. I was fleeing through the Jurassic Frontier when I tripped and fell. I cried out in pain, and a disgusting black creature sidled up to me. This is it, I'm done for. Heavens help me! I promise I'll change my ways!

name: A Pinnacle Just for You
flavor: My acquaintance says hunters love to pursue their prey as long as they've got the stamina to do so. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind popping up to the Ruined Pinnacle to demonstrate for me?
flavor_zh: My acquaintance says hunters love to pursue their prey as long as they've got the stamina to do so. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. Would you mind popping up to the Ruined Pinnacle to demonstrate for me?

name: The Phantom Beast!
flavor: That thing we spotted up on the Arctic Ridge must have been the Phantom Beast. It radiated a faint light as it slid along the ground. Whoever hunts it down is in for some pretty sweet loot, that's for sure!
flavor_zh: That thing we spotted up on the Arctic Ridge must have been the Phantom Beast. It radiated a faint light as it slid along the ground. Whoever hunts it down is in for some pretty sweet loot, that's for sure!

name: Reality or Fantasy?
flavor: Ugh... The Jurassic Frontier... Yes, that's where the horned phantom showed itself... And unless that white beast's fury is stopped, the land will be plunged into disaster! Hunters of the Oracle, hear me! Defeat the Phantom Beast and fulfill the prophecy!
flavor_zh: Ugh... The Jurassic Frontier... Yes, that's where the horned phantom showed itself... And unless that white beast's fury is stopped, the land will be plunged into disaster! Hunters of the Oracle, hear me! Defeat the Phantom Beast and fulfill the prophecy!

name: Giant Dragon Invasion
goal: Slay a Lao-Shan Lung or repel it
flavor: An urgent report from the Schrade region came in. A Lao-Shan Lung has been attacking settlements there. I'd like you to help defend a fort on one of its regular attack paths. Pay attention to barricade integrity, and of course, keep an eye on the monster!
flavor_zh: An urgent report from the Schrade region came in. A Lao-Shan Lung has been attacking settlements there. I'd like you to help defend a fort on one of its regular attack paths. Pay attention to barricade integrity, and of course, keep an eye on the monster!

name: Trial by Fart
flavor: So, not to brag or anything but I'm a pretty big deal in my hunter class. They expect great things of me. So I thought I'd go prove them all right by hunting something awesome! Uh, I didn't realize Congalala are so hard to hunt though. Can you come save my reputation?
name_zh: 桃毛兽王对新人的洗礼
sub_goal_zh: 破坏桃毛兽王的头冠与爪
flavor_zh: So, not to brag or anything but I'm a pretty big deal in my hunter class. They expect great things of me. So I thought I'd go prove them all right by hunting something awesome! Uh, I didn't realize Congalala are so hard to hunt though. Can you come save my reputation?

name: The Mud Must Flow
flavor: Here's a tip: the most amazing thing from the Dunes is obviously the mud a Barroth flings off itself, once it's all dried in the sun! Ugh, just talking about it makes me want some. Hey, can you help me snag some?
name_zh: 旧沙漠无与伦比的沙子
sub_goal_zh: 破坏土砂龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: Here's a tip: the most amazing thing from the Dunes is obviously the mud a Barroth flings off itself, once it's all dried in the sun! Ugh, just talking about it makes me want some. Hey, can you help me snag some?

name: The Pinnacle of Good Records
flavor: Howdy everybody! Out on the road I saw huge boulders cracking together and something came lumbering out! It gave off a sort of black aura, and I thought, well darn, this is gonna make for one heck of a record! You wanna get over here and help me record it?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏岩龙的背部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Howdy everybody! Out on the road I saw huge boulders cracking together and something came lumbering out! It gave off a sort of black aura, and I thought, well darn, this is gonna make for one heck of a record! You wanna get over here and help me record it?

name: Sweets for My Sweets
flavor: I wanna repay everyone who helped advertise my business by making a super awesome dessert! All the secret ingredients I need are in the Jurassic Frontier, but what is also there is a Malfestio! Eek! Hunty, pleeease help get rid of it? I'll give you cake? Please?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏夜鸟的头部与尾巴
flavor_zh: I wanna repay everyone who helped advertise my business by making a super awesome dessert! All the secret ingredients I need are in the Jurassic Frontier, but what is also there is a Malfestio! Eek! Hunty, pleeease help get rid of it? I'll give you cake? Please?

name: Zamtrios, Right Ahead!
flavor: It's unsinkable, they said. Enjoy the maiden voyage of this decadent ship, they said. It definitely won't be split in half by a marauding sharkbeast, they said. Look, can someone hunt this thing? The carpets are getting ruined in first class. I can't even look at steerage.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏变形冰鲨的头部与尾巴
flavor_zh: It's unsinkable, they said. Enjoy the maiden voyage of this decadent ship, they said. It definitely won't be split in half by a marauding sharkbeast, they said. Look, can someone hunt this thing? The carpets are getting ruined in first class. I can't even look at steerage.

name: Frozen Seaway Horror Story
flavor: I was crawling around a cave on the Frozen Seaway, looking for something, as one does, when I became aware of a presence. A white face floated in the dark behind me. A jagged mouth...a long...long...neck... -- Here the record ends --
sub_goal_zh: 破坏白电的头部与身体
flavor_zh: I was crawling around a cave on the Frozen Seaway, looking for something, as one does, when I became aware of a presence. A white face floated in the dark behind me. A jagged mouth...a long...long...neck... -- Here the record ends --

name: Temnoceranophobia
flavor: My master is an awesome hunter... most of the time. One day he just blurted out that he can't deal with "creepy Nerscylla" -- something about their eyes? -- and now he's just not the same to me. Can you wipe this stain from his honor by taking over the hunt?
name_zh: 老师的克星是狞猛的影蜘蛛
flavor_zh: My master is an awesome hunter... most of the time. One day he just blurted out that he can't deal with "creepy Nerscylla" -- something about their eyes? -- and now he's just not the same to me. Can you wipe this stain from his honor by taking over the hunt?

name: The Pinnacle of Terror
flavor: I'm spending time in the company of some Lynians at the Ruined Pinnacle. See, they took me in when I was chased by a Hyper Rathian. I'm a live and let live kind of hunter, but these Lynians might still be in danger. Can you take out the Rathian? I'll just chill here.
name_zh: 无人山岭中愤怒的雌火龙
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雌火龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: I'm spending time in the company of some Lynians at the Ruined Pinnacle. See, they took me in when I was chased by a Hyper Rathian. I'm a live and let live kind of hunter, but these Lynians might still be in danger. Can you take out the Rathian? I'll just chill here.

name: Eat in Pieces
flavor: I have this kind of embarrassing habit whenever I eat, so I thought what better place to eat in privacy than the Desert, right? WRONG. I nearly turned into dinner when this Nibelsnarf with a seriously dark aura turned up! I just want to eat in peace!
flavor_zh: I have this kind of embarrassing habit whenever I eat, so I thought what better place to eat in privacy than the Desert, right? WRONG. I nearly turned into dinner when this Nibelsnarf with a seriously dark aura turned up! I just want to eat in peace!

name: Diabolical Deluge
flavor: The worst has happened. A Hyper Plesioth arrived in the Jungle and has flooded the river. Six villages are underwater! Communication is cut off due to the damage. We need an outstanding hunter to get in there and sort this mess out!
flavor_zh: The worst has happened. A Hyper Plesioth arrived in the Jungle and has flooded the river. Six villages are underwater! Communication is cut off due to the damage. We need an outstanding hunter to get in there and sort this mess out!

name: Shhhhut Up
flavor: *psst* We had some heavy snow, now everyone is terrified there'll be an avalanche. We have to be super quiet! Even this writing is in a whisper. We can hold out, but there's a Hyper Blangonga nearby who could ruin everything! Could you maybe shut it up?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雪狮子王的牙与尾巴
flavor_zh: *psst* We had some heavy snow, now everyone is terrified there'll be an avalanche. We have to be super quiet! Even this writing is in a whisper. We can hold out, but there's a Hyper Blangonga nearby who could ruin everything! Could you maybe shut it up?

name: It's a Miner's Life
flavor: 'Ey up. Been trouble down t'mine. No sooner did we start work than a bleedin' great Lavasioth turned up! We miners're no stranger to danger, but we're not idiots. If you could duff it up or summit so we can get back to work, that'd be grand. Ta!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏熔岩龙的头部与1背鳍
flavor_zh: 'Ey up. Been trouble down t'mine. No sooner did we start work than a bleedin' great Lavasioth turned up! We miners're no stranger to danger, but we're not idiots. If you could duff it up or summit so we can get back to work, that'd be grand. Ta!

name: No Place to Run
flavor: I was walking down the safest road I know to get back home, nothing bad's ever happened on this road and you know where I'm going with this, don't you? Hyper Shogun Ceanataur. You gotta get rid of it or I'll never get back to my village. Please help!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏将军镰蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: I was walking down the safest road I know to get back home, nothing bad's ever happened on this road and you know where I'm going with this, don't you? Hyper Shogun Ceanataur. You gotta get rid of it or I'll never get back to my village. Please help!

name: ...Or Just Wait for It to Poop
flavor: What I'm about to tell you is absolutely true, I swear. It sounds crazy, but my armor-crafting friend made a suit of hermetically sealed armor and...well, got swallowed whole by a Hyper Najarala. Please do something, Hunter!
name_zh: 关于绞蛇龙的消化功能
sub_goal_zh: 破坏绞蛇龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: What I'm about to tell you is absolutely true, I swear. It sounds crazy, but my armor-crafting friend made a suit of hermetically sealed armor and...well, got swallowed whole by a Hyper Najarala. Please do something, Hunter!

name: Nargacuga in the Jurassic Frontier
flavor: The Jurassic Frontier. All is shrouded in darkness. Suddenly, crimson splits the gloom on wings of shadow! The fearsome Nargacuga stands, wrapped in fog and illuminated by a single shaft of moonlight... Then you come out of nowhere and beat it up. Okay?
name_zh: 古代森林中迅龙的目击报告
sub_goal_zh: 破坏迅龙的刃翼，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: The Jurassic Frontier. All is shrouded in darkness. Suddenly, crimson splits the gloom on wings of shadow! The fearsome Nargacuga stands, wrapped in fog and illuminated by a single shaft of moonlight... Then you come out of nowhere and beat it up. Okay?

name: Harvest Tour: Volcanic Hollow
goal: Survive until time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Ah, gathering time again? Then I've got just the Quest for you, darling. Gathering up as much as you can, and deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough.
goal_zh: 时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Ah, gathering time again? Then I've got just the Quest for you, darling. Gathering up as much as you can, and deliver a Paw Pass Ticket when you've had enough.

name: Paralyzing Peril
flavor: I came here with my meowster, but as we were exploring I felt a tingle in my meowstache. Then we were attacked by the tingle king himself, Lagiacrus! We got purralyzed before we could blink! Purrlease help!
flavor_zh: I came here with my meowster, but as we were exploring I felt a tingle in my meowstache. Then we were attacked by the tingle king himself, Lagiacrus! We got purralyzed before we could blink! Purrlease help!

name: Problem at the Pinnacle
flavor: The Ruined Pinnacle hides so many secrets, but my efforts to uncover them have been met by more than a little resistance from the resident Gore Magala. Any chance you could, you know...make it go away?
sub_goal_zh: 缴纳1个不祥的狂龙结晶
flavor_zh: The Ruined Pinnacle hides so many secrets, but my efforts to uncover them have been met by more than a little resistance from the resident Gore Magala. Any chance you could, you know...make it go away?

name: Strutting the Royal Runway
flavor: The spotlight beckons! For my next performance, I am to dance gracefully upon the shell of a Neopteron. Our props team is too stingy to make one, so fetch me the real thing instead. Break a leg!
flavor_zh: The spotlight beckons! For my next performance, I am to dance gracefully upon the shell of a Neopteron. Our props team is too stingy to make one, so fetch me the real thing instead. Break a leg!

name: Hunt-a-Thon: Yian Garuga
flavor: A pair of Yian Garuga have reared their ugly heads, and it seems the Jungle isn't big enough for both of them. They're just screaming their heads off and smashing things up! Hunter, please put a stop to their pathetic squabble!
flavor_zh: A pair of Yian Garuga have reared their ugly heads, and it seems the Jungle isn't big enough for both of them. They're just screaming their heads off and smashing things up! Hunter, please put a stop to their pathetic squabble!

name: Primal Forest Fears
goal: Hunt a Nerscylla and a Malfestio
flavor: While traversing the Primal Forest, I've realized something very strange. I should have been going east this whole time, but I've clearly gone west. I...I can't move my feet! Oh no...no, it can't be... It's a-- -- Here the record ends --
goal_zh: 狩猎1只影蜘蛛和1头夜鸟
flavor_zh: While traversing the Primal Forest, I've realized something very strange. I should have been going east this whole time, but I've clearly gone west. I...I can't move my feet! Oh no...no, it can't be... It's a-- -- Here the record ends --

name: Hunt-a-Thon: Gravios
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: An' ole pal o' mine asked if this here Caravaneer could take a gander at some Gravios a-nestin' in the Primal Forest. Normally I'd be happy to oblige the feller, but I can't handle 'em on my ownsome. Can ya handle maybe two of 'em?
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: An' ole pal o' mine asked if this here Caravaneer could take a gander at some Gravios a-nestin' in the Primal Forest. Normally I'd be happy to oblige the feller, but I can't handle 'em on my ownsome. Can ya handle maybe two of 'em?

name: Hunter Dojo: Tail-do
flavor: You seek the way of the hunter, do you? Then you must hone your abilities! Your mind must be as sharp as the tail of Glavenus-sensei! And when we are finished, you will have a smoldering battle instinct to rival the beast itself!
flavor_zh: You seek the way of the hunter, do you? Then you must hone your abilities! Your mind must be as sharp as the tail of Glavenus-sensei! And when we are finished, you will have a smoldering battle instinct to rival the beast itself!

name: It's Gotta Be Coal
flavor: Do they expect me to work my culinary magic using a wood fire, like some kind of common COOK? I am a chef! I require Coal! You! Fetch me some from the Volcanic Hollow. You should really know how to make a pickaxe by now -- Mystery Bone and Iron Ore, remember?
flavor_zh: Do they expect me to work my culinary magic using a wood fire, like some kind of common COOK? I am a chef! I require Coal! You! Fetch me some from the Volcanic Hollow. You should really know how to make a pickaxe by now -- Mystery Bone and Iron Ore, remember?

name: PR Disaster
goal: Hunt a Rathian and a Glavenus
flavor: There's been sightings of a serious threat to Bherna's tourist industry! And people, I guess. We've got a Glavenus on the ground and a Rathian in the sky... We're basically inaccessible as it stands! Please, do something! Our PR hangs in the balance!
name_zh: 贝鲁纳村观光业大危机！
goal_zh: 狩猎1头雌火龙和1头斩龙
flavor_zh: There's been sightings of a serious threat to Bherna's tourist industry! And people, I guess. We've got a Glavenus on the ground and a Rathian in the sky... We're basically inaccessible as it stands! Please, do something! Our PR hangs in the balance!

name: I Hope It's Not Barioth Flavored
flavor: Discovery of the century! A machine that CREATES SORBET! I'll call it... "Sorby McSorbface". Or something. I can decide on a name after you get back from Barioth hunting. Oh, did I forget to mention that? I need you to go hunt a Barioth. Snap to it!
name_zh: 冰牙龙是大发明的关键？
flavor_zh: Discovery of the century! A machine that CREATES SORBET! I'll call it... "Sorby McSorbface". Or something. I can decide on a name after you get back from Barioth hunting. Oh, did I forget to mention that? I need you to go hunt a Barioth. Snap to it!

name: Hunter Dojo: Tusk-fu
flavor: Push, shove, heave, and then some! To join our dojo, you must first capture Gammoth-sensei! There are no clever tricks. You must become one with the mountain. Firm! Strong! Resolute! And being really darn stubborn can't hurt either!
flavor_zh: Push, shove, heave, and then some! To join our dojo, you must first capture Gammoth-sensei! There are no clever tricks. You must become one with the mountain. Firm! Strong! Resolute! And being really darn stubborn can't hurt either!

name: Howl at the Moon
flavor: I'm trying to remember something I saw in a dream long ago... You know what might help me recall it, Hunter? If you could purrchance go to the Misty Peaks and hunt a Zinogre. That news is sure to jog my memory, nya!
flavor_zh: I'm trying to remember something I saw in a dream long ago... You know what might help me recall it, Hunter? If you could purrchance go to the Misty Peaks and hunt a Zinogre. That news is sure to jog my memory, nya!

name: Hunter Dojo: Bubble-jitsu
flavor: So, you would master the way of the hunter? Let's journey on the path to hunterdom together! A true hunter has total mastery of their techniques, making each hunt a bewitching dance. Go and study under Mizutsune-sensei to learn how to move with grace!
name_zh: 泡狐龙流 猎人道场
flavor_zh: So, you would master the way of the hunter? Let's journey on the path to hunterdom together! A true hunter has total mastery of their techniques, making each hunt a bewitching dance. Go and study under Mizutsune-sensei to learn how to move with grace!

name: "Kiken" Means "Danger"!
flavor: I see it! Up above ship! Biiiig kage! Kage means "shadow"! In all the blue sky, a Rathalos flying. Not rumor! I see it with own eyes! It appear in single minute, DOKAAAAN! That why you must hunt! I relying on you!
flavor_zh: I see it! Up above ship! Biiiig kage! Kage means "shadow"! In all the blue sky, a Rathalos flying. Not rumor! I see it with own eyes! It appear in single minute, DOKAAAAN! That why you must hunt! I relying on you!

name: Hunter Dojo: Lightning Wushu
flavor: Hey, bro! Another acolyte on the road to hunterlightenment? I dig it. A hunter's gotta be aggressive, know what I'm sayin'? Strike like lightning, instill fear like thunder, all that jazz. You wanna learn how to do that? Go talk to Astalos-sensei. By which I mean "hunt".
flavor_zh: Hey, bro! Another acolyte on the road to hunterlightenment? I dig it. A hunter's gotta be aggressive, know what I'm sayin'? Strike like lightning, instill fear like thunder, all that jazz. You wanna learn how to do that? Go talk to Astalos-sensei. By which I mean "hunt".

name: Heavenly Fire, Earthly Flame
goal: Hunt a Lavasioth and a Rathalos
flavor: What's happening!? First a monster comes flying out of the volcano and then another monster comes bursting out from the earth! Where can I hide!? And I'm all out of Cool Drinks! I'm at the end of my rope here!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头熔岩龙和1头火龙
flavor_zh: What's happening!? First a monster comes flying out of the volcano and then another monster comes bursting out from the earth! Where can I hide!? And I'm all out of Cool Drinks! I'm at the end of my rope here!

name: Frontier Fisticuffs
flavor: I feel like the local monsters are mocking our efforts to settle this land! A couple more of them have appeared to do their worst, but we're not giving up! This is our land and they can't have it! We'll build our settlement over their dead bodies!
flavor_zh: I feel like the local monsters are mocking our efforts to settle this land! A couple more of them have appeared to do their worst, but we're not giving up! This is our land and they can't have it! We'll build our settlement over their dead bodies!

name: Down With This Sort of Thing
flavor: What on earth is going on!? Monsters are just going about willy-nilly making the worst racket on MY Ancestral Steppe! This kind of noise pollution has to stop! Somebody contact the Guild and get this mess fixed!
flavor_zh: What on earth is going on!? Monsters are just going about willy-nilly making the worst racket on MY Ancestral Steppe! This kind of noise pollution has to stop! Somebody contact the Guild and get this mess fixed!

name: Searing Sands
flavor: Wind's getting hot... Big storm's coming, like we've not seen for years. Round about now a whole bunch of monsters'll gather together. If you like a challenge I can tell you where to find them. Of course, if you end up biting the hot gritty dust that's your own concern.
flavor_zh: Wind's getting hot... Big storm's coming, like we've not seen for years. Round about now a whole bunch of monsters'll gather together. If you like a challenge I can tell you where to find them. Of course, if you end up biting the hot gritty dust that's your own concern.

name: Arena Bakalaka-Battle! Woo!
flavor: Happy day-day! Hunter now eligibbible for become minion. But minion of Cha-Cha or Kayamba? Final-final test at hand. In Quest, think-alink of all your true-true leader did for you and make decision. Shaka-laka!
flavor_zh: Happy day-day! Hunter now eligibbible for become minion. But minion of Cha-Cha or Kayamba? Final-final test at hand. In Quest, think-alink of all your true-true leader did for you and make decision. Shaka-laka!

name: Material Old Girl
flavor: Young'uns need to know the fun of getting materials from monsters to upgrade their armor! You look like you know your way around different armors, so I'm going to ask you to take down a Hyper Basarios and a Hyper Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano!
flavor_zh: Young'uns need to know the fun of getting materials from monsters to upgrade their armor! You look like you know your way around different armors, so I'm going to ask you to take down a Hyper Basarios and a Hyper Shogun Ceanataur in the Volcano!

name: Let the Games Begin
goal: Hunt a Kecha Wacha and a Nerscylla
flavor: Ladies, gentlemen, Lynians and Temnocerans! Welcome to this special surprise show of mine! We've got a Kecha Wacha full of beans and a Nerscylla that's even more aggressive than usual, and they're both gonna make a beeline for you! Good luck!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头奇猿狐和1只影蜘蛛
flavor_zh: Ladies, gentlemen, Lynians and Temnocerans! Welcome to this special surprise show of mine! We've got a Kecha Wacha full of beans and a Nerscylla that's even more aggressive than usual, and they're both gonna make a beeline for you! Good luck!

name: Sky Render
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: Well, darling, this one will be hairy with a capital H. Your target? It tears through the sky, leaving red trails, and all who see it relay tales of woe and misfortune. In short, it's a Valstrax. Don't let your guard down for a second.
flavor_zh: Well, darling, this one will be hairy with a capital H. Your target? It tears through the sky, leaving red trails, and all who see it relay tales of woe and misfortune. In short, it's a Valstrax. Don't let your guard down for a second.

name: Lavaclad Beast
flavor: Agnaktor surround themselves in lava that cools and hardens to form a protective armor, right? I was wondering why I couldn't use that principle for my own armor... Could you take one on while I watch and make notes? From a safe distance...
flavor_zh: Agnaktor surround themselves in lava that cools and hardens to form a protective armor, right? I was wondering why I couldn't use that principle for my own armor... Could you take one on while I watch and make notes? From a safe distance...

name: Battle of 1001 Blades
flavor: Heh heh heh... Did you know the scales of a Seregios are as sharp as any blade? I wonder what'd it be like to cut something with one of those babies... How'd you like to hunt a Seregios and test out those scales for yourself? Heh heh heh...
flavor_zh: Heh heh heh... Did you know the scales of a Seregios are as sharp as any blade? I wonder what'd it be like to cut something with one of those babies... How'd you like to hunt a Seregios and test out those scales for yourself? Heh heh heh...

name: Misty Opportunity?
flavor: There's a lovely little spot in the Misty Peaks that's nice and warm, purrfect for a catnap! Or it would be, except there's a dumb Duramboros making everything cold and shady with its massive bulk! You gotta save my catnap before it's too late!
name_zh: 小山也经不住暖日的诱惑
flavor_zh: There's a lovely little spot in the Misty Peaks that's nice and warm, purrfect for a catnap! Or it would be, except there's a dumb Duramboros making everything cold and shady with its massive bulk! You gotta save my catnap before it's too late!

name: Tracing the Family Tree
flavor: *cough* I'm trying to trace the evolution of *cough* flying wyverns by examining the primitive *sniff* skeletal structure of the Tigrex. Would you hunt one for me? After all, it's not like-- *splutter* not like I could-- *hack* *wheeze* It's not like I-- *haaark*...
flavor_zh: *cough* I'm trying to trace the evolution of *cough* flying wyverns by examining the primitive *sniff* skeletal structure of the Tigrex. Would you hunt one for me? After all, it's not like-- *splutter* not like I could-- *hack* *wheeze* It's not like I-- *haaark*...

name: Beware Twin Horns on the Sand
flavor: I've got a good test for you, darling. A Diablos is lurking around the Desert, blocking us off from some precious resources, so it needs to be removed. If you're who I know you are, you'll be able to take care of this with style. Make it one to get my heart fluttering!
name_zh: 出现在沙漠上的勇猛双角
flavor_zh: I've got a good test for you, darling. A Diablos is lurking around the Desert, blocking us off from some precious resources, so it needs to be removed. If you're who I know you are, you'll be able to take care of this with style. Make it one to get my heart fluttering!

name: Slam Gunk
flavor: You know about the Brachydios that live in the Volcanic Hollow? Course you don't. I'll keep it simple: they can somehow activate the slime, which makes it explode. I need to know how they do this, and you're going to catch one for me. Think you can manage?
flavor_zh: You know about the Brachydios that live in the Volcanic Hollow? Course you don't. I'll keep it simple: they can somehow activate the slime, which makes it explode. I need to know how they do this, and you're going to catch one for me. Think you can manage?

name: Ends of the Earth
flavor: I saw it! A monster with golden scales making its way to the Sanctuary! I'm getting all kinds of premonitions... I wish I could say it was nothing, just the ramblings of an old man, but I fear destruction will follow, just like in the legends... We have to do something.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏天廻龙的角与翼爪
flavor_zh: I saw it! A monster with golden scales making its way to the Sanctuary! I'm getting all kinds of premonitions... I wish I could say it was nothing, just the ramblings of an old man, but I fear destruction will follow, just like in the legends... We have to do something.

name: Paint It Gold
flavor: I simply adore things that are decked out in glittering gold. I've heard stories about the Rajang's golden hair. I would love to acquire some for my collection, so would you hunt the beast at the Ancestral Steppe for me, perhaps?
flavor_zh: I simply adore things that are decked out in glittering gold. I've heard stories about the Rajang's golden hair. I would love to acquire some for my collection, so would you hunt the beast at the Ancestral Steppe for me, perhaps?

name: Everything in Moderation
flavor: Dearie me! What a to-do! A Deviljho in the Marshlands! It'll gobble up all the lovely Aptonoth if we're not careful! Then there'll be none left for me to eat! I will not stand for such a thing, you hear? Please take care of that Deviljho and save my Aptonoth!
flavor_zh: Dearie me! What a to-do! A Deviljho in the Marshlands! It'll gobble up all the lovely Aptonoth if we're not careful! Then there'll be none left for me to eat! I will not stand for such a thing, you hear? Please take care of that Deviljho and save my Aptonoth!

name: Heaven and Hell
flavor: I've seen many a monster in my time, but I've never seen such a disgusting one before. Seems like a bad omen if you ask me... Hey, young 'un, why not take care of that beast? You know, before something bad goes down...
flavor_zh: I've seen many a monster in my time, but I've never seen such a disgusting one before. Seems like a bad omen if you ask me... Hey, young 'un, why not take care of that beast? You know, before something bad goes down...

name: Blizzard Blower
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
sub_goal: Wound Kushala Daora's head and wings
flavor: Forecasts says it should be clear, yet the blizzard goes on and on. I suspect that the appearance of that Kushala Daora is responsible for the sudden changes in weather. It'd be quite a challenge for us to get rid of it... Do you think you could look into it?
flavor_zh: Forecasts says it should be clear, yet the blizzard goes on and on. I suspect that the appearance of that Kushala Daora is responsible for the sudden changes in weather. It'd be quite a challenge for us to get rid of it... Do you think you could look into it?

name: Steel Yourself
goal: Slay a Kushala Daora or repel it
sub_goal: Wound K.Daora's head and sever its tail
flavor: Hey, have you heard anything about this steel dragon doohickey in the Jungle? I need it. I need to make a sword out of a dragon. I've never needed anything more in my life. I also need you to take care of it while I pick up the materials, okay?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏钢龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Hey, have you heard anything about this steel dragon doohickey in the Jungle? I need it. I need to make a sword out of a dragon. I've never needed anything more in my life. I also need you to take care of it while I pick up the materials, okay?

name: Out of Thin Air
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
flavor: While out on a mission, I got that feeling I was being followed. I spun round but there was nothing there. Spooked me for sure, but just as I was thinking it was all my imagination, the beast suddenly revealed itself! No time to explain further, just get out there and slay it!
flavor_zh: While out on a mission, I got that feeling I was being followed. I spun round but there was nothing there. Spooked me for sure, but just as I was thinking it was all my imagination, the beast suddenly revealed itself! No time to explain further, just get out there and slay it!

name: Into Thin Air
goal: Slay a Chameleos or repel it
sub_goal: Break Chameleos's horn and sever its tail
flavor: The other day, I came across one of those Elder Dragons you hear about in the stories. Thought I was about to bite it, but then it just vanished! Hey! Don't give me that look! I know what I saw! Vanished right into nothin'! I hope you, or someone else, can take care of it...
sub_goal_zh: 破坏霞龙的角，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: The other day, I came across one of those Elder Dragons you hear about in the stories. Thought I was about to bite it, but then it just vanished! Hey! Don't give me that look! I know what I saw! Vanished right into nothin'! I hope you, or someone else, can take care of it...

name: Explosion Marks the Spot
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
flavor: I came here looking for lost treasure at the Volcano, but unfortunately it seems to be well guarded! The treasure's just out of reach, and unless we can avoid the beast's explosions, we'll never lay hands on it. So...fancy helping me fulfill my dream of riches?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏炎王龙的头部与翼爪
flavor_zh: I came here looking for lost treasure at the Volcano, but unfortunately it seems to be well guarded! The treasure's just out of reach, and unless we can avoid the beast's explosions, we'll never lay hands on it. So...fancy helping me fulfill my dream of riches?

name: Sandblasting
goal: Slay a Teostra or repel it
sub_goal: Wound Teostra's head and sever its tail
flavor: Big explosions have been spotted sending huge plumes of sand into the air. Might be the work of a Teostra. It'll be a dangerous mission, but if we want to keep nearby villages safe, we'll need a skilled hunter like you to help. We pray you're up to the challenge!
name_zh: 散落在沙漠上的爆炎尘
sub_goal_zh: 破坏炎王龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Big explosions have been spotted sending huge plumes of sand into the air. Might be the work of a Teostra. It'll be a dangerous mission, but if we want to keep nearby villages safe, we'll need a skilled hunter like you to help. We pray you're up to the challenge!

name: Silver-Tongued Storyteller
sub_goal: Wound Silver Rathalos's wings and back
flavor: I used to love my granny's tales of the Silver Rathalos...but I never imagined it actually existed. The stories usually ended up with a nearby village being attacked, so best not to ignore this one... A skilled hunter, such as yourself, could take care of it.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏银火龙的翼与背部
flavor_zh: I used to love my granny's tales of the Silver Rathalos...but I never imagined it actually existed. The stories usually ended up with a nearby village being attacked, so best not to ignore this one... A skilled hunter, such as yourself, could take care of it.

name: Gold Digger
sub_goal: Wound Gold Rathian's wings and back
flavor: Listen! There's been a Gold Rathian! You know, the one with the golden scales! Made of gold! Sweet, precious gold! Wow! I smell an opportunity to make some serious dough! I hear you can handle yourself. Fancy taking her on for me?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏金火龙的翼与背部
flavor_zh: Listen! There's been a Gold Rathian! You know, the one with the golden scales! Made of gold! Sweet, precious gold! Wow! I smell an opportunity to make some serious dough! I hear you can handle yourself. Fancy taking her on for me?

name: The Jungle VIP
flavor: I was in the Jungle pursuing a monster, but this crazy golden furball came leaping out at me. It wasn't like your usual Rajang, either. It was furious, attacking anything that moved! You gotta get rid of it for me, please! I'm gonna get flashbacks...
flavor_zh: I was in the Jungle pursuing a monster, but this crazy golden furball came leaping out at me. It wasn't like your usual Rajang, either. It was furious, attacking anything that moved! You gotta get rid of it for me, please! I'm gonna get flashbacks...

name: Deranged Desert Deviljho
flavor: I can't believe this. We've clearly claimed this land and now some Deviljho's shown up to attack us and our little town. I'm not gonna let it eat all our hard work! Now the odds might be bad, but as long as we look to the future we'll be fine! Who's with me!?
flavor_zh: I can't believe this. We've clearly claimed this land and now some Deviljho's shown up to attack us and our little town. I'm not gonna let it eat all our hard work! Now the odds might be bad, but as long as we look to the future we'll be fine! Who's with me!?

name: Brachydios Brute Squad
flavor: We were visiting Ingle Isle when we were attacked by some creepy monster covered in slime, which slapped its creepy slime-arms in a flash of light and sent us all flying! This isn't how you treat a defense squad! Go on, teach it some manners!
flavor_zh: We were visiting Ingle Isle when we were attacked by some creepy monster covered in slime, which slapped its creepy slime-arms in a flash of light and sent us all flying! This isn't how you treat a defense squad! Go on, teach it some manners!

name: Trial by Akantor
flavor: The Hunter's Guild has massed its forces and managed to corner an Akantor. All that remains is to hunt it down now. Of course, this is a highly dangerous task, so we're looking for experienced hunters to take the job. Think you've got what it takes?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏霸龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: The Hunter's Guild has massed its forces and managed to corner an Akantor. All that remains is to hunt it down now. Of course, this is a highly dangerous task, so we're looking for experienced hunters to take the job. Think you've got what it takes?

name: Polar Peril
flavor: I have another confidential job for you. It's rather private, but important. I'd appreciate your discretion. The job entails you putting down a certain Ukanlos in the Polar Field. It's a dangerous one for sure, so if you want we can discuss worst-case scenarios?
flavor_zh: I have another confidential job for you. It's rather private, but important. I'd appreciate your discretion. The job entails you putting down a certain Ukanlos in the Polar Field. It's a dangerous one for sure, so if you want we can discuss worst-case scenarios?

name: Who Will Hunt the Rain?
flavor: I can't remember the last day it didn't rain. We're all out of dry firewood, and even if we had any, the wind would just blow out our fires. Please, I can't stand this storm anymore! Help us, before we all catch pneumonia!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏岚龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: I can't remember the last day it didn't rain. We're all out of dry firewood, and even if we had any, the wind would just blow out our fires. Please, I can't stand this storm anymore! Help us, before we all catch pneumonia!

name: A Bone to Pick
flavor: My whole village vanished in a single night. All my friends who lived by the sea, even their newborn child, all gone. For some reason I was spared, and since then I have cherished one hope, and one hope only: that someone'll turn that bag of bones into literal bones.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏骸龙的左右喷射孔
flavor_zh: My whole village vanished in a single night. All my friends who lived by the sea, even their newborn child, all gone. For some reason I was spared, and since then I have cherished one hope, and one hope only: that someone'll turn that bag of bones into literal bones.

name: Castle on the Run
flavor: Ahtal-Ka, you know, the monster that's rumored to be a moving fortress? Well, it seems to have vanished somewhere round the Forlorn Citadel. Can something so big just disappear like that? Now's our chance to find out. Set course for battle!
flavor_zh: Ahtal-Ka, you know, the monster that's rumored to be a moving fortress? Well, it seems to have vanished somewhere round the Forlorn Citadel. Can something so big just disappear like that? Now's our chance to find out. Set course for battle!

name: Setting the Barioth High
flavor: I rode out to the Frozen Seaway to challenge a white knight who is said to dwell there, but instead I found myself faced with an odd black-glowing knight in place of the white. I thought to challenge him regardless but, alas, was bested. Go in my place, I beg you!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏冰牙龙的头部与棘
flavor_zh: I rode out to the Frozen Seaway to challenge a white knight who is said to dwell there, but instead I found myself faced with an odd black-glowing knight in place of the white. I thought to challenge him regardless but, alas, was bested. Go in my place, I beg you!

name: Neopteronophobia
sub_goal: Wound S.Queen's head and sever her tail
flavor: My master is an awesome hunter...most of the time. He let slip that he can't stand how Seltas Queens crunch up Seltas. It would be super embarrassing to be the apprentice of an insectophobe, so could you get rid of the bugs so he can stop shuddering?
name_zh: 老师的弱点是狞猛的重甲虫
sub_goal_zh: 破坏重甲虫的头部与尾巴
flavor_zh: My master is an awesome hunter...most of the time. He let slip that he can't stand how Seltas Queens crunch up Seltas. It would be super embarrassing to be the apprentice of an insectophobe, so could you get rid of the bugs so he can stop shuddering?

name: Let's Get Igneous
flavor: The Volcano really does have the most striking rock formations! There's one in particular I would love to get my hands on, but it has to be toasted by a Hyper Rathalos and left to simmer in magma to get the full effect. Does that strike you as doable?
flavor_zh: The Volcano really does have the most striking rock formations! There's one in particular I would love to get my hands on, but it has to be toasted by a Hyper Rathalos and left to simmer in magma to get the full effect. Does that strike you as doable?

name: Seeking the Sea King
sub_goal: Wound Lagiacrus's chest and sever its tail
flavor: Hey there, kid! Remember when I gave you those weapon blueprints? Well, it just so happens I remembered another one of 'em, and I think you'd like it! Go hunt me down a Hyper Lagiacrus in the Jungle and I'll slap some of my smithly wisdom on ya!
name_zh: 狞猛的海之王者乃武器的素材
sub_goal_zh: 破坏海龙的胸部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Hey there, kid! Remember when I gave you those weapon blueprints? Well, it just so happens I remembered another one of 'em, and I think you'd like it! Go hunt me down a Hyper Lagiacrus in the Jungle and I'll slap some of my smithly wisdom on ya!

name: Marshland Fandango
flavor: Now there's a Gravios on my tail! Why does this keep happening to me!? Why am I not in the lab looking at it under a microscope!? I'm no hunter. I could take on all the Mosswine you want, but this? Nu-uh. YOU do the hunting, Hunter!
flavor_zh: Now there's a Gravios on my tail! Why does this keep happening to me!? Why am I not in the lab looking at it under a microscope!? I'm no hunter. I could take on all the Mosswine you want, but this? Nu-uh. YOU do the hunting, Hunter!

name: It Takes Mizutsune to Tango
sub_goal: Wound Mizutsune's head and sever its tail
flavor: I must have more pupils! Through me, the ancient dance of our ancestors lives on: the dance of the Hyper Mizutsune! Is it not dazzling enough? I'll simply have to go and refresh my skills from the source. I can use the experience to solicit more followers!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏泡狐龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: I must have more pupils! Through me, the ancient dance of our ancestors lives on: the dance of the Hyper Mizutsune! Is it not dazzling enough? I'll simply have to go and refresh my skills from the source. I can use the experience to solicit more followers!

name: If These Rocks Could Talk
flavor: Very clever of that hunted Hyper Astalos to slip away in the Jungle like that. Very clever indeed. But not clever enough! I've located an outcrop where the rocks have been deformed by high electrical currents. Shall we go and pay our friend a visit?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏电龙的头冠与翼爪
flavor_zh: Very clever of that hunted Hyper Astalos to slip away in the Jungle like that. Very clever indeed. But not clever enough! I've located an outcrop where the rocks have been deformed by high electrical currents. Shall we go and pay our friend a visit?

name: The Big Push
flavor: We undergo rigorous training day and night to protect our people. So why can't we beat this one lumbering Gammoth!? We hate to admit it, but you're the best for dealing with Hyper monsters like this guy. Go take him down and keep our land safe!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏巨兽的头部与鼻子
flavor_zh: We undergo rigorous training day and night to protect our people. So why can't we beat this one lumbering Gammoth!? We hate to admit it, but you're the best for dealing with Hyper monsters like this guy. Go take him down and keep our land safe!

name: All Creatures Cleaved and Small
sub_goal: Wound Glavenus's back and sever its tail
flavor: To learn the art of quick-draw, one's mind must be still as water. And yet, the Glavenus is seen to cut its prey skillfully yet in a profound rage. I begin to question my principles. Can you show me the beast's combat techniques to deepen my understanding?
name_zh: 抛弃杂念斩断森罗万象
sub_goal_zh: 破坏斩龙的背部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: To learn the art of quick-draw, one's mind must be still as water. And yet, the Glavenus is seen to cut its prey skillfully yet in a profound rage. I begin to question my principles. Can you show me the beast's combat techniques to deepen my understanding?

name: Agnaktor's Deep
flavor: I was really getting very invested in my research at the Volcanic Hollow. If only that Hyper Agnaktor hadn't shown up and ruined everything! It even made me drop a rare Wycademy book on archaeology! I can get it back, I think, but I'd need your help.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏炎戈龙的头部与胸部
flavor_zh: I was really getting very invested in my research at the Volcanic Hollow. If only that Hyper Agnaktor hadn't shown up and ruined everything! It even made me drop a rare Wycademy book on archaeology! I can get it back, I think, but I'd need your help.

name: Something Wicked
sub_goal: Wound G. Magala's wingarms and wings
flavor: What is with that disgusting freak of a monster!? They already look bad to begin with, but this one had a big, creepy aura around it! That thing needs to be hunted before someone gets seriously injured! Well don't just stand there -- GO!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑蚀龙的翼爪与翼
flavor_zh: What is with that disgusting freak of a monster!? They already look bad to begin with, but this one had a big, creepy aura around it! That thing needs to be hunted before someone gets seriously injured! Well don't just stand there -- GO!

name: Seregios Exposé
flavor: A Seregios, presumed Hyper, has been sighted in the Dunes. Any and all hunters capable of tackling the creature are being scouted as we speak. This has been your average bystander chugging Cool Drinks, reporting live from the scene.
name_zh: 视地点而狞猛的千刃龙
flavor_zh: A Seregios, presumed Hyper, has been sighted in the Dunes. Any and all hunters capable of tackling the creature are being scouted as we speak. This has been your average bystander chugging Cool Drinks, reporting live from the scene.

name: Appeal from Authority
flavor: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please hunt the Hyper Duramboros currently rampaging through our villages. (Ugh, the stress. Once I've rebuilt my house and bought a new bed, I'm going to nap for a week.)
sub_goal_zh: 破坏尾锤龙的角与尾巴
flavor_zh: Hunter, I ask this on behalf of all the chiefs in this region: Please hunt the Hyper Duramboros currently rampaging through our villages. (Ugh, the stress. Once I've rebuilt my house and bought a new bed, I'm going to nap for a week.)

name: Tigrex Trap
sub_goal: Wound Tigrex's head and sever its tail
flavor: Some criminal with a grudge against the Guild managed to lure some hunters out to the mountain with a false SOS call. Now they're being menaced by a Hyper Tigrex! The criminal was re-apprehended, but the Tigrex is still at large and causing mayhem!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏轰龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Some criminal with a grudge against the Guild managed to lure some hunters out to the mountain with a false SOS call. Now they're being menaced by a Hyper Tigrex! The criminal was re-apprehended, but the Tigrex is still at large and causing mayhem!

name: Backwater Battle
flavor: A Diablos with a strange, dark aura has been seen wandering this desolate place. But we're not going to let a little thing like that deter us. We didn't come here just to turn tail and run at the sight of a terrifying rampaging monster! If it thinks it can scare us away, it's wrong!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏角龙的双角与背部
flavor_zh: A Diablos with a strange, dark aura has been seen wandering this desolate place. But we're not going to let a little thing like that deter us. We didn't come here just to turn tail and run at the sight of a terrifying rampaging monster! If it thinks it can scare us away, it's wrong!

name: Even Brachydios Need A Holiday
sub_goal: Wound Brachydios's head and sever its tail
flavor: A Brachydios has started loiterin' around the Deserted Island. It's makin' it very difficult for people to use the seaways, not to mention makin' us Moga people mighty nervous. Why does it even want to be there? There's nothing to do!
name_zh: 孤岛中的狞猛碎龙何所思
sub_goal_zh: 破坏碎龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: A Brachydios has started loiterin' around the Deserted Island. It's makin' it very difficult for people to use the seaways, not to mention makin' us Moga people mighty nervous. Why does it even want to be there? There's nothing to do!

name: Path of the Hunter
flavor: You are approaching true huntlightenment. But there is still a ways to go yet, Hunter! You already have the strength you need -- you just need to learn to wield it to your maximum potential. Find your center, and everything will flow from there!
flavor_zh: You are approaching true huntlightenment. But there is still a ways to go yet, Hunter! You already have the strength you need -- you just need to learn to wield it to your maximum potential. Find your center, and everything will flow from there!

name: Fade to Black
goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
flavor: The black dragon of legend is no longer just a legend. Make use of what you find within the ancient castle and you might stand a chance. The fate of our nation lies in your hands!
flavor_zh: The black dragon of legend is no longer just a legend. Make use of what you find within the ancient castle and you might stand a chance. The fate of our nation lies in your hands!

name: Glory Glory Alatreon
flavor: Disasters befall us, lives are lost. In the wake of the dragon, only death remains. Its coming means ruin. Repent, people! Repent of your sins! Unless some brave hunter wants to come and slay this thing for us?
flavor_zh: Disasters befall us, lives are lost. In the wake of the dragon, only death remains. Its coming means ruin. Repent, people! Repent of your sins! Unless some brave hunter wants to come and slay this thing for us?

name: The End Is Nigh
goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
flavor: It's come! The time has come! Not to mention the dragon! Its scales are steeped in blood! It leaves hellfire in its wake! Hunter, if you think you can stop it, then now is the time to give it a whirl!
flavor_zh: It's come! The time has come! Not to mention the dragon! Its scales are steeped in blood! It leaves hellfire in its wake! Hunter, if you think you can stop it, then now is the time to give it a whirl!

name: Old Fatalis
goal: Slay a Fatalis or repel it
flavor: Hohoho, the time is ripe! The hour is come! Now the party begins and we must all dance, dance, dance! Put on your best armor, pick up your best weapon and greet your partner! Don't forget to bow! Ahahahaha!
flavor_zh: Hohoho, the time is ripe! The hour is come! Now the party begins and we must all dance, dance, dance! Put on your best armor, pick up your best weapon and greet your partner! Don't forget to bow! Ahahahaha!

name: Supersonic
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: You know what? My ship's a ton faster than that piece of junk over there. But we ended up gettin' chased by some superfast monster, and the shockwave it left behind dropped us right outta the air. Nobody hurts my ship like that, nobody! Can someone take him out?
flavor_zh: You know what? My ship's a ton faster than that piece of junk over there. But we ended up gettin' chased by some superfast monster, and the shockwave it left behind dropped us right outta the air. Nobody hurts my ship like that, nobody! Can someone take him out?

name: Hunter Dojo: Valstrax-ryu
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: You're looking pretty huntlightened, we must say. Feel like training? One of a hunter's most important weapons is resourcefulness, a quick wit, like the ability to read Valstrax's attacks in its wingtips. Think you've got it? Go see Valstrax-sensei and see what happens!
name_zh: 天彗龙流 猎人道场
flavor_zh: You're looking pretty huntlightened, we must say. Feel like training? One of a hunter's most important weapons is resourcefulness, a quick wit, like the ability to read Valstrax's attacks in its wingtips. Think you've got it? Go see Valstrax-sensei and see what happens!

name: Scales of Justice
goal: Slay a Valstrax or repel it
flavor: So I was on my way to hunt up a shipment of Popo fur when a Valstrax passed by me. I hovered around for a bit just to see if it hadn't dropped a shiny, shiny scale...when it spotted me. I don't need to explain what happened next, do I? Just avenge me, please!
flavor_zh: So I was on my way to hunt up a shipment of Popo fur when a Valstrax passed by me. I hovered around for a bit just to see if it hadn't dropped a shiny, shiny scale...when it spotted me. I don't need to explain what happened next, do I? Just avenge me, please!

name: Deviljho Hunt
flavor: Yeah, I used to be a hunter. I loved the job, too. But then one day this massive beast came out of nowhere... Almost did me in. I quit the biz. I couldn't hack it. But you -- I bet you could take that monster on...
flavor_zh: Yeah, I used to be a hunter. I loved the job, too. But then one day this massive beast came out of nowhere... Almost did me in. I quit the biz. I couldn't hack it. But you -- I bet you could take that monster on...

name: Price Freeze
flavor: Navigating the Frozen Seaway isn't this sailor's idea of fun, but I could have done without the Tigrex playing hide and seek around the place. You need to put a stop to it before my prices freeze for good!
flavor_zh: Navigating the Frozen Seaway isn't this sailor's idea of fun, but I could have done without the Tigrex playing hide and seek around the place. You need to put a stop to it before my prices freeze for good!

name: Seregios Scuffle
flavor: I really didn't deserve any of this. I was just observing some volcanic activity here, when a Seregios showed up and started whaling on me. Like, dude, if the Volcano blows it'll take you with it! We're on the same side here! Not any more, though. Wanna hunt it for me?
name_zh: 前方，千刃龙以外禁止入内
flavor_zh: I really didn't deserve any of this. I was just observing some volcanic activity here, when a Seregios showed up and started whaling on me. Like, dude, if the Volcano blows it'll take you with it! We're on the same side here! Not any more, though. Wanna hunt it for me?

name: Diabolical Delight
flavor: Bwahahaha, I can't believe it! I heard stories long ago about the terrifying Diablos, and now I'm actually in one! Can't tell you how happy that makes me! So, are you gonna be the one to carve your name into history and capture one of these bad boys?
flavor_zh: Bwahahaha, I can't believe it! I heard stories long ago about the terrifying Diablos, and now I'm actually in one! Can't tell you how happy that makes me! So, are you gonna be the one to carve your name into history and capture one of these bad boys?

name: Emergency at the Arctic Ridge!
flavor: Urgent. Signs of Rajang detected in Arctic Ridge. Civilian travel routes in danger. People stranded on mountain also at risk. Proceed immediately to Arctic Ridge with all haste.
flavor_zh: Urgent. Signs of Rajang detected in Arctic Ridge. Civilian travel routes in danger. People stranded on mountain also at risk. Proceed immediately to Arctic Ridge with all haste.

name: Brachydios Bypass
flavor: This Brachydios came out of nowhere so me and my friend had to hide in a cave. I was hurt so my friend acted as a decoy so I could get away...but he hasn't returned! I'm gonna go to the Volcano to find him. Can you cover me by hunting the Brachydios?
flavor_zh: This Brachydios came out of nowhere so me and my friend had to hide in a cave. I was hurt so my friend acted as a decoy so I could get away...but he hasn't returned! I'm gonna go to the Volcano to find him. Can you cover me by hunting the Brachydios?

name: A Very Long Engravement
goal: Hunt a Glavenus and a Gravios
flavor: An airship's gone missing in the Volcano region...and my fiancée was on board. I know lots of Glavenus and Gravios live in the region... I know it looks grim, but I can't give up. Can you hunt the monsters while I lead the search party?
flavor_zh: An airship's gone missing in the Volcano region...and my fiancée was on board. I know lots of Glavenus and Gravios live in the region... I know it looks grim, but I can't give up. Can you hunt the monsters while I lead the search party?

name: A Titanic Clash
goal: Hunt an Agnaktor and a Duramboros
flavor: Uh... I may have, uh, done a bad thing. I let an Agnaktor and a Duramboros into the Arena at the same time, and the two of them just went crazy! It's like hell on earth in there! Please, somebody do something before more damage is done!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头炎戈龙和1头尾锤龙
flavor_zh: Uh... I may have, uh, done a bad thing. I let an Agnaktor and a Duramboros into the Arena at the same time, and the two of them just went crazy! It's like hell on earth in there! Please, somebody do something before more damage is done!

name: The Ol' Razzle Dazzle
goal: Hunt a Deviljho and a Rajang
flavor: You ready? You must be ready. Both monsters are waiting for you in what I can only assume is eager anticipation! I want you to give those beasties all you've got. Give me a fantastic show!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头恐暴龙和1头金狮子
flavor_zh: You ready? You must be ready. Both monsters are waiting for you in what I can only assume is eager anticipation! I want you to give those beasties all you've got. Give me a fantastic show!

name: Quest of Friendship
flavor: Feh heh heh, if this Quest doesn't make us best buds I don't know what will! Time to show the other Guildmasters what you're made of with the mother of all Quests! The harder the Quest the deeper the bond, I always say!
name_zh: 牵绊的象征！孤岛大决战
flavor_zh: Feh heh heh, if this Quest doesn't make us best buds I don't know what will! Time to show the other Guildmasters what you're made of with the mother of all Quests! The harder the Quest the deeper the bond, I always say!

name: Fiery Four-way Fracas
flavor: Hahahah! As soon as I heard how well my apprentice was doing, I knew I had to make some new armor to celebrate! Guess who gets to go to the Volcano and hunt every big sucker they can find in the search for materials? YOU! I'll keep the forge hot for you.
flavor_zh: Hahahah! As soon as I heard how well my apprentice was doing, I knew I had to make some new armor to celebrate! Guess who gets to go to the Volcano and hunt every big sucker they can find in the search for materials? YOU! I'll keep the forge hot for you.

name: Pitched Pinnacle Battle
sub_goal: Wound Deviljho's head, sever its tail
flavor: We're up at the Ruined Pinnacle on a survey but a Deviljho took us by surprise. It had some kind of dark aura and powerful attacks which are giving us some trouble. If there's a skilled hunter who can help us out of this, that would be great.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏恐暴龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: We're up at the Ruined Pinnacle on a survey but a Deviljho took us by surprise. It had some kind of dark aura and powerful attacks which are giving us some trouble. If there's a skilled hunter who can help us out of this, that would be great.

name: A Tragedy in Silver and Gold
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: My husband protected me from those fiends, those monsters! But they were Hyper monsters, and he was just one man... He never stood a chance. I've spent all my life searching for them, and I've tracked them to the Ruined Pinnacle. Please, put an end to this pain.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: My husband protected me from those fiends, those monsters! But they were Hyper monsters, and he was just one man... He never stood a chance. I've spent all my life searching for them, and I've tracked them to the Ruined Pinnacle. Please, put an end to this pain.

name: Rajang Against The Machine
flavor: Long ago I banished a man who turned out to be innocent, and he swore revenge. Now I fear that time has come, as he's leading a Hyper Rajang to my city! I'm eager to make amends with him and atone for my mistake, but you must defend the city!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏金狮子的角与尾巴
flavor_zh: Long ago I banished a man who turned out to be innocent, and he swore revenge. Now I fear that time has come, as he's leading a Hyper Rajang to my city! I'm eager to make amends with him and atone for my mistake, but you must defend the city!

name: What's Mine is Mine
flavor: You know how long it took us to find some high-quality ore? Long enough for an Uragaan to shuffle up next to us and then start rolling around wrecking the place! Get its Hyper behind outta here before the entire mine caves in!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏爆锤龙的颚与背部
flavor_zh: You know how long it took us to find some high-quality ore? Long enough for an Uragaan to shuffle up next to us and then start rolling around wrecking the place! Get its Hyper behind outta here before the entire mine caves in!

name: A Jurassic Frontier Just for You
sub_goal: Wound G.Rathian's head and sever its tail
flavor: My acquaintance says that hunters' weapon arms tremble uncontrollably when up against a powerful enemy. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. So how about you take a quick sojourn to the Jurassic Frontier and show me?
sub_goal_zh: 破坏金火龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: My acquaintance says that hunters' weapon arms tremble uncontrollably when up against a powerful enemy. Naturally, I was inclined to discover whether there was any truth to this. So how about you take a quick sojourn to the Jurassic Frontier and show me?

name: By the Light of the Silvery Rath
sub_goal: Wound S.Rathalos's head and sever its tail
