flavor: I gaze here up at the moon in the Misty Peaks, and oh, how beautiful it looks! But wait...how strange. It shines silver, but it's no moon...and it's not particularly beautiful either. Or round! 'Tis an evil glow! Please, Hunter, make it leave!
name_zh: 浮现在夜空的银色太阳
sub_goal_zh: 破坏银火龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: I gaze here up at the moon in the Misty Peaks, and oh, how beautiful it looks! But wait...how strange. It shines silver, but it's no moon...and it's not particularly beautiful either. Or round! 'Tis an evil glow! Please, Hunter, make it leave!

name: Zinogre-enthusiasm
flavor: Looks like some Moga villagers got attacked by a Hyper Zinogre on their way to Yukumo. And I'm the one who invited them to begin with... Ugh, it's all my fault! I hate to be asking you, but could you go out to the Deserted Island and get them to safety?
name_zh: 孤岛遇上狞猛的雷狼龙！
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雷狼龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: Looks like some Moga villagers got attacked by a Hyper Zinogre on their way to Yukumo. And I'm the one who invited them to begin with... Ugh, it's all my fault! I hate to be asking you, but could you go out to the Deserted Island and get them to safety?

name: Arctic Ridge Allegiances
flavor: The Guildmasters have been vying to see who gets the most attention from you lately. I don't really care for such nonsense, myself, so I'll just ask you to clean out the Hyper Monsters at the Arctic Ridge. Be careful -- they're all exceptionally strong!
name_zh: 牵绊的象征？雪山狞猛大决战
flavor_zh: The Guildmasters have been vying to see who gets the most attention from you lately. I don't really care for such nonsense, myself, so I'll just ask you to clean out the Hyper Monsters at the Arctic Ridge. Be careful -- they're all exceptionally strong!

name: Arena Allegiances
flavor: I hear the Val Habar Master has been proactive of late in trying to monopolize your talent. Well, I'm not going to sit idly by and let him have his way! I've prepared a Quest for you. Let your success demonstrate to whom you really owe your loyalty!
name_zh: 牵绊的象征！斗技场大决战
flavor_zh: I hear the Val Habar Master has been proactive of late in trying to monopolize your talent. Well, I'm not going to sit idly by and let him have his way! I've prepared a Quest for you. Let your success demonstrate to whom you really owe your loyalty!

name: The Sun and the Moon
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: The sun and the moon are opposing entities, destined never to meet. But suppose they do? Why, it would spell the end of the world! And now the Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian at the Ruined Pinnacle have come to bring ruin upon us all! Gods have mercy!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: The sun and the moon are opposing entities, destined never to meet. But suppose they do? Why, it would spell the end of the world! And now the Silver Rathalos and Gold Rathian at the Ruined Pinnacle have come to bring ruin upon us all! Gods have mercy!

name: Primal Screams
flavor: We've just had word from the Primal Forest. It seems one of our expedition teams was attacked by an irregular type of Gore Magala. We'll need you to hunt it while we evacuate the team. It won't be easy, I know, but you're the only one we can turn to, Hunter!
name_zh: 原生林中混沌之龙的呻吟
flavor_zh: We've just had word from the Primal Forest. It seems one of our expedition teams was attacked by an irregular type of Gore Magala. We'll need you to hunt it while we evacuate the team. It won't be easy, I know, but you're the only one we can turn to, Hunter!

name: Garuga's Comeuppance
sub_goal: Wound Yian Garuga's head and wingtalon
flavor: Some jackanapes'd trashed up my veggies, an' I was of a mind to give 'em a real earful. 'Course, that was 'til I heard some overgrown birdfowl gone Hyper was what done the deed! Don't look like he's in the mood for a talkin'. Maybe see if a hunt'll do him good!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑狼鸟的头部与翼爪
flavor_zh: Some jackanapes'd trashed up my veggies, an' I was of a mind to give 'em a real earful. 'Course, that was 'til I heard some overgrown birdfowl gone Hyper was what done the deed! Don't look like he's in the mood for a talkin'. Maybe see if a hunt'll do him good!

name: Jurassic Skulduggery
flavor: Our sources inform us that a close relative of the king has been abducted by a faction seeking to overthrow His Highness. They left by way of the Jurassic Frontier, which is now brimming with large monsters. Assist our rescue party, Hunter, we beseech you!
flavor_zh: Our sources inform us that a close relative of the king has been abducted by a faction seeking to overthrow His Highness. They left by way of the Jurassic Frontier, which is now brimming with large monsters. Assist our rescue party, Hunter, we beseech you!

name: Verdant Hills Missive
flavor: I've had ENOUGH! I've already had it up to here dodging Yian Garuga beaks and Najarala tails. Now there's a Rathian and an Astalos!? This is my last chance. Entrusted this note to a friendly Mosswine. Go on without me, my Mosswine friend. Run free! Find help!
flavor_zh: I've had ENOUGH! I've already had it up to here dodging Yian Garuga beaks and Najarala tails. Now there's a Rathian and an Astalos!? This is my last chance. Entrusted this note to a friendly Mosswine. Go on without me, my Mosswine friend. Run free! Find help!

name: R.I.P.
goal: Hunt a Rathalos and a Rathian
flavor: We were finally ready to sign a peace treaty with the neighboring military powers, but just as we were putting pen to paper, along comes a pair of Hyper wyverns! They're no symbols of peace! Get them out of here, pronto!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头火龙和1头雌火龙
flavor_zh: We were finally ready to sign a peace treaty with the neighboring military powers, but just as we were putting pen to paper, along comes a pair of Hyper wyverns! They're no symbols of peace! Get them out of here, pronto!

name: Death at My Greaves
goal: Hunt a Gravios and a Nerscylla
flavor: The Primal Forest used to be a safe place...relatively speaking. Now? Nobody comes out of there alive. Save for one girl, who was delirious when we found her. Said she danced toe-to-toe with Death itself. Turns out "Death" is a pair of Hyper monsters!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头铠龙和1只影蜘蛛
flavor_zh: The Primal Forest used to be a safe place...relatively speaking. Now? Nobody comes out of there alive. Save for one girl, who was delirious when we found her. Said she danced toe-to-toe with Death itself. Turns out "Death" is a pair of Hyper monsters!

name: Pinnacle Problems
flavor: We knew what we were getting into when we went to survey the Ruined Pinnacle. We were ready for literally anything...except THOSE! A Hyper Basarios, Zinogre, AND Astalos? It's a sight to behold, let me tell you. Hunter, trounce that terrible trio!
flavor_zh: We knew what we were getting into when we went to survey the Ruined Pinnacle. We were ready for literally anything...except THOSE! A Hyper Basarios, Zinogre, AND Astalos? It's a sight to behold, let me tell you. Hunter, trounce that terrible trio!

name: A Bed of Sand
flavor: My son never came back from his hunt. He knew what he was getting into...but that doesn't stop me from wanting something to remember him by. It's no small errand, but would you brave a den of Hyper monsters to bring me closure, Hunter?
flavor_zh: My son never came back from his hunt. He knew what he was getting into...but that doesn't stop me from wanting something to remember him by. It's no small errand, but would you brave a den of Hyper monsters to bring me closure, Hunter?

name: Jungle Funk
flavor: Stay calm! An airship delivering a large consignment of Dung Bombs has crashed, and now the Jungle's covered in sh...*ahem*...shovel-loads of the stuff. Hyper Monsters fleeing the stench are hindering the recovery effort... What to do...?
flavor_zh: Stay calm! An airship delivering a large consignment of Dung Bombs has crashed, and now the Jungle's covered in sh...*ahem*...shovel-loads of the stuff. Hyper Monsters fleeing the stench are hindering the recovery effort... What to do...?

name: Grudge Match: Malfestio
flavor: You DO know your left from your right, don't you? This Malfestio's got powers that'll make you forget. Watch yourself! Weapons: Great Sword, Sword & Shield, Hammer, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

name: Boltreaver G4: Hunt
goal: Hunt a Boltreaver Astalos and an Astalos
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Boltreaver Astalos and a Hyper Astalos in the Verdant Hills. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头青电主电龙和1头电龙
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Boltreaver Astalos and a Hyper Astalos in the Verdant Hills. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.

name: Boltreaver G5: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've a Boltreaver Astalos at the Sanctuary that needs hunting. Watch out for a Thunderlord Zinogre joining the fray, too. Good luck, Hunter!
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've a Boltreaver Astalos at the Sanctuary that needs hunting. Watch out for a Thunderlord Zinogre joining the fray, too. Good luck, Hunter!

name: Boltreaver EX: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is reserved for only the most trusted Wycademy hunters. We have confirmed reports of a Boltreaver Astalos in the Sanctuary. I must warn you that this beast is far worse than others of its kind. Steel yourself. It won't be easy.
name_zh: 【超特殊许可】青电主狩猎委托
flavor_zh: This Quest is reserved for only the most trusted Wycademy hunters. We have confirmed reports of a Boltreaver Astalos in the Sanctuary. I must warn you that this beast is far worse than others of its kind. Steel yourself. It won't be easy.

name: Elderfrost G1: Capture
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We need you to capture an Elderfrost Gammoth from the Frozen Seaway. Supplies will be delayed, so make sure to take everything you need with you.
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We need you to capture an Elderfrost Gammoth from the Frozen Seaway. Supplies will be delayed, so make sure to take everything you need with you.

name: Elderfrost G2: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. Your target is an Elderfrost Gammoth at the Arctic Ridge. Careful, though -- if you faint even once you'll lose your reward and fail the Quest, so keep an eye on your Health.
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. Your target is an Elderfrost Gammoth at the Arctic Ridge. Careful, though -- if you faint even once you'll lose your reward and fail the Quest, so keep an eye on your Health.

flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've received word of two Elderfrost Gammoths in the Frozen Seaway. Please hunt them both, and make sure you take every precaution.

goal: Hunt an Elderfrost Gammoth and a Blangonga
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of an Elderfrost Gammoth and a Hyper Blangonga at the Arctic Ridge. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银峰巨兽和1头雪狮子王
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of an Elderfrost Gammoth and a Hyper Blangonga at the Arctic Ridge. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.

name: Elderfrost G5: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've an Elderfrost Gammoth on the Polar Field that needs hunting. Watch out for a Tigrex and a Snowbaron Lagombi joining the fray, too. Good luck, Hunter!
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've an Elderfrost Gammoth on the Polar Field that needs hunting. Watch out for a Tigrex and a Snowbaron Lagombi joining the fray, too. Good luck, Hunter!

flavor_zh: This Quest is reserved for only the most trusted Wycademy hunters. We have confirmed reports of an Elderfrost Gammoth on the Polar Field. I must warn you that this beast is far worse than others of its kind. Steel yourself. It won't be easy.

name: Bloodbath G1: Hunt
flavor: Special Permit Quests are normally regulated by the Wycademy, but consider this an exception. A beautiful hunter and her companion once faced off against the Bloodbath Diablos. They couldn't finish the job. But you can. Take it down, Hunter.
flavor_zh: Special Permit Quests are normally regulated by the Wycademy, but consider this an exception. A beautiful hunter and her companion once faced off against the Bloodbath Diablos. They couldn't finish the job. But you can. Take it down, Hunter.

name: Bloodbath G2: Capture
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. Your target is a Bloodbath Diablos in the Desert. Careful, though -- if you faint even once you'll lose your reward and fail the Quest, so keep an eye on your Health.
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. Your target is a Bloodbath Diablos in the Desert. Careful, though -- if you faint even once you'll lose your reward and fail the Quest, so keep an eye on your Health.

name: Bloodbath G3: Hunt
goal: Hunt a Bloodbath Diablos and a Diablos
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Bloodbath Diablos and a Diablos in the Desert. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头鏖魔角龙和1头角龙
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Bloodbath Diablos and a Diablos in the Desert. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.

name: Bloodbath G4: Hunt
goal: Hunt a Bloodbath Diablos and a Seregios
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Bloodbath Diablos and a Hyper Seregios in the Dunes. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头鏖魔角龙和1头千刃龙
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've got sightings of a Bloodbath Diablos and a Hyper Seregios in the Dunes. We need you to head over there and deal with them however you see fit.

name: Bloodbath G5: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've a Bloodbath Diablos at Ingle Isle that needs hunting. ...Actually, word just in is that there are two Bloodbath Diablos on the island. Good luck, Hunter!
flavor_zh: This Quest is for experienced Special Permit holders only. We've a Bloodbath Diablos at Ingle Isle that needs hunting. ...Actually, word just in is that there are two Bloodbath Diablos on the island. Good luck, Hunter!

name: Bloodbath EX: Hunt
flavor: This Quest is reserved for only the most trusted Wycademy hunters. We have confirmed reports of a Bloodbath Diablos on Ingle Isle. I must warn you that this beast is far worse than others of its kind. Steel yourself. It won't be easy.
flavor_zh: This Quest is reserved for only the most trusted Wycademy hunters. We have confirmed reports of a Bloodbath Diablos on Ingle Isle. I must warn you that this beast is far worse than others of its kind. Steel yourself. It won't be easy.

name: Prowler's First Errand
flavor: My! Why, aren't you a cutie! Tough as any hunter, you say? I see... In that case, could I trouble you to bring me some Unique Ferns from the Jurassic Frontier? Good luck, dear!
flavor_zh: My! Why, aren't you a cutie! Tough as any hunter, you say? I see... In that case, could I trouble you to bring me some Unique Ferns from the Jurassic Frontier? Good luck, dear!

name: Jurassic Fungologist
flavor: You like kinoko? Jumbo Village love kinoko! Villagers ask Neko to gather Abyssal Mushrooms from Jurassic Frontier. Saa! Do me this favor and kinoko trade get better, too! "Kinoko" means mushroom!
name_zh: 调查古代森林蘑菇的生态
flavor_zh: You like kinoko? Jumbo Village love kinoko! Villagers ask Neko to gather Abyssal Mushrooms from Jurassic Frontier. Saa! Do me this favor and kinoko trade get better, too! "Kinoko" means mushroom!

name: Lucky Frontier Cat
flavor: Ah, a Prowler! You came at the right time! Would you be willing to collect me some points in the Jurassic Frontier? Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?
name_zh: 古代森林的点数招财猫
flavor_zh: Ah, a Prowler! You came at the right time! Would you be willing to collect me some points in the Jurassic Frontier? Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?

name: Verdant Hills Bully
flavor: I refuse to stand by and see my precious Felynes bullied! Oh, I'm talking about those cursed Melynx running amok. If you can help me out, I'll teach you how to easily employ more Felynes!
flavor_zh: I refuse to stand by and see my precious Felynes bullied! Oh, I'm talking about those cursed Melynx running amok. If you can help me out, I'll teach you how to easily employ more Felynes!

name: Lucky Hills Cat
flavor: Ah, my good Prowler friend! I've had nothing but good luck since our last little encounter. Now, I need you to collect points in the Verdant Hills. Deliver any items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you!
flavor_zh: Ah, my good Prowler friend! I've had nothing but good luck since our last little encounter. Now, I need you to collect points in the Verdant Hills. Deliver any items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you!

name: The Mining Drag
flavor: Girl, this Balmstone Piece smells something FIERCE. If I had more, I could carry them around as perfume and REALLY work it! Get some for me, would you? Good luck, and DON'T screw it up!
flavor_zh: Girl, this Balmstone Piece smells something FIERCE. If I had more, I could carry them around as perfume and REALLY work it! Get some for me, would you? Good luck, and DON'T screw it up!

name: Felyne Fishing Weekly
flavor: We Felynes love fishing, but we need to purrform more studies if we want to discover the secrets of fishing and share them with the world! Those big pink Premium Sashimi should be purrfect for our research!
flavor_zh: We Felynes love fishing, but we need to purrform more studies if we want to discover the secrets of fishing and share them with the world! Those big pink Premium Sashimi should be purrfect for our research!

name: Grooming the Moofahs
flavor: Okay, just a little off the...ack! Cutting Moofah fur is like trying to trim a hairball! Do me a solid and show me how you deal with it! ...You DO have a Cutting weapon, don't you? Every good fur stylist needs one!
flavor_zh: Okay, just a little off the...ack! Cutting Moofah fur is like trying to trim a hairball! Do me a solid and show me how you deal with it! ...You DO have a Cutting weapon, don't you? Every good fur stylist needs one!

name: Bug Reports
goal: Slay a total of 10 Vespoid or Hornetaur
flavor: Saikin, lately, Marshlands filled with giant insects. Ruining seinokei, ecosystem of Moga Village! Get rid of bugs, they ask. Come with Neko to turn the mushi into mush! "Mushi" means bug!
name_zh: 沼泽出现虫子异常情况？
flavor_zh: Saikin, lately, Marshlands filled with giant insects. Ruining seinokei, ecosystem of Moga Village! Get rid of bugs, they ask. Come with Neko to turn the mushi into mush! "Mushi" means bug!

name: Great Maccao Headbreaker
flavor: Hey, how about a friendly little competition? Let's see if either of us can wound the head of one of those gaudy Great Maccao! If you succeed, then I'll teach you how to hire more Palicoes!
name_zh: 挑战破坏跳狗龙王的头部！
flavor_zh: Hey, how about a friendly little competition? Let's see if either of us can wound the head of one of those gaudy Great Maccao! If you succeed, then I'll teach you how to hire more Palicoes!

name: Dash It All
flavor: No matter how many times a Bullfango charges me, I can never evade it. And I'm not lion, I'm trying real hard! I just turn around, and run straight! What am I doing wrong!?
flavor_zh: No matter how many times a Bullfango charges me, I can never evade it. And I'm not lion, I'm trying real hard! I just turn around, and run straight! What am I doing wrong!?

name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
flavor: Hey, Prowler. You'll help a kit in need, right? I need a Gargwa Egg. Why? 'Claws I said so! Less talkin', more egg-straction! Here's a tip: poke it from behind, and maybe it'll leave an egg for ya. I'm countin' on you!
flavor_zh: Hey, Prowler. You'll help a kit in need, right? I need a Gargwa Egg. Why? 'Claws I said so! Less talkin', more egg-straction! Here's a tip: poke it from behind, and maybe it'll leave an egg for ya. I'm countin' on you!

name: The Secret Ingredient
flavor: The secret to cooking is to waste as little time as possible and blast everything at high heat! Then, just top it with my secret ingredient... What? I'm out of stock!? Please, get me some more!
flavor_zh: The secret to cooking is to waste as little time as possible and blast everything at high heat! Then, just top it with my secret ingredient... What? I'm out of stock!? Please, get me some more!

name: Marshlands Fishing?
flavor: Tanzia Market have freshest sakana. "Sakana" means fish! Shikashi! But! If you scout out good fishing spots, we ensure good supply! Sure to make trade for oishii fish improve, too! "Oishii" means tasty!
flavor_zh: Tanzia Market have freshest sakana. "Sakana" means fish! Shikashi! But! If you scout out good fishing spots, we ensure good supply! Sure to make trade for oishii fish improve, too! "Oishii" means tasty!

name: Arctic Point Expedition
flavor: I found the cutest Felynes, dear! But first they want some points, I fear. If you can help with Point collection then we'll have better Scout selection!
flavor_zh: I found the cutest Felynes, dear! But first they want some points, I fear. If you can help with Point collection then we'll have better Scout selection!

name: Blood Red Marshlands
flavor: Prowler, heed my request! There's an Iodrome in the Marshlands I've been hunting, but a gang of Ioprey keep getting in the way! Do you think you could lend me a hand out there?
flavor_zh: Prowler, heed my request! There's an Iodrome in the Marshlands I've been hunting, but a gang of Ioprey keep getting in the way! Do you think you could lend me a hand out there?

name: An Offer You Can't Relieve
flavor: Hey, Prowler! You'll help a kit in need, right? I need a Wyvern Egg! Little dangerous, but that's purr for the course for you, nya? That egg should be nutritious enough to... Uh, nevermind! Just get that egg!
flavor_zh: Hey, Prowler! You'll help a kit in need, right? I need a Wyvern Egg! Little dangerous, but that's purr for the course for you, nya? That egg should be nutritious enough to... Uh, nevermind! Just get that egg!

name: Uroktor Hide 'n Seek
flavor: I was playing hide-and-seek at the Volcano when Uroktor burst from the ground -- talk about a surpurrise! Luckily, I burrowed before they could see me. If you run into trouble, be sure to hide as soon as possible!
flavor_zh: I was playing hide-and-seek at the Volcano when Uroktor burst from the ground -- talk about a surpurrise! Luckily, I burrowed before they could see me. If you run into trouble, be sure to hide as soon as possible!

name: Into the Volcano
flavor: Ugh... I took this job, but I'm having a little trouble finishing it. Help me out? Remobras hate loud noises, so use that to your advantage. Also... They're ravenous carnivores. Good luck!
flavor_zh: Ugh... I took this job, but I'm having a little trouble finishing it. Help me out? Remobras hate loud noises, so use that to your advantage. Also... They're ravenous carnivores. Good luck!

name: Kut-Ku Earbreaker
flavor: Was delivering new trade cart when spotted by Yian Kut-Ku! Prowler, find dishonorable beast and attack its big mimi! "Mimi" means ears! Then Neko can finally deliver new cart to help with trade! Yakusoku!
flavor_zh: Was delivering new trade cart when spotted by Yian Kut-Ku! Prowler, find dishonorable beast and attack its big mimi! "Mimi" means ears! Then Neko can finally deliver new cart to help with trade! Yakusoku!

name: The Right Cattitude
flavor: Wow! That talent! It's hard to believe you're a Felyne like me! Maybe you could handle an Arzuros, too? Nah... No way just a Felyne could take one of those on... Huh? You'll try it!? My hero!
name_zh: 散落于红叶的，是熊还是猫
flavor_zh: Wow! That talent! It's hard to believe you're a Felyne like me! Maybe you could handle an Arzuros, too? Nah... No way just a Felyne could take one of those on... Huh? You'll try it!? My hero!

name: D. Hermitaur Shellbreaker
flavor: Hey, how about a friendly little competition? Let's see if either of us can smash the shell of a Daimyo Hermitaur! I'll even give you a tip: try mounting it first! If you win, I'll give you some more tips!
name_zh: 挑战破坏大名盾蟹的壳！
flavor_zh: Hey, how about a friendly little competition? Let's see if either of us can smash the shell of a Daimyo Hermitaur! I'll even give you a tip: try mounting it first! If you win, I'll give you some more tips!

name: Surrounded by Blue and Green
flavor: Shimatta... Was delivering new cart when fell victim to cowardly kougeki. "Kougeki" means attack! Prowler, get rid of dishonorable beasts and Neko give beloved cart for kind help! Yakusoku!
flavor_zh: Shimatta... Was delivering new cart when fell victim to cowardly kougeki. "Kougeki" means attack! Prowler, get rid of dishonorable beasts and Neko give beloved cart for kind help! Yakusoku!

name: Poison and Fangs
goal: Hunt a Bulldrome and an Iodrome
flavor: I found some Felynes strong and wise. I'm sure they'd make for great allies! Go forth to aid them without pause and maybe then they'll join our cause!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头野猪王和1头红速龙王
flavor_zh: I found some Felynes strong and wise. I'm sure they'd make for great allies! Go forth to aid them without pause and maybe then they'll join our cause!

name: Prowler's Second Errand
flavor: My! I hear you're taking on ever more difficult Quests, young Prowler. Well done, well done! Do you think you could take on another one from me? Word has it there are Tall Mushrooms up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Bring a few back for me, there's a dear!
flavor_zh: My! I hear you're taking on ever more difficult Quests, young Prowler. Well done, well done! Do you think you could take on another one from me? Word has it there are Tall Mushrooms up at the Ruined Pinnacle. Bring a few back for me, there's a dear!

name: Conga Line
flavor: Hello there, Prowler! You've come right in time to purrovide help! A herd of Conga are blocking the way through the Jurassic Furontier. Do you think you could thin their numbers and open it up? Mates' rates, right, furiend?
flavor_zh: Hello there, Prowler! You've come right in time to purrovide help! A herd of Conga are blocking the way through the Jurassic Furontier. Do you think you could thin their numbers and open it up? Mates' rates, right, furiend?

name: Dashing Velocidrome
flavor: Huh, what? Another hint for how to employ Felynes is that what you want? Haha! Well, maybe you need to prove your worth on the battlefield again, no? Go hunt a Velocidrome in the Primal Forest, then I'll tell you want you want to hear!
flavor_zh: Huh, what? Another hint for how to employ Felynes is that what you want? Haha! Well, maybe you need to prove your worth on the battlefield again, no? Go hunt a Velocidrome in the Primal Forest, then I'll tell you want you want to hear!

name: Eggcellent Surprise
flavor: Nya! Prowler! I need you to get something fur me! Herbivore Eggs! OK? Why, you ask? I'm secretly making a gift fur my brother who nursed me back to health! Can you help?
flavor_zh: Nya! Prowler! I need you to get something fur me! Herbivore Eggs! OK? Why, you ask? I'm secretly making a gift fur my brother who nursed me back to health! Can you help?

name: Cold-Blooded Giadrome
flavor: I spotted a herd of Giaprey led by two Giadrome up here at the Arctic Ridge. I nervously weighed up whether I could take them on, but in the end I chickened out. So much for peace, though -- they attacked me! Help!
flavor_zh: I spotted a herd of Giaprey led by two Giadrome up here at the Arctic Ridge. I nervously weighed up whether I could take them on, but in the end I chickened out. So much for peace, though -- they attacked me! Help!

name: Picturesque Pinnacle
goal: Slay a total of 20 Konchu or Altaroth
flavor: I worked so hard to reach the Ruined Pinnacle and take in the beauty of its view. My heart was purified. However, the tranquility was ruined by those horrible Konchu and Altaroth. Slay them, slay them all! I must be allowed to enjoy the view in peace!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20只盾虫或甲虫
flavor_zh: I worked so hard to reach the Ruined Pinnacle and take in the beauty of its view. My heart was purified. However, the tranquility was ruined by those horrible Konchu and Altaroth. Slay them, slay them all! I must be allowed to enjoy the view in peace!

name: Congalala Crestbreaker
flavor: I found a young man in the Primal Forest, who told me he wanted a Congalala crest. If you help me get one, I'll let you see, some more furry friends chosen specially by me!
name_zh: 挑战破坏桃毛兽王的头冠！
flavor_zh: I found a young man in the Primal Forest, who told me he wanted a Congalala crest. If you help me get one, I'll let you see, some more furry friends chosen specially by me!

name: Innocent Curiosity
flavor: Nya... They're a little tingly, but Great Thunderbugs are so purretty, don't you think? One thing I don't get, though: how do they spurrkle like that? Hunt as many as you can and let meow know what you find out!
flavor_zh: Nya... They're a little tingly, but Great Thunderbugs are so purretty, don't you think? One thing I don't get, though: how do they spurrkle like that? Hunt as many as you can and let meow know what you find out!

name: A Poison Paradise
goal: Hunt a Volvidon and an Iodrome
flavor: Now just where am I going to get fresh paralytic fluid and toxin from? If only a Volvidon and an Iodrome showed up at the Volcano right now and some incredibly helpful hunter decided to go hunt them down for me. Ah well. Oh, didn't see you there. Don't mind me.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头赤甲兽和1头红速龙王
flavor_zh: Now just where am I going to get fresh paralytic fluid and toxin from? If only a Volvidon and an Iodrome showed up at the Volcano right now and some incredibly helpful hunter decided to go hunt them down for me. Ah well. Oh, didn't see you there. Don't mind me.

name: Lucky Dunes Cat
flavor: Are you the lucky Prowler I've been told about? I don't really believe in luck, but whatever. He said you're the real deal. Please deliver some goods for me. Um, anything from the Dunes will do, I guess. Whatever you feel like delivering!
flavor_zh: Are you the lucky Prowler I've been told about? I don't really believe in luck, but whatever. He said you're the real deal. Please deliver some goods for me. Um, anything from the Dunes will do, I guess. Whatever you feel like delivering!

name: Basarios Chestbreaker
flavor: Hey, care to play a little game? I call it "Breaking Basarios". Basically, you have to smash a Basarios's chest plate, and you win if you survive. A free tip: you'll probably find it easier if you mount it. Win the game, and I'll share some more great tips with you!
flavor_zh: Hey, care to play a little game? I call it "Breaking Basarios". Basically, you have to smash a Basarios's chest plate, and you win if you survive. A free tip: you'll probably find it easier if you mount it. Win the game, and I'll share some more great tips with you!

name: Lucky Hills Cat
flavor: Hello Prowler! Recently I really feel like fortune is smiling on me. Maybe I should be more open to superstition, haha! Anyway, I have a request for you. Could you make a delivery in the Verdant Hills? Deliver...whatever. Just whatever items you like!
flavor_zh: Hello Prowler! Recently I really feel like fortune is smiling on me. Maybe I should be more open to superstition, haha! Anyway, I have a request for you. Could you make a delivery in the Verdant Hills? Deliver...whatever. Just whatever items you like!

name: Ludroth Lunacy
flavor: Why are there so many Ludroth here all of a sudden? Did we do something to attract them? Did...did I do something to attract them? Are they...in love with me? Am...am I in love...with THEM? THIS IS TERRIBLE! Please, make them go away!
flavor_zh: Why are there so many Ludroth here all of a sudden? Did we do something to attract them? Did...did I do something to attract them? Are they...in love with me? Am...am I in love...with THEM? THIS IS TERRIBLE! Please, make them go away!

name: Duramboros Humpbreaker
flavor: Still interested in breaking body parts, brah? Good, good, that's what I like to hear. How about we tackle a Duramboros hump next? Try not to get distracted by its big, juicy tail -- just topple it and get that hump!
name_zh: 挑战破坏尾锤龙的肉峰！
flavor_zh: Still interested in breaking body parts, brah? Good, good, that's what I like to hear. How about we tackle a Duramboros hump next? Try not to get distracted by its big, juicy tail -- just topple it and get that hump!

name: Snow Festival
goal: Hunt a Giadrome and a Lagombi
flavor: Brrrr! I am COLD. I can't feel my toes anymore... Getting lost in the Frozen Seaway was bad enough, but two great stinking monsters popped up out of nowhere and attacked! I tried to hit back at them but I ended up getting frozen like a popsicle. Help!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头白速龙王和1头白兔兽
flavor_zh: Brrrr! I am COLD. I can't feel my toes anymore... Getting lost in the Frozen Seaway was bad enough, but two great stinking monsters popped up out of nowhere and attacked! I tried to hit back at them but I ended up getting frozen like a popsicle. Help!

name: Drome Rush!
flavor: I'd found a helper, I was sure -- but he found the Arena held more allure. If you do his Quest and hunt the foes, maybe it will help my woes.
flavor_zh: I'd found a helper, I was sure -- but he found the Arena held more allure. If you do his Quest and hunt the foes, maybe it will help my woes.

name: Dance: The Final Frontier
flavor: I wish to hold a ball in the Jurassic Frontier, but some ruffians have crashed the venue, and their clothes are simply atrocious... Ooh, I can't stand it! Would you be a darling and drive them off?
flavor_zh: I wish to hold a ball in the Jurassic Frontier, but some ruffians have crashed the venue, and their clothes are simply atrocious... Ooh, I can't stand it! Would you be a darling and drive them off?

name: Taste the Mountains
flavor: For today's menu, Mountain Herbal Soup! Highly nourishing and purromotes good blood circulation. Now, it's quite easy to make, but I do need lots of Mountain Herbs. Meow get moving!
name_zh: 药膳汤羹由雪山草制成
flavor_zh: For today's menu, Mountain Herbal Soup! Highly nourishing and purromotes good blood circulation. Now, it's quite easy to make, but I do need lots of Mountain Herbs. Meow get moving!

name: Lucky Mountain Cat
flavor: Ah, my good Prowler friend! It must be fate that brought us together again! This time, I want you to collect points in the Misty Peaks. Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?
flavor_zh: Ah, my good Prowler friend! It must be fate that brought us together again! This time, I want you to collect points in the Misty Peaks. Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?

name: Running with the Night
flavor: I'm studying the nighttime ecology of the Jurassic Frontier, but some Rhenoplos keep getting in my way. Can you help me? They like to charge foes, so try luring them into walls to stun them!
name_zh: 穿梭在黑夜中的硬甲龙
flavor_zh: I'm studying the nighttime ecology of the Jurassic Frontier, but some Rhenoplos keep getting in my way. Can you help me? They like to charge foes, so try luring them into walls to stun them!

name: A Cricket to Love
flavor: Hi there, Prowler! Seen any Silver Crickets around here? No? Aww... I hear there are tons of them on the Deserted Island, but my parents won't let me go on my own... Can you go and get some for me!?
flavor_zh: Hi there, Prowler! Seen any Silver Crickets around here? No? Aww... I hear there are tons of them on the Deserted Island, but my parents won't let me go on my own... Can you go and get some for me!?

name: A Resplendent Dance
flavor: We've secured the venue for our ball, but alas, I have yet to find my partner... Ah, you there! Would you join me for a dance? My, what large feathers yo-- a Great Maccao!? Help!
flavor_zh: We've secured the venue for our ball, but alas, I have yet to find my partner... Ah, you there! Would you join me for a dance? My, what large feathers yo-- a Great Maccao!? Help!

name: Hot Scales & Sharp Pincers
goal: Slay a total of 15 Ceanataurs or Uroktor
flavor: I took a request to take out some Ceanataurs, but once I got there, the place was full of Uroktor as well! I don't really care which, but can you help me thin out their numbers a bit? Please! I need your help!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐15头镰蟹或熔岩兽
flavor_zh: I took a request to take out some Ceanataurs, but once I got there, the place was full of Uroktor as well! I don't really care which, but can you help me thin out their numbers a bit? Please! I need your help!

name: There's Always Room for Fish
flavor: Oh... I'm so hungry I could eat a Plesioth! But I'd be satisfied with some smaller fish... Could you bring me some? Preferably Goldenfish! Their golden scales are so purrty, I bet they taste pawsitively delightful!
flavor_zh: Oh... I'm so hungry I could eat a Plesioth! But I'd be satisfied with some smaller fish... Could you bring me some? Preferably Goldenfish! Their golden scales are so purrty, I bet they taste pawsitively delightful!

name: Out of the Frying Pan
flavor: Aaand the challenger... A Prowler!? Cute! Daring! Not afraid of a Bulldrome, eh? How about going toe to toe with an Arzuros right after? No?
flavor_zh: Aaand the challenger... A Prowler!? Cute! Daring! Not afraid of a Bulldrome, eh? How about going toe to toe with an Arzuros right after? No?

name: The Grandmeowster's Trials
flavor: As Meowster of Moves, the time has come for me to give you the ultimate test. Muster all your strength! Show no weakness! Now go, and do me purroud!
flavor_zh: As Meowster of Moves, the time has come for me to give you the ultimate test. Muster all your strength! Show no weakness! Now go, and do me purroud!

name: We Cat All Be Heroes
flavor: To a Palico, there's nothing cooler than a Seltas. Just seeing one gives me the chills! You think you're tougher than a Seltas? Purr-lease! If you really think so, go purrove it!
flavor_zh: To a Palico, there's nothing cooler than a Seltas. Just seeing one gives me the chills! You think you're tougher than a Seltas? Purr-lease! If you really think so, go purrove it!

name: Fois Gras Faux Pas
flavor: You can't cook a meal without the proper ingredients! And the ones we need today come from sand monsters... What are we making with the ingredients? No idea! I'll figure that out once you get them!
flavor_zh: You can't cook a meal without the proper ingredients! And the ones we need today come from sand monsters... What are we making with the ingredients? No idea! I'll figure that out once you get them!

name: Splash in the Moonlight
flavor: Ahh, perfect weather for a romantic evening with my beloved, just the two of... Huh!? Where did these Ludroth come from!? Don't worry darling, I'll bring back help!
flavor_zh: Ahh, perfect weather for a romantic evening with my beloved, just the two of... Huh!? Where did these Ludroth come from!? Don't worry darling, I'll bring back help!

name: Calm, Cool, and Collected
flavor: Purrhaps they don't scare hunters much, but we find them apawling! There're bigger beasts out there, but the sight of them pouncing on poor little Felynes is just pawful! Please, get rid of them for us!
flavor_zh: Purrhaps they don't scare hunters much, but we find them apawling! There're bigger beasts out there, but the sight of them pouncing on poor little Felynes is just pawful! Please, get rid of them for us!

name: Kecha Wacha Earbreaker
flavor: Sure, you're decent at targeting body parts, but you could still learn a thing or two from "the Partbreaker"! For practice, try smashing some Kecha Wacha ears! 'Course, you can't reach 'em while it's hanging on vines!
name_zh: 挑战破坏奇猿狐的耳朵！
flavor_zh: Sure, you're decent at targeting body parts, but you could still learn a thing or two from "the Partbreaker"! For practice, try smashing some Kecha Wacha ears! 'Course, you can't reach 'em while it's hanging on vines!

name: Fish On!
flavor: Whoa! I finally caught the big ones -- two whole Silverfish! Hm? Why ya looking at me like that? You may like fish, but you'll never beat my record. Let's see if you can catch three of them at the Deserted Island!
flavor_zh: Whoa! I finally caught the big ones -- two whole Silverfish! Hm? Why ya looking at me like that? You may like fish, but you'll never beat my record. Let's see if you can catch three of them at the Deserted Island!

name: Lucky Volcano Cat
flavor: Ah, my favorite Prowler! Fate brings us together once more! I want to ask you to collect points at the Volcanic Hollow. Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?
name_zh: 地底火山的点数招财猫
flavor_zh: Ah, my favorite Prowler! Fate brings us together once more! I want to ask you to collect points at the Volcanic Hollow. Deliver whatever items you like. Oughta be a breeze for you, eh?

name: Under the Blazing Sun
flavor: The Dunes are home to Felynes bold, yet proud and fierce, if truth be told. Aiding them with this hunt, I expect, will be more than enough to earn their respect!
flavor_zh: The Dunes are home to Felynes bold, yet proud and fierce, if truth be told. Aiding them with this hunt, I expect, will be more than enough to earn their respect!

name: Everywhere You Look
flavor: Yikes! What are those things!? Twins? I thought I was seeing double! Even if you can catch them on their own, they'll call the little ones and purrolong the fight. At any rate, don't get in over your whiskers!
flavor_zh: Yikes! What are those things!? Twins? I thought I was seeing double! Even if you can catch them on their own, they'll call the little ones and purrolong the fight. At any rate, don't get in over your whiskers!

name: Malfestio Headbreaker
flavor: Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of parts lately? See those scales everywhere? Guess no one told Malfestio not to litter. So smash it in the head 'til it gets the message! If you can't get close, use your 'rang, brah!
flavor_zh: Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of parts lately? See those scales everywhere? Guess no one told Malfestio not to litter. So smash it in the head 'til it gets the message! If you can't get close, use your 'rang, brah!

name: The Snow Must Go On
flavor: I went to the Frozen Seaway in search of some flowers, but when I found them, a giant bunny kept tossing snowballs at me! The flowers are too delicate for such violence! Put a stop to it!
flavor_zh: I went to the Frozen Seaway in search of some flowers, but when I found them, a giant bunny kept tossing snowballs at me! The flowers are too delicate for such violence! Put a stop to it!

name: Big Bro's Benevolence
flavor: Hey, just the Prowler I need! That egg you got me did the trick! My adorable lil' sis... she's all better! Now that she's Felyne fine, I wanna give her rare stones as a purresent. Only the best for my sis!
flavor_zh: Hey, just the Prowler I need! That egg you got me did the trick! My adorable lil' sis... she's all better! Now that she's Felyne fine, I wanna give her rare stones as a purresent. Only the best for my sis!

name: The Ball's in Your Court
flavor: Hey, Prowler! I've got the perfect job for you. All you've got to do is play with this ball. It's not yarn, but I promise you it's just as fun! I've made all the preparations. Now, go enjoy yourself!
flavor_zh: Hey, Prowler! I've got the perfect job for you. All you've got to do is play with this ball. It's not yarn, but I promise you it's just as fun! I've made all the preparations. Now, go enjoy yourself!

name: Uragaan Shellbreaker
flavor: Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of parts lately? You must be itchin' for a real challenge, so try rockin' a rock-solid Uragaan head! Tough even for pro bros like me, but try bustin' out some bombs!
flavor_zh: Hey, brah! Smashin' tons of parts lately? You must be itchin' for a real challenge, so try rockin' a rock-solid Uragaan head! Tough even for pro bros like me, but try bustin' out some bombs!

name: Poison, Poison, Go Away
flavor: And now for the weather in the Frozen Seaway. The fair skies take a turn for the worse as Remobras cloud the skies and bring a chance of poison showers. Don't forget your umbrella!
flavor_zh: And now for the weather in the Frozen Seaway. The fair skies take a turn for the worse as Remobras cloud the skies and bring a chance of poison showers. Don't forget your umbrella!

name: Meownster Hunter
flavor: The time has come to test your skills. Remember what I have taught you, commit your body and soul to this challenge, and overcome your limits. Now go, and do me purr-oud!
flavor_zh: The time has come to test your skills. Remember what I have taught you, commit your body and soul to this challenge, and overcome your limits. Now go, and do me purr-oud!

name: Bnahabra in the Stomach
flavor: The wings! They're so loud, I can hear them even meow! The Ruined Pinnacle is full of the purrvasive sound of Bnahabra! It just sets my fur on end! How about you have a little extermination party?
flavor_zh: The wings! They're so loud, I can hear them even meow! The Ruined Pinnacle is full of the purrvasive sound of Bnahabra! It just sets my fur on end! How about you have a little extermination party?

name: Lucky Steppe Cat
flavor: Ohhh, you're the prowler who does requests, right? Perfect. Anyway, I'm sorry this is a little short notice, but could you do something for me in the Ancestral Steppe? Just a delivery. Of what? Oh, I don't know. What do you want to deliver? Just pick any old thing!
name_zh: 遗迹平原的点数招财猫
flavor_zh: Ohhh, you're the prowler who does requests, right? Perfect. Anyway, I'm sorry this is a little short notice, but could you do something for me in the Ancestral Steppe? Just a delivery. Of what? Oh, I don't know. What do you want to deliver? Just pick any old thing!

name: Desert Furrontier
flavor: Prowler, we're in need of a helping paw! We've managed to corner a pack of Genprey, but they've turned out to be more furrocious than we expected. Can you help us out and hunt them down before they break out and start rampaging?
flavor_zh: Prowler, we're in need of a helping paw! We've managed to corner a pack of Genprey, but they've turned out to be more furrocious than we expected. Can you help us out and hunt them down before they break out and start rampaging?

name: Primal Furrontier
flavor: Prowler, once again we're in need of your purrowess to help us out. We've been playing cat-and-mouse with some Congas and they're finally good and cornered, but we need that last bit of oomph to win the day. Think you've got time for a hunt?
flavor_zh: Prowler, once again we're in need of your purrowess to help us out. We've been playing cat-and-mouse with some Congas and they're finally good and cornered, but we need that last bit of oomph to win the day. Think you've got time for a hunt?

name: Thank-You Gift
flavor: I want to go collecting! And I know just what I want to purrocure! There's a special mushroom in the Verdant Hills, and I want some! I'll fry them with eggs and make a delicious breakfast for my favorite littermate! Purrlease say you'll find some for me!
flavor_zh: I want to go collecting! And I know just what I want to purrocure! There's a special mushroom in the Verdant Hills, and I want some! I'll fry them with eggs and make a delicious breakfast for my favorite littermate! Purrlease say you'll find some for me!

name: Royal Ludroth Manebreaker
flavor: What up, brah! How's your part-smashin' game? Feelin' good about it? Hey, you ever tried a royal smash? It's a blast, brah. Find a Royal Ludroth and just smash its mane like there's no tomorrow. Seriously, take your Boomerang and give it a bash, brah.
flavor_zh: What up, brah! How's your part-smashin' game? Feelin' good about it? Hey, you ever tried a royal smash? It's a blast, brah. Find a Royal Ludroth and just smash its mane like there's no tomorrow. Seriously, take your Boomerang and give it a bash, brah.

name: Laughter is Not the Best Antidote
flavor: GAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! I went into a hunt in the Marshlands unprepared and just as I thought, the place was full of poison! Gahaha, poison central! I was supposed to take care of an Iodrome but really, that poison! Gahahaha! Would you mind hunting in my place?
flavor_zh: GAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA! I went into a hunt in the Marshlands unprepared and just as I thought, the place was full of poison! Gahaha, poison central! I was supposed to take care of an Iodrome but really, that poison! Gahahaha! Would you mind hunting in my place?

name: Volcano Furrontier
goal: Slay a total of 18 Ceanataurs or Uroktor
flavor: You purrobably know the drill by meow, Hunter, but we need to ask you for help again. This time it's Uroktor and Ceanataurs. It seemed like a good idea at the time! Anyway, we're really hoping to have the last laugh on this one, so...help? Purrlease?
goal_zh: 合计讨伐18头镰蟹或熔岩兽
flavor_zh: You purrobably know the drill by meow, Hunter, but we need to ask you for help again. This time it's Uroktor and Ceanataurs. It seemed like a good idea at the time! Anyway, we're really hoping to have the last laugh on this one, so...help? Purrlease?

name: Lucky Jungle Cat
flavor: Oh, it's the lucky Prowler again. If you believe in such things. Luck, I mean. Obviously, I believe in Prowlers... Anyway, will you do me a favor? I'm so in love with the Jungle recently, so will you make a delivery there for me? Just deliver whatever, it's not important.
flavor_zh: Oh, it's the lucky Prowler again. If you believe in such things. Luck, I mean. Obviously, I believe in Prowlers... Anyway, will you do me a favor? I'm so in love with the Jungle recently, so will you make a delivery there for me? Just deliver whatever, it's not important.

name: Nerscylla Hidebreaker
flavor: How's the part-breaking going, brah? Great! That's excellent to hear. Next up I think you should tackle a Nerscylla. Mount it or use a Boomerang, that's my advice to a fellow breaker! Hope you're not afraid of spiders! Haha...ha ha...ha...*shudder*.
name_zh: 挑战破坏影蜘蛛的背部！
flavor_zh: How's the part-breaking going, brah? Great! That's excellent to hear. Next up I think you should tackle a Nerscylla. Mount it or use a Boomerang, that's my advice to a fellow breaker! Hope you're not afraid of spiders! Haha...ha ha...ha...*shudder*.

name: Lagiacrus Headbreaker
flavor: I found a boy, but he just said "Lagiacrus! Break its head!" Would it be too much to ask for you to take this violent task?
flavor_zh: I found a boy, but he just said "Lagiacrus! Break its head!" Would it be too much to ask for you to take this violent task?

name: Ninjadromes
flavor: Using the snow as cover for their hostile incursions? These beasts have more guile than I gave them credit for. Almost ninja-like in their cunning! I fear you will need all your wits to take them out, Prowler.
name_zh: 隐匿在雪中的白速龙王
flavor_zh: Using the snow as cover for their hostile incursions? These beasts have more guile than I gave them credit for. Almost ninja-like in their cunning! I fear you will need all your wits to take them out, Prowler.

name: Seltas Spat
flavor: Y'know, Prowler, even husbands out in nature have it tough. The other day, in the Jurassic Frontier, I saw a poor Seltas being literally manipulated by his wife. I believed in love, Prowler! Tell me it gets better than this! Listen, how about you hunt that Seltas for me?
name_zh: 穿甲虫与夫妇间的牵绊
flavor_zh: Y'know, Prowler, even husbands out in nature have it tough. The other day, in the Jurassic Frontier, I saw a poor Seltas being literally manipulated by his wife. I believed in love, Prowler! Tell me it gets better than this! Listen, how about you hunt that Seltas for me?

name: Gravios Backbreaker
flavor: Hey brah! Still smashin' those parts? That's what we like to hear! I think you're ready to take on some Gravios armor! Even I have trouble with this one -- no, no, it's true! Just try and mount it and see what happens, that's my best advice to you, brah.
flavor_zh: Hey brah! Still smashin' those parts? That's what we like to hear! I think you're ready to take on some Gravios armor! Even I have trouble with this one -- no, no, it's true! Just try and mount it and see what happens, that's my best advice to you, brah.

name: Meownster Hunter Ultimate
flavor: I have nothing left to teach you. My part in your journey may be over, but I have no doubt that you will continue to improve and climb higher and higher. So go! Go and show the world what a real Prowler can do!
flavor_zh: I have nothing left to teach you. My part in your journey may be over, but I have no doubt that you will continue to improve and climb higher and higher. So go! Go and show the world what a real Prowler can do!

name: Grudge Match: Great Maccao
flavor: To think, lil' Greenhorn taking on a Great Maccao! I'm moved... Just like YOU should do when a Great Maccao tries to jump-kick you in the face! Support: Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: To think, lil' Greenhorn taking on a Great Maccao! I'm moved... Just like YOU should do when a Great Maccao tries to jump-kick you in the face! Support: Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing, Gathering

name: Grudge Match: Gypceros
flavor: This time, you're up against a Gypceros! Be careful: They're clever, and will sometimes play dead. Don't end up as monster chow! That's an order! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Gathering
flavor_zh: This time, you're up against a Gypceros! Be careful: They're clever, and will sometimes play dead. Don't end up as monster chow! That's an order! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Gathering

name: Grudge Match: Bird Wyverns
goal: Slay a Gendrome and an Iodrome
flavor: All right, Greenhorn! You're up against not one, but TWO Bird Wyverns that use Poison and Paralysis! Shaking in your boots? If so, bring a friend! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Healing, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: All right, Greenhorn! You're up against not one, but TWO Bird Wyverns that use Poison and Paralysis! Shaking in your boots? If so, bring a friend! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Healing, Bombing, Gathering

name: Grudge Match: Barroth
flavor: Looking to push yourself beyond your limits? Then try this Barroth on for size! If the mud bothers you, you should be upping your Palico Skill game! Support: Charisma, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast
flavor_zh: Looking to push yourself beyond your limits? Then try this Barroth on for size! If the mud bothers you, you should be upping your Palico Skill game! Support: Charisma, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast

name: Grudge Match: Tetsucabra
flavor: Want to ensure your legend lives on forever? Then just take down this Tetsucabra and your wish will be granted! Keep an eye on your foe to spot shortcuts to victory! Support: Fighting, Assisting, Healing, Gathering, Beast
flavor_zh: Want to ensure your legend lives on forever? Then just take down this Tetsucabra and your wish will be granted! Keep an eye on your foe to spot shortcuts to victory! Support: Fighting, Assisting, Healing, Gathering, Beast

name: Grudge Match: Congalala
flavor: Ever wanted to show off your full strength regardless of all propriety? The Congalala knows how you feel! This fragrant foe has many aromatic advantages, so use your head! Support: Charisma, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast
flavor_zh: Ever wanted to show off your full strength regardless of all propriety? The Congalala knows how you feel! This fragrant foe has many aromatic advantages, so use your head! Support: Charisma, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast

name: A Season for Lava
goal: Hunt 2 before time expires or deliver a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: Hehehe! This is quite the haul! A group of Uragaan've shown up near the Volcano! We can pick 'em off at our leisure! Although, there're a few too many for me to face alone. Think ya can give me a hand?
goal_zh: 狩猎数量达到2头后时间耗尽或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: Hehehe! This is quite the haul! A group of Uragaan've shown up near the Volcano! We can pick 'em off at our leisure! Although, there're a few too many for me to face alone. Think ya can give me a hand?

name: Crows: The Black Crows
flavor: There's some weirdos makin' trouble in this area. I don't care why they're here, they just need to get gone! Think you can do somethin' 'bout it? If you do, I might give you somethin' good.
flavor_zh: There's some weirdos makin' trouble in this area. I don't care why they're here, they just need to get gone! Think you can do somethin' 'bout it? If you do, I might give you somethin' good.

name: Yowamushi Pedal: Princess
flavor: I can't deliver this jersey to its destination with these large beasts in my way! Please, Hunter! Take care of them and clear a path for me so I can get moving again! I beg of you!
name_zh: 飙速宅男･公――主公主公主！
flavor_zh: I can't deliver this jersey to its destination with these large beasts in my way! Please, Hunter! Take care of them and clear a path for me so I can get moving again! I beg of you!

name: Baki: Biggest vs. Strongest
flavor: In the red corner, we have the Immovable Mountain: the one and only Gammoth! And from the blue corner we have the brave hunter who refuses to lose! Our winner will receive a fabulous prize, so good luck!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏巨兽的头部与鼻子
flavor_zh: In the red corner, we have the Immovable Mountain: the one and only Gammoth! And from the blue corner we have the brave hunter who refuses to lose! Our winner will receive a fabulous prize, so good luck!

name: CoroCoro: Rolling Bowlers
flavor: It's so fascinating to see these monsters rolling about. And just as I was thinking how grand it would be to see three of them at once, here they are! If you're able to hunt these monsters, I'll give you a special present.
name_zh: 可乐可乐･滚动的巨球们
flavor_zh: It's so fascinating to see these monsters rolling about. And just as I was thinking how grand it would be to see three of them at once, here they are! If you're able to hunt these monsters, I'll give you a special present.

name: Ushio & Tora: White Mizutsune
flavor: I'm smelling the worst smell from somewhere... It doesn't seem to be coming from a monster, but it stinks nonetheless. Think you could go deal with it for me? Oh, and if you could remove this spear for me, that'd be great.
name_zh: 潮与虎：白面者的泡狐龙
sub_goal_zh: 破坏泡狐龙的头部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: I'm smelling the worst smell from somewhere... It doesn't seem to be coming from a monster, but it stinks nonetheless. Think you could go deal with it for me? Oh, and if you could remove this spear for me, that'd be great.

name: Magi: Rescue from the Fall
flavor: There's an evil force about... The darkness is encroaching upon him. But it's okay! With your help, we'll be able to keep him from harm. Now, let us work together to dispel the darkness!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑蚀龙的触角与翼
flavor_zh: There's an evil force about... The darkness is encroaching upon him. But it's okay! With your help, we'll be able to keep him from harm. Now, let us work together to dispel the darkness!

name: The Exploding Flame King
flavor: This Quest should really fire you up! Teostra: cloaked in flame, it burns everything in its path... Phew! If you can beat the heat, I'll reward you with an item that'll let you forge some special gear!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏炎王龙的头部与翼爪
flavor_zh: This Quest should really fire you up! Teostra: cloaked in flame, it burns everything in its path... Phew! If you can beat the heat, I'll reward you with an item that'll let you forge some special gear!

name: Yu-Gi-Oh: A Beautiful Wyvern
flavor: It's time for the final match... This dragon is quite strong, but you've got the unbreakable bonds of friendship on your side! Now, get ready... It's time to d-d-d-duel!
name_zh: 游戏王･与优美之龙的决斗
flavor_zh: It's time for the final match... This dragon is quite strong, but you've got the unbreakable bonds of friendship on your side! Now, get ready... It's time to d-d-d-duel!

name: Jump: Boiling Magma
flavor: A Hyper Lavasioth is a worthy opponent indeed. We pirates tend to be at our best when we face a powerful foe. If you pass our little test, we'll give you a ticket for making some legendary pirate weapons!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏熔岩龙的头部与1背鳍
flavor_zh: A Hyper Lavasioth is a worthy opponent indeed. We pirates tend to be at our best when we face a powerful foe. If you pass our little test, we'll give you a ticket for making some legendary pirate weapons!

name: Famitsu: Mizutsune Feature
flavor: The Editorial Department here heard about a new monster resembling a fox, and we'd like for you to get some info on it. Oh, you'll need to hunt it too, naturally! We'll reward you with materials for new weapons!
flavor_zh: The Editorial Department here heard about a new monster resembling a fox, and we'd like for you to get some info on it. Oh, you'll need to hunt it too, naturally! We'll reward you with materials for new weapons!

name: Dengeki: Turbulent Seas
flavor: Here's a little challenge from the Dengeki editors! The target: a Hyper Lagiacrus, in all of its electric fury! If you manage to avoid a shocking defeat, you'll receive a ticket good for making a brand new weapon!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏海龙的胸部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Here's a little challenge from the Dengeki editors! The target: a Hyper Lagiacrus, in all of its electric fury! If you manage to avoid a shocking defeat, you'll receive a ticket good for making a brand new weapon!

name: Uniqlo Shock Fest
flavor: I've come up with the perfect idea for a look that's stylish AND casual! Getting the materials may be a bit of a challenge, but if you can help me, we'll shock the fashion world!
name_zh: 优衣库･前所未有的冲击
flavor_zh: I've come up with the perfect idea for a look that's stylish AND casual! Getting the materials may be a bit of a challenge, but if you can help me, we'll shock the fashion world!

name: Star Fox: Battle at Arctic Ridge
flavor: This is Star Fox! I've spotted a Hyper Monster near the Arctic Ridge! However, this sector is unstable and I'm unable to land. I need you to get in there and neutralize it. You'll be properly rewarded! Good luck!
flavor_zh: This is Star Fox! I've spotted a Hyper Monster near the Arctic Ridge! However, this sector is unstable and I'm unable to land. I need you to get in there and neutralize it. You'll be properly rewarded! Good luck!

name: The Three Virtues
flavor: A large number of big baddies have come crawlin' out and are causin' quite the commotion! We need yer wisdom, strength, and courage to drive off these scoundrels! We'll make it worth yer while with a special item!
name_zh: 塞尔达传说･力量、智慧与勇气
flavor_zh: A large number of big baddies have come crawlin' out and are causin' quite the commotion! We need yer wisdom, strength, and courage to drive off these scoundrels! We'll make it worth yer while with a special item!

name: Metroid: Special Mission
flavor: Something is plotting to steal the galaxy's most powerful weapon! Scanning... That beak, that ominous purple skin... Could it be!? Please, Hunter! Hurry to the Volcanic Hollow before it's too late!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏黑狼鸟的背部，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Something is plotting to steal the galaxy's most powerful weapon! Scanning... That beak, that ominous purple skin... Could it be!? Please, Hunter! Hurry to the Volcanic Hollow before it's too late!

name: The Steel Vanguard
flavor: Can you hear me...? A force bent on tearing the world asunder is closing in. Stand tall against this deliverer of chaos, and grant this great land eternal peace.
flavor_zh: Can you hear me...? A force bent on tearing the world asunder is closing in. Stand tall against this deliverer of chaos, and grant this great land eternal peace.

name: The Voracious King
flavor: Can you hear me...? An evil has awakened, threatening to plunge the world into darkness. Stand tall against this devourer of light, and grant this great land eternal glory.
flavor_zh: Can you hear me...? An evil has awakened, threatening to plunge the world into darkness. Stand tall against this devourer of light, and grant this great land eternal glory.

name: DMC: The Seltas Queen's Cry
flavor: Hey, can you hear that? One of the monsters fled that way. Well, I guess it's not really much of a monster, more of a bug, actually. Anyways, if you can take care of it for me, I'll be sure to make it worth your while.
flavor_zh: Hey, can you hear that? One of the monsters fled that way. Well, I guess it's not really much of a monster, more of a bug, actually. Anyways, if you can take care of it for me, I'll be sure to make it worth your while.

name: Mega Man: Yellow Devil
flavor: The Royal Ludroth is a royal pain. Every time a hunter gets rid of one, it seems another pops up in its place. Reminds me of a certain evil scientist. No matter how many times he's defeated, he keeps coming back!
flavor_zh: The Royal Ludroth is a royal pain. Every time a hunter gets rid of one, it seems another pops up in its place. Reminds me of a certain evil scientist. No matter how many times he's defeated, he keeps coming back!

name: Capcom: Brilliant Orchestra
flavor: I have THE WORST writer's block right now. I want to compose a song that depicts the emotion of a hunt, but I have zero inspi- ration. I bet if I saw you in action, the notes would come pouring out of my pen.
sub_goal_zh: 破坏绞蛇龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: I have THE WORST writer's block right now. I want to compose a song that depicts the emotion of a hunt, but I have zero inspi- ration. I bet if I saw you in action, the notes would come pouring out of my pen.

name: Felyne Village: The Tourney
flavor: Nya, nya, nya, nya, nya! I'm here to give you a super cool deluxe purresent! Although, nothing comes for furree! You need to win the little hunting tournament we're purrlanning! Now, let's get started, nya!
name_zh: 艾露猫村･暖呼呼狩猎大会
flavor_zh: Nya, nya, nya, nya, nya! I'm here to give you a super cool deluxe purresent! Although, nothing comes for furree! You need to win the little hunting tournament we're purrlanning! Now, let's get started, nya!

name: Fan Club: Great All Stars
flavor: Hey, buddy! There's nothing like takin' on the best of the best in a little tussle! Better yet, you'll get an item that lets you make special weapons and armor! I'm so glad I joined the MH Fan Club! Best decision I ever made!
name_zh: MH Fan Club･王者全明星赛
flavor_zh: Hey, buddy! There's nothing like takin' on the best of the best in a little tussle! Better yet, you'll get an item that lets you make special weapons and armor! I'm so glad I joined the MH Fan Club! Best decision I ever made!

name: Fan Club: Remobra Removal
flavor: Hello, everybody! Our foe this time around is a large pack of Remobras! Once you've taken 'em out, I'll give you an item that you can trade for some special MH Fan Club armor! Good hunting!
name_zh: MH Fan Club･蛇龙狩猎战线
flavor_zh: Hello, everybody! Our foe this time around is a large pack of Remobras! Once you've taken 'em out, I'll give you an item that you can trade for some special MH Fan Club armor! Good hunting!

name: Capcom: White & Black
flavor: A group posing as us showed up in the Misty Peaks and totally wrecked the place! What'll we do if people think it's us!? We're begging you, Hunter! Help us out and we'll give you a special ticket as a present!
flavor_zh: A group posing as us showed up in the Misty Peaks and totally wrecked the place! What'll we do if people think it's us!? We're begging you, Hunter! Help us out and we'll give you a special ticket as a present!

name: Capcom: The Ruler's Rage
flavor: A wyvern that once attacked my kingdom has returned, causing the land to tremble beneath it as it strikes without warning. I need your strength, brave hunter. Please slay this beast and restore peace to the land!
flavor_zh: A wyvern that once attacked my kingdom has returned, causing the land to tremble beneath it as it strikes without warning. I need your strength, brave hunter. Please slay this beast and restore peace to the land!

name: Moonlit Tryst
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: The time is ripe! We are having a large banquet tonight! Come forth, you reckless hunters! The moon demands fresh blood! Do what you can to survive this night of madness and revelry!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: The time is ripe! We are having a large banquet tonight! Come forth, you reckless hunters! The moon demands fresh blood! Do what you can to survive this night of madness and revelry!

name: Raging Twins
flavor: H-H-Hey! What are you doing? I absolutely, positively, WOULD NOT go in there, if I were you. There are not one, but TWO Rajang in there. Hey! Did you even here what I said? Two of them, you crazy bat!
flavor_zh: H-H-Hey! What are you doing? I absolutely, positively, WOULD NOT go in there, if I were you. There are not one, but TWO Rajang in there. Hey! Did you even here what I said? Two of them, you crazy bat!

name: All's Hair in Glove & War
flavor: I am absolutely LIVID right now. I JUST ordered a set of gloves made from quality hair, when what do I see but even BETTER hair on a Hyper Rajang! I won't stand for it! Get me that hair!
flavor_zh: I am absolutely LIVID right now. I JUST ordered a set of gloves made from quality hair, when what do I see but even BETTER hair on a Hyper Rajang! I won't stand for it! Get me that hair!

name: A Golden Moon Rises
flavor: Maah bah baaaah brah baaaaah bah bah baaaah. Meh meh... Ba-baaah baaaah bah... Braah braah brah bah bah♪ Mah Mah, brah bah bah♪ (Message by Carrier Moofah)
name_zh: 浮现在太古上空的黄金月亮
sub_goal_zh: 破坏金火龙的头部与翼
flavor_zh: Maah bah baaaah brah baaaaah bah bah baaaah. Meh meh... Ba-baaah baaaah bah... Braah braah brah bah bah♪ Mah Mah, brah bah bah♪ (Message by Carrier Moofah)

name: Silver and Gold
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: Two Hyper Raths are roaming about in the Forlorn Arena. It is a thing of beauty to see them in their many-colored splendor. I do not think you could ask for a better stage to raise the curtain on this majestic tale of war.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: Two Hyper Raths are roaming about in the Forlorn Arena. It is a thing of beauty to see them in their many-colored splendor. I do not think you could ask for a better stage to raise the curtain on this majestic tale of war.

name: Secret Nibelsnarf Hunt
flavor: Day in and day out, I dream of a glorious victory against a monster. Alas, father is not having any of it. *sigh* Well, don't let that Hyper Nibelsnarf in the Dunes go to waste...
name_zh: 潜入任务 狩猎潜口龙！
flavor_zh: Day in and day out, I dream of a glorious victory against a monster. Alas, father is not having any of it. *sigh* Well, don't let that Hyper Nibelsnarf in the Dunes go to waste...

name: The Obvious Choice...
flavor: Shhh... Don't make any noise! We want to observe it in its natural habitat undisturbed... Ah, what a unique specimen. I doubt we'll ever find another one like it!
name_zh: 沙漠的大名･正襟危坐的盾
sub_goal_zh: 破坏大名盾蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: Shhh... Don't make any noise! We want to observe it in its natural habitat undisturbed... Ah, what a unique specimen. I doubt we'll ever find another one like it!

name: It Would Be a Shame If...
flavor: Would you just look at it... Take it all in... To think, a specimen such as this has gone THIS long without being hunted. Well, I can only think of one thing to do... Go get it Hunter!
name_zh: 火山的将军･跳舞的镰刀
sub_goal_zh: 破坏将军镰蟹的双钳与壳
flavor_zh: Would you just look at it... Take it all in... To think, a specimen such as this has gone THIS long without being hunted. Well, I can only think of one thing to do... Go get it Hunter!

name: Not Stepping One Foot...
flavor: What was THAT all about? Look, I know ol' Brachy, and what I just saw was totally weird. Something had it all worked up, and I'm not even getting close enough to find out what it was. That's what I've got YOU for!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏碎龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: What was THAT all about? Look, I know ol' Brachy, and what I just saw was totally weird. Something had it all worked up, and I'm not even getting close enough to find out what it was. That's what I've got YOU for!

name: Picturesque Encounter
flavor: Picture it: a Hyper Zinogre in the Frozen Seaway, locked in an epic struggle against a powerful hunter... Wouldn't that make an amazing piece? Of course it would! Go make it happen, wouldja?
name_zh: 在白银世界中向荒天怒吼
sub_goal_zh: 破坏雷狼龙的头部与前肢
flavor_zh: Picture it: a Hyper Zinogre in the Frozen Seaway, locked in an epic struggle against a powerful hunter... Wouldn't that make an amazing piece? Of course it would! Go make it happen, wouldja?

name: Absolute Power
flavor: As if those things could get any more aggressive, this Tigrex seems especially amped up. Our walls are useless against them. You must stop it before it lays waste to everything in its path!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏轰龙的爪，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: As if those things could get any more aggressive, this Tigrex seems especially amped up. Our walls are useless against them. You must stop it before it lays waste to everything in its path!

name: A Land Draped in Fantasy
flavor: Is there anybody willing to face the majestic Kirin that has just manifested in the Forlorn Arena? Nothing has prepared you for the likes of this beast. If you wish to experience a land filled with dreams, please step forth.
flavor_zh: Is there anybody willing to face the majestic Kirin that has just manifested in the Forlorn Arena? Nothing has prepared you for the likes of this beast. If you wish to experience a land filled with dreams, please step forth.

name: The Formless One
flavor: Numerous observers have found signs of a Chameleos around the Forlorn Arena. The Guild has also received reports of people being hit with poison from an unseen foe. Hunter, please investigate these strange incidents.
flavor_zh: Numerous observers have found signs of a Chameleos around the Forlorn Arena. The Guild has also received reports of people being hit with poison from an unseen foe. Hunter, please investigate these strange incidents.

name: The White God Returns
flavor: Lately, in the deepest reaches of the polar region, the earth has been shaking tremendously. The people fear the very ground will open up and swallow them whole. Their fears may become reality if something is not done.
flavor_zh: Lately, in the deepest reaches of the polar region, the earth has been shaking tremendously. The people fear the very ground will open up and swallow them whole. Their fears may become reality if something is not done.

name: Evil Descendeth Upon Us
flavor: From the heavens descended a being bathed in light from a sacred mountain. With it, came a storm that plunged the world into calamity. Someone, deliver us from this evil, lest we exist in darkness forever.
flavor_zh: From the heavens descended a being bathed in light from a sacred mountain. With it, came a storm that plunged the world into calamity. Someone, deliver us from this evil, lest we exist in darkness forever.

name: Where Gods Fear to Tread
flavor: Long time, no see, hunters. I've prepared a test for you all. This day your opponent is an Alatreon. Which will emerge victorious in battle, you? Or the beast feared by the very heavens themselves!?
flavor_zh: Long time, no see, hunters. I've prepared a test for you all. This day your opponent is an Alatreon. Which will emerge victorious in battle, you? Or the beast feared by the very heavens themselves!?

name: Harbinger of Death
flavor: I've received an urgent request from the Wycademy. It seems that another Nakarkos has been spotted in Wyvern's End. I'd like to avoid a situation like before. Hunter you must face and defeat that Nakarkos!
flavor_zh: I've received an urgent request from the Wycademy. It seems that another Nakarkos has been spotted in Wyvern's End. I'd like to avoid a situation like before. Hunter you must face and defeat that Nakarkos!

name: No Party Poopers!
flavor: I'm throwing a party featuring some of my very favorite pets. I'm bringing a Kecha Wacha, Blangonga, and a Rajang to the fray! Don't come to this throwdown if you ain't gonna throw down!
flavor_zh: I'm throwing a party featuring some of my very favorite pets. I'm bringing a Kecha Wacha, Blangonga, and a Rajang to the fray! Don't come to this throwdown if you ain't gonna throw down!

name: The Five Kings of Destruction
flavor: And so it begins! Having honed their fangs over the years, five masters of disaster have just appeared near the Forlorn Arena. Will they prove to be the end of you, or will you overcome them and be the ultimate hunter!?
flavor_zh: And so it begins! Having honed their fangs over the years, five masters of disaster have just appeared near the Forlorn Arena. Will they prove to be the end of you, or will you overcome them and be the ultimate hunter!?

name: How It's Done
flavor: My home's constantly in danger, meaning lot's of kids grow up to be hunters. Unfortunately, there aren't any master hunters around to train the newcomers how to hunt Hyper Monsters. Care to show them the ropes?
flavor_zh: My home's constantly in danger, meaning lot's of kids grow up to be hunters. Unfortunately, there aren't any master hunters around to train the newcomers how to hunt Hyper Monsters. Care to show them the ropes?

name: Unbridled Rage
flavor: As a hunter, you gotta know your limit. For me, ol' Deviljho is mine. That crazy pickle just about did me in on more than one occasion. I heard some nutty hunter is gonna take on two of 'em today.
flavor_zh: As a hunter, you gotta know your limit. For me, ol' Deviljho is mine. That crazy pickle just about did me in on more than one occasion. I heard some nutty hunter is gonna take on two of 'em today.

name: Insanity and Destruction
goal: Hunt a Deviljho and a Rajang
flavor: Recently, I've been wondering about something... You hunters always carry out my requests without hesitation, but I am curious as to the extent of your strength. I've prepared a little test to see what you can do!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头恐暴龙和1头金狮子
flavor_zh: Recently, I've been wondering about something... You hunters always carry out my requests without hesitation, but I am curious as to the extent of your strength. I've prepared a little test to see what you can do!

name: Volcano Item Delivery
flavor: Hey, you there! Yo know what they say about idle hands... Don't just sit on 'em, go to the Volcano and gather us some Account Items. Don't matter what, just make sure you put 'em in the Delivery Box!
flavor_zh: Hey, you there! Yo know what they say about idle hands... Don't just sit on 'em, go to the Volcano and gather us some Account Items. Don't matter what, just make sure you put 'em in the Delivery Box!

name: Anything For a Buck
flavor: One of my biggest clients came to me with a request. She saw a Great Maccao and just HAD to have its hide as a throw rug... Weird, but business is business. Help a guy out?
flavor_zh: One of my biggest clients came to me with a request. She saw a Great Maccao and just HAD to have its hide as a throw rug... Weird, but business is business. Help a guy out?

name: A Mammoth Mistake
flavor: Gammoths are so cute and cuddly! Least I thought so 'til I tried to hug one. It attacked me and now I can't even move my arms. I just wanted some wooley lovin'! Why's it gotta be so cold?
flavor_zh: Gammoths are so cute and cuddly! Least I thought so 'til I tried to hug one. It attacked me and now I can't even move my arms. I just wanted some wooley lovin'! Why's it gotta be so cold?

name: The Untamed Mountains
goal: Hunt a Duramboros and a Gammoth
