flavor: One is a great peak covered in moss and spins like a tornado, while the other is covered in snow and buffeted by gusts of wind. Conquer these two peaks and you will never fear another mountain again.
goal_zh: 狩猎1头尾锤龙和1头巨兽
flavor_zh: One is a great peak covered in moss and spins like a tornado, while the other is covered in snow and buffeted by gusts of wind. Conquer these two peaks and you will never fear another mountain again.

name: The Best of the Best
flavor: There is nothing left to say. If you wish to claim the title of the strongest hunter, you must go forth and forge your own path to glory. Destiny waits for no one, Hunter!
flavor_zh: There is nothing left to say. If you wish to claim the title of the strongest hunter, you must go forth and forge your own path to glory. Destiny waits for no one, Hunter!

name: The Greatest Hunter
flavor: Want to be a part of hunting history? Think you got what it takes to face all of the most popular monsters in a row? Prove yourself and your name will echo within the hall of legends!
flavor_zh: Want to be a part of hunting history? Think you got what it takes to face all of the most popular monsters in a row? Prove yourself and your name will echo within the hall of legends!

name: Retreat Run-in
flavor: I set up this place to celebrate the health and happiness of my beloved children, but it's been overrun by monsters! I need you to go out there and strike them down with the ferocity of a dragon!
flavor_zh: I set up this place to celebrate the health and happiness of my beloved children, but it's been overrun by monsters! I need you to go out there and strike them down with the ferocity of a dragon!

name: Overcome with Awe
flavor: Hunter, I don't think I've ever seen anybody hunt with as much style and grace as you! I am hoping that you will put your superior skills on display in the Arena! It truly is an honor to meet you!
flavor_zh: Hunter, I don't think I've ever seen anybody hunt with as much style and grace as you! I am hoping that you will put your superior skills on display in the Arena! It truly is an honor to meet you!

name: The Hammer and the Pike
goal: Hunt an Uragaan and an Agnaktor
flavor: The Princess just set out for the Arena, saying something about becoming a hunter! The palace guards went after her, but they're no match for any monster! Please hunter, get them before they get her!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头爆锤龙和1头炎戈龙
flavor_zh: The Princess just set out for the Arena, saying something about becoming a hunter! The palace guards went after her, but they're no match for any monster! Please hunter, get them before they get her!

name: Jump: The Desert Crown
flavor: Legend says that in the great sand sea of the Dunes slumbers a precious crown. But watch for the mud attacks that follow it. That crown is your "ticket" to making some legendary pirate weapons!
flavor_zh: Legend says that in the great sand sea of the Dunes slumbers a precious crown. But watch for the mud attacks that follow it. That crown is your "ticket" to making some legendary pirate weapons!

name: Strider: Frozen Mission
flavor: This is headquarters. Your mission: hunt a Deviljho. Your reward, should you prove successful: some sweet duds. Don't forget: it's either hunt or be hunted. Now, get to work.
flavor_zh: This is headquarters. Your mission: hunt a Deviljho. Your reward, should you prove successful: some sweet duds. Don't forget: it's either hunt or be hunted. Now, get to work.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Power
flavor: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of power, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire a weapon of great potency.
name_zh: 塞尔达传说･力量的试炼
flavor_zh: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of power, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire a weapon of great potency.

name: Fire Emblem: Warding Despair
flavor: A silver wyvern is wreaking destruction. It's horrible... It's as though we were under the tyranny of the Shadow Dragon once more. Lend us your strength, Hunter, and as reward I will lend you mine!
name_zh: FE･在世界被绝望笼罩之前
flavor_zh: A silver wyvern is wreaking destruction. It's horrible... It's as though we were under the tyranny of the Shadow Dragon once more. Lend us your strength, Hunter, and as reward I will lend you mine!

name: Okami: Most Wanted
flavor: Some monster that looks just like Nechku is causin' a mess out there... Heh, what're you sharpening your weapon for? You think you can take it, eh? Well then, show me what you got, Hunter!
name_zh: 大神･妖怪通缉令出差版
flavor_zh: Some monster that looks just like Nechku is causin' a mess out there... Heh, what're you sharpening your weapon for? You think you can take it, eh? Well then, show me what you got, Hunter!

name: Ghosts 'n Goblins: Seeing Red
flavor: I have to save the princess, but that RED demon is in my way again... If only I weren't turned into a frog, I'd spear him in a second! If anyone out there can help me out, I'll make sure you're rewarded!
name_zh: 魔界村･红色强敌的危险火焰
flavor_zh: I have to save the princess, but that RED demon is in my way again... If only I weren't turned into a frog, I'd spear him in a second! If anyone out there can help me out, I'll make sure you're rewarded!

name: Case Closed: Desert Arrest!
flavor: The monster thought to be at the center of a spate of nasty incidents absconded to the Desert. Fierce resistance is expected, but we must take it alive!
name_zh: 名侦探柯南･沙漠中的追捕剧！
flavor_zh: The monster thought to be at the center of a spate of nasty incidents absconded to the Desert. Fierce resistance is expected, but we must take it alive!

name: Kingdom: Test of the Best!
flavor: I heard that the strongest being in this land was some giant crab. Are you not a hunter? Will you stand for that? Go beat him! Prove your worth! Show me that nothing under heaven will stop you!
name_zh: 王者天下･大陆最强决出战！
flavor_zh: I heard that the strongest being in this land was some giant crab. Are you not a hunter? Will you stand for that? Go beat him! Prove your worth! Show me that nothing under heaven will stop you!

name: Shonen: Winged Nocturne
flavor: Do you like Malfestio, the night flier with wings like deep starry skies? Yeah? Then get out on the Jurassic Frontier, hunt the night away, and I'll give you an item to help forge some special gear!
flavor_zh: Do you like Malfestio, the night flier with wings like deep starry skies? Yeah? Then get out on the Jurassic Frontier, hunt the night away, and I'll give you an item to help forge some special gear!

name: Drifters: Isle of Lost Souls
flavor: The hunt is the true measure of a man. The culmination of all his actions and desires. Show me your hunting prowess, and take no item into battle with you. I want to see only your wits and your strength!
flavor_zh: The hunt is the true measure of a man. The culmination of all his actions and desires. Show me your hunting prowess, and take no item into battle with you. I want to see only your wits and your strength!

name: Famitsu: Kecha the Scoop!
sub_goal: Wound Kecha Wacha's claws and tail
flavor: After hearing about a rampant Kecha Wacha at the Vertical Slayground, our editing team rushed over to get the deets, only to find ourselves under attack! Help us and we'll give you exclusive weapon tickets!
sub_goal_zh: 破坏奇猿狐的爪与尾巴
flavor_zh: After hearing about a rampant Kecha Wacha at the Vertical Slayground, our editing team rushed over to get the deets, only to find ourselves under attack! Help us and we'll give you exclusive weapon tickets!

name: Dengeki: Top of Old Sparky
flavor: We at Dengeki would like to challenge you to hunt the mystical Kirin at the newly discovered Ruined Pinnacle! Clear our ELECTRIC Quest and we'll give you tickets to really make some sparks fly!
name_zh: 电击･迅雷闪耀下的无人山岭
flavor_zh: We at Dengeki would like to challenge you to hunt the mystical Kirin at the newly discovered Ruined Pinnacle! Clear our ELECTRIC Quest and we'll give you tickets to really make some sparks fly!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Courage
sub_goal: Wound K.Daora's wings and sever its tail
flavor: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of courage, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire armor to match your gallantry.
name_zh: 塞尔达传说･勇气的试炼
sub_goal_zh: 破坏钢龙的翼，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of courage, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire armor to match your gallantry.

name: Into the Maw of Darkness
flavor: Got a little job for ya from the den: a Hyper Zinogre. It's a real tough cookie with a wicked aura, like a Makai Knight. Are you the Golden Knight or aren't ya? C'mon, cut that guy down to size!
flavor_zh: Got a little job for ya from the den: a Hyper Zinogre. It's a real tough cookie with a wicked aura, like a Makai Knight. Are you the Golden Knight or aren't ya? C'mon, cut that guy down to size!

name: Fan Club: Climbing The Ranks
flavor: Greetings, underling! So you think you can slack off, eh? How the blazes are you gonna beat G-rank Quests with that attitude!? Time for a test. Go beat a Hyper Lagiacrus and I might just promote you!
name_zh: MH Fan Club･热血升段考试
sub_goal_zh: 破坏海龙的胸部与背部
flavor_zh: Greetings, underling! So you think you can slack off, eh? How the blazes are you gonna beat G-rank Quests with that attitude!? Time for a test. Go beat a Hyper Lagiacrus and I might just promote you!

name: URGENT: COAL MINERS NEEDED
goal: Deliver 10 pieces of Coal or a Paw Pass Ticket
flavor: -- JOB AVAILABLE -- Delivery of coal from Volcanic Hollow. Job ends once required amount is delivered. Bonus reward for extra items beyond required amount. CAUTION: Harsh conditions. We take no responsibility for any injuries.
goal_zh: 燃石炭缴纳数量达到10个或者缴纳猫车票券
flavor_zh: -- JOB AVAILABLE -- Delivery of coal from Volcanic Hollow. Job ends once required amount is delivered. Bonus reward for extra items beyond required amount. CAUTION: Harsh conditions. We take no responsibility for any injuries.

name: Frozen Free-For-All
goal: Hunt a Zamtrios and a Tetsucabra
flavor: I haven't seen my brother in days. Not since he went to the Frozen Seaway to fish... A fisherman told me he saw him, but he also mentioned a Zamtrios and a Tetsucabra having an earth- shaking fight. That means my brother's somewhere in the middle! Help!
name_zh: 冰海大决斗：变形冰鲨对鬼蛙
goal_zh: 狩猎1头变形冰鲨和1头鬼蛙
flavor_zh: I haven't seen my brother in days. Not since he went to the Frozen Seaway to fish... A fisherman told me he saw him, but he also mentioned a Zamtrios and a Tetsucabra having an earth- shaking fight. That means my brother's somewhere in the middle! Help!

name: Nerscylla Nightmare
flavor: Here at the Slayground today I'm proud to present our Terrible Twosome! One's a Hyper Nerscylla, the other's...also a Hyper Nerscylla! If you're a fan of dark auras and giant creepy-crawlies, then you're gonna love facing these two!
flavor_zh: Here at the Slayground today I'm proud to present our Terrible Twosome! One's a Hyper Nerscylla, the other's...also a Hyper Nerscylla! If you're a fan of dark auras and giant creepy-crawlies, then you're gonna love facing these two!

name: It'll Come Out in the Wash
flavor: Hunter, we've got a stellar lineup for you, with all kinds of abnormal status fun! We've got mud, poison, and my personal favorite: FARTING! Everything to make a hunt really interesting! So...yeah, better pack some Deodorant, eh?
name_zh: 除都除不掉的状态异常！？
flavor_zh: Hunter, we've got a stellar lineup for you, with all kinds of abnormal status fun! We've got mud, poison, and my personal favorite: FARTING! Everything to make a hunt really interesting! So...yeah, better pack some Deodorant, eh?

name: "My Love is Like a Chill Wind...?"
flavor: This amazing girl saved me from being stranded in the Arctic Ridge... Now I need to find her and confess my love for her! Girls like when you do that in the snow, right? We just need some privacy from the monsters, okay? I hope the ring is the right size...
flavor_zh: This amazing girl saved me from being stranded in the Arctic Ridge... Now I need to find her and confess my love for her! Girls like when you do that in the snow, right? We just need some privacy from the monsters, okay? I hope the ring is the right size...

name: A Solid Argument
goal: Hunt a Basarios and a Gravios
flavor: You know, I look at the rocky armor on Basarios and Gravios and I just think, "Man, nature can be so useful!" Gives me ideas for some ultra durable armor, but you'll need to run some field tests for me, i.e. hit the monsters as hard as you can!
flavor_zh: You know, I look at the rocky armor on Basarios and Gravios and I just think, "Man, nature can be so useful!" Gives me ideas for some ultra durable armor, but you'll need to run some field tests for me, i.e. hit the monsters as hard as you can!

name: Glimmers of False Hope
goal: Hunt a Silver Rathalos and a Gold Rathian
flavor: I was doing my nightly round of the Misty Peaks, same as ever, only this time it seemed a whole lot lighter out. Then I looked up -- Hyper wyverns! There's no telling what'll happen if they get to the village! Please, Hunter, stop them!
goal_zh: 狩猎1头银火龙和1头金火龙
flavor_zh: I was doing my nightly round of the Misty Peaks, same as ever, only this time it seemed a whole lot lighter out. Then I looked up -- Hyper wyverns! There's no telling what'll happen if they get to the village! Please, Hunter, stop them!

name: Violence in the Verdure
flavor: We have a situation on our hands concerning a Hyper Astalos in the Verdant Hills. It's only getting more aggressive with time. Could you stop its rampage, Hunter? Else I fear we will have to cordon off the hills entirely...
name_zh: 山林中尽展暴虐极限之物
sub_goal_zh: 破坏电龙的背部与翼爪
flavor_zh: We have a situation on our hands concerning a Hyper Astalos in the Verdant Hills. It's only getting more aggressive with time. Could you stop its rampage, Hunter? Else I fear we will have to cordon off the hills entirely...

name: Paws Off My Fish!
sub_goal: Wound Mizutsune's top fin and sever its tail
flavor: This is unfurgivable! I've been meowsted from my favorite fishing spot by a Mizutsune! My furiend suppawses it's a Hypurr type. People call me hypurractive but that doesn't give me reclaws to be a jerk!
name_zh: 请守护垂钓场的和平喵！
sub_goal_zh: 破坏泡狐龙的背鳍，并切断尾巴
flavor_zh: This is unfurgivable! I've been meowsted from my favorite fishing spot by a Mizutsune! My furiend suppawses it's a Hypurr type. People call me hypurractive but that doesn't give me reclaws to be a jerk!

name: Big, Bad 'n' Woolly
flavor: "i think gamot iz a big meeny and i want it to go fol in a hoal!" My daughter's spelling notwithstanding, she was chased by a Hyper Gammoth when she was out playing and now she's afraid to go out. Can you hunt it so she can feel safer?
flavor_zh: "i think gamot iz a big meeny and i want it to go fol in a hoal!" My daughter's spelling notwithstanding, she was chased by a Hyper Gammoth when she was out playing and now she's afraid to go out. Can you hunt it so she can feel safer?

name: Blade Blazing Brightly Black
flavor: We tried hunting a Glavenus after it made an attack on a nearby colony, but it was so vicious and gave off such a terrible aura that we couldn't even scratch it. That said, there's no way we're letting it hang around any longer. Show us your stuff, Hunter!
name_zh: 燃烧黑色火焰的灼热之刃
sub_goal_zh: 破坏斩龙的头部与背部
flavor_zh: We tried hunting a Glavenus after it made an attack on a nearby colony, but it was so vicious and gave off such a terrible aura that we couldn't even scratch it. That said, there's no way we're letting it hang around any longer. Show us your stuff, Hunter!

name: Forewarned is Four-Horned
flavor: I haven't been able to sleep for fear that the frightful Diablos out there will turn their rage on the people...! Please, won't you teach the two of them some manners? I do so need my beauty sleep!
flavor_zh: I haven't been able to sleep for fear that the frightful Diablos out there will turn their rage on the people...! Please, won't you teach the two of them some manners? I do so need my beauty sleep!

name: Meat is Murder
flavor: I s-s-saw a... No, I c-c-can't! It was at the Ancestral St-t-teppe, a...a D-D-Deviljho! It just...ate the other animals! Nature is the w-w-worst! What kind of circle of l-l-life is this!? I want no p-part in it. And I d-d-don't want that Deviljho to have a p-p-part in it either!
flavor_zh: I s-s-saw a... No, I c-c-can't! It was at the Ancestral St-t-teppe, a...a D-D-Deviljho! It just...ate the other animals! Nature is the w-w-worst! What kind of circle of l-l-life is this!? I want no p-part in it. And I d-d-don't want that Deviljho to have a p-p-part in it either!

name: The Cry of Chaos
flavor: Ahhh, the weeping... The sound lingers in the ears. He has strayed from the path of righteousness... Who will end this cycle? Only in thorough defeat will he be humbled and leave the confusion and chaos of the past behind him.
flavor_zh: Ahhh, the weeping... The sound lingers in the ears. He has strayed from the path of righteousness... Who will end this cycle? Only in thorough defeat will he be humbled and leave the confusion and chaos of the past behind him.

name: Brutal Brachydios
flavor: Our vessel has crashed! We're located on Ingle Isle. A Brachydios was sighted near the crash site and has us cornered. Looks like a Hyper monster. It lifted its glowing red arms and an explosion has cut off all our escape routes. SOS! Mayday!
flavor_zh: Our vessel has crashed! We're located on Ingle Isle. A Brachydios was sighted near the crash site and has us cornered. Looks like a Hyper monster. It lifted its glowing red arms and an explosion has cut off all our escape routes. SOS! Mayday!

name: Bequest Quest
flavor: Ugh... This is it for me. Received a distress call from...the Sanctuary... A Rajang causing trouble... I went to put it down but...ugh...it was just too...strong... There must be a hunter out there...who can finish the job... Tell him I sent you...
flavor_zh: Ugh... This is it for me. Received a distress call from...the Sanctuary... A Rajang causing trouble... I went to put it down but...ugh...it was just too...strong... There must be a hunter out there...who can finish the job... Tell him I sent you...

name: Forget Valstrax, Big Sis is Scarier!
flavor: We're the Justice Alliance! Big Sis told us to go an' deal with Valstrax 'coz it's been terrorizin' people. But BOY OH BOY is he scary! We just turned tail an' ran right outta there. Argh, but Big Sis is gonna be emm ay dee! Someone hunt Valstrax so she won't murder us!
name_zh: 大姐大可比天彗龙更恐怖啊！
flavor_zh: We're the Justice Alliance! Big Sis told us to go an' deal with Valstrax 'coz it's been terrorizin' people. But BOY OH BOY is he scary! We just turned tail an' ran right outta there. Argh, but Big Sis is gonna be emm ay dee! Someone hunt Valstrax so she won't murder us!

name: The Gloom of 1,001 Nights
flavor: A storm of dust   a writhing darkness A ruined fortress      rebuilt Walls     veterans of many battles In the depths  a guarded treasure A dancing golden charm        sand A queen at her spinning wheel    challenge her    a fool, or a hero?
name_zh: 一千零一夜的太古之阁
flavor_zh: A storm of dust   a writhing darkness A ruined fortress      rebuilt Walls     veterans of many battles In the depths  a guarded treasure A dancing golden charm        sand A queen at her spinning wheel    challenge her    a fool, or a hero?

name: A Terrible Light
flavor: Light which envelops the world is not always a light which brightens the world. The Shagaru Magala that has been sighted at the Sanctuary is a calamitous presence indeed. Take up arms, Hunter, and douse its terrible light!
flavor_zh: Light which envelops the world is not always a light which brightens the world. The Shagaru Magala that has been sighted at the Sanctuary is a calamitous presence indeed. Take up arms, Hunter, and douse its terrible light!

name: Legitimate Soaratorium Quest
flavor: Ah. Yes. Hello, person whom I definitely know and have seen before. It's me, your good friend the Soaratorium Gal. This next Quest is a totally legitimate Quest that I happened to forget about until now and which you have to keep a total secret, OK? Oh my gosh. Totes.
flavor_zh: Ah. Yes. Hello, person whom I definitely know and have seen before. It's me, your good friend the Soaratorium Gal. This next Quest is a totally legitimate Quest that I happened to forget about until now and which you have to keep a total secret, OK? Oh my gosh. Totes.

name: Lord of the Volcanic Hollow
flavor: Pursued by Teostra [STOP] Awaiting rescue behind big rock [STOP] Holding breath [STOP] Hoping Teostra doesn't see me [STOP] Getting closer [STOP] I think it saw me [MESSAGE ENDS ABRUPTLY]
flavor_zh: Pursued by Teostra [STOP] Awaiting rescue behind big rock [STOP] Holding breath [STOP] Hoping Teostra doesn't see me [STOP] Getting closer [STOP] I think it saw me [MESSAGE ENDS ABRUPTLY]

name: Welcome Back To Hell
flavor: You're not going to like this, but I have an urgent Wycademy report saying another Nakarkos has reared its ugly heads in Wyvern's End. Our man on the ground says this one's the worst that's ever been recorded!
flavor_zh: You're not going to like this, but I have an urgent Wycademy report saying another Nakarkos has reared its ugly heads in Wyvern's End. Our man on the ground says this one's the worst that's ever been recorded!

name: Monster on a Crusade
flavor: Akantor is waging war against me to steal my birthright! I'm secretly a prince, you see -- the son of the gods of light and darkness! I can hear his call... Could you fight in my stead? I can use my holy powers to help you from afar...
flavor_zh: Akantor is waging war against me to steal my birthright! I'm secretly a prince, you see -- the son of the gods of light and darkness! I can hear his call... Could you fight in my stead? I can use my holy powers to help you from afar...

name: Ukanlos-Made Global Cooling
flavor: When the Ukanlos appears, all the warmth bleeds from the world and life withers in the cold. Now we have to face not only an avalanche, but Ukanlos as well. Its every step cracks mountains, blows snowy gales. At this rate it'll freeze the whole world! Help!
flavor_zh: When the Ukanlos appears, all the warmth bleeds from the world and life withers in the cold. Now we have to face not only an avalanche, but Ukanlos as well. Its every step cracks mountains, blows snowy gales. At this rate it'll freeze the whole world! Help!

name: Lao-Shan Lung Time No See
goal: Slay a Lao-Shan Lung or repel it
flavor: We've got ourselves an emergency! A Lao-Shan Lung is approaching as we speak! I can't believe this is happening again! We're managing to hold him off, but we can't last much longer, and the village is in danger! Urgently requesting backup! Like, right now!
flavor_zh: We've got ourselves an emergency! A Lao-Shan Lung is approaching as we speak! I can't believe this is happening again! We're managing to hold him off, but we can't last much longer, and the village is in danger! Urgently requesting backup! Like, right now!

name: Alatreon and Alack
flavor: The embodiment of light and darkness. Clad in armor that defies the heavens, it looses white lightning and black fire. Don't succumb to the disasters it unleashes. Duck and weave. Pursue. Attack. Left unchecked, it will cause a darkness lasting till the end of time.
flavor_zh: The embodiment of light and darkness. Clad in armor that defies the heavens, it looses white lightning and black fire. Don't succumb to the disasters it unleashes. Duck and weave. Pursue. Attack. Left unchecked, it will cause a darkness lasting till the end of time.

name: End of a Dark History
flavor: When I was a child, I heard stories about an empire that suffered a tragic fate. Now, everything is starting to happen as I was told. Please, stop this calamity from bringing ruin upon us all! This is not how our story ends!
flavor_zh: When I was a child, I heard stories about an empire that suffered a tragic fate. Now, everything is starting to happen as I was told. Please, stop this calamity from bringing ruin upon us all! This is not how our story ends!

name: To Slay a Legend
flavor: Fate may be written in the stars, but it is our armor and our own merits that become us. The wyvern of legend stands before you. But fear not, for the hunters of old watch over you now. Stand proud, Hunter; this is your hour.
flavor_zh: Fate may be written in the stars, but it is our armor and our own merits that become us. The wyvern of legend stands before you. But fear not, for the hunters of old watch over you now. Stand proud, Hunter; this is your hour.

name: Defy the Prophecy
flavor: When the Great Dread emerged from the depths of the world, none could hope to oppose it. None, that is, until the Bravest of Hearts appeared. Despair turned to hope, and with it, the chance to turn the tides. Hunter, the glory is all yours.
flavor_zh: When the Great Dread emerged from the depths of the world, none could hope to oppose it. None, that is, until the Bravest of Hearts appeared. Despair turned to hope, and with it, the chance to turn the tides. Hunter, the glory is all yours.

name: Monster Hunter Channel I
flavor: The hunter's spirit will never die! Howdy, folks! Today with me in the Arena, we have a very special guest ready to be pitted against our fang-tacular menagerie! Are you excited yet? I know I am! Okay, let's get this show on the road!
flavor_zh: The hunter's spirit will never die! Howdy, folks! Today with me in the Arena, we have a very special guest ready to be pitted against our fang-tacular menagerie! Are you excited yet? I know I am! Okay, let's get this show on the road!

name: Monster Hunter Channel II
flavor: The hunter's spirit will never die! Howdy, folks! I've got a hunch today's episode is going to be pretty darn exciting! This time our intrepid hunter will be up against some real legends! I don't know about you, but I am STOKED for this! Let's. Get. HUNTING!
flavor_zh: The hunter's spirit will never die! Howdy, folks! I've got a hunch today's episode is going to be pretty darn exciting! This time our intrepid hunter will be up against some real legends! I don't know about you, but I am STOKED for this! Let's. Get. HUNTING!

name: Event: Slay a Mizutsune
flavor: Today you face a Mizutsune. Don't let its foam and bubbles fool you. That thing will rip your face right off. Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Lance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: Today you face a Mizutsune. Don't let its foam and bubbles fool you. That thing will rip your face right off. Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Lance, Light Bowgun

name: Event: Slay a Glavenus
flavor: I have trained you to become a hardened warrior. Today you prove yourself against the mighty Glavenus! Weapons: Great Sword, Insect Glaive, Hammer, Switch Axe, Bow
flavor_zh: I have trained you to become a hardened warrior. Today you prove yourself against the mighty Glavenus! Weapons: Great Sword, Insect Glaive, Hammer, Switch Axe, Bow

name: Event: Slay a Gammoth
flavor: Today, you will face a Gammoth. It will stomp you into next week if you're not careful. I will too if you don't defeat it! Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: Today, you will face a Gammoth. It will stomp you into next week if you're not careful. I will too if you don't defeat it! Weapons: Long Sword, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

name: Event: Slay an Astalos
flavor: The Astalos is a formidable opponent. It will stop at nothing to achieve its goal of ripping you a new one! Weapons: Sword & Shield, Lance, Charge Blade, Insect Glaive, Bow
flavor_zh: The Astalos is a formidable opponent. It will stop at nothing to achieve its goal of ripping you a new one! Weapons: Sword & Shield, Lance, Charge Blade, Insect Glaive, Bow

name: Event: Slay a Lagiacrus
flavor: Did you get lost on the way to daycare? Am I here to take care of you? No? GOOD! Now go take out that Lagi! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: Did you get lost on the way to daycare? Am I here to take care of you? No? GOOD! Now go take out that Lagi! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

name: Event: Hunt-a-thon 1
flavor: Your path to glory begins with a Tigrex, a Zinogre, and a Nargacuga. Honor our beloved Arena with your victory! Weapons: Great Sword, Lance, Charge Blade, Insect Glaive, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: Your path to glory begins with a Tigrex, a Zinogre, and a Nargacuga. Honor our beloved Arena with your victory! Weapons: Great Sword, Lance, Charge Blade, Insect Glaive, Light Bowgun

name: Event: Hunt-a-thon 2
flavor: Today, you will fight a Rajang and a Deviljho. You may find Glory, or you may draw your last breath. Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Bow
flavor_zh: Today, you will fight a Rajang and a Deviljho. You may find Glory, or you may draw your last breath. Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Switch Axe, Bow

name: Event: Hunt-a-thon 3
flavor: Glory is at hand, Greenhorn! It is yours if you slay a Gammoth, an Astalos, a Mizutsune, and a Glavenus! Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Gunlance, Charge Blade, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: Glory is at hand, Greenhorn! It is yours if you slay a Gammoth, an Astalos, a Mizutsune, and a Glavenus! Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Gunlance, Charge Blade, Heavy Bowgun

name: Event: Slay a Zinogre
flavor: This Challenge Quest requires you to slay a Zinogre. Do not underestimate this handsome beast's nimble movements. Weapons: Long Sword, Lance, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: This Challenge Quest requires you to slay a Zinogre. Do not underestimate this handsome beast's nimble movements. Weapons: Long Sword, Lance, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Light Bowgun

name: Event: Slay a Gore Magala
flavor: The Gore Magala's Frenzy virus spreads like the perfume of a beautiful woman. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Charge Blade, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: The Gore Magala's Frenzy virus spreads like the perfume of a beautiful woman. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Charge Blade, Light Bowgun

name: Event: Slay a Tigrex
flavor: There is a certain grace to the Tigrex's brutality. Try not to get caught up in its majesty. Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Bow, Gunlance
flavor_zh: There is a certain grace to the Tigrex's brutality. Try not to get caught up in its majesty. Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Bow, Gunlance

name: Event: Slay a Rathalos
flavor: A sight to behold to witness a Rathalos dance across the sky... In this Challenge Quest, I hope your form can compete. Weapons: Great Sword, Charge Blade, Switch Axe, Hunting Horn, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: A sight to behold to witness a Rathalos dance across the sky... In this Challenge Quest, I hope your form can compete. Weapons: Great Sword, Charge Blade, Switch Axe, Hunting Horn, Heavy Bowgun

name: Event: Slay a Nargacuga
flavor: This is a Challenge Quest to slay a Nargacuga. Watch its movements and strike with conviction, or this will be our last conversation. Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hammer, Lance, Bow
flavor_zh: This is a Challenge Quest to slay a Nargacuga. Watch its movements and strike with conviction, or this will be our last conversation. Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hammer, Lance, Bow

name: Event: Hunt-a-thon 4
flavor: Welcome to the Arena. We've prepared four monsters for you today, with the elements of Ice, Water, Fire, & Thunder. Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: Welcome to the Arena. We've prepared four monsters for you today, with the elements of Ice, Water, Fire, & Thunder. Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Hunting Horn, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Dreadqueen
flavor: Welcome to the Arena! Today we've got a real treat in store for you. A dread-treat! A treat with a sting in the tail! Literally! Seriously, watch out for her tail. It's pretty venomous. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: Welcome to the Arena! Today we've got a real treat in store for you. A dread-treat! A treat with a sting in the tail! Literally! Seriously, watch out for her tail. It's pretty venomous. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Hammer, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Thunderlord
flavor: Welcome to the Thunderlord! Haha, I've always wanted to say that. He won't welcome you. He'll just shock you and knock you out like that! So don't get too close! He's just not touchy-feely. Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow
flavor_zh: Welcome to the Thunderlord! Haha, I've always wanted to say that. He won't welcome you. He'll just shock you and knock you out like that! So don't get too close! He's just not touchy-feely. Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow

name: XX Trials: Silverwind
flavor: I hope you've done your stretches, because your foe today is a strapping Silverwind Nargacuga who's spoiling for a fight! Watch his tailsword, he's pretty handy with it! Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Charge Blade, Lance, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: I hope you've done your stretches, because your foe today is a strapping Silverwind Nargacuga who's spoiling for a fight! Watch his tailsword, he's pretty handy with it! Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Charge Blade, Lance, Heavy Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Dreadking
flavor: Hey, do you think it's regicide if you slay a Dreadking Rathalos? I sure hope not, because I've been saving this one for you! We'll be watching this fight with anxiety-- I mean anticipation! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: Hey, do you think it's regicide if you slay a Dreadking Rathalos? I sure hope not, because I've been saving this one for you! We'll be watching this fight with anxiety-- I mean anticipation! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Insect Glaive, Heavy Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Grimclaw
flavor: Well, it's Grimclaw past Tigrex o' clock here in the Arena, and that means it's high time you were here! Try not to get him mad! He's just a big, heavily-armed, dragon-shaped softy deep down. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Hammer, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Bow
flavor_zh: Well, it's Grimclaw past Tigrex o' clock here in the Arena, and that means it's high time you were here! Try not to get him mad! He's just a big, heavily-armed, dragon-shaped softy deep down. Weapons: Sword & Shield, Hammer, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Bow

name: XX Trials: Gravios
flavor: Think you're good enough to go toe to toe with a Gravios, Hunter? Tough nut to crack with those rock-hard scales. Tell me how that works out for ya! Weapons: Sword & Shield, Charge Blade, Hunting Horn, Insect Glaive, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: 未知

name: XX Trials: Elderfrost
flavor: You like the cold, Hunter? Well, you're in for a treat, 'cause old Elderfrost here's gonna bring along the next ice age! But what's a little wind and snow when you're breaking a sweat? Weapons: Great Sword, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: You like the cold, Hunter? Well, you're in for a treat, 'cause old Elderfrost here's gonna bring along the next ice age! But what's a little wind and snow when you're breaking a sweat? Weapons: Great Sword, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Hunt-a-thon I
flavor: A Boltreaver and a Soulseer? Can't say I can see that going well for you. But you seem to have a good head on your shoulders, so I reckon we'll soon see, won't we? Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: A Boltreaver and a Soulseer? Can't say I can see that going well for you. But you seem to have a good head on your shoulders, so I reckon we'll soon see, won't we? Weapons: Great Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Hunt-a-thon II
flavor: A Hellblade and a Bloodbath, AND a Valstrax to top it all off? Hunter, if this is some idea of a joke, then I... No? Hah. Struggling against impossible odds, is it? I like your style! Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Lance, Bow
flavor_zh: A Hellblade and a Bloodbath, AND a Valstrax to top it all off? Hunter, if this is some idea of a joke, then I... No? Hah. Struggling against impossible odds, is it? I like your style! Weapons: Long Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Lance, Bow

name: XX Trials: Stonefist
flavor: For this Stonefist Hermitaur fight, you get extra brownie points for style. Yes, that rock-hard shell is going to need some elegant smashing... Weapons: Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Charge Blade, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: For this Stonefist Hermitaur fight, you get extra brownie points for style. Yes, that rock-hard shell is going to need some elegant smashing... Weapons: Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Charge Blade, Gunlance, Heavy Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Drilltusk
flavor: The challenge this time is to dispatch a Drilltusk Tetsucabra with style and grace. He may be tough and powerful, but you'd be surprised what a little charm and precision can do! Weapons: Dual Blades, Hammer, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow
flavor_zh: The challenge this time is to dispatch a Drilltusk Tetsucabra with style and grace. He may be tough and powerful, but you'd be surprised what a little charm and precision can do! Weapons: Dual Blades, Hammer, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow

name: XX Trials: Redhelm
flavor: It's time to prove you can slay a Redhelm Arzuros with panache. Don't merely dodge, but dance away from those claws! Plié, plié, grand jeté! Weapons: Great Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Heavy Bowgun
flavor_zh: It's time to prove you can slay a Redhelm Arzuros with panache. Don't merely dodge, but dance away from those claws! Plié, plié, grand jeté! Weapons: Great Sword, Sword & Shield, Hunting Horn, Charge Blade, Heavy Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Deadeye
flavor: Asymmetry is very much in vogue right now, so your challenge is to show us a battle with a Deadeye that's also a feast for the...living eyes? Anyway, make it spectacular is what I'm saying. Weapons: Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer, Lance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: Asymmetry is very much in vogue right now, so your challenge is to show us a battle with a Deadeye that's also a feast for the...living eyes? Anyway, make it spectacular is what I'm saying. Weapons: Great Sword, Long Sword, Hammer, Lance, Light Bowgun

name: XX Trials: Snowbaron
flavor: Time to take a challenge worthy of the Snowbaron Lagombi's noble name and fight it with flair! Take your cue from the charming dance of the Lagombi in the snow, and crush it with grace! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow
flavor_zh: Time to take a challenge worthy of the Snowbaron Lagombi's noble name and fight it with flair! Take your cue from the charming dance of the Lagombi in the snow, and crush it with grace! Weapons: Long Sword, Dual Blades, Switch Axe, Insect Glaive, Bow

name: XX Trials: Hunt-a-thon III
flavor: This will be the utmost test of your style. A graceful Nightcloak Malfestio and an angry, though elegant, Brachydios? I'm sure you can style this one out, Hunter. Weapons: Great Sword, Hammer, Lance, Gunlance, Light Bowgun
flavor_zh: This will be the utmost test of your style. A graceful Nightcloak Malfestio and an angry, though elegant, Brachydios? I'm sure you can style this one out, Hunter. Weapons: Great Sword, Hammer, Lance, Gunlance, Light Bowgun

name: CoroCoro: Lost in the Swamp
goal: Slay a total of 20 Ceanataurs and Iopreys
flavor: I came here with Zombie to try and collect some insects! Wow! This place is huge! There're probably all kinds of bugs to find! ...Zombie? Where'd you go? I-It's kinda scary all alone... Help!
name_zh: 可乐可乐･误入了沼泽哦
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20头红速龙或镰蟹
flavor_zh: I came here with Zombie to try and collect some insects! Wow! This place is huge! There're probably all kinds of bugs to find! ...Zombie? Where'd you go? I-It's kinda scary all alone... Help!

name: The King of Lynians!
goal: Defeat a total of 20 Felynes and Melynxes
flavor: I've prepared a tournament to decide who's the REAL King of Lynians! Knock out the other Felyne and Melynx contenders to claim the title of champ, AND an item that'll let you make some special Palico gear!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20只艾露猫或梅拉露
flavor_zh: I've prepared a tournament to decide who's the REAL King of Lynians! Knock out the other Felyne and Melynx contenders to claim the title of champ, AND an item that'll let you make some special Palico gear!

name: Jump: Crimson Strongmen
flavor: I know about powerful people in small packages. I would like to ask your help hunting two red monsters running wild near the Volcano. In return, I've prepared an item that will let you make some nice pirate gear.
flavor_zh: I know about powerful people in small packages. I would like to ask your help hunting two red monsters running wild near the Volcano. In return, I've prepared an item that will let you make some nice pirate gear.

name: Initiate: Operation Moofah
flavor: ENERGY LEVELS...FALLING. WITHOUT...MONEY...PARTS ARE INOPERABLE. COLLECT MOOFAH FUR AND I COULD... SELL IT FOR LOTS OF MONEY. HELP ME, PROWLER. YOU ARE MY ONLY HOPE.
flavor_zh: ENERGY LEVELS...FALLING. WITHOUT...MONEY...PARTS ARE INOPERABLE. COLLECT MOOFAH FUR AND I COULD... SELL IT FOR LOTS OF MONEY. HELP ME, PROWLER. YOU ARE MY ONLY HOPE.

name: The Uniqlo Avant-garde
goal: Slay a total of 20 Vespoids and Bnahabras
flavor: What Felynes need is a great look FOR Felynes, BY Felynes, and I've got just the thing! I'll need your help gathering the materials, but just think how snazzy you'll look in my design!
goal_zh: 合计讨伐20只巨蜂或飞甲虫
flavor_zh: What Felynes need is a great look FOR Felynes, BY Felynes, and I've got just the thing! I'll need your help gathering the materials, but just think how snazzy you'll look in my design!

name: Nakayoshi: Silver Crystal
flavor: I've just heard that the Ore we've been looking for is in a cave in the Marshlands! Say you'll help verify the rumor! If you do, I'll reward you with an item you can use to forge special Palico gear!
flavor_zh: I've just heard that the Ore we've been looking for is in a cave in the Marshlands! Say you'll help verify the rumor! If you do, I'll reward you with an item you can use to forge special Palico gear!

name: CoroCoro: Big Bad Bugs
flavor: I can teach you how to protect yourself from dangerous bugs. Let's practice using those big ones over there! Just use your death ray to take 'em out! Wha!? You Prowlers don't have a death ray!?
flavor_zh: I can teach you how to protect yourself from dangerous bugs. Let's practice using those big ones over there! Just use your death ray to take 'em out! Wha!? You Prowlers don't have a death ray!?

name: A Hero's Return
flavor: There's a monster out there running wild and keeping me from getting anything done! I want you to go and smash its fangs in! If you help me out, I'll give you an item to make some great new Palico gear!
flavor_zh: There's a monster out there running wild and keeping me from getting anything done! I want you to go and smash its fangs in! If you help me out, I'll give you an item to make some great new Palico gear!

name: Mario: The White Donkey Kong?
flavor: We've got trouble! There's a Donkey Kong doppelganger on the loose and it just stole my precious mushroom! If you help me out, I'll reward you with an item that'll enable you to make the perfect gear!
flavor_zh: We've got trouble! There's a Donkey Kong doppelganger on the loose and it just stole my precious mushroom! If you help me out, I'll reward you with an item that'll enable you to make the perfect gear!

name: Animal Crossing: Picnic Day
flavor: It's a great day for a picnic! Go and visit a bunch of places to get us some goodies! When you get back, I'll reward you with an item that can be used to make special Palico gear.
flavor_zh: It's a great day for a picnic! Go and visit a bunch of places to get us some goodies! When you get back, I'll reward you with an item that can be used to make special Palico gear.

name: SF: Ultimate Entrance Exam
flavor: Hm... Are you here to join us? In that case, let's get the exam started! You must take on my most dedicated disciples! If you can beat them, I just might let you become my newest student!
flavor_zh: Hm... Are you here to join us? In that case, let's get the exam started! You must take on my most dedicated disciples! If you can beat them, I just might let you become my newest student!

name: Fan Club: Arena Action
flavor: Oh my gorsh! I'm finally a MH Fan Club member! I'm schuper pumped! I can't believe I get to fight four Fanged Beasts right off the bat! If we beat 'em we'll be able to make some schuper cute Palico gear!
name_zh: MH Fan Club･斗技场连续特训！
flavor_zh: Oh my gorsh! I'm finally a MH Fan Club member! I'm schuper pumped! I can't believe I get to fight four Fanged Beasts right off the bat! If we beat 'em we'll be able to make some schuper cute Palico gear!

name: Making the Cut
flavor: Argh! Every time I fight a Rathian, I can't cut off her tail! She's always doing that flippy thing and then I get poisoned. Can you help a girl out and show me how it's done?
name_zh: 拜托！切断雌火龙的尾巴
flavor_zh: Argh! Every time I fight a Rathian, I can't cut off her tail! She's always doing that flippy thing and then I get poisoned. Can you help a girl out and show me how it's done?

name: Catch a Rathalos by the Tail
flavor: Yo, what up, brah! Still bringin' the pain to the monster game? You know I have, but my lil' breaker-in-trainin' can't seem to get the hang of cuttin' off tails. Drops some science on her, wouldja?
flavor_zh: Yo, what up, brah! Still bringin' the pain to the monster game? You know I have, but my lil' breaker-in-trainin' can't seem to get the hang of cuttin' off tails. Drops some science on her, wouldja?

name: Too Hot to Handle
flavor: I have a lil' purroblem, Prowler. This Powderstone is too hot for me to get my paws on. I could really use a Palico with heat- resistant Palico Skills, or one who can quickly recover after taking damage.
flavor_zh: I have a lil' purroblem, Prowler. This Powderstone is too hot for me to get my paws on. I could really use a Palico with heat- resistant Palico Skills, or one who can quickly recover after taking damage.

name: Case Closed: Monster Files
flavor: Help! There's a total hullaballoo going off at the Arena, and my little friends are trapped! I'm told only a Prowler can get the job done. I'll be sure to provide a reward!
name_zh: 名侦探柯南･连续狩猎案件！
flavor_zh: Help! There's a total hullaballoo going off at the Arena, and my little friends are trapped! I'm told only a Prowler can get the job done. I'll be sure to provide a reward!

name: Baki: Deadly Claws
flavor: Prowler! Your opponent this time is the deadly Glavenus. If you manage to take the tail of that foul fiend, then I will grant you the title of Kaioh! After all... what do I care!
flavor_zh: Prowler! Your opponent this time is the deadly Glavenus. If you manage to take the tail of that foul fiend, then I will grant you the title of Kaioh! After all... what do I care!

name: WORST: Skull Motif
flavor: You got what it takes to step up to a Lagombi? Yeah? How about two of 'em? Get it done, and I'll give you a little memento of someone I know you look up to.
flavor_zh: You got what it takes to step up to a Lagombi? Yeah? How about two of 'em? Get it done, and I'll give you a little memento of someone I know you look up to.

name: CoroCoro: Fart of Darkness
flavor: Hey, you! Will you help out an old geezer? I need you to hunt a monster with dangerous farts! You can hack a few farts, right? Burn 'em up with a death ray or somethin'!
name_zh: 可乐可乐･放出危险臭屁的野兽
flavor_zh: Hey, you! Will you help out an old geezer? I need you to hunt a monster with dangerous farts! You can hack a few farts, right? Burn 'em up with a death ray or somethin'!

name: Turnabout Takedown
flavor: Young Prowler! I have two Giadromes in the Arena who both say they're innocent, but this court sees no reason to further prolong the trial. Both defendants are... G U I L T Y
name_zh: 逆转裁判･斗技场中的法庭之战
flavor_zh: Young Prowler! I have two Giadromes in the Arena who both say they're innocent, but this court sees no reason to further prolong the trial. Both defendants are... G U I L T Y

name: Capcom: Prowler's Spirit
flavor: Ah, nothing like making pals with a monster you're hunting! Usually. This time I wanted to get pally with a Gravios, but something seems odd. It's got this hatchling or something? Can you go investigate?
flavor_zh: Ah, nothing like making pals with a monster you're hunting! Usually. This time I wanted to get pally with a Gravios, but something seems odd. It's got this hatchling or something? Can you go investigate?

name: The Legend of Zelda: Wisdom
flavor: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of wisdom, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire Palico equipment to further your knowledge.
name_zh: 塞尔达传说･智慧的试炼
flavor_zh: Adventurer, you have done well to reach this place. If you pass my trial of wisdom, I shall bestow upon you the means to acquire Palico equipment to further your knowledge.

name: Event: Slay a Volvidon
flavor: Today, Prowler, you're up against a Volvidon. Come back victorious or don't come back! That's an order! Support: Charisma, Protection Healing, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: Today, Prowler, you're up against a Volvidon. Come back victorious or don't come back! That's an order! Support: Charisma, Protection Healing, Bombing, Gathering

name: Event: Slay a Royal Ludroth
flavor: The Royal Ludroth is a vicious creature with a sponge-like mane. Be careful or I'll need it to mop up what's left of you. Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing
flavor_zh: The Royal Ludroth is a vicious creature with a sponge-like mane. Be careful or I'll need it to mop up what's left of you. Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing

name: Event: Slay a Lagombi
flavor: What'll it be today, Prowler? Glory for our beloved Arena or monster chow? Get out there and slay that Lagombi! That's an order! Support: Protection, Bombing, Charisma, Fighting, Gathering
flavor_zh: What'll it be today, Prowler? Glory for our beloved Arena or monster chow? Get out there and slay that Lagombi! That's an order! Support: Protection, Bombing, Charisma, Fighting, Gathering

name: Event: Slay a Yian Kut-Ku
flavor: Prowler! Your chance at glory is at hand. Make our beloved Arena proud by slaying a Yian Kut-Ku. Hooooah! Support: Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: Prowler! Your chance at glory is at hand. Make our beloved Arena proud by slaying a Yian Kut-Ku. Hooooah! Support: Fighting, Protection, Healing, Bombing, Gathering

name: Event: Slay an Arzuros
flavor: Ten-hut, Prowler! Today, you'll be facing an Arzuros. Under- estimate it and you'll be in a world of hurt! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: Ten-hut, Prowler! Today, you'll be facing an Arzuros. Under- estimate it and you'll be in a world of hurt! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Bombing, Gathering

name: Event: Hunt-a-thon 5
flavor: True Prowlers test themselves in a Hunt-a-thon! This time, you'll face a Yian Kut-Ku, a Velocidrome, and an Arzuros! Make us proud! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Gathering
flavor_zh: True Prowlers test themselves in a Hunt-a-thon! This time, you'll face a Yian Kut-Ku, a Velocidrome, and an Arzuros! Make us proud! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Gathering

name: XX Trials: Rathalos
flavor: Good to see you back in the ring, Prowler! Now, let's see if a bout with the King of the Skies won't put some meat on those scrawny bones! Support: Charisma, Assisting, Healing, Bombing, Gathering
flavor_zh: Good to see you back in the ring, Prowler! Now, let's see if a bout with the King of the Skies won't put some meat on those scrawny bones! Support: Charisma, Assisting, Healing, Bombing, Gathering

name: XX Trials: Tigrex
flavor: Well, well, well. Looks like the lil' Greenhorn's all ready to wrestle a Tigrex! Just be quick on your toes or things're gonna go pancake-shaped! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Beast
flavor_zh: Well, well, well. Looks like the lil' Greenhorn's all ready to wrestle a Tigrex! Just be quick on your toes or things're gonna go pancake-shaped! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Beast

name: XX Trials: Nargacuga
flavor: So, today you're up against a Nargacuga. You'll need to keep those shiny peepers peeled since they're fast critters, but I reckon you're faster on your paws, so hup to it! Support: Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast
flavor_zh: So, today you're up against a Nargacuga. You'll need to keep those shiny peepers peeled since they're fast critters, but I reckon you're faster on your paws, so hup to it! Support: Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Bombing, Beast

name: XX Trials: Zinogre
flavor: Felyne, it's time for you to fight a Zinogre! It builds up an electric charge when it howls, so prick those ears up, you hear? Support: Fighting, Assisting, Healing, Bombing, Beast
flavor_zh: Felyne, it's time for you to fight a Zinogre! It builds up an electric charge when it howls, so prick those ears up, you hear? Support: Fighting, Assisting, Healing, Bombing, Beast

name: XX Trials: Brachydios
flavor: The gunk on a Brachydios's arms is bad news. Don't ask me what it is. Just don't touch it, or else... BOOM! Say g'night, Prowler! Support: Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Gathering, Beast
flavor_zh: The gunk on a Brachydios's arms is bad news. Don't ask me what it is. Just don't touch it, or else... BOOM! Say g'night, Prowler! Support: Fighting, Protection, Assisting, Gathering, Beast

name: XX Trials: Hunt-a-thon IV
flavor: Greenhorn, you've really come along in leaps and bounds. But now comes your greatest test: Take on a Great Maccao, a Malfestio, and a Glavenus, and I might just be impressed! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Beast
flavor_zh: Greenhorn, you've really come along in leaps and bounds. But now comes your greatest test: Take on a Great Maccao, a Malfestio, and a Glavenus, and I might just be impressed! Support: Charisma, Fighting, Protection, Healing, Beast
